name: EulerFiniteGrades.bilinear_evaluate
statement:
theorem bilinear_evaluate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] W →ₗ[ℝ] Q)
    (u : ℕ → V) (v : ℕ → W) :
    B (evaluate M κ u) (evaluate M κ v) = evaluate (2*M) κ (convolution M B u v)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_above
statement:
theorem convolution_above (M n : ℕ) (hn : 2*M < n)
    (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] W →ₗ[ℝ] Q) (u : ℕ → V) (v : ℕ → W) :
    convolution M B u v n = 0

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_zero
statement:
theorem convolution_zero (M : ℕ) (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] W →ₗ[ℝ] Q)
    (u : ℕ → V) (v : ℕ → W) (hu : u 0 = 0) : convolution M B u v 0 = 0

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_add
statement:
theorem evaluate_add (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u v : ℕ → V) :
    evaluate M κ (fun n => u n+v n) = evaluate M κ u+evaluate M κ v

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_eq_tail
statement:
theorem evaluate_eq_tail (M K : ℕ) (hK : K ≤ M+1) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → V)
    (hzero : ∀ n < K, u n = 0) :
    evaluate M κ u = ∑ n ∈ Ico K (M+1), κ^n • u n

name: EulerFiniteGrades.inverse_evaluate
statement:
theorem inverse_evaluate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (u : ℕ → V) (hu : u 0=0) :
    κ⁻¹ • evaluate M κ u = ∑ n ∈ range M, κ^n • u (n+1)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.map_evaluate
statement:
theorem map_evaluate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (u : ℕ → V) :
    L (evaluate M κ u) = evaluate M κ (fun n => L (u n))

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_extend
statement:
theorem evaluate_extend (M N : ℕ) (hMN : M ≤ N) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → V)
    (hu : ∀ n, M < n → u n=0) : evaluate N κ u = evaluate M κ u

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_truncate
statement:
theorem evaluate_truncate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → V) :
    evaluate M κ (truncate M u) = evaluate M κ u

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_truncate_extend
statement:
theorem evaluate_truncate_extend (M N : ℕ) (hMN : M ≤ N) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → V) :
    evaluate N κ (truncate M u) = evaluate M κ u

name: EulerFiniteGrades.inverse_evaluate_shiftDown
statement:
theorem inverse_evaluate_shiftDown (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (u : ℕ → V) (hu : u 0=0) :
    κ⁻¹ • evaluate M κ u = evaluate M κ (shiftDown M u)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.inverse_evaluate_shiftDown_extend
statement:
theorem inverse_evaluate_shiftDown_extend (M N : ℕ) (hMN : M ≤ N)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (u : ℕ → V) (hu : u 0=0) :
    κ⁻¹ • evaluate M κ u = evaluate N κ (shiftDown M u)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.shiftDown_above
statement: theorem shiftDown_above (M n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → V) (hn : M ≤ n) : shiftDown M u n = 0

name: EulerFiniteGrades.truncate_of_gt
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncate_of_gt (M n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → V) (hn : M < n) :
    truncate M u n = 0

name: EulerFiniteGrades.truncate_of_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncate_of_le (M n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → V) (hn : n ≤ M) :
    truncate M u n = u n

name: EulerFiniteGrades.assemble_above
statement:
theorem assemble_above (M n : ℕ) (hn : M+1 < n) (u c : ℕ → V) :
    assemble M u c n = 0

name: EulerFiniteGrades.assemble_interior
statement:
theorem assemble_interior (M n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hMn : n ≤ M) (u c : ℕ → V) :
    assemble M u c n = u n+c (n-1)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.assemble_last
statement:
theorem assemble_last (M : ℕ) (u c : ℕ → V) :
    assemble M u c (M+1) = c M

name: EulerFiniteGrades.assemble_zero
statement:
theorem assemble_zero (M : ℕ) (u c : ℕ → V) (hu : u 0=0) :
    assemble M u c 0 = 0

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_assemble
statement:
theorem evaluate_assemble (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u c : ℕ → V) :
    evaluate (M+1) κ (assemble M u c) = evaluate M κ u + κ • evaluate M κ c

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_assemble_from_one
statement:
theorem evaluate_assemble_from_one (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u c : ℕ → V)
    (hu : u 0=0) (hc : c 0=0) :
    evaluate (M+1) κ (assemble M u c) =
      ∑ i ∈ range M, (κ^(i+1) • u (i+1) + κ^(i+2) • c (i+1))

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_from_one
statement:
theorem evaluate_from_one (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → V) (hu : u 0=0) :
    evaluate M κ u = ∑ i ∈ range M, κ^(i+1) • u (i+1)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.evaluate_shiftUp
statement:
theorem evaluate_shiftUp (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → V) :
    evaluate (M+1) κ (shiftUp M u) = κ • evaluate M κ u

name: EulerFiniteGrades.bounded_pairs_eq_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem bounded_pairs_eq_antidiagonal (M n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ M) :
    ((range (M+1)) ×ˢ (range (M+1))).filter (fun ij => ij.1+ij.2=n) = antidiagonal n

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_congr_below
statement:
theorem convolution_congr_below (M n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ M)
    (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] W →ₗ[ℝ] Q) (u u' : ℕ → V) (v v' : ℕ → W)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ n, u i=u' i) (hv : ∀ i ≤ n, v i=v' i) :
    convolution M B u v n = convolution M B u' v' n

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_eq_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem convolution_eq_antidiagonal (M n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ M)
    (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] W →ₗ[ℝ] Q) (u : ℕ → V) (v : ℕ → W) :
    convolution M B u v n = ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, B (u ij.1) (v ij.2)

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_eq_range
statement:
theorem convolution_eq_range (M n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ M)
    (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] W →ₗ[ℝ] Q) (u : ℕ → V) (v : ℕ → W) :
    convolution M B u v n = ∑ i ∈ range (n+1), B (u i) (v (n-i))

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_next_delta
statement:
theorem convolution_next_delta (M p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hMp : p+1 ≤ M)
    (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (u u' : ℕ → V) (δ : V) (hu0 : u 0=0)
    (hu : ∀ i < p, u' i=u i) (hδ : u' p=u p+δ) :
    convolution M B u' u' (p+1) = convolution M B u u (p+1) +
      B δ (u 1) + B (u 1) δ

name: EulerFiniteGrades.convolution_strict_congr
statement:
theorem convolution_strict_congr (M p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hMp : p ≤ M)
    (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (u u' : ℕ → V) (hu0 : u 0=0)
    (hu : ∀ i < p, u' i=u i) :
    convolution M B u' u' p = convolution M B u u p

name: Euler.ComparatorBridge.frame_wronskian_constant
statement:
theorem frame_wronskian_constant
    (F G H B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F (G t) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt G (H t) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hH : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ v, H t v = -(B t (F t v)))
    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (B t).IsSymmetric)
    (v w : E) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ⟪G t v, F t w⟫_ℝ - ⟪F t v, G t w⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪G 0 v, F 0 w⟫_ℝ - ⟪F 0 v, G 0 w⟫_ℝ

name: Euler.ComparatorBridge.strain_symmetric_of_frame_wronskian
statement:
theorem strain_symmetric_of_frame_wronskian
    (F G H B S J : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F (G t) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt G (H t) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hH : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ v, H t v = -(B t (F t v)))
    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (B t).IsSymmetric)
    (hS : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ v, G t v = S t (F t v))
    (hJ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ v, F t (J t v) = v)
    (hzero : (S 0).IsSymmetric)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : (S t).IsSymmetric

name: EulerGevreyComposition.factorialProduct_extendLeft
statement:
lemma factorialProduct_extendLeft (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    factorialProduct c.extendLeft = factorialProduct c

name: EulerGevreyComposition.factorialProduct_extendMiddle
statement:
lemma factorialProduct_extendMiddle (c : OrderedFinpartition n) (i : Fin c.length) :
    factorialProduct (c.extendMiddle i) =
      ((c.partSize i : ℝ) + 1) * factorialProduct c

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partitionSum_le
statement:
theorem partitionSum_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    partitionSum n x ≤ (x+2)^n * (n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partitionSum_succ
statement:
lemma partitionSum_succ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    partitionSum (n+1) x =
      ∑ c : OrderedFinpartition n,
        (x * ((c.length : ℝ) + 1)^2 + ∑ i, ((c.partSize i : ℝ) + 1)^2) *
          partitionWeight x c

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partitionSum_succ_le
statement:
lemma partitionSum_succ_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    partitionSum (n+1) x ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1)^2 * (x+2) * partitionSum n x

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partitionWeight_extendLeft
statement:
lemma partitionWeight_extendLeft (x : ℝ) (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    partitionWeight x c.extendLeft =
      (x * ((c.length : ℝ) + 1)^2) * partitionWeight x c

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partitionWeight_extendMiddle
statement:
lemma partitionWeight_extendMiddle (x : ℝ) (c : OrderedFinpartition n) (i : Fin c.length) :
    partitionWeight x (c.extendMiddle i) =
      ((c.partSize i : ℝ) + 1)^2 * partitionWeight x c

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partitionWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma partitionWeight_nonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    0 ≤ partitionWeight x c

name: EulerGevreyComposition.sum_partSize
statement:
lemma sum_partSize (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    ∑ i, c.partSize i = n

name: EulerGevreyComposition.sum_partSize_real
statement:
lemma sum_partSize_real (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    ∑ i, (c.partSize i : ℝ) = n

name: EulerGevreyComposition.sum_partSize_succ_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_partSize_succ_sq_le (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    ∑ i, ((c.partSize i : ℝ) + 1)^2 ≤ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_gevrey
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_gevrey
    (f : E → F) (g : F → G) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (A B R S : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hgjet : ∀ j y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g y‖ ≤ A * S^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hfjet : ∀ j, 0 < j → ∀ x,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ B * R^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤
      A * (R*(B*S+2))^n * (n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_gevrey_at
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_gevrey_at
    (f : E → F) (g : F → G) (n : ℕ) (x : E)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ n f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ n g (f x))
    (A B R S : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hgjet : ∀ j ≤ n,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (f x)‖ ≤ A * S^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hfjet : ∀ j, 0 < j → j ≤ n →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ B * R^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤
      A * (R*(B*S+2))^n * (n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.norm_taylorComp_le
statement:
theorem norm_taylorComp_le
    (q : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ F G) (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ E F)
    (n : ℕ) (A B R S : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hq : ∀ j ≤ n, ‖q j‖ ≤ A * S^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hp : ∀ j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ‖p j‖ ≤ B * R^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2) :
    ‖q.taylorComp p n‖ ≤ A * (R*(B*S+2))^n * (n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.partition_bound_factorization
statement:
lemma partition_bound_factorization {n : ℕ} (c : OrderedFinpartition n)
    (A B R S : ℝ) :
    (A * S^c.length * (c.length.factorial : ℝ)^2) *
        (∏ i, B * R^(c.partSize i) * ((c.partSize i).factorial : ℝ)^2) =
      A * R^n * partitionWeight (B*S) c

name: EulerGevreyFlowBootstrap.continuous_barrier
statement:
theorem continuous_barrier (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T B a : ℝ)
    (_hT : 0 ≤ T) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (ha : 0 < a) (hBa : B*T < a)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, f s ≤ a) → f t ≤ B*t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, f t ≤ B*t

name: EulerGevreyFlowBootstrap.rationalRate_le
statement:
theorem rationalRate_le (B R a u : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hu : R*(a+u) ≤ 1/2) : rationalRate B R a u ≤ B

name: EulerGevreyFlowBootstrap.rational_integral_bootstrap
statement:
theorem rational_integral_bootstrap (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T B R : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 < R) (hsmall : B*R*T ≤ 1/8)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (hineq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, R*((4*R)⁻¹+f s) ≤ 1/2) →
      f t ≤ ∫ s in 0..t, rationalRate B R ((4*R)⁻¹) (f s)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, f t ≤ B*t ∧ R*((4*R)⁻¹+f t) ≤ 3/8

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.coefficient_sum_le_eval
statement:
theorem coefficient_sum_le_eval (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : NonnegativeCoefficients p)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∑ j ∈ s, p.coeff j*x^j ≤ p.eval x

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.comp_coefficient
statement:
theorem comp_coefficient (p q : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.coeff 0 = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (n.factorial : ℝ)*(q.comp p).coeff n =
      ∑ c : OrderedFinpartition n,
        ((c.length.factorial : ℝ)*q.coeff c.length) *
          ∏ i, ((c.partSize i).factorial : ℝ)*p.coeff (c.partSize i)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.factorialProduct_nonneg
statement:
lemma factorialProduct_nonneg {n : ℕ} (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    0 ≤ factorialProduct c

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.jetPolynomial_coeff
statement:
theorem jetPolynomial_coeff (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (jetPolynomial N a).coeff j = if j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N then a j else 0

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.jetPolynomial_coeff_of_mem
statement:
theorem jetPolynomial_coeff_of_mem (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) : (jetPolynomial N a).coeff j = a j

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.jetPolynomial_eval
statement:
theorem jetPolynomial_eval (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (jetPolynomial N a).eval x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, a j*x^j

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.jetPolynomial_nonnegative
statement:
theorem jetPolynomial_nonnegative (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 0 ≤ a j) :
    NonnegativeCoefficients (jetPolynomial N a)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.jetPolynomial_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem jetPolynomial_zero (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (jetPolynomial N a).coeff 0 = 0

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.nonnegative_comp
statement:
theorem nonnegative_comp {p q : ℝ[X]} (hp : NonnegativeCoefficients p)
    (hq : NonnegativeCoefficients q) : NonnegativeCoefficients (q.comp p)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.nonnegative_mul
statement:
theorem nonnegative_mul {p q : ℝ[X]} (hp : NonnegativeCoefficients p)
    (hq : NonnegativeCoefficients q) : NonnegativeCoefficients (p*q)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.nonnegative_pow
statement:
theorem nonnegative_pow {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : NonnegativeCoefficients p) (n : ℕ) :
    NonnegativeCoefficients (p^n)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.partition_factorial_le
statement:
theorem partition_factorial_le {n : ℕ} (c : OrderedFinpartition n) :
    (c.length.factorial : ℝ) * factorialProduct c ≤ n.factorial

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.polynomial_contDiff
statement:
theorem polynomial_contDiff (p : ℝ[X]) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => p.eval y)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.polynomial_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem polynomial_iteratedDeriv (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun y => p.eval y) x =
      (Polynomial.derivative^[n] p).eval x

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingAlgebra.polynomial_iteratedDeriv_zero
statement:
theorem polynomial_iteratedDeriv_zero (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun y => p.eval y) 0 = (n.factorial : ℝ)*p.coeff n

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingComposition.generatingSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem generatingSum_nonneg (P : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ E F)
    (N : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : 0 ≤ generatingSum P N z

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingComposition.generatingSum_taylorComp_le
statement:
theorem generatingSum_taylorComp_le
    (P : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ E F) (Q : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ F G)
    (N : ℕ) (B R z : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hQ : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖Q j‖ ≤ B*R^j*(j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hsmall : R*generatingSum P N z < 1) :
    generatingSum (Q.taylorComp P) N z ≤
      B*(R*generatingSum P N z)/(1-R*generatingSum P N z)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingComposition.generating_sum_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem generating_sum_le_polynomial
    (P : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ E F) (Q : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ F G)
    (N : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 0 ≤ a j)
    (hb : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 0 ≤ b j)
    (hP : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖P j‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ)^2*a j)
    (hQ : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖Q j‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ)^2*b j)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖Q.taylorComp P n‖/(n.factorial : ℝ)^2*z^n) ≤
      (jetPolynomial N b).eval ((jetPolynomial N a).eval z)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingComposition.norm_taylorComp_le_coefficient
statement:
theorem norm_taylorComp_le_coefficient
    (P : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ E F) (Q : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ F G)
    (p q : ℝ[X]) (hp0 : p.coeff 0 = 0)
    (hp : NonnegativeCoefficients p) (hq : NonnegativeCoefficients q)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hP : ∀ j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ‖P j‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ)^2*p.coeff j)
    (hQ : ∀ j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ‖Q j‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ)^2*q.coeff j) :
    ‖Q.taylorComp P n‖ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ)^2*(q.comp p).coeff n

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.derivativeSum_add_le
statement:
theorem derivativeSum_add_le (f g : E → F) (N : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (x : E)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ N f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ N g x) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    derivativeSum (f+g) N z x ≤ derivativeSum f N z x+derivativeSum g N z x

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.derivativeSum_comp_id_add_le
statement:
theorem derivativeSum_comp_id_add_le (f : E → E) (g : E → F) (N : ℕ)
    (z B R : ℝ) (x : E) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ N f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ N g (x+f x))
    (hgj : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (x+f x)‖ ≤ B*R^j*(j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hsmall : R*(z+derivativeSum f N z x) < 1) :
    derivativeSum (g ∘ (id+f)) N z x ≤
      EulerGevreyFlowBootstrap.rationalRate B R z (derivativeSum f N z x)

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.derivativeSum_comp_le
statement:
theorem derivativeSum_comp_le (f : E → F) (g : F → G) (N : ℕ)
    (z B R : ℝ) (x : E) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R)

    (hgj : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.derivativeSum_id_add_le

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.derivativeSum_id_le

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.derivativeSum_nonneg

name: EulerGevreyGeneratingDerivatives.rational_fraction_mono

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.derivativeSum_continuousOn

    (hc : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f t) x) (Icc 0 T)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => derivativeSum (f t) N z x) (Icc 0 T)

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.derivativeSum_le_integral
statement:
theorem derivativeSum_le_integral [CompleteSpace F]
    (f : E → F) (v : ℝ → E → F) (N : ℕ) (z t : ℝ) (x : E)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hc : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      ContinuousOn (fun s => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (v s) x) (Icc 0 t))
    (heq : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x = ∫ s in 0..t, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (v s) x) :
    derivativeSum f N z x ≤ ∫ s in 0..t, derivativeSum (v s) N z x

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.derivativeSum_zero

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.derivative_bound_of_generating_sum
statement:
theorem derivative_bound_of_generating_sum (f : E → F) (N n : ℕ) (R A : ℝ)

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.derivative_term_le_sum

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.flow_generating_sum_bound
statement:
theorem flow_generating_sum_bound
    (ψ b : ℝ → E → E) (N : ℕ) (T B R : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 < R) (hsmall : B*R*T ≤ 1/8)
    (hψ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ContDiff ℝ N (ψ t))
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ContDiff ℝ N (b t)) (hψ0 : ψ 0 = 0)
    (hbjet : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ y, ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t) y‖ ≤ B*R^n*(n.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hcψ : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∀ x,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ψ t) x) (Icc 0 T))
    (hcv : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∀ x,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t ∘ (id+ψ t)) x) (Icc 0 T))
    (heq : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ψ t) x =
        ∫ s in 0..t, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b s ∘ (id+ψ s)) x) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
      derivativeSum (ψ t) N ((4*R)⁻¹) x ≤ B*t

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.flow_generating_sum_bound_of_jet_derivative
statement:
theorem flow_generating_sum_bound_of_jet_derivative
    (ψ b : ℝ → E → E) (N : ℕ) (T B R : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 < R) (hsmall : B*R*T ≤ 1/8)
    (hψ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ContDiff ℝ N (ψ t))
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ContDiff ℝ N (b t)) (hψ0 : ψ 0 = 0)
    (hbjet : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ y, ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t) y‖ ≤ B*R^n*(n.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hd : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ψ s) x)
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t ∘ (id+ψ t)) x) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hcv : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∀ x,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t ∘ (id+ψ t)) x) (Icc 0 T)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x, derivativeSum (ψ t) N ((4*R)⁻¹) x ≤ B*t

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.flow_positive_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem flow_positive_derivative_bound
    (ψ b : ℝ → E → E) (T B R : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 < R) (hsmall : B*R*T ≤ 1/8)

    (hd : ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ψ s) x)
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t ∘ (id+ψ t)) x) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hcv : ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ x,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (b t ∘ (id+ψ t)) x) (Icc 0 T)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x, ∀ n, 0 < n →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ψ t) x‖ ≤ B*t*(4*R)^n*(n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyFlowFinite.jet_integral_of_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem jet_integral_of_hasDerivWithinAt
    (ψ v : ℝ → E → E) (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hψ0 : ψ 0 = 0)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ψ s) x)

name: EulerGevreyComposition.predecessorPartitionSum_succ

name: EulerGevreyComposition.predecessorPartitionSum_succ_le

statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_of_fderiv_eq_comp
    (Y : E → F) (A : F → E →L[ℝ] F) (g : F → G)
    (hY : Differentiable ℝ Y) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (hDY : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ Y x = A (Y x))
    (C R D S : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hAjet : ∀ j y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A y‖ ≤ C * R^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (hgjet : ∀ j y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g y‖ ≤ D * S^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ Y) x‖ ≤
      D * (inverseMapRadius C R * (C*S+2))^n * (n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_predecessor_at
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_predecessor_at

    (A B R S : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hS : 0 ≤ S)

    (hgjet : ∀ j ≤ n,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (f x)‖ ≤ A * S^j * (j.factorial : ℝ)^2)

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ B * R^j * ((j-1).factorial : ℝ)^2) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤ A * R^n * (B*S) * (n.factorial : ℝ)^2

name: EulerGevreyComposition.predecessor_partition_bound_factorization

        (∏ i, B * R^(c.partSize i) * ((c.partSize i - 1).factorial : ℝ)^2) =
      A * R^n * predecessorPartitionWeight (B*S) c

name: EulerLpParameterIntegral.integral_memLp_and_bound
statement:
theorem integral_memLp_and_bound
    (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (μ : Measure β) [SFinite μ]
    (f : α × β → E) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (ν.prod μ))
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, MemLp (fun x => f (s,x)) 2 μ ∧
      (eLpNorm (fun x => f (s,x)) 2 μ).toReal ≤ C) :
    MemLp (fun x => ∫ s, f (s,x) ∂ν) 2 μ ∧
      (eLpNorm (fun x => ∫ s, f (s,x) ∂ν) 2 μ).toReal ≤ ν.real univ*C

name: EulerLpParameterIntegral.integral_norm_sq_eq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_eq (μ : Measure α) (f : α → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) :
    (∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂μ) = (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal^2

name: EulerLpParameterIntegral.intervalIntegral_memLp_and_bound
statement:
theorem intervalIntegral_memLp_and_bound
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (μ : Measure β) [SFinite μ]
    (f : ℝ × β → E)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod μ))
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Icc 0 T), MemLp (fun x => f (s,x)) 2 μ ∧
      (eLpNorm (fun x => f (s,x)) 2 μ).toReal ≤ C) :
    MemLp (fun x => ∫ s in 0..T, f (s,x)) 2 μ ∧
      (eLpNorm (fun x => ∫ s in 0..T, f (s,x)) 2 μ).toReal ≤ T*C

name: EulerLpParameterIntegral.norm_integral_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sq_le (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (f : α → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 ν) :
    ‖∫ s, f s ∂ν‖^2 ≤ ν.real univ*(∫ s, ‖f s‖^2 ∂ν)

name: EulerNonnegativeImproperIntegral.lintegral_eq_top_of_unbounded_partials
statement:
theorem lintegral_eq_top_of_unbounded_partials (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → S < T → IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 S)
    (hnonneg : ∀ x ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hunbounded : ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ S : ℝ, 0 < S ∧ S < T ∧
      K < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..S, f x) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ENNReal.ofReal (f x))=⊤

name: EulerNonnegativeImproperIntegral.ofReal_partial_le_lintegral
statement:
theorem ofReal_partial_le_lintegral (f : ℝ → ℝ) {S T : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hST : S < T) (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 S)
    (hnonneg : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) S, 0 ≤ f x) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..S, f x) ≤
      ∫⁻ x in Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ENNReal.ofReal (f x)

name: EulerPacketResidual.packet_residual_eq_tail
statement:
theorem packet_residual_eq_tail (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, coefficient (N+1) L G H B C u p n=0) :
    residual (N+1) κ L G H B C u p =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • coefficient (N+1) L G H B C u p n

name: EulerPacketResidual.residual_eq_evaluate
statement:
theorem residual_eq_evaluate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0) :
    residual M κ L G H B C u p = evaluate (2*M) κ (coefficient M L G H B C u p)

name: EulerPacketResidual.residual_eq_tail
statement:
theorem residual_eq_tail (M K : ℕ) (hK : K ≤ 2*M+1) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n < K, coefficient M L G H B C u p n=0) :
    residual M κ L G H B C u p =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico K (2*M+1), κ^n • coefficient M L G H B C u p n

name: Euler.ComparatorBridge.stage_mapsTo_closedBall_of_partial_sums

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.continuousOn_of_dense_integral_equation
statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_dense_integral_equation
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u b : ℝ → H} {a c : ℝ}
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume a c)
    (hweak : ∀ t ∈ Icc a c, ∀ φ ∈ D,
      inner ℝ φ (u t) - inner ℝ φ (u a) = ∫ s in a..t, inner ℝ φ (b s)) :
    ContinuousOn u (Icc a c)

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.continuousOn_of_dense_scalar_derivative
statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_dense_scalar_derivative
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u : ℝ → H} {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (C : ℝ≥0)
    (hcont : ∀ φ ∈ D, ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ φ (u t)) (Icc a c))
    (hderiv : ∀ φ ∈ D, ∀ t ∈ Ioo a c,
      ∃ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => inner ℝ φ (u s)) d t ∧
        ‖d‖ ≤ (C : ℝ) * ‖φ‖) :
    ContinuousOn u (Icc a c)

statement:
theorem eq_of_dense_inner_eq {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {x y : H}

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.hasDerivAt_of_dense_weak_equation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_of_dense_weak_equation
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u b : ℝ → H} {a c t : ℝ}

    (hb : ContinuousOn b (Icc a c))
    (hderiv : ∀ φ ∈ D, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a c,
      HasDerivAt (fun r => inner ℝ φ (u r)) (inner ℝ φ (b s)) s)
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo a c) : HasDerivAt u (b t) t

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_integral_equation
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_integral_equation
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u b : ℝ → H} {a c t : ℝ}
    (hb : ContinuousOn b (Icc a c)) (ht : t ∈ Icc a c)
    (hweak : ∀ s ∈ Icc a c, ∀ φ ∈ D,
      inner ℝ φ (u s) - inner ℝ φ (u a) = ∫ r in a..s, inner ℝ φ (b r)) :

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_weak_equation
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_weak_equation

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_scalar_derivative
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_scalar_derivative
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u : ℝ → H} {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (C : ℝ≥0)
    (hcont : ∀ φ ∈ D, ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ φ (u t)) (Icc a c))

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_weak_equation
statement:

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.sub_eq_integral_of_dense_pairing
statement:
theorem sub_eq_integral_of_dense_pairing

    (hweak : ∀ φ ∈ D,

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.sub_eq_integral_of_dense_weak_equation

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_recurrence
statement:
theorem primitive_recurrence {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (x : ℝ) :
    (2 * c) * primitive c j b x =
      scale c j x * b x - primitive c j (sourceCoefficient 0 j b) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_sourceCoefficient
statement:
theorem primitive_sourceCoefficient {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {a : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (x : ℝ) :
    primitive c j (sourceCoefficient c j a) x = scale c j x * a x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_three_one
statement:
theorem primitive_three_one {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    primitive c 3 (fun _ => 1) x = edge c x / (2 * c)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem primitive_zero (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.scale_hasDerivAt

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.correctionIteration_norm_le
statement:
theorem correctionIteration_norm_le
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖Q x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) (hd : 2 * β * ‖d‖ ≤ r)
    (c : E) (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ r) : ‖correctionIteration B Q d c‖ ≤ r

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.correctionIteration_sub_le
statement:
theorem correctionIteration_sub_le
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ r →
      ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ K * (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) * ‖x - y‖)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1)
    (x y : E) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ r) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖correctionIteration B Q d x - correctionIteration B Q d y‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.exists_unique_small_correction
statement:
theorem exists_unique_small_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQnorm : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖Q x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hQdiff : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ r →
      ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ K * (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) * ‖x - y‖)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) (hd : 2 * β * ‖d‖ ≤ r) :
    ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ r ∧ B c + Q c = d

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.moments_synthesize
statement:
theorem moments_synthesize (L : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → V) (c : ι → ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_coefficients_unique
statement:
theorem repair_coefficients_unique (L : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → V)
    (hB : (momentMatrix L b).det ≠ 0) (u : V) (target c : ι → ℝ)
    (hc : moments L (u + synthesize b c) = target) :
    c = coefficients (momentMatrix L b) (target - moments L u)

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_eq_of_profiles_zero
statement:
theorem repair_eq_of_profiles_zero (L : ι → (X → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → X → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_idempotent

    repair L b (repair L b u target) target = repair L b u target

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_support_subset

theorem repair_support_subset (L : ι → (X → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → X → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.exists_ordered_derivative_zeros
statement:

    (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (hz : ∀ j, f (x j) = 0) :
    ∃ y : Fin n → ℝ, StrictMono y ∧
      (∀ j, x j.castSucc < y j ∧ y j < x j.succ) ∧ (∀ j, f' (y j) = 0)

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.exists_zero_of_setIntegral_eq_zero

    (hmass : μ (Set.Icc l u) ≠ 0) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc l u))
    (hzero : ∫ t in Set.Icc l u, f t ∂μ = 0) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc l u, f t = 0

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.expSum_shift
statement:

    expSum (fun j => a j - s) c t = expSum a c t * Real.exp (-s * t)

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.integral_powerSum
statement:
theorem integral_powerSum {n : ℕ} (a c : Fin n → ℝ) (l u : ℝ)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hl : 0 < l) :
    (∫ t in Set.Icc l u, powerSum a c t ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, c i * ∫ t in Set.Icc l u, t ^ a i ∂μ

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.intervalMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingSchedule.angular_integrand_pulse
statement:
theorem angular_integrand_pulse (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

    Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 * y / 2) * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (y, eta) *
        axial c amp (y, eta) =
      (momentScale c 1 * (shape eta)^2) *
        (Real.exp ((c.exponents 1 + 1) * (y - c.pulseStart)) *
          radialPulse c amp eta (Real.exp (y - c.pulseStart)))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingSchedule.constructed_core
statement:
theorem constructed_core (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (axial c amp) ∧
    (∀ p, 0 < angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam p) ∧
    (∀ eta y, c.endpoint ≤ y →
      axial c amp (y, eta) = 0 ∧ massMoment c amp eta y = 0 ∧
        angularMoment c amp eta y = 0) ∧
    (∀ eta y, c.holdStart ≤ y → y ≤ c.pulseStart →
      axial c amp (y, eta) = 0 ∧
      angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (y, eta) =
        radialAmplitude c.P c.dropLength c.lam c.holdStart * shape eta *
          Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + c.lam) * (y - c.holdStart)))

statement:
theorem pulse_closes_prefix (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    prefixM c * eta + momentScale c 0 * shape eta *
      (∫ x in (1 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.pulseLength,
        x ^ c.exponents 0 * radialPulse c amp eta x) = 0 ∧
    prefixJ c * eta * shape eta + momentScale c 1 * (shape eta)^2 *
      (∫ x in (1 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.pulseLength,
        x ^ c.exponents 1 * radialPulse c amp eta x) = 0

      x ^ c.exponents i * radialPulse c amp eta x) =

      (radialAmplitude P dropLength lam y * (slope dropLength lam y - 1 / 2)) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingSchedule.radialAmplitude_hold
statement:

    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ F 0 = b 0 / (2 * c) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → primitive c j b x = scale c j x * F x

statement:

    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ F 0 = b 0 / (2 * c) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b u) =
          Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * F x

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.exists_joint_smooth_factor
statement:
theorem exists_joint_smooth_factor {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : E × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧
      (∀ p : E, F (p, 0) = b (p, 0) / (2 * c)) ∧
      ∀ (p : E) (x : ℝ), 0 < x →
        (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b (p, u)) =
          Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * F (p, x)

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angularPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem angularPrimitive_hasDerivAt
    (h η x : ℝ) (W H I Iη J Jη : ℝ → ℝ) (Wx Hx U Uη Hη : ℝ)
    (hWderiv : HasDerivAt W Wx x) (hH : HasDerivAt H Hx x)
    (hI : HasDerivAt I (H x) x) (hIη : HasDerivAt Iη Hη x)
    (hJ : HasDerivAt J (U * H x) x)
    (hJη : HasDerivAt Jη (Uη * H x + U * Hη) x)
    (hW : W x + x * Wx =
      1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U - coordinateFactor η * Uη) :
    HasDerivAt (angularPrimitive h η W H I Iη J Jη)
      (angularSource h η x (W x) U (H x) Hx Hη) x

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_derivative_algebra
statement:
theorem angular_derivative_algebra
    (h η x W Wx U Uη H Hx Hη : ℝ)
    (hW : W + x * Wx = 1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U - coordinateFactor η * Uη) :
    -((W + x * Wx) * H + x * W * Hx) + (1 - h) * H -
      axialExponent h * η * Hη - coordinateFactor η * (Uη * H + U * Hη) +
      2 * (h - axialExponent h) * η * (U * H) =
      angularSource h η x W U H Hx Hη

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_integrated_identity
statement:
theorem angular_integrated_identity
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AngularMomentData h η X)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      0 X volume =
      angularPrimitive h η p.W p.H p.I p.Iη p.J p.Jη X

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_integrated_lag
statement:
theorem angular_integrated_lag
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AngularMomentData h η X) (hX : X ≠ 0) (hH : p.H X ≠ 0)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      0 X volume / (X * p.H X) =
      -p.W X + ((1 - h) * p.I X - axialExponent h * η * p.Iη X -
        coordinateFactor η * p.Jη X + 2 * (h - axialExponent h) * η * p.J X) /
          (X * p.H X)

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_lag_primitive_iff
statement:
theorem angular_lag_primitive_iff
    (H Q : ℝ → ℝ) (x Hx Qx Sq : ℝ)
    (hH : HasDerivAt H Hx x) (hQ : HasDerivAt Q Qx x) (hHne : H x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => y * H y * Q y) (H x * Sq) x ↔
      x * Qx + (1 + x * Hx / H x) * Q x = Sq

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_source_logarithmic_form
statement:
theorem angular_source_logarithmic_form
    (h η x W U H Hx Hη : ℝ) (hH : H ≠ 0) :
    H * (-W * (x * Hx / H) - h * (1 - 2 * η * U) -
      (axialExponent h * η + coordinateFactor η * U) * (Hη / H)) =
      angularSource h η x W U H Hx Hη

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_stress_coefficient
statement:
theorem angular_stress_coefficient
    (x R E L Qs Ex : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (E / R) * (x * Qs / L - (1 - 2 * x * Ex / E)) =
      (E / R) * (x * Qs / L) + (2 * x * Ex - E) / R

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axialPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem axialPrimitive_hasDerivAt
    (h η x : ℝ) (W U M Mη S Sη P Pη : ℝ → ℝ)
    (Wx Ux Uη E Eη Px Pηx : ℝ)
    (hWderiv : HasDerivAt W Wx x) (hU : HasDerivAt U Ux x)
    (hM : HasDerivAt M (U x) x) (hMη : HasDerivAt Mη Uη x)
    (hS : HasDerivAt S ((U x) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 / 2) x)
    (hSη : HasDerivAt Sη (2 * U x * Uη - E * Eη) x)
    (hPderiv : HasDerivAt P Px x) (hPηderiv : HasDerivAt Pη Pηx x)
    (hW : W x + x * Wx =
      1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U x - coordinateFactor η * Uη)
    (hP : x * Px = E ^ 2 / 2) (hPη : x * Pηx = E * Eη) :
    HasDerivAt (axialPrimitive h η W U M Mη S Sη P Pη)
      (axialSource h η x (W x) (U x) Ux Uη (P x) Px (Pη x)) x

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_derivative_algebra
statement:
theorem axial_derivative_algebra
    (h η x W Wx U Ux Uη E Eη P Px Pη Pηx : ℝ)
    (hW : W + x * Wx = 1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U - coordinateFactor η * Uη)
    (hP : x * Px = E ^ 2 / 2)
    (hPη : x * Pηx = E * Eη) :
    -((W + x * Wx) * U + x * W * Ux) + axialExponent h * (U - η * Uη) +
      4 * h * η * (U ^ 2 - E ^ 2 / 2) -
      coordinateFactor η * (2 * U * Uη - E * Eη) +
      (4 * velocityExponent h * η * P - coordinateFactor η * Pη) +
      x * (4 * velocityExponent h * η * Px - coordinateFactor η * Pηx) =
      axialSource h η x W U Ux Uη P Px Pη

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_integrated_identity
statement:
theorem axial_integrated_identity
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AxialMomentData h η X)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) 0 X volume =
      axialPrimitive h η p.W p.U p.M p.Mη p.S p.Sη p.P p.Pη X

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_integrated_lag
statement:
theorem axial_integrated_lag
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AxialMomentData h η X) (hX : X ≠ 0)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) 0 X volume / X =
      -p.W X * p.U X + axialExponent h * (p.M X - η * p.Mη X) / X +
        (4 * h * η * p.S X - coordinateFactor η * p.Sη X) / X +
        4 * velocityExponent h * η * p.P X - coordinateFactor η * p.Pη X

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_lag_primitive_iff
statement:
theorem axial_lag_primitive_iff
    (N : ℝ → ℝ) (x Nx Sn : ℝ) (hN : HasDerivAt N Nx x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => y * N y) Sn x ↔ x * Nx + N x = Sn

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_stress_coefficient
statement:
theorem axial_stress_coefficient
    (x R E L Ns Ux : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (E / R) * (x * Ns / (L * E) + 2 * x * Ux / E) =
      (x / R) * (Ns / L + 2 * Ux)

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.stressFree_angular_lag_algebra
statement:
theorem stressFree_angular_lag_algebra
    (x L φ φx φxx : ℝ) (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    x * (-2 * L * (φxx * φ - φx ^ 2) / φ ^ 2) +
      (2 + x * φx / φ) * (-2 * L * φx / φ) =
      -2 * L * (x * φxx + 2 * φx) / φ

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.stressFree_axial_lag_algebra
statement:
theorem stressFree_axial_lag_algebra (x L Ux Uxx : ℝ) :
    x * (-2 * L * Uxx) + (-2 * L * Ux) = -2 * L * (x * Uxx + Ux)

theorem W_balance (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) :

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_equation
statement:
theorem angularLag_equation (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) (hH : P.H p ≠ 0) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.angularLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 +
      (1 + p.1 * radialPartial P.H p / P.H p) * P.angularLag h p =
        P.angularSource h p / P.H p

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_equation_logarithmic
statement:
theorem angularLag_equation_logarithmic (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : 0 < p.1) (hf : P.f p ≠ 0) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.angularLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 +
      (1 + p.1 * deriv (fun x => Real.log (P.H (x, p.2))) p.1) * P.angularLag h p =
        -P.W h p * (p.1 * deriv (fun x => Real.log (P.H (x, p.2))) p.1) -
          h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * P.U p) -
            (axialExponent h * p.2 + coordinateFactor p.2 * P.U p) *
              deriv (fun η => Real.log (P.E (p.1, η))) p.2

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem angularLag_hasDerivAt (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) (hH : P.H p ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => P.angularLag h (x, p.2))
      ((P.angularSource h p * (p.1 * P.H p) -
        primitive (P.angularSource h) p * (P.H p + p.1 * radialPartial P.H p)) /
          (p.1 * P.H p) ^ 2) p.1

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_integrated
statement:
theorem angularLag_integrated (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) (hH : P.H p ≠ 0) :
    P.angularLag h p = -P.W h p +
      ((1 - h) * P.I p - axialExponent h * p.2 * parameterPartial P.I p -
        coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.J p +
          2 * (h - axialExponent h) * p.2 * P.J p) / (p.1 * P.H p)

statement:
theorem axialLag_equation (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_equation_explicit
statement:
theorem axialLag_equation_explicit (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.axialLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 + P.axialLag h p =
      -P.W h p * (p.1 * radialPartial P.U p) -
        velocityExponent h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * P.U p) * P.U p -
          (axialExponent h * p.2 + coordinateFactor p.2 * P.U p) * parameterPartial P.U p -
            coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.pressure p +
              4 * velocityExponent h * p.2 * P.pressure p +
                2 * p.2 * (p.1 * radialPartial P.pressure p)

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem axialLag_hasDerivAt (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => P.axialLag h (x, p.2))
      ((P.axialSource h p * p.1 - primitive (P.axialSource h) p) / p.1 ^ 2) p.1

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_integrated
statement:
theorem axialLag_integrated (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    P.axialLag h p = -P.W h p * P.U p +
      axialExponent h * (P.M p - p.2 * parameterPartial P.M p) / p.1 +
        (4 * h * p.2 * P.S p - coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.S p) / p.1 +
          4 * velocityExponent h * p.2 * P.pressure p - coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.pressure p

theorem bessel_contiguous (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_eq_constant_add_tail
statement:
theorem bessel_eq_constant_add_tail (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    bessel k t = 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) + ∑' n : ℕ, term k (n + 1) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_le_odd_partial_sum
statement:
theorem bessel_le_odd_partial_sum (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hodd : Odd j)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 4) :
    bessel k t ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j, term k n t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_ode
statement:
theorem bessel_ode (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    t * deriv (deriv (bessel k)) t + ((k : ℝ) + 1) * deriv (bessel k) t +
      bessel k t = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_add_mul_deriv
statement:
theorem bessel_one_add_mul_deriv (t : ℝ) :
    bessel 1 t + t * deriv (bessel 1) t = bessel 0 t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_gt_quarter
statement:
theorem bessel_one_gt_quarter (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :
    1 / 4 < bessel 1 t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_le_one
statement:
theorem bessel_one_le_one (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 4) :
    bessel 1 t ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_log_slope_gt
statement:
theorem bessel_one_log_slope_gt (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 99 / 50 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 2) :
    236 / 100 < -2 * t * deriv (bessel 1) t / bessel 1 t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_zero
statement: theorem bessel_zero (k : ℕ) : bessel k 0 = 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_zero_lt_neg_eighteen_hundredths
statement:
theorem bessel_zero_lt_neg_eighteen_hundredths
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 99 / 50 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 2) :
    bessel 0 t < -(18 / 100)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.cubic_lower_le_bessel
statement:
theorem cubic_lower_le_bessel (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :
    AxisProfile.cubicLower t ≤ bessel 1 t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.cubic_tail_antitone
statement:
theorem cubic_tail_antitone (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :
    Antitone (fun n : ℕ => term 1 (n + 4) (-t))

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.cubic_tail_nonneg
statement:
theorem cubic_tail_nonneg (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :
    0 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, term 1 (n + 4) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.deriv_bessel
statement:
theorem deriv_bessel (k : ℕ) :
    deriv (bessel k) = fun t : ℝ => -bessel (k + 1) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.deriv_profile
statement:
theorem deriv_profile (χ : ℝ) :
    deriv (profile χ) = fun Y : ℝ => -(χ / 2) * bessel 2 ((χ / 2) * Y)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.factorial_reciprocal
statement:
theorem factorial_reciprocal (k : ℕ) :
    1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.hasDerivAt_bessel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_bessel (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (bessel k) (-bessel (k + 1) t) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.hasDerivAt_profile
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_profile (χ Y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (profile χ) (-(χ / 2) * bessel 2 ((χ / 2) * Y)) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.hasDerivAt_term_succ
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_term_succ (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (term k (n + 1)) (-term (k + 1) n t) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.magnitude_tail_antitone
statement:
theorem magnitude_tail_antitone (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 4) :
    Antitone (fun n : ℕ => term k (n + j) (-t))

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem profile_eq_tsum (χ Y : ℝ) :
    profile χ Y = ∑' n : ℕ, (-χ * Y / 2) ^ n /
      ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_gt_quarter
statement:
theorem profile_gt_quarter (χ Y : ℝ) (hχ0 : 0 ≤ χ) (hχ1 : χ ≤ 1)
    (hY0 : 0 ≤ Y) (hY1 : Y ≤ 41 / 10) : 1 / 4 < profile χ Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_log_slope_at_four
statement:
theorem profile_log_slope_at_four (χ : ℝ) (hχ0 : 99 / 100 ≤ χ) (hχ1 : χ ≤ 1) :
    236 / 100 < -8 * deriv (profile χ) 4 / profile χ 4

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_pos
statement:
theorem profile_pos (χ Y : ℝ) (hχ0 : 0 ≤ χ) (hχ1 : χ ≤ 1)
    (hY0 : 0 ≤ Y) (hY1 : Y ≤ 41 / 10) : 0 < profile χ Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_scaled_ode
statement:
theorem profile_scaled_ode (χ Y : ℝ) :
    2 * (Y * deriv (deriv (profile χ)) Y + 2 * deriv (profile χ) Y) =
      -χ * profile χ Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_zero
statement: theorem profile_zero (χ : ℝ) : profile χ 0 = 1

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.second_deriv_bessel
statement:
theorem second_deriv_bessel (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (bessel k)) t = bessel (k + 2) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.second_deriv_profile
statement:
theorem second_deriv_profile (χ Y : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (profile χ)) Y = (χ / 2) ^ 2 * bessel 3 ((χ / 2) * Y)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.summable_norm_term
statement:
theorem summable_norm_term (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖term k n t‖)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.summable_term
statement: theorem summable_term (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => term k n t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.summable_term_tail
statement:
theorem summable_term_tail (k j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => term k (n + j) t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_contiguous
statement:
theorem term_contiguous (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    term k (n + 1) t = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * term (k + 1) (n + 1) t -
      t * term (k + 2) n t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_norm_le
statement:
theorem term_norm_le (k n : ℕ) (t R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (ht : |t| ≤ R) :
    ‖term k n t‖ ≤ R ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_sign
statement:
theorem term_sign (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    term k n t = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * term k n (-t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_succ_ratio
statement:
theorem term_succ_ratio (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    term k (n + 1) t =
      (-t) / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + k + 1)) * term k n t

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.abs_bilinear_term_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinear_term_le (a x y wx wy F G : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (_hG : 0 ≤ G) (hwx : 0 ≤ wx) (_hwy : 0 ≤ wy)
    (hx : |x| ≤ F * wx) (hy : |y| ≤ G * wy) :
    |a * x * y| ≤ (F * G) * (a * wx * wy)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.abs_double_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_double_sum_le {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (f M : ι → κ → ℝ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ k ∈ t, |f i k| ≤ M i k) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, f i k| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, M i k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.averageJet_bound
statement:
theorem averageJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (_hε : 0 < ε) (_hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |averageJet f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.choose_factorials
statement:
theorem choose_factorials (k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (l.factorial : ℝ) =
      ((k + l).factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.choose_product_le
statement:
theorem choose_product_le (i j k l : ℕ) :
    (i + k).choose k * (j + l).choose l ≤ ((i + j) + (k + l)).choose (k + l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_factorial
statement:
theorem coreWeight_factorial (ε : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m =
      (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ n * (ε⁻¹) ^ m * ((n + m).factorial : ℝ) / (n.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_parameter_shift
statement:
theorem coreWeight_parameter_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε i (k + 1) =
      (20 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * coreWeight ε (i + 1) k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_pos
statement:
theorem coreWeight_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    0 < coreWeight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_product_le
statement:
theorem coreWeight_product_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * coreWeight ε i k * coreWeight ε j l ≤
      coreWeight ε (i + j) (k + l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_radial_identity
statement:
theorem coreWeight_radial_identity {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m * ((n : ℝ) + m + 1) =
      20 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * coreWeight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_radial_le
statement:
theorem coreWeight_radial_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m ≤ 20 * coreWeight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.inverseMixedJet_bound
statement:
theorem inverseMixedJet_bound {ε F G : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |inverseMixedJet r f g n m| ≤ (5120 / ε) * F * G * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.jetProduct_bound
statement:
theorem jetProduct_bound {ε F G : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |jetProduct f g n m| ≤ 64 * F * G * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixedWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem mixedWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n m : ℕ) :
    mixedWeightSum ε r n m ≤ (5120 / ε) * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixed_factors_le_divisor
statement:
theorem mixed_factors_le_divisor {r n i j : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hij : i + j = n) :
    ((i : ℝ) + 1) * (j : ℝ) ≤ radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixed_weight_term_le
statement:
theorem mixed_weight_term_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r n i j : ℕ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hij : i + j = n) (m k l : ℕ) :
    (((m.choose k : ℝ) * j) / radialDivisor r n) * weight ε i (k + 1) * weight ε j l ≤
      (80 / ε) * ((m.choose k : ℝ) * weight ε (i + 1) k * weight ε j l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.parameterPrimitiveJet_bound
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitiveJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |parameterPrimitiveJet f n m| ≤ (80 / ε) * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.primitiveJet_bound
statement:
theorem primitiveJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |primitiveJet f n m| ≤ 80 * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.productWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem productWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    productWeightSum ε n m ≤ 64 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.radialDivisor_ge_one
statement: theorem radialDivisor_ge_one {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.radialDivisor_pos
statement: theorem radialDivisor_pos {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) : 0 < radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.reciprocal_square_telescope
statement:
theorem reciprocal_square_telescope (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    1 / x ^ 2 ≤ 2 / x - 2 / (x + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.regularInverseJet_bound
statement:
theorem regularInverseJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |regularInverseJet r f n m| ≤ 80 * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.regularInverseMixedJet_bound
statement:
theorem regularInverseMixedJet_bound {ε F G : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |regularInverseMixedJet r f g n m| ≤ (5120 / ε) * F * G * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.shiftedProductWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem shiftedProductWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    shiftedProductWeightSum ε n m ≤ 64 * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_convolution_le
statement:
theorem squareDecay_convolution_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, squareDecay ij.1 * squareDecay ij.2) ≤ 8 * squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_le_four_succ
statement: theorem squareDecay_le_four_succ (n : ℕ) : squareDecay n ≤ 4 * squareDecay (n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_pos
statement: theorem squareDecay_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_product_le
statement:
theorem squareDecay_product_le (i j : ℕ) :
    squareDecay i * squareDecay j ≤
      2 * squareDecay (i + j) * (squareDecay i + squareDecay j)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_succ_le
statement: theorem squareDecay_succ_le (n : ℕ) : squareDecay (n + 1) ≤ squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.sum_squareDecay_le
statement:
theorem sum_squareDecay_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), squareDecay i) ≤ 2 - 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.sum_squareDecay_le_two
statement:
theorem sum_squareDecay_le_two (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), squareDecay i) ≤ 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_eq_core_decay
statement:
theorem weight_eq_core_decay (ε : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m = coreWeight ε n m * squareDecay n * squareDecay m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_parameter_radial_shift
statement:
theorem weight_parameter_radial_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    weight ε i (k + 1) ≤ (80 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * weight ε (i + 1) k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_parameter_radial_shift_ratio
statement:
theorem weight_parameter_radial_shift_ratio {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    weight ε i (k + 1) / weight ε (i + 1) k ≤ (80 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_pos
statement: theorem weight_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) : 0 < weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_product_term_le
statement:
theorem weight_product_term_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * weight ε i k * weight ε j l ≤
      coreWeight ε (i + j) (k + l) * (squareDecay i * squareDecay j) *
        (squareDecay k * squareDecay l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_radial_shift
statement:
theorem weight_radial_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m ≤ 80 * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_radial_shift_ratio
statement:
theorem weight_radial_shift_ratio {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m / weight ε (n + 1) m ≤ 80

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.Window.continuous_project
statement: theorem Window.continuous_project (I : Window) : Continuous I.project

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.Window.project_of_mem
statement:
theorem Window.project_of_mem (I : Window) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    I.project x = ⟨x, hx⟩

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem abs_iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (A : CoefficientSpace I w) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_jet_le
statement:
theorem abs_jet_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |jet I w A.1 n m x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_jet_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_jet_sub_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A B : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |jet I w A.1 n m x - jet I w B.1 n m x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A - B‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_complete
statement: theorem axisSpace_complete (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) : CompleteSpace (AxisSpace I ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem axisSpace_derivative_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval x| ≤
      AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε n m * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_norm_le_iff
statement:
theorem axisSpace_norm_le_iff (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C ↔ ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval),
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval x| /
        AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε n m ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_smooth
statement:
theorem axisSpace_smooth (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ext
statement:
theorem coefficient_ext (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, w n m ≠ 0) (A B : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (h : ∀ n x, x ∈ I.interval → coefficient I w A n x = coefficient I w B n x) :
    A = B

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ofJetFamily
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I w (ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound) n x = J n 0 x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ofSmoothFamily
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofSmoothFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I w (ofSmoothFamily I w hw F hF C hC hbound) n x = F n x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.compatible_rawOfJetFamily
statement:
theorem compatible_rawOfJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m) :
    Compatible I w (rawOfJetFamily I w hw J hcont C hbound)

theorem contDiffOn_coefficient (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.contDiffOn_jet
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_jet (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.continuous_jet
statement:
theorem continuous_jet (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A : RawJets I) (n m : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.continuous_jet_joint

theorem continuous_jet_joint (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.continuous_jet_parameter
statement:
theorem continuous_jet_parameter (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.derivWithin_jet
statement:
theorem derivWithin_jet (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient
statement:
theorem iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.iteratedDerivWithin_jet
statement:
theorem iteratedDerivWithin_jet (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_add (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A B : RawJets I)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w (A + B) n m x = jet I w A n m x + jet I w B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_ofJetFamily
statement:
theorem jet_ofJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    jet I w (ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound).1 n m x = J n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_ofSmoothFamily
statement:
theorem jet_ofSmoothFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    jet I w (ofSmoothFamily I w hw F hF C hC hbound).1 n m x =
      iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_rawOfJetFamily
statement:
theorem jet_rawOfJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    jet I w (rawOfJetFamily I w hw J hcont C hbound) n m x = J n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_smul (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (A : RawJets I)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w (c • A) n m x = c * jet I w A n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_sub (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A B : RawJets I)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w (A - B) n m x = jet I w A n m x - jet I w B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_zero (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w 0 n m x = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.norm_le_iff_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem norm_le_iff_derivative_bound (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m) (A : CoefficientSpace I w) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C ↔ ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval),
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| / w n m ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.norm_ofJetFamily_le
statement:
theorem norm_ofJetFamily_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m) :
    ‖ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.norm_ofSmoothFamily_le
statement:
theorem norm_ofSmoothFamily_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m) :
    ‖ofSmoothFamily I w hw F hF C hC hbound‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.normalized_derivative
statement:
theorem normalized_derivative (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, w n m ≠ 0) (A : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval) :
    iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x / w n m =
      A.1 ((n, m), x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.quotient_abs_derivative
statement:
theorem quotient_abs_derivative (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

    (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| / w n m =
      |A.1 ((n, m), x)|

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.coefficient_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem coefficient_iteratedDeriv (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n m : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (coefficient I (weight ε) A n) η = jet I (weight ε) A.1 n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.evaluationCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationCLM_apply (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    evaluationCLM I hε hR hR20 k m p hp A = mixedSeries I ε A k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.iteratedDeriv_Y
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv r (fun y => mixedSeries I ε A k m (y, η)) Y =
      mixedSeries I ε A (k + r) m (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.iteratedDeriv_eta
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.jetBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem jetBound_nonneg {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (k m : ℕ) :

statement: theorem linearForm_norm (u v : ℝ) : ‖linearForm u v‖ ≤ |u| + |v|

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.majorant_scale
statement:

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_add
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_add (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:
theorem mixedSeries_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :

statement:
theorem mixedSeries_contDiffAt_nat (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

theorem mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

theorem mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_sub
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_sub (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_sub_bound
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_sub_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :

statement:
theorem mixedSeries_summable (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:
theorem mixedSeries_uniform (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20)

statement:
theorem mixedSeries_zero (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixed_derivative_profile
statement:
theorem mixed_derivative_profile (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun x => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, x)) Y) η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) * Y ^ (n - k) *
        jet I (weight ε) A.1 n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixed_derivative_profile_coefficients
statement:
theorem mixed_derivative_profile_coefficients (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun x => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, x)) Y) η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) * Y ^ (n - k) *
        iteratedDeriv m (coefficient I (weight ε) A n) η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.polynomialJet_bound

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem term_hasFDerivAt (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.2 ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    HasFDerivAt (term I ε A k m n)
      (linearForm (term I ε A (k + 1) m n p) (term I ε A k (m + 1) n p)) p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_smul
statement:
theorem term_smul (I : Window) (ε c : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    term I ε (c • A) k m n p = c * term I ε A k m n p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_sub
statement:
theorem term_sub (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    term I ε (A - B) k m n p = term I ε A k m n p - term I ε B k m n p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.unitInterval_in_enlargedWindow
statement:
theorem unitInterval_in_enlargedWindow {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioo (enlargedUnitWindow δ hδ).left (enlargedUnitWindow δ hδ).right

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.weight_upper
statement:
theorem weight_upper {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m ≤ (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ n * (ε⁻¹) ^ m * (m.factorial : ℝ) *
      (((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ m)

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.average_row_bound
statement:
theorem average_row_bound {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    |1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)| * weight ε n (0 + m) ≤ 1 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.coefficient_product
statement:
theorem coefficient_product (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I (weight ε) (product I hε A B) n x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
        coefficient I (weight ε) A ij.1 x * coefficient I (weight ε) B ij.2 x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.continuousOn_leibnizSum
statement:
theorem continuousOn_leibnizSum (I : Window) (f g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (f k) I.interval)
    (hg : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (g k) I.interval) (m : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x => leibnizSum (fun k => f k x) (fun k => g k x) m) I.interval

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_bound
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r p : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (d b : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hshift : ∀ i k, weight ε i (p + k) ≤ C * b i * weight ε (i + 1) k)
    (hfactor : ∀ n i j, i + j = n → b i * d j ≤ radialDivisor r n)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m x| ≤
      ((64 * C) * ‖A‖ * ‖B‖) * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_continuous
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_continuous (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m) I.interval

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_deriv
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_deriv (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m)
      (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n (m + 1) x) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_succ_eq
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_succ_eq (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    differentialFamily I ε r p d A B (n + 1) m x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, (d ij.2 / radialDivisor r n) *
        leibnizSum (fun k => inputJet I ε A ij.1 (p + k) x)
          (fun l => inputJet I ε B ij.2 l x) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.hasDerivWithinAt_leibnizSum
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_leibnizSum (I : Window) (f g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ k x, x ∈ I.interval → HasDerivWithinAt (f k) (f (k + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (hg : ∀ k x, x ∈ I.interval → HasDerivWithinAt (g k) (g (k + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun y => leibnizSum (fun k => f k y) (fun k => g k y) m)
      (leibnizSum (fun k => f k x) (fun k => g k x) (m + 1)) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.inputJet_bound
statement:
theorem inputJet_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A : AxisSpace I ε)

    |inputJet I ε A n m x| ≤ ‖A‖ * weight ε n m

theorem inverse_row_bound {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n m : ℕ) :
    |inverseScale r n| * weight ε n.pred (0 + m) ≤ 80 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_bilinearLift
statement:
theorem jet_bilinearLift (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (F : BoundedBilinearJetFamily I ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (bilinearLift I hε F A B) n m x = F.value A B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_bilinearValue
statement:
theorem jet_bilinearValue (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (F : BoundedBilinearJetFamily I ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_inverseDotProduct
statement:
theorem jet_inverseDotProduct (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (inverseDotProduct I hε r hr A B) n m x =
      differentialFamily I ε r 0 (fun j => (j : ℝ)) A B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_inverseMixed
statement:
theorem jet_inverseMixed (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (inverseMixed I hε r hr A B) n m x =

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_inverseParamProduct
statement:
theorem jet_inverseParamProduct (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (inverseParamProduct I hε r hr A B) n m x =

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_linearLift
statement:
theorem jet_linearLift (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (F : BoundedLinearJetFamily I ε) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (linearLift I hε F A) n m x = F.value A n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_linearValue
statement:
theorem jet_linearValue (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (F : BoundedLinearJetFamily I ε) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_product
statement:
theorem jet_product (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (product I hε A B) n m x =
      jetProduct (fun i k => inputJet I ε A i k x) (fun j l => inputJet I ε B j l x) n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_regularInverse_succ
statement:
theorem jet_regularInverse_succ (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (regularInverse I hε r hr A) (n + 1) m x =
      inputJet I ε A n m x / radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_regularInverse_zero
statement:
theorem jet_regularInverse_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.leibnizSum_succ
statement:
theorem leibnizSum_succ (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    leibnizSum f g (m + 1) =
      leibnizSum (fun k => f (k + 1)) g m +
        leibnizSum f (fun l => g (l + 1)) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.leibniz_boundary
statement:
theorem leibniz_boundary (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal m, (m.choose kl.1 : ℝ) * f kl.1 * g (kl.2 + 1)) =
      f 0 * g (m + 1) +
        ∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal m, (m.choose (kl.1 + 1) : ℝ) * f (kl.1 + 1) * g kl.2

statement:
