name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.angular_remainder_expansion
statement:
theorem angular_remainder_expansion
    (t h D η d U W H κ φ u bu buη φdot φη : ℝ) :
    ((W + h - 2 * h * η * U) * φ + W * φdot + H * φη) +
        d * κ * u * φ -
        t * (((2 * D * η) * bu + (2 * h * η) * u) * φ +
          d * buη * φ + (2 * D * η) * bu * φdot +
          d * buη * φdot - d * u * φη) =
      ((W - t * ((2 * D * η) * bu + d * buη)) +
          h * (1 - 2 * η * (U + t * u)) + d * u * κ) * φ +
        (W - t * ((2 * D * η) * bu + d * buη)) * φdot +
        (H + t * d * u) * φη

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.axial_remainder_expansion
statement:
theorem axial_remainder_expansion
    (t A D η d U Uη W H u bu buη udot uη P Pη Pdot : ℝ) :
    ((A - 4 * A * η * U + d * Uη) * u + W * udot + H * uη) -
        t * ((2 * A * η) * (u * u) + (2 * D * η) * bu * udot +
          d * buη * udot - d * u * uη) +
        (-4 * A * η * P + d * Pη - 2 * η * Pdot) =
      A * (1 - 4 * η * U) * u - 2 * A * η * t * (u * u) +
        (W - t * ((2 * D * η) * bu + d * buη)) * udot +
        H * uη + d * Uη * u + t * d * u * uη -
        4 * A * η * P + d * Pη - 2 * η * Pdot

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.coefficient_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem coefficient_fixedPoint
    (I : AxisCoefficientSpace.Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (d : AxisData (AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε))
    (S : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε →L[ℝ] AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    let O := coefficientOperators I hε
    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ →
      ∀ a : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε, ‖a‖ ≤ M →
      ∃ x : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε × AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        referencePair O d S +
          (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a x = x ∧
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤
          remainderBound O d S (‖referencePair O d S‖ + 1) M (by positivity) hM / (2 * Λ) ∧
        ∀ y, ‖y - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 →
          referencePair O d S +
            (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a y = y → y = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.evaluated_mixed_error
statement:
theorem evaluated_mixed_error (I : AxisCoefficientSpace.Window)

    (A B : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε) (K : ℝ) (hK : ‖A - B‖ ≤ K)
    (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| ≤ R) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv m
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A (y, z)) Y) η -
      iteratedDeriv m
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => AxisEvaluation.profile I ε B (y, z)) Y) η‖ ≤
        AxisEvaluation.jetBound ε R k m * K

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.exists_fixedPoint_of_controlled
statement:
theorem exists_fixedPoint_of_controlled [CompleteSpace E]
    (x₀ : E) (f : Controlled E E (‖x₀‖ + 1))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hbound : s * f.bound ≤ 1)
    (hlip : s * f.lip ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∃ x : E, ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      x₀ + s • f.eval x = x ∧
      ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ s * f.bound ∧
      ∀ y : E, ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 1 → x₀ + s • f.eval y = y → y = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.exists_unique_natural_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem exists_unique_natural_fixedPoint [CompleteSpace V]
    (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V) (S : V →L[ℝ] V)
    (x₀ : V × V) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : contractionThreshold O d S x₀ M hM ≤ Λ)
    (a : V) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M) :
    ∃ x : V × V, ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      x₀ + (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a x = x ∧
      ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ remainderBound O d S (‖x₀‖ + 1) M (by positivity) hM / (2 * Λ) ∧
      ∀ y : V × V, ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 1 →
        x₀ + (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a y = y → y = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.fixedPoint_integrated_equations
statement:
theorem fixedPoint_integrated_equations (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S Q : V →L[ℝ] V) (hS : ∀ y : V, S y + Q (S y) = y)
    (t s : ℝ) (a : V) (x : V × V)
    (hfixed : referencePair O d S + s • naturalRemainder O d S t a x = x) :
    x.1 + Q x.1 =
        d.one + s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).1 ∧
      x.2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • O.j1 (O.product d.inverseL d.zStar) +
        s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).2

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.integrated_equations_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem integrated_equations_fixedPoint (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S Q : V →L[ℝ] V) (hS : ∀ y : V, S (y + Q y) = y)
    (t s : ℝ) (a : V) (x : V × V)
    (hφ : x.1 + Q x.1 =
      d.one + s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).1)
    (hu : x.2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • O.j1 (O.product d.inverseL d.zStar) +
      s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).2) :
    referencePair O d S + s • naturalRemainder O d S t a x = x

statement:

statement:
theorem naturalRemainder_sub_le (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S : V →L[ℝ] V) (R M : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) (a : V) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M)

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.natural_axis_profiles
statement:
theorem natural_axis_profiles
    (I : AxisCoefficientSpace.Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε)
    (d : AxisData (AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε))
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    let O := coefficientOperators I hε
    let S := AxisResolvent.naturalResolvent I hε χ
    let Q := AxisResolvent.naturalOperator I hε χ
    let x₀ := referencePair O d S
    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ →
      ∀ a : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε, ‖a‖ ≤ M →
      ∃ x : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε × AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ remainderBound O d S (‖x₀‖ + 1) M (by positivity) hM / (2 * Λ) ∧
        x.1 + Q x.1 = d.one + (1 / (2 * Λ)) •
          (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) (1 / Λ) a x).1 ∧
        x.2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • O.j1 (O.product d.inverseL d.zStar) +
          (1 / (2 * Λ)) • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) (1 / Λ) a x).2 ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.1) (AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.2) (AxisEvaluation.strip I 20)

statement:

statement:

    (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V) (S : V →L[ℝ] V)

    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ → ∀ a : V, ‖a‖ ≤ M →
      ∃ x : V × V,
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        referencePair O d S +

        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤

        ∀ y : V × V, ‖y - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 →

            (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a y = y → y = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.average_axis

statement:
theorem average_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:

    (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :

      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, profile I ε A (y, η)

statement:

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.differentialFamily_cancel
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_cancel (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (d : ℕ → ℝ) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n : ℕ) (η : ℝ) :
    radialDivisor r n * differentialFamily I ε r p d A B (n + 1) 0 η =
      ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, inputJet I ε A ij.1 p η *
        (d ij.2 * inputJet I ε B ij.2 0 η)

statement:

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.inverseMixed_actual_equation
statement:
theorem inverseMixed_actual_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    Y * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun y => profile I ε (inverseMixed I hε r hr A B) (y, η)) Y +
      (r : ℝ) * deriv (fun y => profile I ε (inverseMixed I hε r hr A B) (y, η)) Y =
      deriv (fun x => profile I ε A (Y, x)) η *
        (Y * deriv (fun y => profile I ε B (y, η)) Y)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.inverseMixed_axis_zero
statement:
theorem inverseMixed_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    profile I ε (inverseMixed I hε r hr A B) (0, η) = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.inverseMixed_equation
statement:
theorem inverseMixed_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : |Y| < 20) (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    radialValue I ε r (inverseMixed I hε r hr A B) (Y, η) =
      mixedSeries I ε A 0 1 (Y, η) * (Y * mixedSeries I ε B 1 0 (Y, η))

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.inverseParamProduct_axis_zero
statement:
theorem inverseParamProduct_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.inverseParamProduct_equation
statement:
theorem inverseParamProduct_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : |Y| < 20) (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    radialValue I ε r (inverseParamProduct I hε r hr A B) (Y, η) =

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.jet_average_eval
statement:
theorem jet_average_eval (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (average I hε A) n m η = inputJet I ε A n m η / ((n : ℝ) + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.jet_mulY_eval
statement:
theorem jet_mulY_eval (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (mulY I hε A) n m η = multiplyYScale n * inputJet I ε A n.pred m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.jet_parameterPrimitive_eval
statement:
theorem jet_parameterPrimitive_eval (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (parameterPrimitive I hε A) n m η =
      primitiveScale n * inputJet I ε A n.pred (1 + m) η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.jet_primitive_eval
statement:
theorem jet_primitive_eval (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterPrimitive_Y_value
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitive_Y_value (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterPrimitive_axis_zero
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitive_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterPrimitive_eq_deriv_eta
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitive_eq_deriv_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterPrimitive_eta_value
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitive_eta_value (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitive_hasDerivAt (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterSeries
statement:
theorem parameterSeries (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (m : ℕ) (Y η : ℝ) :
    mixedSeries I ε A 0 m (Y, η) = ∑' n : ℕ, Y ^ n * inputJet I ε A n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.parameterSeries_norm_summable
statement:
theorem parameterSeries_norm_summable (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < 20) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖Y ^ n * inputJet I ε A n m η‖)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.polynomialJet_dot
statement:
theorem polynomialJet_dot (n : ℕ) (Y : ℝ) :
    Y * polynomialJet n 1 Y = (n : ℝ) * Y ^ n

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.polynomialJet_radial
statement:
theorem polynomialJet_radial (r n : ℕ) (Y : ℝ) :
    Y * polynomialJet (n + 1) 2 Y + (r : ℝ) * polynomialJet (n + 1) 1 Y =
      radialDivisor r n * Y ^ n

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.powerSeries_mul
statement:
theorem powerSeries_mul {f g : ℕ → ℝ} {Y : ℝ}
    (hf : Summable (fun n => ‖Y ^ n * f n‖))
    (hg : Summable (fun n => ‖Y ^ n * g n‖)) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, Y ^ n * f n) * (∑' n : ℕ, Y ^ n * g n) =
      ∑' n : ℕ, Y ^ n * ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, f ij.1 * g ij.2

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.primitive_Y_value
statement:
theorem primitive_Y_value (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.primitive_axis_zero
statement:
theorem primitive_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.primitive_eq_mulY_average
statement:
theorem primitive_eq_mulY_average (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.primitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem primitive_hasDerivAt (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.primitive_integral
statement:
theorem primitive_integral (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20)
    (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    profile I ε (primitive I hε A) (Y, η) =
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, profile I ε A (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_axis
statement:
theorem profile_axis (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (η : ℝ) :
    profile I ε A (0, η) = coefficient I (weight ε) A 0 η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_deriv_Y
statement:
theorem profile_deriv_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_deriv_eta
statement:
theorem profile_deriv_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_iteratedDeriv_Y
statement:
theorem profile_iteratedDeriv_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20)

    iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, η)) Y = mixedSeries I ε A k 0 (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_mulY
statement:
theorem profile_mulY (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < 20) (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    profile I ε (mulY I hε A) (Y, η) = Y * profile I ε A (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_product
statement:
theorem profile_product (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < 20) (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    profile I ε (product I hε A B) (Y, η) =
      profile I ε A (Y, η) * profile I ε B (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.profile_series_norm_summable
statement:
theorem profile_series_norm_summable (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < 20) :
    Summable (fun n => ‖Y ^ n * coefficient I (weight ε) A n η‖)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.radialValue_eq_derivatives
statement:
theorem radialValue_eq_derivatives (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20)
    (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    radialValue I ε r A (Y, η) =
      Y * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun y => profile I ε A (y, η)) Y +
        (r : ℝ) * deriv (fun y => profile I ε A (y, η)) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.radialValue_of_convolution
statement:
theorem radialValue_of_convolution (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (C : AxisSpace I ε) (f g : ℕ → ℝ) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < 20)
    (hf : Summable (fun n => ‖Y ^ n * f n‖))
    (hg : Summable (fun n => ‖Y ^ n * g n‖))
    (hC : ∀ n, radialDivisor r n * inputJet I ε C (n + 1) 0 η =
      ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, f ij.1 * g ij.2) :
    radialValue I ε r C (Y, η) = (∑' n, Y ^ n * f n) * (∑' n, Y ^ n * g n)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.radialValue_series
statement:
theorem radialValue_series (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < 20) :
    radialValue I ε r A (Y, η) =
      ∑' n : ℕ, radialDivisor r n * Y ^ n * coefficient I (weight ε) A (n + 1) η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.radial_segment_mem
statement:
theorem radial_segment_mem {Y y : ℝ} (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.regularInverse_actual_equation
statement:
theorem regularInverse_actual_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    Y * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun y => profile I ε (regularInverse I hε r hr A) (y, η)) Y +
      (r : ℝ) * deriv (fun y => profile I ε (regularInverse I hε r hr A) (y, η)) Y =
      profile I ε A (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.regularInverse_axis_zero
statement:
theorem regularInverse_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    profile I ε (regularInverse I hε r hr A) (0, η) = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluationAlgebra.regularInverse_equation
statement:
theorem regularInverse_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A : AxisSpace I ε) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : |Y| < 20) (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    radialValue I ε r (regularInverse I hε r hr A) (Y, η) = profile I ε A (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.angular_remainder_evaluation
statement:
theorem angular_remainder_evaluation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (hd : CompatibleData I ε χ d) (t : ℝ) (a : AxisSpace I ε)
    (x : AxisSpace I ε × AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε 2
        (AxisContraction.naturalRemainder (AxisContraction.coefficientOperators I hε)
          d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) t a x).1 p =
      angularRemainder (parameters I ε χ d) t
        (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.1) (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.2)
        (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (AxisOperators.average I hε x.2)) p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.axial_remainder_evaluation
statement:
theorem axial_remainder_evaluation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (hd : CompatibleData I ε χ d) (t : ℝ) (a : AxisSpace I ε)
    (x : AxisSpace I ε × AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε 1
        (AxisContraction.naturalRemainder (AxisContraction.coefficientOperators I hε)
          d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) t a x).2 p =
      axialRemainder (parameters I ε χ d) t
        (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.2)
        (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (AxisOperators.average I hε x.2))
        (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (pressureCoefficient I hε a x.1)) p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.coefficient_product_constant
statement:
theorem coefficient_product_constant (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (hA : RadiallyConstant I ε A)
    (n : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I (weight ε) (AxisOperators.product I hε A B) n η =
      coefficient I (weight ε) A 0 η * coefficient I (weight ε) B n η

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.errorConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem errorConstant_nonneg (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 ≤ errorConstant I hε χ d M hM

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.exists_scaled_profiles
statement:
theorem exists_scaled_profiles (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (hd : CompatibleData I ε χ d) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ →
      ∀ a : AxisSpace I ε, ‖a‖ ≤ M → RadiallyConstant I ε a →
      ∃ Φ u B P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        IsScaledSolution I (parameters I ε χ d) (1 / Λ) (inputValue I ε a) Φ u B P ∧
        UniformMixedError I ε (errorConstant I hε χ d M hM / (2 * Λ))
          Φ u (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (referenceCoefficients I hε χ d).1)
          (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (referenceCoefficients I hε χ d).2)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.integrated_solution
statement:
theorem integrated_solution (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (hd : CompatibleData I ε χ d) (t s : ℝ) (hst : 2 * s = t)
    (a : AxisSpace I ε) (ha : RadiallyConstant I ε a)
    (x : AxisSpace I ε × AxisSpace I ε)
    (hφ : x.1 + AxisResolvent.naturalOperator I hε χ x.1 =
      d.one + s • (AxisContraction.naturalRemainder
        (AxisContraction.coefficientOperators I hε) d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) t a x).1)
    (hu : x.2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • AxisOperators.regularInverse I hε 1 (by norm_num)
        (AxisOperators.product I hε d.inverseL d.zStar) +
      s • (AxisContraction.naturalRemainder
        (AxisContraction.coefficientOperators I hε) d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) t a x).2) :
    IsScaledSolution I (parameters I ε χ d) t (inputValue I ε a)
      (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.1) (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε x.2)
      (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (AxisOperators.average I hε x.2))
      (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (pressureCoefficient I hε a x.1))

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.mixedDerivative_profile
statement:
theorem mixedDerivative_profile (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    mixedDerivative k m (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A) p =
      AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries I ε A k m p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.naturalOperator_axis_zero
statement:
theorem naturalOperator_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.partialEta_profile
statement:
theorem partialEta_profile (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    partialEta (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A) p = AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries I ε A 0 1 p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.partialY_profile
statement:
theorem partialY_profile (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.pressure_equation
statement:
theorem pressure_equation (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (a Φ : AxisSpace I ε) (ha : RadiallyConstant I ε a)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    partialY (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (pressureCoefficient I hε a Φ)) p =
      (inputValue I ε a p.2) ^ 2 * (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε Φ p) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.pressure_integral
statement:
theorem pressure_integral (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (a Φ : AxisSpace I ε) (ha : RadiallyConstant I ε a)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (pressureCoefficient I hε a Φ) p =
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..p.1,
        (inputValue I ε a p.2) ^ 2 * (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε Φ (y, p.2)) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_add
statement:
theorem profile_add (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (A + B) p =
      AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A p + AxisEvaluation.profile I ε B p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_inputValue
statement:
theorem profile_inputValue (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_neg

theorem profile_neg (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_radiallyConstant
statement:
theorem profile_radiallyConstant (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_smul
statement:
theorem profile_smul (I : Window) (ε c : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_sub
statement:
theorem profile_sub (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (A - B) p =
      AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A p - AxisEvaluation.profile I ε B p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.profile_zero
statement:
theorem profile_zero (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (0 : AxisSpace I ε) p = 0

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_add
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_add (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r (A + B) p =
      radialEvaluation I ε r A p + radialEvaluation I ε r B p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_constant
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_constant (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (hA : RadiallyConstant I ε A)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r A p = 0

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_dot
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_dot (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r (AxisOperators.inverseDotProduct I hε r hr A B) p =
      AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A p * (p.1 * partialY (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε B) p)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_eq
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_eq (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r A p = radialDifferential r (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A) p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_mixed
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_mixed (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r (AxisOperators.inverseMixed I hε r hr A B) p =
      partialEta (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A) p *
        (p.1 * partialY (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε B) p)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_naturalOperator
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_naturalOperator (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ A : AxisSpace I ε) (hχ : RadiallyConstant I ε χ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε 2 (AxisResolvent.naturalOperator I hε χ A) p =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inputValue I ε χ p.2 * AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_param
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_param (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (A B : AxisSpace I ε)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r (AxisOperators.inverseParamProduct I hε r hr A B) p =

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_product_constant
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_product_constant (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r : ℕ) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (hA : RadiallyConstant I ε A)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip I 20) :
    radialEvaluation I ε r (AxisOperators.product I hε A B) p =
      AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A p * radialEvaluation I ε r B p

statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_regularInverse (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_smul
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_smul (I : Window) (ε c : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.radialEvaluation_sub
statement:
theorem radialEvaluation_sub (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisBridge.remainder_axis_zero
statement:
theorem remainder_axis_zero (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε)) (t : ℝ) (a : AxisSpace I ε)
    (x : AxisSpace I ε × AxisSpace I ε) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    AxisEvaluation.profile I ε
        (AxisContraction.naturalRemainder (AxisContraction.coefficientOperators I hε)
          d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) t a x).1 (0, η) = 0 ∧

name: NavierStokes.AxisReference.coefficient_naturalOperator_succ
statement:
theorem coefficient_naturalOperator_succ (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ A : AxisSpace I ε) (hχ : RadiallyConstant I ε χ)
    (n : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I (weight ε) (AxisResolvent.naturalOperator I hε χ A) (n + 1) η =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (coefficient I (weight ε) χ 0 η *
        coefficient I (weight ε) A n η / radialDivisor 2 n)

name: NavierStokes.AxisReference.exists_positive_scaled_profiles
statement:
theorem exists_positive_scaled_profiles (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (hd : CompatibleData I ε χ d)
    (hχ : ∀ η ∈ I.interval, 0 ≤ inputValue I ε χ η ∧ inputValue I ε χ η ≤ 1)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ →
      ∀ a : AxisSpace I ε, ‖a‖ ≤ M → RadiallyConstant I ε a →
      ∃ Φ u B P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        IsScaledSolution I (parameters I ε χ d) (1 / Λ) (inputValue I ε a) Φ u B P ∧
        UniformMixedError I ε (errorConstant I hε χ d M hM / (2 * Λ))
          Φ u (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (referenceCoefficients I hε χ d).1)
          (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (referenceCoefficients I hε χ d).2) ∧
        (∀ Y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (41 / 10), ∀ η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right, 1 / 8 < Φ (Y, η)) ∧
        (∀ η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right, 99 / 100 ≤ inputValue I ε χ η →
          23 / 10 < -8 * partialY Φ (4, η) / Φ (4, η))

name: NavierStokes.AxisReference.log_slope_of_uniformMixedError
statement:
theorem log_slope_of_uniformMixedError (I : Window) {ε K Λ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : AxisSpace I ε) (d : AxisContraction.AxisData (AxisSpace I ε))
    (hd : CompatibleData I ε χ d) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hΛ : stabilityScale ε K ≤ Λ)
    {Φ u u₀ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (herr : UniformMixedError I ε (K / (2 * Λ)) Φ u
      (AxisEvaluation.profile I ε (referenceCoefficients I hε χ d).1) u₀)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right)
    (hχ99 : 99 / 100 ≤ inputValue I ε χ η) (hχ1 : inputValue I ε χ η ≤ 1) :
    23 / 10 < -8 * partialY Φ (4, η) / Φ (4, η)

statement:
theorem log_slope_stability {v₀ v d₀ d : ℝ}

    (hderiv : |d - d₀| ≤ 1 / 1000) (hslope : 236 / 100 < -8 * d₀ / v₀) :

statement:
theorem positive_of_uniformMixedError (I : Window) {ε K Λ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:
theorem referenceCoefficients_deriv_Y_eq (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:

name: NavierStokes.AxisReference.reference_coefficient
statement:
theorem reference_coefficient (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ e : AxisSpace I ε) (hχ : RadiallyConstant I ε χ)
    (he : RadiallyConstant I ε e) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval)
    (he0 : coefficient I (weight ε) e 0 η = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient I (weight ε) (AxisResolvent.naturalResolvent I hε χ e) n η =
      (-coefficient I (weight ε) χ 0 η / 2) ^ n /
        ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.AxisReference.reference_coefficient_succ
statement:
theorem reference_coefficient_succ (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ e : AxisSpace I ε) (hχ : RadiallyConstant I ε χ)
    (he : RadiallyConstant I ε e) (n : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I (weight ε) (AxisResolvent.naturalResolvent I hε χ e) (n + 1) η =
      (-coefficient I (weight ε) χ 0 η / 2) *
        coefficient I (weight ε) (AxisResolvent.naturalResolvent I hε χ e) n η /
          radialDivisor 2 n

theorem uniform_normalizedExp_axisData

    (hε : 0 < ε) (hερ : ε < ρ)
    (hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (closedTube I ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ closedTube I ρ, (F z).re ≤ M)
    (hreal : ∀ x ∈ I.interval, (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0) :
    ∀ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ → ∀ C : ℝ, Real.exp (Λ * M) ≤ C →
      ∃ a : AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖a‖ ≤ radiusLoss (ε / ρ) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ I.interval, coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a 0 x =
          Real.exp (Λ * (F (x : ℂ)).re) / C) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∀ x ∈ I.interval,
          coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a n x = 0)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalProfile.angular_equation_reconstruct
statement:
theorem angular_equation_reconstruct {h j σ Λ : ℝ} {P0 a₀ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    {Φ u B P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsScaledSolution window (actualData h j σ P0) (1 / Λ) a₀ Φ u B P)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ)
    (ha : HasDerivAt a₀ ((Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2) * a₀ p.2) p.2) :
    2 * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * radialDifferential 2 (angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ) p =
      transportW h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ B) p *
        (p.1 * partialY (angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ) p + angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ p) +
      h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u p) *
        angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ p +
      transportH h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p *
        partialEta (angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ) p

    (b : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) {u B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    (havg : ∀ q ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip window 20,
      q.1 * B q = ∫ Y in (0 : ℝ)..q.1, u (Y, q.2))
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) :
    p.1 * affineProfile b c Λ B p =
      ∫ X in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, affineProfile b c Λ u (X, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalProfile.axial_equation_reconstruct
statement:
theorem axial_equation_reconstruct {h j σ Λ : ℝ} {P0 a₀ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) {Φ u B P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsScaledSolution window (actualData h j σ P0) (1 / Λ) a₀ Φ u B P)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) :
    2 * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 *
        radialDifferential 1 (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p =
      transportW h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ B) p *
        (p.1 * partialY (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p) +
      NaturalAxisData.A h *
        (1 - 2 * p.2 * affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u p) *
        affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u p +
      transportH h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p *
        partialEta (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p +
      NaturalAxisData.d p.2 * partialEta (affineProfile P0 (1 / Λ) Λ P) p -
      4 * NaturalAxisData.A h * p.2 * affineProfile P0 (1 / Λ) Λ P p -
      2 * p.2 * p.1 * partialY (affineProfile P0 (1 / Λ) Λ P) p

statement:

    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j)
    {g a : ℝ → ℝ} {cap B : ℝ}
    (hp : PressureDatum.Admissible g a cap) (hB : 2 ≤ B)
    (hg : ∀ y ≤ 0, g y = B ^ 2 * Real.exp ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * y))
    (ha : ∀ y ≤ 0, a y = 1) :
    ∃ δ σ Λ C : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < σ ∧ 0 < Λ ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∃ f U V Pr : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        IsNaturalSolution h j Λ (PressureDatum.pressure g a)
          (realAmplitude h j σ Λ C) f U V Pr ∧
        (∀ p ∈ domain Λ, 0 ≤ Λ * p.1 → Λ * p.1 ≤ 41 / 10 → 0 < f p) ∧
        (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          |NaturalAxisData.Z h j (PressureDatum.pressure g a) η| ≤ δ →
            23 / 10 < -2 * (4 / Λ) * partialY f (4 / Λ, η) / f (4 / Λ, η))

    ∃ δ₀ > 0, ∀ δ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ → ∀ X, N.endpoint ≤ X → ∀ η ∈ K,

      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => Φ (N.refU δ (X, y), N.U (N.endpoint, y))) η -
        iteratedDeriv k (fun y => Φ (N.U (N.endpoint, y), N.U (N.endpoint, y))) η| < ε

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.histories_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem histories_difference_factorization {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) -
      profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) =
        y * activation T κ y *
          historyDifferenceFamily T N.endpoint (refLog N δ) (refAxial N δ) r ((κ, y), η)

    profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (N.endpoint, η) =

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.histories_log_formula
statement:
theorem histories_log_formula {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) =
      logHistory N.endpoint
        (fun s ξ => profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) s (N.endpoint, ξ))
        (activatedAngular T κ (refLog N δ)) (controlled T κ (refAxial N δ)) r (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.histories_parameter_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem histories_parameter_jet_bounds {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ parameterInterval) (r : HistoryRow) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
        profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ) -
          profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ)) η| ≤
            M * y * activation T κ y

theorem refU_logPullback {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit)
    (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    logPullback N.endpoint (N.refU δ) (y, η) = refAxial N δ (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.reference_histories_log_formula
statement:
theorem reference_histories_log_formula {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit)
    (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) =
      logHistory N.endpoint
        (fun s ξ => profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) s (N.endpoint, ξ))
        (referenceAngular (refLog N δ)) (refAxial N δ) r (y, η)

theorem activation_angular_equation (T κ : ℝ) {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L : Field}

theorem activation_flat_form {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.actualP2_eq
statement:
theorem actualP2_eq (T κ : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    actualP2 T κ X0 L U (y, η) = damping T κ y * referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) *

NavierStokes.StressActivation.angular_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem angular_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.angular_relative_difference
statement:
theorem angular_relative_difference {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.angular_relative_parameter_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem angular_relative_parameter_jet_bounds {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {J K : Set ℝ}
    (hJ : IsOpen J) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {L : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
        activatedAngular T κ L (y, ξ) / referenceAngular L (y, ξ) - 1) η| ≤
          M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.compact_parameter_jet_bound
statement:

    (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H ((univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ×ˢ J)) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => H ((κ, y), ξ)) η| ≤ M

theorem controlled_bound {T κ M y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ ≤ 1)

    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (logDomain J hJ).carrier) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |radialPartial F (t, η)| ≤ M) :
    |controlled T κ F (y, η) - F (y, η)| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.controlled_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem controlled_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {F : Field}

theorem density_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ X0 : ℝ)

    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U) r (y, η) -
      logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U r (y, η) =

statement:
theorem history_difference_integral {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ X0 : ℝ)

      logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U r (y, η) =

        logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U) r (y, ξ) -

    {H : FamilyPoint → ℝ} (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H ((univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ×ˢ J))
    {E : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ κ y, ∀ η ∈ J, E κ y η = y * activation T κ y * H ((κ, y), η))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (E κ y) η| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.shearSize_error
statement:
theorem shearSize_error (T : ℝ) {κ X0 : ℝ} (hκ : κ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hp : referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0) :
    shearSize T κ X0 L U (y, η) - damping T κ y * referenceSize X0 L U (y, η) =
      damping T κ y * (referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) ^ 2 / referenceP1 L (y, η)) *
        ((referenceAngular L (y, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, η)) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.shearSlope_eq
statement:
theorem shearSlope_eq (T : ℝ) {κ X0 : ℝ} (hκ : κ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hp : referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0) :
    shearSlope T κ X0 L U (y, η) =
      (referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) / referenceP1 L (y, η)) *
        (referenceAngular L (y, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, η))

statement:

    (hδ0R : 2 * δ0 < rampLimit) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ parameterInterval) (r : HistoryRow) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T (hT : T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) δ0) (hTR : 2 * T < rampLimit),
      ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          profileHistory (FromReference.histories N hT.1 hT.1 hTR κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ) -
            profileHistory (N.histories hT.1 hTR P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ)) η| ≤
              M * y * activation T κ y

statement:

    (hTR : 2 * T < rampLimit) (hδ0 : 0 < δ0) (hδ0R : 2 * δ0 < rampLimit)
    (hTδ0 : T ≤ δ0) (κ : ℝ) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (r : HistoryRow) {u η : ℝ} (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (FromReference.histories N hT hT hTR κ P0 hP0) r
        (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) -
      profileHistory (N.histories hT hTR P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) =
        scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) *
          historyErrorFactor N.endpoint (FromReference.refLog N δ0) (FromReference.refAxial N δ0) r
            ((κ, T), (u, η))

      T * weightedPrimitive 1 κ (fun p => B (T * p.1, p.2)) (u, η)

theorem weightedPrimitive_scaled_factor {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (κ : ℝ) (B : Field) (u η : ℝ) :

      scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * primitiveErrorFactor B ((κ, T), (u, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.weightedPrimitive_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem weightedPrimitive_uniform_jets {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {B : Field} (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (T0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => weightedPrimitive T κ B (y, ξ)) η| ≤
          M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.width_uniform_jet_bound
statement:
theorem width_uniform_jet_bound {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hK : IsCompact K)

    {E : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ κ T, 0 < T → ∀ u η, η ∈ J →
      E κ T (T * u) η = scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * H ((κ, T), (u, η)))
    (T0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,

statement:
theorem EntranceProfile.regular_cone_at_four {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (F : EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    let p : ℝ × ℝ := (4 / Λ, η)
    let q := p.1 * regularAngularLag h F.profile.family.f F.profile.family.U
      F.profile.family.Ubar p / NaturalAxisData.L h η
    let n := p.1 * regularAxialLag h F.profile.family.U F.profile.family.Ubar
      F.profile.family.Pi p / (NaturalAxisData.L h η * angularVelocity F.profile.family.f p)

statement:
theorem Sq_coefficient_identity {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0) (x : CoefficientPair d.coefficients.epsilon)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hC : 0 < C) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ)
    (hval : 1 / 8 ≤ AxisEvaluation.profile window d.coefficients.epsilon x.1
      (rescalePoint Λ p)) :
    Sq h (angularField h j σ Λ C x) (axialField j Λ x)
        (averageField j Λ d.coefficients.epsilon_pos x) p =
      NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +

statement:
theorem Sq_reconstruction {h j σ Λ : ℝ} (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ → ℝ}
    {Φ u B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) (ha : a p.2 ≠ 0)
    (hval : 1 / 8 ≤ Φ (rescalePoint Λ p))
    (had : HasDerivAt a ((Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2) * a p.2) p.2) :
    Sq h (angularProfile a Λ Φ)
      (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u)
      (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ B) p =
      NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +
        sourceRemainder h j σ (rescalePoint Λ p) (1 / Λ)
          ![Φ (rescalePoint Λ p), partialY Φ (rescalePoint Λ p),
            partialEta Φ (rescalePoint Λ p), u (rescalePoint Λ p),
            B (rescalePoint Λ p), partialEta B (rescalePoint Λ p)]

    (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (T0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ hT : 0 < T, T ≤ T0 → ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,

            M * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |profileStockTwo (StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) h

name: NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.log_stocks_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem log_stocks_uniform_jets {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ J)
    (T0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          logViewOne h X0 (activatedAngular T κ L)
              (logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)) (y, ξ) -
            logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
              (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, ξ)) η| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          logViewTwo h X0 (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)
              (logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)) (y, ξ) -
            logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
              (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, ξ)) η| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.boundary_polynomial
statement:
theorem boundary_polynomial (P J v : ℝ) :
    2 * (P - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * J ^ 2 =
      2 * v ^ 2 - (4 * P + J ^ 2) * v + 2 * P ^ 2 + 2 * J ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.coneBound_gt_two
statement: theorem coneBound_gt_two {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) : 2 < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.coneBound_le_parameter
statement: theorem coneBound_le_parameter {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) : coneBound P J ≤ P

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.equation_eleven_sufficient
statement:
theorem equation_eleven_sufficient {a b w : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hfirst : 0 < a - b * w)
    (hsecond : 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a + (a - 2) * w ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ p₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p →
      2 < p * (1 - b * w / a) ∧ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) <
        coneBound (p * (1 - b * w / a)) (p * (w + b / a))

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.finite_amplitude_cone
statement:
theorem finite_amplitude_cone {c j v p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hP : 2 < p * c) (hvP : v < p * c)
    (hscale : 4 * c * v < p * (2 * c ^ 2 - (v - 2) * j ^ 2)) :
    v < coneBound (p * c) (p * j)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.normalized_factorization
statement:
theorem normalized_factorization (a b w : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (w + b / a) ^ 2 -
        2 * (1 - b * w / a) ^ 2 =
      (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) * ((a - 2) * w ^ 2 + 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a - 2)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.normalized_test_negative
statement:
theorem normalized_test_negative {a b w : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hcriterion : 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a + (a - 2) * w ^ 2 < 2) :
    (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (w + b / a) ^ 2 -
      2 * (1 - b * w / a) ^ 2 < 0

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.relaxed_cone_of_le_two
statement:
theorem relaxed_cone_of_le_two {P J v : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) (hv : v ≤ 2) :
    v < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_ge_quarter
statement:
theorem rootTerm_ge_quarter {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) :
    J ^ 2 / 4 ≤ rootTerm P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem rootTerm_nonneg (P J : ℝ) : 0 ≤ rootTerm P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_sq
statement:
theorem rootTerm_sq {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) :
    rootTerm P J ^ 2 = J ^ 2 * ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.square_difference
statement:
theorem square_difference (P J v : ℝ) :
    (P + J ^ 2 / 4 - v) ^ 2 - J ^ 2 * ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16) =
      (P - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * J ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.sufficiently_large_amplitude_cone
statement:
theorem sufficiently_large_amplitude_cone {c j v : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmargin : (v - 2) * j ^ 2 < 2 * c ^ 2) :
    ∃ p₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p →
      2 < p * c ∧ v < coneBound (p * c) (p * j)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.true_cone_iff
statement:
theorem true_cone_iff {P J v : ℝ} (hv : 2 < v) :
    (2 < P ∧ v < coneBound P J) ↔
      (v < P ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 < 2 * (P - v) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_equation_eleven
statement:
theorem compact_equation_eleven {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ ε p₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ 1 - b x * w x / a x ∧
        ε ≤ 2 * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ^ 2 -
          (a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) - 2) * (w x + b x / a x) ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        2 < p * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ∧
        a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) <
          coneBound (p * (1 - b x * w x / a x)) (p * (w x + b x / a x))

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_equation_eleven_gap
statement:
theorem compact_equation_eleven_gap {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ η p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 + η < p * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ∧
        a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) + η <
          coneBound (p * (1 - b x * w x / a x)) (p * (w x + b x / a x))

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_family_quadratic_stable
statement:
theorem compact_family_quadratic_stable {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ P' J' v' : ℝ,
      |P' - P x| ≤ ρ → |J' - J x| ≤ ρ → |v' - v x| ≤ ρ →
        2 < v' ∧ v' < P' ∧ (v' - 2) * J' ^ 2 < 2 * (P' - v') ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_family_trueCone_stable
statement:
theorem compact_family_trueCone_stable {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ P' J' v' : ℝ,
      dist (P', J', v') (P x, J x, v x) ≤ ρ →
        2 < v' ∧ 2 < P' ∧ v' < coneBound P' J'

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_normalized_cone
statement:
theorem compact_normalized_cone {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c j v : X → ℝ} (hc : ContinuousOn c K) (hj : ContinuousOn j K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K) (hcpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < c x)
    (hmargin : ∀ x ∈ K, (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2 < 2 * c x ^ 2) :
    ∃ ε p₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ c x ∧ ε ≤ 2 * c x ^ 2 - (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        2 < p * c x ∧ v x < coneBound (p * c x) (p * j x)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_normalized_cone_gap
statement:
theorem compact_normalized_cone_gap {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c j v : X → ℝ} (hc : ContinuousOn c K) (hj : ContinuousOn j K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K) (hcpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < c x)
    (hmargin : ∀ x ∈ K, (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2 < 2 * c x ^ 2) :
    ∃ η p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 + η < p * c x ∧ v x + η < coneBound (p * c x) (p * j x)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_source_margins
statement:
theorem compact_source_margins {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ a x ∧ ε ≤ a x - b x * w x ∧
        ε ≤ 2 - (2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_trueCone_margins
statement:
theorem compact_trueCone_margins {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ v x - 2 ∧ ε ≤ P x - 2 ∧ ε ≤ coneBound (P x) (J x) - v x

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_trueCone_stable
statement:
theorem compact_trueCone_stable {S : Set ConeDatum} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hcone : S ⊆ trueCone) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ z' : ConeDatum,
      dist z' z ≤ ρ → z' ∈ trueCone

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.isOpen_trueCone

statement:

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.activation_uniform_collar
statement:
theorem activation_uniform_collar {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (θ * T), activation T κ y < m

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.actual_comparisons
statement:
theorem actual_comparisons (h : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ) {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hi : ∀ r, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (initial r) J)
    (hcoef : ∀ η ∈ J, NaturalAxisData.L h η ≠ 0)
    {T0 Mref : ℝ} (hT0 : T0 ≤ 1) (hMref : 0 ≤ Mref)
    (href : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K,
      referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0 ∧
      |referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η)| ≤ Mref ∧
      |referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) / referenceP1 L (y, η)| ≤ Mref ∧
      |referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) ^ 2 / referenceP1 L (y, η)| ≤ Mref)
    (hmatch : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K,
      ActivationStocks.logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP1 L (y, η) ∧
      ActivationStocks.logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |activatedProjection h X0 initial L U T κ (y, η) - referenceSize X0 L U (y, η)| ≤
          C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |shearSize T κ X0 L U (y, η) - damping T κ y * referenceSize X0 L U (y, η)| ≤
          C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |activatedCross h X0 initial L U T κ (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.collar_lower_of_errors
statement:
theorem collar_lower_of_errors {c B r e s v : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ r) (hrB : r ≤ B)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hs : s ≤ 1) (heB : e * (B + 1) ≤ c / 4)
    (hv : |v - (1 - e) * r| ≤ s * e) :
    2 + c / 2 < v

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.compact_reference_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_reference_bounds {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 < c) {A B : Field}
    (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K))
    (hB : ContinuousOn B (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K))
    (hApos : ∀ p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K, 0 < A p)
    (hzero : ∀ η ∈ K, 2 + 2 * c ≤ A (0, η) + B (0, η) ^ 2 / A (0, η)) :
    ∃ τ α M : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ T ∧ 0 < α ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) τ, ∀ η ∈ K,
        α ≤ A (y, η) ∧ 2 + c < A (y, η) + B (y, η) ^ 2 / A (y, η) ∧
        A (y, η) + B (y, η) ^ 2 / A (y, η) ≤ M ∧
        |B (y, η)| ≤ M ∧ |B (y, η) / A (y, η)| ≤ M ∧
        |B (y, η) ^ 2 / A (y, η)| ≤ M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.compact_reference_collar
statement:
theorem compact_reference_collar {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 < c) {r : Field}
    (hr : ContinuousOn r (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K))
    (hzero : ∀ η ∈ K, 2 + 2 * c ≤ r (0, η)) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ T ∧ ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) τ, ∀ η ∈ K,
      2 + c < r (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_comparison_from_stock_bounds
statement:
theorem cone_comparison_from_stock_bounds {κ A B z p q R M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hκ : |κ| ≤ 1) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (hB : |B| ≤ M) (hBA : |B / A| ≤ M) (hB2A : |B ^ 2 / A| ≤ M)
    (hp : |p - A| ≤ M * z) (hq : |q - B| ≤ M * z) (hR : |R - 1| ≤ M * z) :
    |stockProjection p q ((B / A) * R) - (A + B ^ 2 / A)| ≤ comparisonConstant M * z ∧
    |κ * (A + (B ^ 2 / A) * R ^ 2) - κ * (A + B ^ 2 / A)| ≤ comparisonConstant M * z ∧
    |stockCross p q ((B / A) * R)| ≤ comparisonConstant M * z

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_error_bounds
statement:
theorem cone_error_bounds {κ A B z dA dB dR M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hκ : |κ| ≤ 1) (hz : |z| ≤ 1)
    (hB : |B| ≤ M) (hBA : |B / A| ≤ M) (hB2A : |B ^ 2 / A| ≤ M)
    (hdA : |dA| ≤ M) (hdB : |dB| ≤ M) (hdR : |dR| ≤ M) :
    |projectionError A B z dA dB dR| ≤ comparisonConstant M ∧
    |crossError A B z dA dB dR| ≤ comparisonConstant M ∧
    |sizeError κ A B z dR| ≤ comparisonConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_error_factorizations
statement:
theorem cone_error_factorizations (κ A B z dA dB dR : ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    stockProjection (A + z * dA) (B + z * dB) ((B / A) * (1 + z * dR)) -
        (A + B ^ 2 / A) = z * projectionError A B z dA dB dR ∧
    stockCross (A + z * dA) (B + z * dB) ((B / A) * (1 + z * dR)) =
        z * crossError A B z dA dB dR ∧
    κ * (A + (B ^ 2 / A) * (1 + z * dR) ^ 2) - κ * (A + B ^ 2 / A) =
        z * sizeError κ A B z dR

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_gap_factorization
statement:
theorem cone_gap_factorization (r e y dP dv dJ : ℝ) :
    2 * ((r + y * e * dP) - ((1 - e) * r + y * e * dv)) ^ 2 -
        (((1 - e) * r + y * e * dv) - 2) * (y * e * dJ) ^ 2 =
      e ^ 2 * normalizedConeGap r ((1 - e) * r + y * e * dv) y dP dv dJ

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.errorTolerance_bounds
statement:
theorem errorTolerance_bounds {c B s : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hs : s ≤ errorTolerance c B) :
    s ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ s ≤ c / 2 ∧ (B + 1) * s ≤ 1 / 4

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.errorTolerance_pos
statement:
theorem errorTolerance_pos {c B : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    0 < errorTolerance c B

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.exists_actual_stress_direction
statement:
theorem exists_actual_stress_direction (h : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ) {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hKJ : K ⊆ J)
    {L U : Field} (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hi : ∀ r, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (initial r) J)
    (hcoef : ∀ η ∈ J, NaturalAxisData.L h η ≠ 0) {T0 : ℝ}
    (hmatch : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K,
      ActivationStocks.logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP1 L (y, η) ∧
      ActivationStocks.logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η)) :
    ∃ D : ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (ActivationBounds.scaledDomain J) ∧
      (∀ κ T η : ℝ, D ((κ, T), (0, η)) =
        (referenceAngular L (0, η) * referenceP1 L (0, η),
          referenceAngular L (0, η) * referenceP2 X0 L U (0, η))) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ κ u η : ℝ, T * u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0 → η ∈ K →
        activatedStress h X0 initial L U T κ (T * u, η) =
          (activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).1,
            activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.inverseRelativeError_smooth
NavierStokes.ActivationCone.inverse_relative_scaled_factor
statement:
theorem inverse_relative_scaled_factor {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (κ : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (u : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    referenceAngular L (T * u, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (T * u, η) - 1 =
      ActivationBounds.scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * inverseRelativeError L ((κ, T), (u, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.inverse_relative_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem inverse_relative_uniform_jets {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {L : Field} (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (T0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          referenceAngular L (y, ξ) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, ξ) - 1) η| ≤
            M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_activation_direction
statement:
theorem natural_activation_direction {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ∃ D : ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (ActivationBounds.scaledDomain ReferencePath.parameterInterval) ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      (∀ κ T η : ℝ, η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
        ε ≤ (D ((κ, T), (0, η))).1 ∧
        ε ≤ (D ((κ, T), (0, η))).1 +
          (referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (0, η) / referenceP1 L (0, η)) *
            (D ((κ, T), (0, η))).2 - 2 * referenceAngular L (0, η)) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ κ u η : ℝ, T * u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) δ → η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
        activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (T * u, η) =
          (activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).1,
            activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_initial_activation
statement:
theorem natural_initial_activation {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ∃ Tstar θ : ℝ, 0 < Tstar ∧ Tstar ≤ δ ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) Tstar, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ y ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          activation T κ y ≤ activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) -
            shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η) ∧
          2 + 1 / 32 < activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) ∧
          (shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η) - 2) *
              activatedCross h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) ^ 2 <
            2 * (activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) -
              shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η)) ^ 2 ∧
          shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η) <
            coneBound (activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η))
              (activatedCross h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η)) ∧
          (y ≤ θ * T → 2 + 1 / 16 < shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_reference_bounds
NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_reference_log_match
statement:
theorem natural_reference_log_match {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalProfile.ProfileFamily d Λ C) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    {y η : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ δ) (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ActivationStocks.logViewOne h N.endpoint (referenceAngular L)
        (logHistory N.endpoint I (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP1 L (y, η) ∧
      ActivationStocks.logViewTwo h N.endpoint (referenceAngular L) U
        (logHistory N.endpoint I (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.normalizedConeGap_at_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedConeGap_at_edge (r v dP dv dJ : ℝ) :
    normalizedConeGap r v 0 dP dv dJ = 2 * r ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.normalizedConeGap_edge_positive
statement:
theorem normalizedConeGap_edge_positive {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (v dP dv dJ : ℝ) :
    0 < normalizedConeGap r v 0 dP dv dJ

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.ramp_cone_of_errors
statement:
theorem ramp_cone_of_errors {c B r e s P J v : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ r) (hrB : r ≤ B)
    (he : 0 < e) (he1 : e ≤ 1) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hsquarter : s ≤ 1 / 4) (hsc : s ≤ c / 2)
    (hsB : (B + 1) * s ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hP : |P - r| ≤ s * e) (hv : |v - (1 - e) * r| ≤ s * e)
    (hJ : |J| ≤ s * e) :
    e ≤ P - v ∧ 2 + c / 4 < P ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 < 2 * (P - v) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_at_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedStress_at_edge (F A B κ dA dB dR : ℝ) :
    reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR = (F * A, F * B)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_edge_margin
statement:
theorem reducedStress_edge_margin {F A B c κ dA dB dR : ℝ}
    (hF : 0 < F) (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ A + B ^ 2 / A) :
    2 * F < (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).1 +
      (B / A) * (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_edge_projection
statement:
theorem reducedStress_edge_projection (F A B κ dA dB dR : ℝ) :
    (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).1 +
      (B / A) * (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).2 =
      F * (A + B ^ 2 / A)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_first_positive
statement:
theorem reducedStress_first_positive {F A B κ y dA dB dR α M : ℝ}
    (hF : 0 < F) (hα : 0 < α) (hA : α ≤ A) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hdA : |dA| ≤ M) (hsmall : y * M ≤ α / 2) :
    0 < (reducedStress F A B κ y dA dB dR).1

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_nonzero
statement:
theorem reducedStress_nonzero {F A B κ y dA dB dR α M : ℝ}
    (hF : 0 < F) (hα : 0 < α) (hA : α ≤ A) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hdA : |dA| ≤ M) (hsmall : y * M ≤ α / 2) :
    reducedStress F A B κ y dA dB dR ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_smooth
statement:
theorem reducedStress_smooth {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} {F A B κ y dA dB dR : E → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S) (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A S)
    (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B S) (hκ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ κ S)
    (hy : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ y S) (hdA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dA S)
    (hdB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dB S) (hdR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dR S) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => reducedStress (F p) (A p) (B p) (κ p) (y p) (dA p) (dB p) (dR p)) S

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.referenceP1_natural
statement:
theorem referenceP1_natural {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < rampLimit)
    {y η : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ δ) (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    referenceP1 (FromReference.refLog N δ) (y, η) =
      NaturalEntrance.p1 N.f (N.fromLog (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.referenceP1_smooth
statement:
theorem referenceP1_smooth {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < rampLimit) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (referenceP1 (FromReference.refLog N δ))
      (logDomain parameterInterval parameterInterval_open).carrier

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.referenceP2_natural
statement:
theorem referenceP2_natural {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < rampLimit)
    {y η : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ δ) (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    referenceP2 N.endpoint (FromReference.refLog N δ) (FromReference.refAxial N δ) (y, η) =
      NaturalEntrance.p2 N.f N.U (N.fromLog (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.referenceP2_smooth
statement:
theorem referenceP2_smooth {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < rampLimit) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (referenceP2 N.endpoint (FromReference.refLog N δ) (FromReference.refAxial N δ))
      (logDomain parameterInterval parameterInterval_open).carrier

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reference_coordinates_smooth
statement:
theorem reference_coordinates_smooth {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (referenceP1 L) (logDomain J hJ).carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (referenceP2 X0 L U) (logDomain J hJ).carrier

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.shearSize_eq
statement:
theorem shearSize_eq (T : ℝ) {κ X0 : ℝ} (hκ : κ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hA : referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0) :
    shearSize T κ X0 L U (y, η) = damping T κ y *
      (referenceP1 L (y, η) + (referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) ^ 2 / referenceP1 L (y, η)) *
        (referenceAngular L (y, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, η)) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.stress_factorization
statement:
theorem stress_factorization (F A B κ y e dA dB dR : ℝ) (hκ : κ = 1 - e) :
    (F * ((A + y * e * dA) - κ * A),
      F * ((B + y * e * dB) - κ * B * (1 + y * e * dR))) =
    (e * (F * (A + y * dA)),
      e * (F * (B + y * (dB - κ * B * dR))))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.true_collar_of_errors
statement:
theorem true_collar_of_errors {c B r e s P J v : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ r) (hrB : r ≤ B)
    (he : 0 < e) (he1 : e ≤ 1) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hsquarter : s ≤ 1 / 4) (hsc : s ≤ c / 2)
    (hsB : (B + 1) * s ≤ 1 / 4) (heB : e * (B + 1) ≤ c / 4)
    (hP : |P - r| ≤ s * e) (hv : |v - (1 - e) * r| ≤ s * e)
    (hJ : |J| ≤ s * e) :
    e ≤ P - v ∧ 2 + c / 2 < v ∧ 2 < P ∧ v < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.uniform_ramp_from_comparison
statement:
theorem uniform_ramp_from_comparison {K : Set ℝ} {r : Field}
    {P J v : ℝ → ℝ → Field} {c B C T0 : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT0 : 0 < T0)
    (href : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K, 2 + c ≤ r (y, η) ∧ r (y, η) ≤ B)
    (herr : ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |P T κ (y, η) - r (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |v T κ (y, η) - damping T κ y * r (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |J T κ (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y) :
    ∃ Tstar θ : ℝ, 0 < Tstar ∧ Tstar ≤ T0 ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) Tstar, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ y ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
          activation T κ y ≤ P T κ (y, η) - v T κ (y, η) ∧
          2 + c / 4 < P T κ (y, η) ∧
          (v T κ (y, η) - 2) * J T κ (y, η) ^ 2 <
            2 * (P T κ (y, η) - v T κ (y, η)) ^ 2 ∧
          v T κ (y, η) < coneBound (P T κ (y, η)) (J T κ (y, η)) ∧
          (y ≤ θ * T → 2 + c / 2 < v T κ (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceJetBounds.amplitudeConstant_nonneg
statement:

NavierStokes.ReferenceJetBounds.ordered_reference_bounds
statement:
theorem ordered_reference_bounds {h j σ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∃ B M Kerr : ℝ, 1 < B ∧ 0 < M ∧ 0 ≤ Kerr ∧
      ∀ Λ : ℝ, ∀ hΛ : 0 < Λ, M ≤ Λ → ∃ KΛ > 0,
        ∀ C : ℝ, d.normalizationThreshold Λ ≤ C → ∀ F : CoefficientProfile d Λ C,
          ∃ r > 0, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r →
            TransitionControl (referenceInput F hΛ) δ (1 / Λ) (1 / C) ∧
            JetBounds h j σ Λ C B KΛ ((referenceInput F hΛ).refF δ) ((referenceInput F hΛ).refU δ) ∧
            ∀ p ∈ holdSet, (referenceInput F hΛ).endpoint ≤ p.1 →
              Nonempty (SlopeSample d Λ B Kerr ((referenceInput F hΛ).refF δ) p)

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.bounds_from_sources
statement:
theorem bounds_from_sources (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K ν : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hν : 0 < ν) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hcut : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |NaturalAxisData.Z h j P0 η| ≤ ν →
      99 / 100 < NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ η)
    (hCbig : 18 * K / ((4 / Λ) * (ν / 2)) < C)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ holdRegion,
      (47 / 50 : ℝ) * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 + 12 / 5 <
        sourceQ (referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0) h p)
    (hn : ∀ p ∈ holdRegion,
      |(referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0).axialSource h p - NaturalAxisData.Z h j P0 p.2| < ν / 2)
    (hfbound : ∀ p ∈ holdRegion, |(referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0).f p| ≤ K / C) :
    ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0

statement:
theorem exists_reference_bounds {h j σ ν : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}

    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hcut : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |NaturalAxisData.Z h j P0 η| ≤ ν →
      99 / 100 < NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ η) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ Λ : ℝ, ∀ hΛ : 0 < Λ, M ≤ Λ →
      ∃ C₀ > 0, ∀ C : ℝ, C₀ ≤ C →
        ∃ E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C,
          ∃ r > 0, ∀ δ : ℝ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, δ < r →

theorem p1_lower_from_initial {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1)
    (h : ℝ) (hL : 0 < NaturalAxisData.L h p.2) {a b q : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (haX : a ≤ p.1) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hf : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, 0 < P.f (s, p.2))
    (hmono : AntitoneOn (fun s => P.f (s, p.2)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1))
    (hsource : ∀ s ∈ Icc a p.1, q ≤ sourceQ P h (s, p.2))
    (hinit : b ≤ p1 P h (a, p.2)) :

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.p1_preserves_lower
statement:
theorem p1_preserves_lower {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1)
    (h : ℝ) (hL : 0 < NaturalAxisData.L h p.2) {a b q : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (haX : a ≤ p.1) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hqa : b * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 ≤ q * a)
    (hf : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, 0 < P.f (s, p.2))

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.pressure_parameter_increment_bound
statement:

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qJets_bound
statement:
theorem qJets_bound (h j σ : ℝ) {Λ B φ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) {p : Point}
    (hφ : |φ| ≤ B)
    (hu : |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B)
    (hv : |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B)
    (hvη : |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B)
    (hfη : |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B) :
    qJets P j σ h Λ φ p ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) B

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qModel_at_chi_zero
statement:
theorem qModel_at_chi_zero {h j σ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (v : CoefficientFamily h j σ P0) (B : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (p : SourceParameter B)
    (hchi : NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.1.val.2 = 0) :
    qModel v B p 0 = -NaturalAxisData.W h j p.1.val.2 -
      h * (1 - 2 * p.1.val.2 * NaturalAxisData.U j p.1.val.2)

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qModel_continuous
NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qModel_uniform_lower
statement:
theorem qModel_uniform_lower {h j σ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (v : CoefficientFamily h j σ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (B : ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, M ≤ Λ → ∀ p : SourceParameter B,
      ∀ e : ℝ, |e| ≤ K / Λ →
        (47 / 50 : ℝ) * NaturalAxisData.L h p.1.val.2 * Λ *
            NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.1.val.2 + 12 / 5 <
          NaturalAxisData.L h p.1.val.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.1.val.2 +
            qModel v B p (1 / Λ, e)

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.sourceN_model
statement:
theorem sourceN_model (h j : ℝ) {Λ B : ℝ} (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (p : Point) (hη : p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hv : nJets P j Λ p ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) B) :
    P.axialSource h p = nModel h j P.pressure0 B
      (⟨p.2, hη⟩, ⟨nJets P j Λ p, hv⟩) (pressureJets P Λ p)

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.sourceQ_model
statement:
theorem sourceQ_model (h j σ : ℝ) {Λ φ Y θ r : ℝ} (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (hφ : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ φ) (p : Point)
    (hrad : p.1 * radialPartial P.f p / P.f p = θ * Y * r / φ) :
    sourceQ P h p = NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +
      qRemainder h j σ (Y, p.2) θ (qJets P j σ h Λ φ p) (1 / Λ) r

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.sourceQ_uniform_threshold
statement:
theorem sourceQ_uniform_threshold {h j σ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (v : CoefficientFamily h j σ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) {B K : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ Λ : ℝ, M ≤ Λ → ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point),
      ∀ Y θ φ e : ℝ,
        (Y, p.2) ∈ NaturalEntrance.entranceSet → θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ φ → φ ≤ B → |e| ≤ K / Λ →
        |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B →
        |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B →
        |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B →
        |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B →
        p.1 * radialPartial P.f p / P.f p = θ * Y *
          (NaturalEntrance.sourceJets v.epsilon_pos (NaturalEntrance.referencePair v) (Y, p.2) 1 + e) / φ →
        (47 / 50 : ℝ) * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 + 12 / 5 <
          sourceQ P h p

theorem base_integrals_eq_activation (T κ y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ δ)

    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    integrate R.initialLog (baseSlope T κ R.angularStock) (y, η) =
      controlled T κ (StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ) (y, η) ∧

    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.exists_joint_small_control
statement:
theorem exists_joint_small_control {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ parameterInterval) (N : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    ∃ T0 > 0, ∃ κ0 > 0, ∃ w0 > 0, T0 ≤ δ ∧ κ0 < 1 ∧
      2 * w0 < R.finalTime - R.bigTime ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) κ0,
      ∀ w₁ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0, ∀ w₂ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0,
        R.SmallLogControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂ ∧ R.SmallPhysicalControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.log_fields_eq_activation
