theorem log_fields_eq_activation {T κ w₁ w₂ y : ℝ}
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) (hy : y ≤ δ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    R.logAmplitude T κ w₁ w₂ (y, η) = controlled T κ (StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ) (y, η) ∧
    R.axialVelocity T κ w₁ (y, η) = controlled T κ (StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ) (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.naturalF_jet_bound
statement:
theorem naturalF_jet_bound (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hscale : AxisReference.stabilityScale d.coefficients.epsilon (profileErrorConstant d) ≤ Λ)
    {C : ℝ} (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C) (hC : 0 < C)
    {X η B : ℝ} (hY : Λ * X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (41 / 10)) (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    {N n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hb : ∀ i ≤ N, ∀ ξ ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |iteratedDeriv i (normalizedNaturalLog d E (Λ * X)) ξ| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => E.family.f (X, ξ)) η| ≤
      (n.factorial * Real.exp (B + 1) * (B + 1) ^ n) / C

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.naturalU_error_jet
statement:
theorem naturalU_error_jet {C : ℝ} (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C)

    iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => E.family.U (X, ξ) - NaturalAxisData.U j ξ) η =
      (1 / Λ) * AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries window d.coefficients.epsilon E.coefficients.2 0 n (Λ * X, η)

statement:
theorem natural_normalization_identity {C : ℝ} (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C)

    (hφ : 0 < AxisEvaluation.profile window d.coefficients.epsilon E.coefficients.1 (Λ * X, η)) :
    E.family.f (X, η) = C⁻¹ * Real.exp (normalizedNaturalLog d E (Λ * X) η)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.natural_stock_identity
statement:
theorem natural_stock_identity (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ δ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let p := N.fromLog (y, η)
    ActivationStocks.profileStockOne (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h p = NaturalEntrance.p1 F.f p ∧
      ActivationStocks.profileStockTwo (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h p = NaturalEntrance.p2 F.f F.U p

    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |iteratedDeriv n (normalizedNaturalLog d E 4) η| ≤ B) :
    ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |iteratedDeriv n ((ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).normalizedInitial C) η| ≤ B

statement:
theorem ofNatural_stock_slopes (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ δ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :

    R.angularStock (y, η) = -2 * radialPartial (StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ) (y, η) ∧
      R.axialStock (y, η) = -2 * radialPartial (StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ) (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.ordered_seed_bounds
statement:
theorem ordered_seed_bounds (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hscale : AxisReference.stabilityScale d.coefficients.epsilon (profileErrorConstant d) ≤ Λ)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ B, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∃ K, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∃ BJ, 1 ≤ BJ ∧
      ∀ C, 0 < C → ∀ E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C,
      ∀ δ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, ∀ hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit,
      let R := ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
      ∀ T κ w₁ w₂,
      δ ≤ R.bigTime → 0 < w₁ → 0 < w₂ →
      R.SmallLogControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) N 1 T κ w₁ w₂ →
      (∀ X, 0 ≤ X → ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ n ≤ N,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ (X, ξ)) η| ≤ K / C ∧
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => R.physicalU T κ w₁ (X, ξ)) η| ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ n ≤ N,
        |iteratedDeriv n (R.endpointLog T κ w₁ w₂ C) η| ≤ BJ ∧
        |iteratedDeriv n (R.endpointU T κ w₁) η| ≤ B)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.parameterJet_angularSlope
statement:
theorem parameterJet_angularSlope {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (T κ b w₁ w₂ : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ J) :
    parameterJet n (angularSlope T κ b w₁ w₂ stock) p =
      (1 - step (b + w₁) w₂ p.1) * (-(damping T κ p.1 * parameterJet n stock p) / 2) -
        if n = 0 then (2 / 5 : ℝ) * step (b + w₁) w₂ p.1 else 0

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.parameterJet_axialSlope
statement:
theorem parameterJet_axialSlope {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (T κ b w : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ J) :
    parameterJet n (axialSlope T κ b w stock) p =
      (1 - step b w p.1) * (-(damping T κ p.1 * parameterJet n stock p) / 2)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.parameterJet_baseSlope
statement:
theorem parameterJet_baseSlope {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}

    {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ J) :
    parameterJet n (baseSlope T κ stock) p = -(damping T κ p.1 * parameterJet n stock p) / 2

statement:
theorem physicalF_hasDerivAt {T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)

statement:
theorem physical_fields_eq_activation {T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) {p : Point} (hη : p.2 ∈ parameterInterval)
    (hX : p.1 ≤ (Input.ofNatural hΛ F).endpoint * Real.exp δ) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ p = StressActivation.FromReference.f N T κ δ p ∧
      R.physicalU T κ w₁ p = StressActivation.FromReference.U N T κ δ p

    (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ p = F.f p ∧
      (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).physicalU T κ w₁ p = F.U p

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.physical_radial_equations
statement:
theorem physical_radial_equations {T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) {p : Point}
    (hη : p.2 ∈ parameterInterval) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    p.1 * radialPartial (R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂) p / R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ p =
      angularSlope T κ R.bigTime w₁ w₂ R.angularStock (R.logPoint p) ∧
    p.1 * radialPartial (R.physicalU T κ w₁) p =
      axialSlope T κ R.bigTime w₁ R.axialStock (R.logPoint p)

statement:
theorem physical_shears {p : Point} (hη : p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hx : r.startRadius ≤ p.1) :
    shearA r.profiles p =
      (1 - TransitionRamp.step (r.reference.bigTime + r.widthU) r.widthA (r.reference.logTime p.1)) *
        r.kappa * ReferenceBounds.p1 r.reference.profiles h p +
      (4 / 5 : ℝ) * TransitionRamp.step (r.reference.bigTime + r.widthU) r.widthA (r.reference.logTime p.1) ∧
    shearB r.profiles p = r.kappa * (1 - TransitionRamp.step r.reference.bigTime r.widthU
      (r.reference.logTime p.1)) * ReferenceBounds.p2 r.reference.profiles h p *
        (r.reference.profiles.f p / r.profiles.f p)

theorem actual_hold_source_threshold {h j σ B : ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hB : 1 ≤ B) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ Λ : ℝ, M ≤ Λ → ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point),
      p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ReferenceBounds.logSlope P p = 3 / 5 →
      |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B →
      |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B →
      |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B →
      |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B →
      (5 / 4 : ℝ) < ReferenceBounds.sourceQ P h p

      |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2) /
        N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < τ →
      |P.f p - N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε ∧
      |parameterPartial P.f p - parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε

    (hp : |p - A| ≤ ε) (hq : |q - B| ≤ ε) (hR : |R - 1| ≤ ε)
    (hprojection : (9 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ A + θ * B ^ 2 / A)
    (herror : ε * projectionConstant M ≤ 1 / 8)
    (hspeed : κ * speedConstant M ≤ 1) :
    Relaxed (κ * A) (κ * θ * B * R) p q

theorem exists_activation_continuation {h j σ ν : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}

      99 / 100 < NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ η) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, ∀ hΛ : 0 < Λ, M ≤ Λ →
      ∃ C0 : ℝ, 1 ≤ C0 ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, C0 ≤ C →

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.exists_comparable_ramp
statement:
theorem exists_comparable_ramp {h j σ Λ C B K r0 : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hΛ1 : 1 ≤ Λ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (hr0 : 0 < r0)
    (href : ∀ δ : ℝ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, δ < r0 →
      ∃ hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit,
        ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0 ∧
        ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K
          ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refF δ)
          ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refU δ))
    (Nextra : ℕ) {εextra : ℝ} (hεextra : 0 < εextra) :
    ∃ r : RampParameters E.profile.family hΛ hsmall hP0, ∃ c : ComparisonScales,
      ComparableRamp (B := B) (K := K) E r c ∧ InitialActivationBound r ∧
      r.reference.SmallPhysicalControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Nextra εextra
        r.actTime r.kappa r.widthU r.widthA ∧
      r.reference.SmallLogControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Nextra εextra
        r.actTime r.kappa r.widthU r.widthA

statement:
theorem field_to_stockJet_transfer (B : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E),
      P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0 → ∀ p : Point, p ∈ D.carrier → p ∈ E.carrier →
      p.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110 →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, ‖fieldJet Q (t, p.2)‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, ‖fieldJet P (t, p.2) - fieldJet Q (t, p.2)‖ < τ) →
      ‖stockJet P p - stockJet Q p‖ < ε

theorem nearby_axial_bounds {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)

    (hj : ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K Q.f Q.U)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion, |P.U p - Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ)

      |parameterPartial P.U p - parameterPartial Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ) :

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.nearby_source_jets
statement:
theorem nearby_source_jets {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)
    {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hj : ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K Q.f Q.U)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion, |P.U p - Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ)
    (huη : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion,
      |parameterPartial P.U p - parameterPartial Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ)
    (hfη : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion,
      |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - parameterPartial Q.f p / Q.f p| ≤ 1)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion) (hpD : p ∈ D.carrier) :
    |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 2 ∧
    |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 2 ∧
    |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B + 2 ∧
    |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B + 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.ordered_reference_preparation
statement:
theorem ordered_reference_preparation {h j σ ν : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hcut : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |NaturalAxisData.Z h j P0 η| ≤ ν →
      99 / 100 < NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ η) :
    ∃ B M : ℝ, 1 < B ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ Λ : ℝ, ∀ hΛ : 0 < Λ, M ≤ Λ →
        (∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point),
          p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ReferenceBounds.logSlope P p = 3 / 5 →
          |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 2 →
          |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 2 →
          |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B + 2 →
          |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B + 2 →
          (5 / 4 : ℝ) < ReferenceBounds.sourceQ P h p) ∧
        ∃ C0 K : ℝ, 1 ≤ C0 ∧ 0 < K ∧
          ∀ C : ℝ, C0 ≤ C → ∃ E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C,
            ∃ r > 0, ∀ δ : ℝ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, δ < r →
              ∃ hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit,
                ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0 ∧
                ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K
                  ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refF δ)
                  ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refU δ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_endpoint_control
statement:
theorem physical_endpoint_control {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).SmallPhysicalControl
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) 1 ε T κ w₁ w₂)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ continuationRegion (4 / Λ)) :
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    |P.U p - N.U (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε ∧
    |parameterPartial P.U p - parameterPartial N.U (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε ∧
    |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2) /
      N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_endpoint_log_value
statement:
theorem physical_endpoint_log_value {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).SmallPhysicalControl
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) 1 ε T κ w₁ w₂)
    {p : Point} (hη : p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hx : p.1 ∈ Icc (4 / Λ)
      (radius (4 / Λ) ((ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime + w₁ + w₂))) :
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    |Real.log (P.f p) - Real.log (N.f (N.endpoint, p.2))| < ε

statement:
theorem physical_fieldJet_before {p : Point}
    (hp : p ∈ (Input.ofNatural hΛ F).radialDomain.carrier)
    (hx : p.1 ≤ (Input.ofNatural hΛ F).endpoint) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    fieldJet P p = fieldJet R.profiles p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_shear_equations
statement:
theorem physical_shear_equations {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ parameterInterval) (hX : 0 < p.1)
    (ht : T ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).logTime p.1) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    shearA P p = (1 - step (R.bigTime + w₁) w₂ (R.logTime p.1)) * κ *
        ReferenceBounds.p1 R.profiles h p + (4 / 5 : ℝ) * step (R.bigTime + w₁) w₂ (R.logTime p.1) ∧
    shearB P p = κ * (1 - step R.bigTime w₁ (R.logTime p.1)) *
      ReferenceBounds.p2 R.profiles h p * (R.profiles.f p / P.f p)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.prepare_stock_comparison
statement:
theorem prepare_stock_comparison {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hΛ1 : 1 ≤ Λ) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) :
    ∃ c : ComparisonScales, ∀ δ : ℝ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, δ < c.referenceRadius →
      ∀ hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit,
      ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0 →
      ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K
        ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refF δ)
        ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refU δ) →
      let Q := ReferenceBounds.referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0
      StockControl Q h c.bound (continuationRegion (4 / Λ)) ∧
        ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D), P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0 →
          ∀ p ∈ continuationRegion (4 / Λ), p ∈ D.carrier →
            (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1,
              ‖fieldJet P (t, p.2) - fieldJet Q (t, p.2)‖ < c.fieldTolerance) →
              StockClose P Q h c.error p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.profileHistory_difference
statement:
theorem profileHistory_difference {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)
    (h0 : P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0) (r : HistoryRow) {p : Point}
    (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hq : p ∈ E.carrier) :
    profileHistory P r p - profileHistory Q r p =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, profileDensity P r (t, p.2) - profileDensity Q r (t, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.profileHistory_parameter_difference
statement:
theorem profileHistory_parameter_difference {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)

    (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hq : p ∈ E.carrier) :
    parameterPartial (profileHistory P r) p - parameterPartial (profileHistory Q r) p =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, parameterPartial (profileDensity P r) (t, p.2) -
        parameterPartial (profileDensity Q r) (t, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.profileHistory_parameter_formula
statement:
theorem profileHistory_parameter_formula {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (r : HistoryRow)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) :
    parameterPartial (profileHistory P r) p = deriv (profileInitial P r) p.2 +
      primitive (parameterPartial (profileDensity P r)) p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.projectionConstant_pos
statement: theorem projectionConstant_pos {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 < projectionConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.projection_comparison
statement:
theorem projection_comparison {A B p q θ R M ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hθ : θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hB : |B| ≤ M) (hBA : |B / A| ≤ M)
    (hp : |p - A| ≤ ε) (hq : |q - B| ≤ ε) (hR : |R - 1| ≤ ε) :
    |p + q * (θ * (B / A) * R) - (A + θ * B ^ 2 / A)| ≤
      ε * projectionConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.projection_identity
statement:
theorem projection_identity (A B p q θ R : ℝ) :
    p + q * (θ * (B / A) * R) - (A + θ * B ^ 2 / A) =
      (p - A) + (q - B) * θ * (B / A) * R + θ * B * (B / A) * (R - 1)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_endpoint_control
statement:
theorem reference_endpoint_control {εU εF εL : ℝ} (hU : 0 < εU) (hF : 0 < εF) (hL : 0 < εL) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r →
      ReferenceJetBounds.TransitionControl N δ εU εF ∧
      ∀ p : Point, N.endpoint ≤ p.1 → p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
        |parameterPartial (N.refF δ) p / N.refF δ p -
          parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2) / N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < εL

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_fieldJet_bound
statement:
theorem reference_fieldJet_bound {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D)
    {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hΛ : 1 ≤ Λ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hj : ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K P.f P.U)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion) :
    ‖fieldJet P p‖ ≤ K + B + 6

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_first_lower
statement:
theorem reference_first_lower {h j σ Λ C δ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hb : ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    (6 / 5 : ℝ) * p.1 ≤ ReferenceBounds.p1 (ReferenceBounds.referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0) h p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_positive_uniform
statement:
theorem reference_positive_uniform :
    ∃ μ r : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r →
      ∀ p : Point, N.endpoint ≤ p.1 → p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → 2 * μ ≤ N.refF δ p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.scalar_hold_barrier
statement:
theorem scalar_hold_barrier {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a X b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (haX : a ≤ X)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Icc a X, DifferentiableAt ℝ g t)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc a X, (3 / 5 : ℝ) * b ≤ t * deriv g t + (3 / 5) * g t)
    (hinit : b < g a) : b < g X

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.short_integral_bound
statement:

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.stockJet_coordinates
statement:
theorem stockJet_coordinates {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (h : ℝ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1) (hf : P.f p ≠ 0) :
    stockOneMap h p (stockJet P p) = ReferenceBounds.p1 P h p ∧
      stockTwoMap h p (stockJet P p) = ReferenceBounds.p2 P h p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.stockJet_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem stockJet_uniform_bound {B B0 : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0) :
    ∃ K > 0, ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point), p ∈ D.carrier →
      p.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110 → |P.pressure0 p.2| ≤ B0 → |deriv P.pressure0 p.2| ≤ B0 →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, ‖fieldJet P (t, p.2)‖ ≤ B) → ‖stockJet P p‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.two_ramp_relaxed
statement:
theorem two_ramp_relaxed (c : ComparisonScales) {κ A B p q R b w₁ w₂ y : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκc : κ ≤ c.damping) (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hAM : A ≤ c.bound) (hB : |B| ≤ c.bound)
    (hBA : |B / A| ≤ c.bound)
    (hp : |p - A| < c.error) (hq : |q - B| < c.error) (hR : |R - 1| < c.error)
    (hc : (9 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ A + B ^ 2 / A) (hbig : b ≤ y → 3 ≤ A) :
    Relaxed
      ((1 - TransitionRamp.step (b + w₁) w₂ y) * κ * A +
        (4 / 5 : ℝ) * TransitionRamp.step (b + w₁) w₂ y)
      (κ * (1 - TransitionRamp.step b w₁ y) * B * R) p q

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_density_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_density_bound (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ K ≥ 0, ∀ X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110, ∀ z : FieldJet, ‖z‖ ≤ B → ‖densityJet X z‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_density_transfer
statement:
theorem uniform_density_transfer (B : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110, ∀ z w : FieldJet,
      ‖z‖ ≤ B → ‖w - z‖ < τ → ‖densityJet X w - densityJet X z‖ < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_stock_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_stock_bound {h j μ B : ℝ} (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) {S : Set Point} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hX : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1) (hη : ∀ p ∈ S, p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ z : StockJet, ‖z‖ ≤ B → μ ≤ z 0 →
      |stockOneMap h p z| ≤ M ∧ |stockTwoMap h p z| ≤ M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_stock_transfer
statement:
theorem uniform_stock_transfer {h j μ B ε : ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    {S : Set Point} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hX : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1) (hη : ∀ p ∈ S, p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ z w : StockJet, ‖z‖ ≤ B → 2 * μ ≤ z 0 → ‖w - z‖ < τ →
      μ < w 0 ∧ |stockOneMap h p w - stockOneMap h p z| < ε ∧
        |stockTwoMap h p w - stockTwoMap h p z| < ε ∧ |z 0 / w 0 - 1| < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.weightedGap_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem weightedGap_hasDerivAt {g : ℝ → ℝ} {g' X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)
    (hg : HasDerivAt g g' X) (b : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (weightedGap g b)
      (Real.exp ((3 / 5 : ℝ) * Real.log X) / X *
        (X * g' + (3 / 5) * g X - (3 / 5) * b)) X

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.exists_common_holomorphic_extension
statement:
theorem exists_common_holomorphic_extension (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ B k) ∧
      ∀ (A : AxisSpace I ε) (Y : ℝ), |Y| ≤ R → ∀ k : ℕ,
        AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterTube J δ) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ, ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ B k * ‖A‖) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => complexProfile I ε A 0 y z) Y =
            complexProfile I ε A k Y z) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), x ∈ J.interval →
          iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
            (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ))

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.mixedSeries_factorial_bound

theorem verticalY_bound {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hc : ∀ n, ‖c n z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ n) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖verticalY c m z‖ ≤ 2 * ((C / a) * ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem verticalY_succ (c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    verticalY c (m + 1) z = Complex.I * verticalX c m z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_tsum
statement:
theorem verticalY_tsum {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hX : Summable (fun m => verticalX c m z))
    (hY : Summable (fun m => verticalY c m z)) :
    (∑' m, verticalY c m z) = Complex.I * ∑' m, verticalX c m z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem verticalY_zero (c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℂ) : verticalY c 0 z = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.weight_le_core
statement:
theorem weight_le_core {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m ≤ coreWeight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.ball_subset_outer
statement:
theorem ball_subset_outer (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (z : Disk c ρ) :
    ball (z : ℂ) (σ - ρ) ⊆ ball c σ

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.cauchyMap_add
statement:
theorem cauchyMap_add (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f g : C(Disk c σ, E)) : cauchyMap c hgap (f + g) = cauchyMap c hgap f + cauchyMap c hgap g

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.cauchyMap_smul
statement:
theorem cauchyMap_smul (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (a : ℂ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : cauchyMap c hgap (a • f) = a • cauchyMap c hgap f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.circle_kernel_identity
statement:
theorem circle_kernel_identity {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (z : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (v : E) :
    weight δ θ • v = deriv (circleMap z δ) θ •
      ((circleMap z δ θ - z) ^ (-2 : ℤ) • v)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.contDiff_derivative_path
statement:
theorem contDiff_derivative_path {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) {n : WithTop ℕ∞}
    {f : X → C(Disk c σ, E)} (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => derivativeCLM c hgap (f x))

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_derivative_path
statement:
theorem continuous_derivative_path {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) {f : X → C(Disk c σ, E)} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun x => derivativeCLM c hgap (f x))

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_integrand
statement:
theorem continuous_integrand (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : Continuous (integrand c hgap f)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_weight
statement: theorem continuous_weight {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : Continuous (weight δ)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_integral
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_integral (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap f z = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ •
      ∫ θ : ℝ in (0)..(2 * Real.pi),
        weight (σ - ρ) θ • f (sample c hgap θ z)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_diffContOnCl
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_diffContOnCl (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (F : ℂ → E) (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (ofContinuousOn c σ F hF.continuousOn_ball) z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_differentiableOn (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (F : ℂ → E) (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (closedBall c σ)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (ofContinuousOn c σ F hF.continuousOn) z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_eq
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_eq (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap f z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_restrict_of_eq
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_restrict_of_eq (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hgap : r < ρ) (houter : ρ ≤ σ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (restrictionCLM c houter f) =
      derivativeCLM c (hgap.trans_le houter) f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_cauchyMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_cauchyMap_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : ‖cauchyMap c hgap f‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹ * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_derivativeCLM_le
statement:
theorem norm_derivativeCLM_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) :
    ‖derivativeCLM (E := E) c hgap‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_integrand_le
statement:
theorem norm_integrand_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖integrand c hgap f θ‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹ * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_restrictionCLM_le
statement:
theorem norm_restrictionCLM_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ) :
    ‖restrictionCLM (E := E) c h‖ ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_restrictionLinear_le
statement:
theorem norm_restrictionLinear_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : ‖restrictionLinear c h f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_weight
statement: theorem norm_weight {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (θ : ℝ) : ‖weight δ θ‖ = δ⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.ofContinuousOn_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofContinuousOn_apply (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (closedBall c r)) (z : Disk c r) :
    ofContinuousOn c r F hF z = F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.offset_ne_zero
statement: theorem offset_ne_zero {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (θ : ℝ) : circleMap 0 δ θ ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrict_derivativeCLM_of_eq
statement:
theorem restrict_derivativeCLM_of_eq (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hr : r ≤ ρ) (hgap : ρ < σ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) :
    restrictionCLM c hr (derivativeCLM c hgap f) =
      derivativeCLM c (hr.trans_lt hgap) f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrictionCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictionCLM_apply (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    restrictionCLM c h f z = f ⟨z.1, closedBall_subset_closedBall h z.2⟩

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrictionCLM_comp
statement:
theorem restrictionCLM_comp (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ} (h₁ : r ≤ ρ) (h₂ : ρ ≤ σ) :
    (restrictionCLM (E := E) c h₁).comp (restrictionCLM c h₂) =
      restrictionCLM c (h₁.trans h₂)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.translated_mem
statement:
theorem translated_mem (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (z : Disk c ρ) (θ : ℝ) : z.1 + circleMap 0 (σ - ρ) θ ∈ closedBall c σ

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_nat
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_nat (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {W : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : P × Z → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ n F (U ×ˢ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ n (family K F) U

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_of_joint
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_of_joint (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (family K F) U

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_of_neighborhood
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_of_neighborhood (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.continuousOn_family

theorem continuousOn_family {K : Set Z} [CompactSpace K] {U : Set P} {F : P × Z → E}

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.family_apply
statement:
theorem family_apply (K : Set Z) (F : P × Z → E) (p : P)

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.family_apply_of_joint
NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.flipCLM_apply
statement:
theorem flipCLM_apply (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (g : C(K, P →L[ℝ] E)) (v : P) (z : K) :
    flipCLM (P := P) (E := E) K g v z = g z v

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.hasFDerivAt_family
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_family (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (F : P × Z → E) (G : P × Z → P →L[ℝ] E)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (U ×ˢ K)) (hG : ContinuousOn G (U ×ˢ K))
    (hderiv : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ z : K, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F (q, z)) (G (p, z)) p)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (family K F) (flipCLM (P := P) (E := E) K (family K G p)) p

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.iteratedFDeriv_family_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_family_apply (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V))
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → P) (z : K) :
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (family K F) p v) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q => F (q, z)) p v

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.iteratedFDeriv_family_apply_of_neighborhood
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_family_apply_of_neighborhood (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (U : Set P) (W : Set (P × Z)) (hW : IsOpen W) (hUK : U ×ˢ K ⊆ W)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → P) (z : K) :
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (family K F) p v) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q => F (q, z)) p v

statement:
theorem cauchyValue_eq (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E) {r : ℝ}

statement:
theorem contDiffOn_cauchyValue (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.contDiffOn_kernel
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_kernel (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) :

theorem contDiffOn_kernelPath (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem contDiffOn_of_disk_family (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)

theorem contDiffOn_of_disk_family_smaller (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hgap : ρ < σ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.hasDerivAt_complex
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_complex (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (v : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ z : Disk c σ, v z = F z) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    HasDerivAt F (derivativeCLM c hgap v z) z

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.hasDerivAt_parameter
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_parameter (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S)
    (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S)
    (hvalues : ∀ r ∈ S, ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ S) (z : Disk c σ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => F s z) (deriv V r z) r

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.hasFDerivAt_joint
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_joint (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S) (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S)
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ S, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F r) (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ r ∈ S, ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ S) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => F p.1 p.2)
      (jointDerivative (deriv V r ⟨z, closedBall_subset_closedBall hgap.le z.2⟩)
        (derivativeCLM c hgap (V r) z)) (r, (z : ℂ))

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.jointDerivative_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem jointDerivative_apply (a b : E) (v : ℝ × ℂ) :
    jointDerivative a b v = v.1 • a + v.2 • b

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.kernelPath_apply
statement:
theorem kernelPath_apply (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball c σ) (θ : Angles) :

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.norm_angleIntegral_le

theorem norm_angleIntegral_le (f : C(Angles, E)) :

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.norm_multiplyPaths_le
statement:
theorem norm_multiplyPaths_le (k : C(Angles, ℂ)) (v : C(Angles, E)) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphicJoint.complexProfile_joint_real_agreement

statement:
theorem diskProfile_apply (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphicJoint.diskProfile_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem diskProfile_contDiffOn (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:

    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) (hK : closedBall c σ ⊆ parameterStrip I (ε * (1 - s)))
    (k : ℕ) {Y Y' : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < R) (hY' : |Y'| < R) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphicJoint.exists_common_joint_extension
statement:
theorem exists_common_joint_extension (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ S : ℝ, R < S ∧ S < 20 ∧ ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ k, 0 ≤ B k) ∧ ∀ (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k : ℕ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => complexProfile I ε A k p.1 p.2)
          (Ioo (-S) S ×ˢ parameterTube J δ) ∧
        ∀ Y : ℝ, |Y| ≤ R →
          AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterTube J δ) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ, ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ B k * ‖A‖) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ,
            iteratedDeriv k (fun y => complexProfile I ε A 0 y z) Y =
              complexProfile I ε A k Y z) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), x ∈ J.interval →
            iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
              (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ))

    (x : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ ReferencePath.parameterInterval) :
    let P := StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0
    E.f T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.f (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    E.U T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.U (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    E.Ubar T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.Ubar (x,η) : ℂ) ∧

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.real_radial_jets
statement:
theorem InitialTube.real_radial_jets {N : ReferencePath.Input} {h R : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (E : InitialTube N h P0 R Ω) {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (k : ℕ) {x η : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioi (-R)) (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    let P := StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0
    radialJet (E.f T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.f (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    radialJet (E.U T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.U (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    radialJet (E.Ubar T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.Ubar (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    radialJet (E.Pi T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.pressure (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.exists_initialTube
statement:
theorem exists_initialTube {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {g a : ℝ → ℝ} {cap : ℝ}
    (hp : PressureDatum.Admissible g a cap)
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ (PressureDatum.pressure g a)}
    (F : CoefficientProfile d Λ C) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ Nonempty (InitialTube (ReferenceJetBounds.referenceInput F hΛ) h
      (PressureDatum.pressure g a) (5/Λ) (AxisHolomorphic.parameterTube parameterWindow ρ))

statement:
theorem exists_natural_extension (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ _ : NaturalExtension (ReferenceJetBounds.referenceInput F hΛ)
      (AxisHolomorphic.parameterTube parameterWindow ρ) (5/Λ),
      AxisHolomorphic.parameterTube parameterWindow ρ ⊆ regularSet h j σ

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.exists_positive_natural_tube
statement:
theorem exists_positive_natural_tube (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      let Ω := AxisHolomorphic.parameterTube parameterWindow δ
      IsOpen Ω ∧ Ω ⊆ regularSet h j σ ∧
      Regular (Ioo (-(5/Λ)) (5/Λ)) Ω (naturalF F) ∧
      Regular (Ioo (-(5/Λ)) (5/Λ)) Ω (naturalU F) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) ((41/10)/Λ), ∀ z ∈ Ω, 0 < (naturalF F (x,z)).re

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.exists_preliminary_tube
statement:
theorem exists_preliminary_tube (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∃ Ω : Set ℂ, IsOpen Ω ∧
      (∀ η ∈ parameterWindow.interval, (η : ℂ) ∈ Ω) ∧
      Ω ⊆ AxisHolomorphic.parameterStrip window (d.coefficients.epsilon*(1-(1/2 : ℝ))) ∧
      Ω ⊆ d.compactSet ∧ Ω ⊆ regularSet h j σ

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.abs_coeff_le
statement: theorem abs_coeff_le (p : ℝ) {i n : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) : |rpowCoeff p i| ≤ coeffBound p n

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.chooseSum_nonneg
statement: theorem chooseSum_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ chooseSum n

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.coeffBound_nonneg
statement: theorem coeffBound_nonneg (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ coeffBound p n

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.comp_jet_bound
statement:
theorem comp_jet_bound {f : E → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set E} {t : Set ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (ht : IsOpen t) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g t) (hmap : MapsTo f s t) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (n : ℕ) {C D : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x)‖ ≤ C)
    (hD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤ n.factorial * C * D ^ n

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.envelope_bounds
statement:
theorem envelope_bounds {w g r : E → ℝ} {x : E} (hw : 0 < w x) (hg : 0 < g x) (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ envelope w g r n x ∧ w x / envelope w g r n x ≤ g x ∧
      (∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ w x * envelope w g r n x) ∧
      (∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i r x‖ ≤ w x * envelope w g r n x)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.envelope_polyBound
statement:
theorem envelope_polyBound {s : Set E} {S T w g r : E → ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ S x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ T x)
    (hlower : PolyBound s S T (fun x => w x / g x))
    (hg : ∀ n, PolyBound s S T (fun x => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ / w x))
    (hr : ∀ n, PolyBound s S T (fun x => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n r x‖ / w x)) (n : ℕ) :
    PolyBound s S T (envelope w g r n)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.half_power_bound
statement:
theorem half_power_bound {B t : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (ht : 0 < t) (hu : t ≤ B) :

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.inverse_distance_one_le
statement:
theorem inverse_distance_one_le {U : Set E} {p : E × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ edgeStrip U) :

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.iteratedDeriv_rpow
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_rpow (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) t = rpowCoeff p n * t ^ (p - (n : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.jet_congr
statement:
theorem jet_congr {f g : E → ℝ} {x : E} (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.locallyBoundedScale_const
statement:
theorem locallyBoundedScale_const (U : Set E) {S : ℝ} (hS : 1 ≤ S) :
    LocallyBoundedScale U (fun _ => S)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.mul_jets_bound
statement:
theorem mul_jets_bound {f g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (n : ℕ) {C D : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (_hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hfj : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ C)
    (hgj : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ D) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤ chooseSum n * C * D

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.nat_le_infty
statement: theorem nat_le_infty (n : ℕ) : (n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.neg_half_power_bound
statement:
theorem neg_half_power_bound {B t : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (ht : 0 < t) (hi : t⁻¹ ≤ B) :
    t ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.norm_jet_const_mul
statement:
theorem norm_jet_const_mul {f : E → ℝ} {x : E} (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x)
    (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => c * f y) x‖ = |c| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.normalized_bounds
statement:
theorem normalized_bounds {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} {w B : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hlo : w / B ≤ g x) (hhi : g x ≤ w * B) :
    normalizeAt w g x ≤ B ∧ (normalizeAt w g x)⁻¹ ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.normalized_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem normalized_contDiffOn {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) (w : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (normalizeAt w g) s

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.normalized_jet_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_jet_bound {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) {w B : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w)
    (n : ℕ) (hjet : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ ≤ w * B) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (normalizeAt w g) x‖ ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.normalized_pos
statement:
theorem normalized_pos {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) : 0 < normalizeAt w g x

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.orderBound_le
statement:
theorem orderBound_le (p : ℝ) {i n : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    i.factorial * coeffBound p i ≤ orderBound p n

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.orderBound_nonneg
statement: theorem orderBound_nonneg (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ orderBound p n

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.polyBound_of_lower
statement:
theorem polyBound_of_lower {s : Set E} {S T w g : E → ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ S x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ T x)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (K N : ℕ)
    (hlower : ∀ x ∈ s, c₀ * w x / (S x ^ K * T x ^ N) ≤ g x) :
    PolyBound s S T (fun x => w x / g x)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.polyBound_of_weighted
statement:
theorem polyBound_of_weighted {s : Set E} {S T w F : E → ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ S x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ T x)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < w x) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (K N : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ≤ C * S x ^ K * T x ^ N * w x) :
    PolyBound s S T (fun x => F x / w x)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.polyBound_one
statement: theorem polyBound_one : PolyBound s S T (fun _ => 1)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.polyBound_zero
statement: theorem polyBound_zero : PolyBound s S T (fun _ => 0)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.rescaled_rpow_jet_bound
statement:
theorem rescaled_rpow_jet_bound {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    {w B : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hpow : (normalizeAt w g x) ^ p ≤ B) (hinv : (normalizeAt w g x)⁻¹ ≤ B)
    (hjet : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ w * B) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => g y ^ p) x‖ ≤
      w ^ p * (n.factorial * coeffBound p n) * B ^ (2 * n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.rpow_comp_jet_bound
statement:
theorem rpow_comp_jet_bound {f : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hfpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < f x)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hp : f x ^ p ≤ B) (hi : (f x)⁻¹ ≤ B)
    (hjet : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y ^ p) x‖ ≤
      n.factorial * coeffBound p n * B ^ (2 * n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.rpow_comp_jets_bound
statement:
theorem rpow_comp_jets_bound {f : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hfpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < f x)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hp : f x ^ p ≤ B) (hi : (f x)⁻¹ ≤ B)
    (hjet : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ B) {i : ℕ} (hin : i ≤ n) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => f y ^ p) x‖ ≤ orderBound p n * B ^ (2 * n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.rpow_jet_bound
statement:
theorem rpow_jet_bound (p : ℝ) {B t : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hp : t ^ p ≤ B) (hi : t⁻¹ ≤ B) {i n : ℕ} (hin : i ≤ n) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) t‖ ≤ coeffBound p n * B ^ (n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.rpow_rescale_eventually
statement:
theorem rpow_rescale_eventually {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (p : ℝ) :
    (fun y => g y ^ p) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => w ^ p * (normalizeAt w g y) ^ p)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.signed_jet_bound
statement:
theorem signed_jet_bound {g r : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r s)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    {w B : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (n : ℕ)
    (hlo : w / B ≤ g x)
    (hgj : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ w * B)
    (hrj : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i r x‖ ≤ w * B) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => r y / (2 * Real.sqrt (g y))) x‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt w * (chooseSum n * orderBound (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) n / 2) * B ^ (2 * n + 2)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.signed_rescale_eventually
statement:
theorem signed_rescale_eventually {g r : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    (fun y => r y / (2 * Real.sqrt (g y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => (Real.sqrt w / 2) *
        (normalizeAt w r y * (normalizeAt w g y) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.sqrt_edge
statement: theorem sqrt_edge (c δ : ℝ) : Real.sqrt (FlatCutoff.edge c δ) = FlatCutoff.edge (c / 2) δ

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.sqrt_jet_bound
statement:
theorem sqrt_jet_bound {g : E → ℝ} {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    {w B : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (n : ℕ)
    (hlo : w / B ≤ g x) (hjet : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ w * B) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => Real.sqrt (g y)) x‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt w * (n.factorial * coeffBound (1 / 2) n) * B ^ (2 * n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.sqrt_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_of_bounds {B t : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hu : t ≤ B) :
    Real.sqrt t ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.weighted_half_control
statement:
theorem weighted_half_control {s : Set E} {S T w g r : E → ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hS : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ S x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ T x)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < w x) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < g x)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r s)
    (hlower : PolyBound s S T (fun x => w x / g x))
    (hgj : ∀ n, PolyBound s S T (fun x => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ / w x))
    (hrj : ∀ n, PolyBound s S T (fun x => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n r x‖ / w x)) :
    (∀ n, PolyBound s S T (fun x =>
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => Real.sqrt (g y)) x‖ / Real.sqrt (w x))) ∧
    (∀ n, PolyBound s S T (fun x =>
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => r y / (2 * Real.sqrt (g y))) x‖ / Real.sqrt (w x)))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.weighted_half_jets
statement:
theorem weighted_half_jets {c : ℝ} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {S g r : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ edgeStrip U, 1 ≤ S p)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ U ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 < g p)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (U ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r (U ×ˢ Ioi 0))
    (hlower : PolyBound (edgeStrip U) S (fun p => p.2⁻¹)
      (fun p => FlatCutoff.edge c p.2 / g p))
    (hgj : WeightedJets c U S g) (hrj : WeightedJets c U S r) :
    WeightedJets (c / 2) U S (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p)) ∧
      WeightedJets (c / 2) U S (fun p => r p / (2 * Real.sqrt (g p)))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.weighted_zero_extension
statement:
theorem weighted_zero_extension {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {S g r : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ edgeStrip U, 1 ≤ S p)
    (hscale : LocallyBoundedScale U S)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ U ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 < g p)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (U ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r (U ×ˢ Ioi 0))
    (hlower : PolyBound (edgeStrip U) S (fun p => p.2⁻¹)
      (fun p => FlatCutoff.edge c p.2 / g p))
    (hgj : WeightedJets c U S g) (hrj : WeightedJets c U S r) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p))) (U ×ˢ univ) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => r p / (2 * Real.sqrt (g p))))
      (U ×ˢ univ) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p))) (x, 0) = 0 ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension
        (fun p => r p / (2 * Real.sqrt (g p)))) (x, 0) = 0

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.weighted_zero_extension_of_bounds
statement:
theorem weighted_zero_extension_of_bounds {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {S g r : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ edgeStrip U, 1 ≤ S p)
    (hscale : LocallyBoundedScale U S)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ U ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 < g p)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (U ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r (U ×ˢ Ioi 0))
    {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (K₀ N₀ : ℕ)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ edgeStrip U,
      c₀ * FlatCutoff.edge c p.2 / (S p ^ K₀ * (p.2⁻¹) ^ N₀) ≤ g p)
    (hgBounds : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ K N : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ edgeStrip U,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g p‖ ≤ C * S p ^ K * FlatCutoff.edge c p.2 / p.2 ^ N)
    (hrBounds : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ K N : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ edgeStrip U,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n r p‖ ≤ C * S p ^ K * FlatCutoff.edge c p.2 / p.2 ^ N) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p))) (U ×ˢ univ) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => r p / (2 * Real.sqrt (g p))))
      (U ×ˢ univ) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p))) (x, 0) = 0 ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension
        (fun p => r p / (2 * Real.sqrt (g p)))) (x, 0) = 0

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.zeroExtension_signed_identity
statement:
theorem zeroExtension_signed_identity {U : Set E} {g r : E × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ U ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 < g p) {p : E × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ∈ U) :
    2 * FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p)) p *
      FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => r p / (2 * Real.sqrt (g p))) p =
      FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension r p

name: NavierStokes.WeightedQuotients.zeroExtension_sqrt_sq
statement:
theorem zeroExtension_sqrt_sq {U : Set E} {g : E × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ U ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 < g p) {p : E × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ∈ U) :
    (FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension (fun p => Real.sqrt (g p)) p) ^ 2 =
      FlatZeroExtension.zeroExtension g p

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.coefficientMass_nonneg
statement: theorem coefficientMass_nonneg (p : ℝ[X]) : 0 ≤ coefficientMass p

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.compact_coefficient_jets
statement:
theorem compact_coefficient_jets {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.deriv_slice

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_div_pow_eq_polynomial
statement:
theorem edge_div_pow_eq_polynomial (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (fun x => FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ j) =
      FlatCutoff.polynomialEdge c (X ^ j)

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_div_pow_iteratedFDeriv_zero
statement:
theorem edge_div_pow_iteratedFDeriv_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_div_pow_jets_bound
statement:
theorem edge_div_pow_jets_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun x => FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ j) x‖ ≤

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_mul_edge
statement:
theorem edge_mul_edge (c d x : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem edge_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (weighted c j B) (p, x)‖ ≤
        C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound_on
statement:
theorem edge_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound_on {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} {V : Set (E × ℝ)} (hV : IsOpen V) (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B V)
    {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S) (n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hSV : S ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) d ⊆ V) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (weighted c j B) (p, x)‖ ≤
        C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound_unit
statement:
theorem edge_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound_unit {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y : E × ℝ =>
        (FlatCutoff.edge c y.2 / y.2 ^ j) * B y) (p, x)‖ ≤
          C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_mul_mixed_derivatives_bound
statement:
theorem edge_mul_mixed_derivatives_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (k : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, m + n ≤ k → ∀ p ∈ S,
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => iteratedDeriv n
          (fun t => weighted c j B (q, t)) x) p‖ ≤ C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_pow
statement:
theorem edge_pow (c x : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    FlatCutoff.edge c x ^ k = FlatCutoff.edge ((k : ℝ) * c) x

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_smul_iteratedFDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem edge_smul_iteratedFDeriv_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → F} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : E × ℝ =>
        (FlatCutoff.edge c y.2 / y.2 ^ j) • B y) (p, x)‖ ≤
          C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.edge_smul_iteratedFDeriv_bound_on
statement:
theorem edge_smul_iteratedFDeriv_bound_on {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)

        (FlatCutoff.edge c y.2 / y.2 ^ j) • B y) (p, x)‖ ≤

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.jetMass_bound
statement:
theorem jetMass_bound (c : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) {i n : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    coefficientMass (FlatCutoff.jetPolynomial c p i) ≤ jetMass c p n

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.jetMass_pos
statement: theorem jetMass_pos (c : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) : 0 < jetMass c p n

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.jetOrder_bound
statement:
theorem jetOrder_bound (c : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) {i n : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    (FlatCutoff.jetPolynomial c p i).natDegree ≤ jetOrder c p n

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.nat_le_infty
statement: theorem nat_le_infty (n : ℕ) : (n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_linear_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_linear_le {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (L : G →L[ℝ] F) (hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) (x : G) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f ∘ L) x‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (L x)‖

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.norm_iteratedFDeriv_parameter_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_parameter_le {f : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (p : E) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => f (p, x)) p‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (p, x)‖

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.norm_iteratedFDeriv_snd_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_snd_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (y : E × ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y : E × ℝ => f y.2) y‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f y.2‖

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.norm_mixed_derivatives_le
statement:
theorem norm_mixed_derivatives_le {f : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (m n : ℕ) (p : E) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => iteratedDeriv n (fun t => f (q, t)) x) p‖ ≤
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + n) f (p, x)‖

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.norm_radialIterate_le
statement:
theorem norm_radialIterate_le {f : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n m : ℕ) (y : E × ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (radialIterate f n) y‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + n) f y‖

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.polynomialEdge_jets_bound
statement:
theorem polynomialEdge_jets_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (FlatCutoff.polynomialEdge c p) x‖ ≤
        C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.polynomial_eval_bound
statement:
theorem polynomial_eval_bound (p : ℝ[X]) {x T : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hx : |x| ≤ T) :
    |p.eval x| ≤ coefficientMass p * T ^ p.natDegree

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.radialIterate_contDiff
statement:
theorem radialIterate_contDiff {f : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (n : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (radialIterate f n)

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.radialIterate_eq
statement:
theorem radialIterate_eq {f : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (n : ℕ) (p : E) (x : ℝ) :
    radialIterate f n (p, x) = iteratedDeriv n (fun t => f (p, t)) x

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.radial_power_iteratedFDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem radial_power_iteratedFDeriv_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j k : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : E × ℝ =>
        (FlatCutoff.edge c y.2 / y.2 ^ j) * (y.2 ^ k * B y)) (p, x)‖ ≤
          C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weightedJets_of_isCompact_closure
statement:
theorem weightedJets_of_isCompact_closure {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {U : Set E} (hU : IsCompact (closure U)) :
    WeightedQuotients.WeightedJets c U (fun _ => 1) (weighted c j B)

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_contDiff
statement:
theorem weighted_contDiff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {B : E × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (weighted c j B)

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_iteratedFDeriv_zero
statement:
theorem weighted_iteratedFDeriv_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) (n : ℕ) (p : E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (weighted c j B) (p, 0) = 0

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_mul
statement:
theorem weighted_mul (c d : ℝ) (j k : ℕ) (B D : E × ℝ → ℝ) :
    (fun y => weighted c j B y * weighted d k D y) =
      weighted (c + d) (j + k) (fun y => B y * D y)

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_mul_iteratedFDeriv_bound {c d : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (j k : ℕ) {B D : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) (hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D)
    {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S) (n : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ a →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => weighted c j B y * weighted d k D y) (p, x)‖ ≤
        C * FlatCutoff.edge (c + d) x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem weighted_of_nonpos (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (B : E × ℝ → ℝ) {y : E × ℝ}
    (hy : y.2 ≤ 0) : weighted c j B y = 0

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_pow
statement:
theorem weighted_pow (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (B : E × ℝ → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (fun y => weighted c j B y ^ k) =
      weighted ((k : ℝ) * c) (j * k) (fun y => B y ^ k)

name: NavierStokes.EdgeWeightJets.weighted_pow_iteratedFDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_pow_iteratedFDeriv_bound {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {B : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => weighted c j B y ^ k) (p, x)‖ ≤
        C * FlatCutoff.edge ((k : ℝ) * c) x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.absorb_logarithmic_weight
statement:
theorem absorb_logarithmic_weight (C p g L q ε : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmall : |logPowerWeight C p (g / 2) q| ≤ ε) :
    |C * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ p * q ^ (g - L)| ≤
      ε * q ^ (g / 2 - L)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_finite_active
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_finite_active (b : ℕ → ℕ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    {j : ℕ | q ≤ 1 / (doublingEnvelope b j : ℝ)}.Finite

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_ge
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_ge (b : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    b n ≤ doublingEnvelope b n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_growth
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_growth (b : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    2 * doublingEnvelope b n ≤ doublingEnvelope b (n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_lower_bound
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_lower_bound (b : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    n + 1 ≤ doublingEnvelope b n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_pos
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_pos (b : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < doublingEnvelope b n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_reciprocal_eventually_small
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_reciprocal_eventually_small (b : ℕ → ℕ)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N, 1 / (doublingEnvelope b j : ℝ) < q

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.doublingEnvelope_strictMono
statement:
theorem doublingEnvelope_strictMono (b : ℕ → ℕ) :
    StrictMono (doublingEnvelope b)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.dyadic_tail_sum
statement:
theorem dyadic_tail_sum (J : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * A) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * A

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_diagonal_scales
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_scales (C p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < g j) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      B ≤ a 0 ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧
      StrictMono a ∧
      (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N, 1 / (a j : ℝ) < q) ∧
      (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m, m ≤ j + 2 → ∀ q : ℝ,
        0 < q → q ≤ 1 / (a j : ℝ) →
          |logPowerWeight (C j m) (p j m) (g j / 2) q| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_integer_scale
statement:
theorem exists_integer_scale {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (C p : ι → ℝ)
    (r ε : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / (a : ℝ) →
        |logPowerWeight (C i) (p i) r q| ≤ ε

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_uniform_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_tail_order (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (L N : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, m ≤ J ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.tendsto_logPowerWeight
statement:
theorem tendsto_logPowerWeight (C p r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Tendsto (logPowerWeight C p r) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.weighted_tail_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_tail_bound (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (L q : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (J : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ (g (J + 1) / 2 - L)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.boundSum_le_scale
statement:
theorem boundSum_le_scale (a : ℕ → E) (j : ℕ) :
    boundSum j (a j) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j * scale a j

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.boundSum_nonneg
statement: theorem boundSum_nonneg (j : ℕ) (v : E) : 0 ≤ boundSum j v

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.deriv_monomial_succ
statement:
theorem deriv_monomial_succ (j : ℕ) (v : E) :
    deriv (monomial (j + 1) v) = monomial j v

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.exists_smooth_compact_extension
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_compact_extension (a : ℕ → E) :
    ∃ f : ℝ → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k f 0 = a k)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.exists_smooth_right_extension
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_right_extension (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) :
    ∃ f : ℝ → E, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ici T) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDerivWithin k f (Ici T) T = a k) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, T + 1 ≤ t → f t = 0)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.exists_template_bound
statement:
theorem exists_template_bound (j k : ℕ) (v : E) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k (template j v) s‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_contDiff
statement: theorem extension_contDiff (a : ℕ → E) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (extension a)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_eq_series
statement:
theorem extension_eq_series (a : ℕ → E) (s : ℝ) :
    extension a s = ∑' j : ℕ,
      (SmoothCutoffs.cutoff ((scale a j : ℝ) * s) * (s ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ))) • a j

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_hasCompactSupport
statement: theorem extension_hasCompactSupport (a : ℕ → E) : HasCompactSupport (extension a)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_jets
statement:
theorem extension_jets (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (extension a) 0 = a k

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_right_jets
statement:
theorem extension_right_jets (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDerivWithin k (extension a) (Ici 0) 0 = a k

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_support
statement: theorem extension_support (a : ℕ → E) : support (extension a) ⊆ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_tsupport
statement: theorem extension_tsupport (a : ℕ → E) : tsupport (extension a) ⊆ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.extension_zero_of_one_le_abs
statement:
theorem extension_zero_of_one_le_abs (a : ℕ → E) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ |s|) :
    extension a s = 0

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.iteratedDeriv_extension
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_extension (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (extension a) s =
      ∑' j : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k (term (scale a j) j (a j)) s

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.iteratedDeriv_monomial_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_monomial_zero (n j : ℕ) (v : E) :
    iteratedDeriv n (monomial j v) 0 = if n = j then v else 0

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.iteratedDeriv_term
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_term {b : ℝ} (hb : b ≠ 0) (j k : ℕ) (v : E) (s : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (term b j v) s =
      (b ^ k / b ^ j) • iteratedDeriv k (template j v) (b * s)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.iteratedDeriv_term_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_term_zero (b : ℝ) (j k : ℕ) (v : E) :
    iteratedDeriv k (term b j v) 0 = if k = j then v else 0

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.localScale_bound
statement:
theorem localScale_bound (a : ℕ → E) (j : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ j * boundSum j (a j) < localScale a j

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.majorant_summable
statement: theorem majorant_summable (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) : Summable (majorant a k)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.monomial_contDiff
statement: theorem monomial_contDiff (j : ℕ) (v : E) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (monomial j v)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.norm_iteratedDeriv_term_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedDeriv_term_le {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (j k : ℕ) (v : E) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (term b j v) s‖ ≤
      (b ^ k / b ^ j) * templateBound j k v

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.norm_iteratedDeriv_term_le_majorant
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedDeriv_term_le_majorant (a : ℕ → E) (k j : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (term (scale a j) j (a j)) s‖ ≤ majorant a k j

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.norm_template_iteratedDeriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_template_iteratedDeriv_le (j k : ℕ) (v : E) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (template j v) s‖ ≤ templateBound j k v

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.rightExtension_contDiff
statement:
theorem rightExtension_contDiff (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rightExtension T a)

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.rightExtension_jets
statement:
theorem rightExtension_jets (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (rightExtension T a) T = a k

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.rightExtension_right_jets
statement:
theorem rightExtension_right_jets (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDerivWithin k (rightExtension T a) (Ici T) T = a k

name: NavierStokes.BorelExtension.rightExtension_zero_from
statement:
theorem rightExtension_zero_from (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : T + 1 ≤ t) :

statement:
theorem constructed_tail (d : TailData) :

    (∀ p, 0 < finalAngular d p) ∧
    0 < decayHold d ∧
    holdLag d (decayHold d) = tailLag d 0 ∧
    tailLag d 3 = 0 ∧
    (∀ eta y, y ≤ d.core.endpoint →
      finalAngular d (y, eta) = angular d.core.P d.core.dropLength d.core.lam (y, eta)) ∧
    (∀ eta y, tailEnd d ≤ y →
      finalAngular d (y, eta) = powerConstant d * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + d.h) * y))

NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoingEdit_eventual_heat
statement:
theorem outgoingEdit_eventual_heat (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (htail : 3 ≤ Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) :
    outgoingEdit d ν K eta X =
      (outgoingAmplitude d * K ^ exponent d.h) *
        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + d.h) ν X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoingEdit_full
statement:
theorem outgoingEdit_full (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (hfull : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) :
    outgoingEdit d ν K eta X =
      outgoingAmplitude d * (X / K) ^ (-exponent d.h) *
        tailShape d (Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) *
          RadialHeatProfile.profile (1 + d.h) (2 * ν / X)

statement:
theorem outgoing_angular (d : TailData) {ν K : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :

statement:

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoing_pressure

theorem outgoing_pressure (d : TailData) {ν K : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_angular
statement:
theorem powerTail_angular {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |angularDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        Real.sqrt 2 * heatConstant h ν * e * M * Real.sqrt K / h

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_bound
statement:
theorem powerTail_bound {K e M X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hX : K ≤ X)
    (h : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    |powerTail h e K f X| ≤ e * M * (X / K) ^ (-exponent h)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_energy
statement:
theorem powerTail_energy {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K) (Ioi K) ∧
      |energyDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (2 * exponent h)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_pressure
statement:
theorem powerTail_pressure {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X / X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |pressureDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (K * (2 * exponent h + 1))

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_square_bound
statement:
theorem powerTail_square_bound {K e M X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hX : K ≤ X) (h : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    powerTail h e K f X ^ 2 ≤ e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * (X / K) ^ (-2 * exponent h)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_weighted_change
statement:
theorem powerTail_weighted_change {h ν K e M q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) (hq : q < exponent h) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X| ≤
        heatConstant h ν * e * M * K ^ q / (exponent h - q)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_weighted_squareChange
statement:
theorem powerTail_weighted_squareChange {h ν K e M q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) (hq : q < 2 * exponent h) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * K ^ q / (2 * exponent h - q)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.pressureDebt_eq

theorem pressureDebt_eq (E : ℝ → ℝ) (h ν K : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.squareChange_bound

      |physicalEnergy d K eta| ≤ C ∧

    (hlate : 3 ≤ Real.log ((s / q) / K) + 1 / 5) :
    q ^ (-exponent d.h) * physicalEdit d K eta (s / q) =

    (hfull : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log ((s / q) / K) + 1 / 5) :
    q ^ (-exponent d.h) * physicalEdit d K eta (s / q) =
      (outgoingAmplitude d * K ^ exponent d.h) *
        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + d.h) τ s *

    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) L) (hX : X ∈ Ioi K) :
    ‖weightedJet W square h K q n ν X‖ ≤
      (B * editBound square h L n) * weightedKernel K p q X

statement:
theorem weightedJet_continuousOn (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedJet_dominated
statement:
theorem weightedJet_dominated (square : Bool) :

theorem weightedJet_integrable (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
