name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.A_add_D
statement: theorem A_add_D (h : ℝ) : A h + D h = 1

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.D_pos
statement: theorem D_pos {h : ℝ} (hh : h < 1 / 2) : 0 < D h

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.L_pos
statement:
theorem L_pos {h η : ℝ} (hh₀ : 0 ≤ h) (hh : h < 1 / 2)
    (hη : η ^ 2 ≤ 1) : 0 < L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.L_sub_two_D
statement: theorem L_sub_two_D (h η : ℝ) : L h η - 2 * D h * η ^ 2 = d η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.axial_chain_coefficient
statement:
theorem axial_chain_coefficient {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (b h η X F FX Fη : ℝ) :
    b * q ^ (b - 1) * qAxial q h η * F +
        q ^ b * (FX * xAxial q h η X + Fη * etaAxial q h η) =
      q ^ (b - D h) * axialCoeff b h η X F FX Fη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.axial_rates
statement:
theorem axial_rates (q h η : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η 0 1 = qAxial q h η ∧
      inverseEta q h η 0 1 = etaAxial q h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.d_add_two_D
statement: theorem d_add_two_D (h η : ℝ) : d η + 2 * D h * η ^ 2 = L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.d_pos
statement: theorem d_pos {η : ℝ} (hη : η ^ 2 < 1) : 0 < d η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.forward_coordinate_identity
statement:
theorem forward_coordinate_identity {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h η : ℝ) :
    q * d η = q - (q ^ D h * η) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.incompressibility_coefficient
statement:
theorem incompressibility_coefficient
    (h η X U UX Uη Ubar UbarX Ubarη UbarηX : ℝ)
    (hU : Ubar + X * UbarX = U) (hUη : Ubarη + X * UbarηX = Uη) :
    (2 * η * U - 2 * D h * η * Ubar - d η * Ubarη +
        X * (2 * η * UX - 2 * D h * η * UbarX - d η * UbarηX)) / L h η =
      -axialCoeff (-A h) h η X U UX Uη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.incompressibility_numerator
statement:
theorem incompressibility_numerator
    (h η X U UX Uη Ubar UbarX Ubarη UbarηX : ℝ)
    (hU : Ubar + X * UbarX = U) (hUη : Ubarη + X * UbarηX = Uη) :
    2 * η * U - 2 * D h * η * Ubar - d η * Ubarη +
        X * (2 * η * UX - 2 * D h * η * UbarX - d η * UbarηX) =
      2 * A h * η * U - d η * Uη + 2 * η * X * UX

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverseEta_recover
statement:
theorem inverseEta_recover {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : L h η ≠ 0)
    (q' η' : ℝ) :
    inverseEta q h η (d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η')
      (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η') = η'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverseQ_recover
statement:
theorem inverseQ_recover {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : L h η ≠ 0)
    (q' η' : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η (d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η')
      (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η') = q'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverse_satisfies_tau
statement:
theorem inverse_satisfies_tau {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (τ' z' : ℝ) :
    d η * inverseQ q h η τ' z' -
        2 * q * η * inverseEta q h η τ' z' = τ'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverse_satisfies_z
statement:
theorem inverse_satisfies_z {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (τ' z' : ℝ) :
    D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * inverseQ q h η τ' z' +
        q ^ D h * inverseEta q h η τ' z' = z'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.jacobian_det
statement:
theorem jacobian_det {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h η : ℝ) :
    d η * q ^ D h - (-2 * q * η) * (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q)) =
      q ^ D h * L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.jacobian_det_pos
statement:
theorem jacobian_det_pos {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hh₀ : 0 ≤ h) (hh : h < 1 / 2) (hη : η ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    0 < d η * q ^ D h - (-2 * q * η) * (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q))

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.qAxial_rpow
statement:
theorem qAxial_rpow {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h η : ℝ) :
    qAxial q h η = 2 * η * q ^ (1 - D h) / L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.rates_unique
statement:
theorem rates_unique {q h η q' η' τ' z' : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (hτ : d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η' = τ')
    (hz : D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η' = z') :
    q' = inverseQ q h η τ' z' ∧ η' = inverseEta q h η τ' z'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.time_chain_coefficient
statement:
theorem time_chain_coefficient {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (b h η X F FX Fη : ℝ) :
    b * q ^ (b - 1) * qTime h η * F +
        q ^ b * (FX * xTime q h η X + Fη * etaTime q h η) =
      q ^ (b - 1) * timeCoeff b h η X F FX Fη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.time_rates
statement:
theorem time_rates (q h η : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η (-1) 0 = qTime h η ∧
      inverseEta q h η (-1) 0 = etaTime q h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.xAxial_from_qAxial
statement:
theorem xAxial_from_qAxial {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h η X : ℝ) :
    xAxial q h η X = -(X / q) * qAxial q h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.xTime_from_qTime
statement:
theorem xTime_from_qTime (q h η X : ℝ) :
    xTime q h η X = -(X / q) * qTime h η

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_abs_lt_one
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_abs_lt_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : |coordinateEta a p| < 1

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_tau
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_tau {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateEta a (t, z))
      (-((1 - a) / 2) * coordinateEta a (τ, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) * scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z)))) τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_time {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateEta a (1 - s, z))
      (((1 - a) / 2) * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (1 - t, z) *
          (1 - a * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) ^ 2))) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateEta a (τ, x))
      ((1 - coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ ((1 - a) / 2) *
          scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z)))) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z_L
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z_L {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateEta a (τ, x))
      ((1 - coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ ((1 - a) / 2) *
          (1 - a * coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2))) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_smooth
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_smooth {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (coordinateEta a) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_sq
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_sq {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    coordinateEta a p ^ 2 = p.2 ^ 2 * coordinateQ a p ^ a / coordinateQ a p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_sq_lt_one
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_sq_lt_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : coordinateEta a p ^ 2 < 1

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_above_threshold
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_above_threshold {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    |p.2| ^ (((1 - a) / 2)⁻¹) < coordinateQ a p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_fderiv_apply {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) (v : ℝ × ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coordinateQ a) p v =
      (v.1 + 2 * p.2 * coordinateQ a p ^ a * v.2) /
        scalarSlope a p.2 (coordinateQ a p)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateQ a (t, z))
      (1 / scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z))) τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau_L
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau_L {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateQ a (t, z))
      (1 / (1 - a * coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2)) τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateQ a (1 - s, z))
      (-1 / scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (1 - t, z))) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time_L
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time_L {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateQ a (1 - s, z))
      (-1 / (1 - a * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) ^ 2)) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_z {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateQ a (τ, x))
      (2 * z * coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ a /
        scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z))) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_z_L
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_z_L {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateQ a (τ, x))
      (2 * coordinateEta a (τ, z) * coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ (1 - (1 - a) / 2) /
        (1 - a * coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2)) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_smooth
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_smooth {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (coordinateQ a) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_smoothOn
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_smoothOn {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (coordinateQ a) {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1}

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_spec
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_spec {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    0 < coordinateQ a p ∧ forwardScalar a p.2 (coordinateQ a p) = p.1

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateX_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem coordinateX_hasDerivAt_time {a s t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u => coordinateX a s (1 - u, z))
      (coordinateX a s (1 - t, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (1 - t, z) * (1 - a * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) ^ 2))) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateX_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem coordinateX_hasDerivAt_z {a s τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateX a s (τ, x))
      (-2 * coordinateEta a (τ, z) * coordinateX a s (τ, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ ((1 - a) / 2) *
          (1 - a * coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2))) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateX_smooth
statement:
theorem coordinateX_smooth {a s : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (coordinateX a s) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.eq_coordinateQ
statement:
theorem eq_coordinateQ {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (he : forwardScalar a p.2 q = p.1) : q = coordinateQ a p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.eventually_inverseMap_forwardMap
statement:
theorem eventually_inverseMap_forwardMap {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hq : 0 < p.1) (hF : 0 < forwardScalar a p.2 p.1) :

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.existsUnique_positive_solution
statement:
theorem existsUnique_positive_solution {a τ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (z : ℝ) : ∃! q : ℝ, 0 < q ∧ forwardScalar a z q = τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.exists_positive_solution
statement:
theorem exists_positive_solution {a τ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (z : ℝ) : ∃ q : ℝ, 0 < q ∧ forwardScalar a z q = τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.forwardMap_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem forwardMap_hasFDerivAt {a : ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ≠ 0)
    (hm : scalarSlope a p.2 p.1 ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (forwardMap a)
      (triangularEquiv (scalarSlope a p.2 p.1) (-2 * p.2 * p.1 ^ a) hm :
        (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.forwardMap_smooth
statement:
theorem forwardMap_smooth {a : ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (forwardMap a) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.forwardScalar_factor
statement:
theorem forwardScalar_factor {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (a z : ℝ) :
    forwardScalar a z q = q ^ a * (q ^ (1 - a) - z ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.forwardScalar_lt
statement:
theorem forwardScalar_lt {a z q₁ q₂ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hqq : q₁ < q₂) (hf₁ : 0 < forwardScalar a z q₁) :

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.inverseMap_forwardMap
statement:
theorem inverseMap_forwardMap {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hq : 0 < p.1) (hF : 0 < forwardScalar a p.2 p.1) :
    inverseMap a (forwardMap a p) = p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.inverseMap_hasFDerivAt_image
statement:
theorem inverseMap_hasFDerivAt_image {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hq : 0 < p.1) (hF : 0 < forwardScalar a p.2 p.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (inverseMap a)
      ((triangularEquiv (scalarSlope a p.2 p.1) (-2 * p.2 * p.1 ^ a)
        (scalarSlope_pos ha ha1 hq hF).ne').symm : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))
      (forwardMap a p)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.inverseMap_smooth_at_image
statement:
theorem inverseMap_smooth_at_image {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hq : 0 < p.1) (hF : 0 < forwardScalar a p.2 p.1) :

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.manuscript_coordinate_existsUnique
statement:
theorem manuscript_coordinate_existsUnique {h τ : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (hτ : 0 < τ) (z : ℝ) :
    ∃! q : ℝ, 0 < q ∧ q - z ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h) = τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.physical_coordinates_smooth
statement:
theorem physical_coordinates_smooth {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞

        (coordinateQ a (1 - x.1, x.2), coordinateEta a (1 - x.1, x.2))) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.positive_solution_unique
statement:
theorem positive_solution_unique {a τ z q₁ q₂ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₂ : 0 < q₂)
    (he₁ : forwardScalar a z q₁ = τ) (he₂ : forwardScalar a z q₂ = τ) : q₁ = q₂

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.scalarSlope_eq_L
statement:
theorem scalarSlope_eq_L {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    scalarSlope a p.2 (coordinateQ a p) = 1 - a * coordinateEta a p ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.scalarSlope_pos
statement:
theorem scalarSlope_pos {a z q : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hf : 0 < forwardScalar a z q) : 0 < scalarSlope a z q

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.tau_coordinate_identity
statement:
theorem tau_coordinate_identity {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    p.1 = coordinateQ a p * (1 - coordinateEta a p ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.D_eq
statement: theorem D_eq (h : ℝ) : (1 - 2 * h) / 2 = D h

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.L_pos
statement:
theorem L_pos {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.T_smoothAt
NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.X_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem X_hasDerivAt_time {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.Z_smoothAt
NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.eta_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem eta_hasDerivAt_time {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityProfile.eta_hasDerivAt_z
statement:

theorem partialX_radialFlux (Ω : RadialDomain) {U : Field}
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U Ω.carrier) (h lam : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hL : CoordinateAlgebra.L h p.2 ≠ 0) :

    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U Ω.carrier) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (lam : ℝ) {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hi : SimilarityProfile.inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    SimilarityProfile.partialS (SimilarityProfile.pullback h lam (radialFlux h lam U)) p +
      SimilarityProfile.partialZ (SimilarityProfile.pullback h (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h + lam) U) p = 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowDivergence.radialFlux_div_radial
statement:
theorem radialFlux_div_radial (h lam : ℝ) (U : Field) {p : Point} (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) :
    radialFlux h lam U p / p.1 = (CoordinateAlgebra.L h p.2)⁻¹ *
      (2 * p.2 * U p - 2 * p.2 * (CoordinateAlgebra.D h + lam) * average U p -
        CoordinateAlgebra.d p.2 * SimilarityProfile.partialEta (average U) p)

name: NavierStokes.SlowDivergence.radialFlux_eq_histories
statement:
theorem radialFlux_eq_histories (Ω : RadialDomain) {U : Field}
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U Ω.carrier) (h lam : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    radialFlux h lam U p =
      (2 * p.2 * (p.1 * U p) -
        2 * p.2 * (CoordinateAlgebra.D h + lam) * primitive U p -
          CoordinateAlgebra.d p.2 * primitive (parameterPartial U) p) /
            CoordinateAlgebra.L h p.2

    radialFlux h lam U p =
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, -SimilarityProfile.Z h (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h + lam) U (x, p.2)

      profilePoint t ⁻¹' (tsupport H ∪ tsupport K)

statement:
theorem tsupport_velocity_cylinder_subset (H K : Profile) (t R Z : ℝ)
    (hH : tsupport H ⊆ {p : ProfilePoint | p.2.1 ≤ R ∧ |p.2.2| ≤ Z})
    (hK : tsupport K ⊆ {p : ProfilePoint | p.2.1 ≤ R ∧ |p.2.2| ≤ Z}) :
    tsupport (fun x : Space => velocity H K (t, x)) ⊆
      {x : Space | radialEnergy x ≤ R ∧ |x 2| ≤ Z}

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricFields.tsupport_velocity_slice_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_velocity_slice_subset (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) :
    tsupport (fun x : Space => velocity H K (t, x)) ⊆
      profilePoint t ⁻¹' (tsupport H ∪ tsupport K)

statement:
theorem velocity_eq_zero_outside_profile_support (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hH : profilePoint t x ∉ tsupport H) (hK : profilePoint t x ∉ tsupport K) :
    velocity H K (t, x) = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricFields.velocity_on_axis
statement:
theorem velocity_on_axis (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hH : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (profilePoint t x))
    (hK : DifferentiableAt ℝ K (profilePoint t x)) (hx0 : x 0 = 0) (hx1 : x 1 = 0) :
    velocity H K (t, x) = H (t, (0, x 2)) • coordinateVector 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricFields.velocity_one
statement:
theorem velocity_one (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hH : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (profilePoint t x))
    (hK : DifferentiableAt ℝ K (profilePoint t x)) :
    velocity H K (t, x) 1 =
      -x 1 * partialZ H (profilePoint t x) / 2 - x 0 * partialS K (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricFields.velocity_two
statement:
theorem velocity_two (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hH : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (profilePoint t x))
    (hK : DifferentiableAt ℝ K (profilePoint t x)) :
    velocity H K (t, x) 2 =
      H (profilePoint t x) + radialEnergy x * partialS H (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricFields.velocity_zero
statement:
theorem velocity_zero (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hH : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (profilePoint t x))
    (hK : DifferentiableAt ℝ K (profilePoint t x)) :
    velocity H K (t, x) 0 =
      -x 0 * partialZ H (profilePoint t x) / 2 + x 1 * partialS K (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.SliceC2.differentiable
statement:
theorem SliceC2.differentiable {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.advection_velocity
statement:
theorem advection_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    advection (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (x 0 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (advectionAxial B U (profilePoint t x))

theorem contDiff_lift_slice {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_add
statement:
theorem direction_add {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hb : Differentiable ℝ b) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => a y + b y) i x = direction a i x + direction b i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_coord_mul
statement:
theorem direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
    (i j : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => y i * g y) j x =
      (coordinateVector j) i * g x + x i * direction g j x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_one
statement:
theorem direction_lift_one {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    direction (lift G t) 1 x = x 1 * lift (partialS G) t x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_two
statement:
theorem direction_lift_two {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    direction (lift G t) 2 x = lift (partialZ G) t x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_zero
statement:
theorem direction_lift_zero {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    direction (lift G t) 0 x = x 0 * lift (partialS G) t x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_neg
statement:
theorem direction_neg (a : Space → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => -a y) i x = -direction a i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_sub
statement:
theorem direction_sub {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hb : Differentiable ℝ b) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => a y - b y) i x = direction a i x - direction b i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.divergence_velocity
statement:
theorem divergence_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    spatialDivergence (velocity B F U) t x =
      partialZ U (profilePoint t x) - 2 * B (profilePoint t x) -
        2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.divergence_velocity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem divergence_velocity_eq_zero {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space)
    (h : partialZ U (profilePoint t x) =
      2 * B (profilePoint t x) + 2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialDivergence (velocity B F U) t x = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.fderiv_lift_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_lift_apply {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t)
    (x v : Space) : fderiv ℝ (lift G t) x v =
      (x 0 * v 0 + x 1 * v 1) * partialS G (profilePoint t x) +
        v 2 * partialZ G (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.fderiv_pack_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_pack_apply {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {a b c : E → ℝ} {x : E} (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x)
    (hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b x) (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) x v =
      pack (fderiv ℝ a x v) (fderiv ℝ b x v) (fderiv ℝ c x v)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.hasFDerivAt_pack
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_pack {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {a b c : E → ℝ} {da db dc : E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {x : E}
    (ha : HasFDerivAt a da x) (hb : HasFDerivAt b db x) (hc : HasFDerivAt c dc x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) (packDerivative da db dc) x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.hasFDerivAt_time_lift
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_time_lift {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun s => lift G s x) (timeProfileDerivative G (profilePoint t x)) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.hasFDerivAt_velocity
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => velocity B F U (t, y)) (velocityJacobian B F U t x) x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_eq_zero {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t)
    (hP : SliceDifferentiable P t) (x : Space)
    (hr : residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (ha : residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (hz : residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x) = 0) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_on_axis
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_on_axis {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t)
    (hP : SliceDifferentiable P t) (x : Space) (hx0 : x 0 = 0) (hx1 : x 1 = 0) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x =
      residualAxial B U P (t, (0, x 2)) • coordinateVector 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_velocity
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_velocity {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t)
    (hP : SliceDifferentiable P t) (x : Space) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x =
      pack (x 0 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.packDerivative_apply

@[simp] theorem packDerivative_apply {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (a b c : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E) : packDerivative a b c v = pack (a v) (b v) (c v)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.pack_two

statement:
theorem pressureGradient_pressure {P : Profile} {t : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_add
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_add {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 a)
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 b) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => a y + b y) x = scalarLaplacian a x + scalarLaplacian b x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_coord_mul
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)
    (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => y i * g y) x =
      x i * scalarLaplacian g x + 2 * direction g i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_lift
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_lift {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (lift G t) x = laplaceScalar G (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_neg
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_neg (a : Space → ℝ) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => -a y) x = -scalarLaplacian a x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_sub
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_sub {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 a)
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 b) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => a y - b y) x = scalarLaplacian a x - scalarLaplacian b x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_weighted_one
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_weighted_one {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => y 1 * lift G t y) x =
      x 1 * laplaceWeighted G (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_weighted_zero
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_weighted_zero {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) (x : Space) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => y 0 * lift G t y) x =
      x 0 * laplaceWeighted G (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.second_direction_coord_mul
statement:
theorem second_direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)
    (i j : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => direction (fun z => z i * g z) j y) j x =
      2 * (coordinateVector j) i * direction g j x +
        x i * direction (fun y => direction g j y) j x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.sliceC2_of_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.spatialLaplacian_velocity
statement:
theorem spatialLaplacian_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t) (x : Space) :
    spatialLaplacian (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) -
        x 1 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (-x 1 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) +
        x 0 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (laplaceScalar U (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.temporalDerivative_velocity
statement:
theorem temporalDerivative_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    temporalDerivative (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) - x 1 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (-x 1 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) + x 0 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (partialT U (profilePoint t x))

statement:
@[simp] theorem timeProfileDerivative_one (G : Profile) (p : ProfilePoint) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.vectorLaplacian_pack
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_pack {a b c : Space → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 a) (hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 b) (hc : ContDiff ℝ 2 c) (x : Space) :
    vectorLaplacian (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) x =
      pack (scalarLaplacian a x) (scalarLaplacian b x) (scalarLaplacian c x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.velocity_from_potential

theorem velocity_from_potential {H K : Profile}

statement:
theorem velocity_from_potential_at (H K : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hH : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (profilePoint t x))
    (hK : DifferentiableAt ℝ K (profilePoint t x)) :

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.advection_velocity
statement:
theorem advection_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    advection (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (x 0 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (advectionAxial B U (profilePoint t x))

NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_two

statement:
theorem divergence_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :

    fderiv ℝ (lift G t) x v =

statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_eq_zero {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}

    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (profilePoint t x))
    (hr : residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (ha : residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (hz : residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x) = 0) :

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_velocity
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_velocity {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (profilePoint t x)) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x =
      pack (x 0 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))

        (partialZ P (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_weighted_zero

theorem scalarLaplacian_weighted_zero {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hG : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 G (profilePoint t x)) :
    scalarLaplacian (fun y => y 0 * lift G t y) x =

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.second_direction_coord_mul
statement:
theorem second_direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x) (i j : Fin 3) :
    direction (fun y => direction (fun z => z i * g z) j y) j x =
      2 * (coordinateVector j) i * direction g j x +
        x i * direction (fun y => direction g j y) j x

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.spatialLaplacian_velocity
statement:
theorem spatialLaplacian_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialLaplacian (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) -
        x 1 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (-x 1 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) +
        x 0 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (laplaceScalar U (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.temporalDerivative_velocity
statement:
theorem temporalDerivative_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    temporalDerivative (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) - x 1 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (-x 1 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) + x 0 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (partialT U (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.vectorLaplacian_pack
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_pack {a b c : Space → ℝ} {x : Space}
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a x) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b x) (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 c x) :
    vectorLaplacian (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) x =
      pack (scalarLaplacian a x) (scalarLaplacian b x) (scalarLaplacian c x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.contDiffAt_radialB
NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.differentiableAt_radialB
NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.divergence_coefficient
statement:
theorem divergence_coefficient {V : Profile} (U : Profile) {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialZ U p - 2 * radialB V p - 2 * p.2.1 * partialS (radialB V) p =
      partialS V p + partialZ U p

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.divergence_radialB
statement:
theorem divergence_radialB {V F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    spatialDivergence (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U) t x =
      partialS V (profilePoint t x) + partialZ U (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.divergence_velocity_at
statement:
theorem divergence_velocity_at {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialDivergence (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity B F U) t x =
      partialZ U (profilePoint t x) - 2 * B (profilePoint t x) -
        2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.fderiv_radialB_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_radialB_apply {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) (v : ProfilePoint) :
    fderiv ℝ (radialB V) p v =
      -fderiv ℝ V p v / (2 * p.2.1) + V p * v.2.1 / (2 * p.2.1 ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.laplaceWeighted_radialB
statement:
theorem laplaceWeighted_radialB {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    laplaceWeighted (radialB V) p =
      -partialS (partialS V) p - partialZ (partialZ V) p / (2 * p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialS_partialS_radialB
statement:
theorem partialS_partialS_radialB {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialS (partialS (radialB V)) p =
      -partialS (partialS V) p / (2 * p.2.1) +
        partialS V p / p.2.1 ^ 2 - V p / p.2.1 ^ 3

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialS_radialB
statement:
theorem partialS_radialB {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialS (radialB V) p =
      radialB (partialS V) p + 2 * radialB (radialB V) p

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialS_radialB_explicit
statement:
theorem partialS_radialB_explicit {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialS (radialB V) p =
      -partialS V p / (2 * p.2.1) + V p / (2 * p.2.1 ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialT_radialB
NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialZ_partialZ_radialB
NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialZ_radialB
NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.physical_radial_flux_residual
statement:
theorem physical_radial_flux_residual {V F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 V (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (profilePoint t x)) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    x 0 * navierStokesResidual (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U)
        (pressure P) t x 0 +
      x 1 * navierStokesResidual (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U)
        (pressure P) t x 1 = fluxResidual V F U P (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.radial_flux_velocity
statement:
theorem radial_flux_velocity (V F U : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    x 0 * AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U (t, x) 0 +
      x 1 * AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U (t, x) 1 =
        V (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.residualRadial_radialB
NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.angularCoefficient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem angularCoefficient_eq_zero_iff (h : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles)
    (n : ℕ) (w : InnerPoint) :
    angularCoefficient h f n w = 0 ↔
      2 * (w.1 * partialX (partialX (f.phi n)) w + 2 * partialX (f.phi n) w) =
        T h (angularExponent h + slowOrder h n) (f.phi n) w +
          convolution (fun i j => f.flux i w *
              (partialX (f.phi j) w + f.phi j w / w.1) +
            f.axial i w * Z h (angularExponent h + slowOrder h j) (f.phi j) w) n -
          previous (fun j => Z2 h (angularExponent h + slowOrder h j) (f.phi j) w) n

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.angular_finite_expansion
statement:
theorem angular_finite_expansion {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.phi n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    transportResidual 1 2 (slowFlux N h f) (slowAxial N h f) (slowSwirl N h C f) (fun _ => 0) p =
      C⁻¹ * (finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (angularExponent h - 1)
        (fun n => angularCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) +
        transportTail N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (angularExponent h) 1
          f.flux f.axial f.phi (SimilarityProfile.inner h p))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.axialCoefficient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem axialCoefficient_eq_zero_iff (h : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles)
    (n : ℕ) (w : InnerPoint) :
    axialCoefficient h f n w = 0 ↔
      2 * (w.1 * partialX (partialX (f.axial n)) w + partialX (f.axial n) w) =
        T h (axialExponent h + slowOrder h n) (f.axial n) w +
          convolution (fun i j => f.flux i w * partialX (f.axial j) w +
            f.axial i w * Z h (axialExponent h + slowOrder h j) (f.axial j) w) n +
          Z h (pressureExponent h + slowOrder h n) (f.pressure n) w -
          previous (fun j => Z2 h (axialExponent h + slowOrder h j) (f.axial j) w) n

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.axialViscosity_shift
statement:
theorem axialViscosity_shift (N : ℕ) (q h b : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h (b - 2 * CoordinateAlgebra.D h) a =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (b - 1 + slowOrder h (n + 1)) * a n

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.axial_finite_expansion
statement:
theorem axial_finite_expansion {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : SlowProfiles) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.axial n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p))
    (hπ : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.pressure n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    transportResidual 0 1 (slowFlux N h f) (slowAxial N h f) (slowAxial N h f)
      (partialZ (slowPressure N h f)) p =
    finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (axialExponent h - 1)
      (fun n => axialCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) +
      transportTail N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (axialExponent h) 0
        f.flux f.axial f.axial (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.derivativeAlong_scale
NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.derivativeAlong_sum
statement:
theorem derivativeAlong_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Profile)
    (v p : ProfilePoint) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) p) :
    derivativeAlong v (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y) p =
      ∑ i ∈ s, derivativeAlong v (f i) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.divergenceCoefficient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem divergenceCoefficient_eq_zero_iff (h : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles)
    (n : ℕ) (w : InnerPoint) :
    divergenceCoefficient h f n w = 0 ↔
      partialX (f.flux n) w =
        -Z h (axialExponent h + slowOrder h n) (f.axial n) w

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.divergence_finite_expansion
statement:
theorem divergence_finite_expansion {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : SlowProfiles) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hv : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.flux n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p))
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.axial n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    partialS (slowFlux N h f) p + partialZ (slowAxial N h f) p =
      finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (-1)
        (fun n => divergenceCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.divergence_slowVelocity
statement:
theorem divergence_slowVelocity {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (ht : t < 1) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x)
    (hv : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.flux n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.phi n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.axial n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x))) :
    ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence (slowVelocity N h C f) t x =
      finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h (profilePoint t x)) h (-1)
        (fun n => divergenceCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.divergence_slowVelocity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem divergence_slowVelocity_eq_zero {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (ht : t < 1) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x)
    (hv : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.flux n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.phi n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.axial n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hdiv : ∀ n ≤ N, divergenceCoefficient h f n
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)) = 0) :
    ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence (slowVelocity N h C f) t x = 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteConvolution_eq
statement:
theorem finiteConvolution_eq {N n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteConvolution N K n = convolution K n

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteProfile_differentiableAt
statement:
theorem finiteProfile_differentiableAt {h e : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (finiteProfile N h e f) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteProfile_order_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteProfile_order_zero (h b : ℝ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) :
    finiteProfile 0 h b f = pullback h b (f 0)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteProfile_smoothAt
statement:
theorem finiteProfile_smoothAt {h e : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (finiteProfile N h e f) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteProfile_value
statement:
theorem finiteProfile_value (N : ℕ) (h b : ℝ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) (p : ProfilePoint) :
    finiteProfile N h b f p = finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h b
      (fun n => f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteProfile_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteProfile_zero (N : ℕ) (h b : ℝ) :
    finiteProfile N h b (fun _ _ => 0) = fun _ => 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_add
statement:
theorem finiteSeries_add (N : ℕ) (q h b : ℝ) (a d : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h b (fun n => a n + d n) =
      finiteSeries N q h b a + finiteSeries N q h b d

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_div_qX
statement:
theorem finiteSeries_div_qX {q X : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hX : X ≠ 0)
    (N : ℕ) (h b : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h b a / (q * X) =
      finiteSeries N q h (b - 1) (fun n => a n / X)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSeries_eq_zero (N : ℕ) (q h e : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n ≤ N, a n = 0) : finiteSeries N q h e a = 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_mul
statement:
theorem finiteSeries_mul {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (N : ℕ) (h b c : ℝ) (a d : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h b a * finiteSeries N q h c d =
      ∑ ij ∈ pairs N, q ^ (b + c + slowOrder h (ij.1 + ij.2)) * (a ij.1 * d ij.2)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_mul_q
statement:
theorem finiteSeries_mul_q {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (N : ℕ) (h b : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    q * finiteSeries N q h b a = finiteSeries N q h (b + 1) a

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_order_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteSeries_order_zero (q h b : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries 0 q h b a = q ^ b * a 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.finiteSeries_scale
statement:
theorem finiteSeries_scale (N : ℕ) (q h b c : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h b (fun n => c * a n) = c * finiteSeries N q h b a

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.navierStokesResidual_slowVelocity
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_slowVelocity {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (ht : t < 1) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x)
    (hv : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.flux n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.phi n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.axial n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hπ : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.pressure n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x))) :
    ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual (slowVelocity N h C f) (slowPressureField N h f) t x =
      let q := SimilarityProfile.q h (profilePoint t x)
      let w := SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)
      AxisymmetricResidual.pack
        (x 0 * (radialFluxExpansion N q h C f w / (2 * radialEnergy x)) -
          x 1 * angularExpansion N q h C f w)
        (x 1 * (radialFluxExpansion N q h C f w / (2 * radialEnergy x)) +
          x 0 * angularExpansion N q h C f w)
        (axialExpansion N q h f w)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.navierStokesResidual_slowVelocity_of_coefficients
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_slowVelocity_of_coefficients
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (ht : t < 1) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x)
    (hv : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.flux n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.phi n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.axial n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hπ : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.pressure n)
      (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)))
    (hA : ∀ n ≤ N, angularCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)) = 0)
    (hZ : ∀ n ≤ N, axialCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)) = 0)
    (hR : ∀ n ≤ N, pressureCoefficient h C f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h (profilePoint t x)) = 0) :
    ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual (slowVelocity N h C f) (slowPressureField N h f) t x =
      truncationResidual N h C f t x

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.omegaCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem omegaCoefficient_eq (h : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) (n : ℕ) (w : InnerPoint) :
    omegaCoefficient h f n w =
      T h (slowOrder h n) (f.flux n) w +
        convolution (fun i j => f.flux i w *
            (partialX (f.flux j) w - f.flux j w / (2 * w.1)) +
          f.axial i w * Z h (slowOrder h j) (f.flux j) w) n -
        2 * w.1 * partialX (partialX (f.flux n)) w -
        previous (fun j => Z2 h (slowOrder h j) (f.flux j) w) n

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.omega_finite_expansion
statement:
theorem omega_finite_expansion {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : SlowProfiles) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.flux n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    transportResidual (-(1 / 2)) 0 (slowFlux N h f) (slowAxial N h f) (slowFlux N h f)
      (fun _ => 0) p =
    finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (-1)
      (fun n => omegaCoefficient h f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) +
      transportTail N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h 0 (-(1 / 2))
        f.flux f.axial f.flux (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.pairTail_order_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairTail_order_zero (w : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    pairTail 0 w K = 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.pair_sum_low
statement:
theorem pair_sum_low (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w n * finiteConvolution N K n) =
      ∑ ij ∈ (pairs N).filter (fun ij => ij.1 + ij.2 ≤ N),
        w (ij.1 + ij.2) * K ij.1 ij.2

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.pair_sum_split
statement:
theorem pair_sum_split (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ ij ∈ pairs N, w (ij.1 + ij.2) * K ij.1 ij.2) =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w n * convolution K n) + pairTail N w K

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.partialSS_finiteProfile
statement:
theorem partialSS_finiteProfile {h b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    partialS (partialS (finiteProfile N h b f)) p =
      finiteProfile N h (b - 2) (fun n => partialX (partialX (f n))) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.partialS_finiteProfile
statement:
theorem partialS_finiteProfile {h b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    partialS (finiteProfile N h b f) p =
      finiteProfile N h (b - 1) (fun n => partialX (f n)) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.partialT_finiteProfile
statement:
theorem partialT_finiteProfile {h b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    AxisymmetricResidual.partialT (finiteProfile N h b f) p =
      finiteProfile N h (b - 1) (fun n => T h (b + slowOrder h n) (f n)) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.partialZZ_finiteProfile
statement:
theorem partialZZ_finiteProfile {h b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    partialZ (partialZ (finiteProfile N h b f)) p =
      finiteProfile N h (b - 2 * CoordinateAlgebra.D h)
        (fun n => Z2 h (b + slowOrder h n) (f n)) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.partialZ_finiteProfile
statement:
theorem partialZ_finiteProfile {h b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    partialZ (finiteProfile N h b f) p =
      finiteProfile N h (b - CoordinateAlgebra.D h)
        (fun n => Z h (b + slowOrder h n) (f n)) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.pressureCoefficient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem pressureCoefficient_eq_zero_iff (h C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles)
    (n : ℕ) (w : InnerPoint) :
    pressureCoefficient h C f n w = 0 ↔
      partialX (f.pressure n) w =
        C⁻¹ ^ 2 * convolution (fun i j => f.phi i w * f.phi j w) n -
          previous (fun j => omegaCoefficient h f j w) n / (2 * w.1)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.pressure_finite_expansion
statement:
theorem pressure_finite_expansion {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hv : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f.flux n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p))
    (hπ : ∀ n ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f.pressure n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    RadialFluxResidual.fluxResidual (slowFlux N h f) (slowSwirl N h C f)
      (slowAxial N h f) (slowPressure N h f) p =
    2 * (SimilarityProfile.inner h p).1 *
      finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (pressureExponent h)
        (fun n => pressureCoefficient h C f n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) +
      pressureTail N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h C f (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.pressure_series_identity
statement:
theorem pressure_series_identity {q X : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hX : X ≠ 0)
    (N : ℕ) (h C tail : ℝ) (phi px omega : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h (-1) omega + tail +
      2 * (q * X) * (finiteSeries N q h (pressureExponent h - 1) px -
        (C⁻¹ * finiteSeries N q h (angularExponent h) phi) ^ 2) =
    2 * X * finiteSeries N q h (pressureExponent h)
      (fun n => px n - C⁻¹ ^ 2 * convolution (fun i j => phi i * phi j) n +
        previous omega n / (2 * X)) +
      (tail + q ^ (pressureExponent h + slowOrder h (N + 1)) * omega N -
        2 * X * C⁻¹ ^ 2 * pairTail N (fun n => q ^ (pressureExponent h + slowOrder h n))
          (fun i j => phi i * phi j))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.previous_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem previous_succ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : previous a (n + 1) = a n

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.previous_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem previous_zero (a : ℕ → ℝ) : previous a 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.q_mul_X
statement:
theorem q_mul_X {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : ProfilePoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) :
    SimilarityProfile.q h p * (SimilarityProfile.inner h p).1 = p.2.1

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.radialDiffusion_series
statement:
theorem radialDiffusion_series {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (N : ℕ)
    (h b X m : ℝ) (a d : ℕ → ℝ) :
    2 * (q * X) * finiteSeries N q h (b - 2) d +
      2 * m * finiteSeries N q h (b - 1) a =
      finiteSeries N q h (b - 1) (fun n => 2 * (X * d n + m * a n))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.recurrence_truncation
statement:
theorem recurrence_truncation (N : ℕ) (w L A : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w n * L n) +
      (∑ ij ∈ pairs N, w (ij.1 + ij.2) * K ij.1 ij.2) -
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w (n + 1) * A n) =
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w n * recurrence L K A n) +
      pairTail N w K - w (N + 1) * A N

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.recurrence_truncation_of_zero
statement:
theorem recurrence_truncation_of_zero (N : ℕ) (w L A : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ n ≤ N, recurrence L K A n = 0) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w n * L n) +
      (∑ ij ∈ pairs N, w (ij.1 + ij.2) * K ij.1 ij.2) -
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w (n + 1) * A n) =
      pairTail N w K - w (N + 1) * A N

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.residualAngular_radialB
statement:
theorem residualAngular_radialB (V F U : Profile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    AxisymmetricResidual.residualAngular (RadialFluxResidual.radialB V) F U p =
      -transportResidual 1 2 V U F (fun _ => 0) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.residualAxial_radialB
statement:
theorem residualAxial_radialB (V U P : Profile) {p : ProfilePoint} (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    AxisymmetricResidual.residualAxial (RadialFluxResidual.radialB V) U P p =
      transportResidual 0 1 V U U (partialZ P) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.rpow_product_order
statement:
theorem rpow_product_order {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h b c : ℝ) (i j : ℕ) :
    q ^ (b + slowOrder h i) * q ^ (c + slowOrder h j) =
      q ^ (b + c + slowOrder h (i + j))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.secondAlong_scale
statement:
theorem secondAlong_scale (c : ℝ) {f : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f p) (v w : ProfilePoint) :
    derivativeAlong w (derivativeAlong v (fun y => c * f y)) p =
      c * derivativeAlong w (derivativeAlong v f) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.secondAlong_sum
statement:
theorem secondAlong_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Profile)
    (v w p : ProfilePoint) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f i) p) :
    derivativeAlong w (derivativeAlong v (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y)) p =
      ∑ i ∈ s, derivativeAlong w (derivativeAlong v (f i)) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.shifted_sum
statement:
theorem shifted_sum (N : ℕ) (w a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w (n + 1) * a n) =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w n * previous a n) + w (N + 1) * a N

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.slowOrder_add
statement:
theorem slowOrder_add (h : ℝ) (i j : ℕ) :
    slowOrder h (i + j) = slowOrder h i + slowOrder h j

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.slowOrder_succ
statement:
theorem slowOrder_succ (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    slowOrder h (n + 1) = slowOrder h n + 2 * h

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.slowOrder_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem slowOrder_zero (h : ℝ) : slowOrder h 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.slowVelocity_components
statement:
theorem slowVelocity_components (N : ℕ) (h C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles)
    (t : ℝ) (x : ProblemStatement.Space) :
    slowVelocity N h C f (t, x) =
      AxisymmetricResidual.pack
        (x 0 * (slowFlux N h f (profilePoint t x) / (2 * radialEnergy x)) -
          x 1 * slowSwirl N h C f (profilePoint t x))
        (x 1 * (slowFlux N h f (profilePoint t x) / (2 * radialEnergy x)) +
          x 0 * slowSwirl N h C f (profilePoint t x))
        (slowAxial N h f (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.slowVelocity_radial_flux
statement:
theorem slowVelocity_radial_flux (N : ℕ) (h C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles)
    (t : ℝ) (x : ProblemStatement.Space) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    x 0 * slowVelocity N h C f (t, x) 0 + x 1 * slowVelocity N h C f (t, x) 1 =
      slowFlux N h f (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.transportResidual_scale
statement:
theorem transportResidual_scale (c α m : ℝ) (V U : Profile) {G : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hG : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 G p) :
    transportResidual α m V U (fun y => c * G y) (fun _ => 0) p =
      c * transportResidual α m V U G (fun _ => 0) p

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.transportTail_order_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem transportTail_order_zero (q h e α : ℝ)
    (v u f : ℕ → InnerProfile) (w : InnerPoint) :
    transportTail 0 q h e α v u f w =
      -q ^ (e - 1 + 2 * h) * Z2 h e (f 0) w

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.transport_finiteProfile
statement:
theorem transport_finiteProfile {h e : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (α m : ℝ) (v u f source : ℕ → InnerProfile) {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hf : ∀ n ≤ N, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f n) (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) :
    transportResidual α m (finiteProfile N h 0 v)
      (finiteProfile N h (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h) u) (finiteProfile N h e f)
      (finiteProfile N h (e - 1) source) p =
    finiteSeries N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h (e - 1)
      (fun n => transportCoefficient h e α m v u f source n (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)) +
    transportTail N (SimilarityProfile.q h p) h e α v u f (SimilarityProfile.inner h p)

name: NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.transport_series_identity
statement:
theorem transport_series_identity {q X : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hX : X ≠ 0)
    (N : ℕ) (h e α m : ℝ) (v u g gt gx gxx gz gzz source : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finiteSeries N q h (e - 1) gt +
      finiteSeries N q h 0 v * (finiteSeries N q h (e - 1) gx +
        α * (finiteSeries N q h e g / (q * X))) +
      finiteSeries N q h (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h) u *
        finiteSeries N q h (e - CoordinateAlgebra.D h) gz -
      (2 * (q * X) * finiteSeries N q h (e - 2) gxx +
        2 * m * finiteSeries N q h (e - 1) gx +
        finiteSeries N q h (e - 2 * CoordinateAlgebra.D h) gzz) +
      finiteSeries N q h (e - 1) source =
    finiteSeries N q h (e - 1)
      (recurrence (transportLinear X m gt gx gxx source) (transportPair X α v u g gx gz) gzz) +
      pairTail N (fun n => q ^ (e - 1 + slowOrder h n)) (transportPair X α v u g gx gz) -
      q ^ (e - 1 + slowOrder h (N + 1)) * gzz N

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.angularComponent_pack
statement:
theorem angularComponent_pack {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (hs : 0 < AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) (R T Z : ℝ) :
    angularComponent x (AxisymmetricResidual.pack (x 0 * R + x 1 * T)
      (x 1 * R - x 0 * T) Z) = -Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) * T

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.axialAxialViscosity_eq
statement:
theorem axialAxialViscosity_eq {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    axialAxialViscosity P h p = SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (-A h - 1 + 2 * h) *
      SlowExpansionResidual.Z2 h (-A h) P.U (inner h p)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.axial_divergence
statement:
theorem axial_divergence (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : 0 < w.1) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * partialX (axial P h) w +
        axial P h w / Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) =
      sourceAxial P h w / L h w.2 +
        2 * (w.1 * partialX (partialX P.U) w + partialX P.U w)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.axial_eq_lag_plus_slope
statement:
theorem axial_eq_lag_plus_slope (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hX : 0 < w.1)
    (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) :
    axial P h w = P.f w *
      (w.1 * P.axialLag h w / (L h w.2 * P.E w) + slopeB P w)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.axial_smoothAt
statement:
theorem axial_smoothAt (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : w.1 ≠ 0) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (axial P h) w

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.axial_transport_coefficient
statement:
theorem axial_transport_coefficient (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    SimilarityProfile.T h (-A h) P.U w +
        SlowDivergence.radialFlux h 0 P.U w * partialX P.U w +
        P.U w * SimilarityProfile.Z h (-A h) P.U w +
        SimilarityProfile.Z h (-2 * A h) P.pressure w =
      -sourceAxial P h w / L h w.2

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.axial_transport_stress
statement:
theorem axial_transport_stress {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    SlowExpansionResidual.transportResidual 0 1 (fluxProfile P h) (axialProfile P h)
        (axialProfile P h) (SimilarityProfile.partialZ (pressureProfile P h)) p +
        axialAxialViscosity P h p = -radialDivergence 1 (physicalStressAxial P h) p

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.hasDerivAt_radialSlice
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_radialSlice {S : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalProfile}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hs : 0 ≤ p.2.1) (hS : DifferentiableAt ℝ S p) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => S (p.1, (r ^ 2 / 2, p.2.2)))
      (Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1) * SimilarityProfile.partialS S p) (Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.inner_X_pos
statement:
theorem inner_X_pos {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    0 < (inner h p).1

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.navierStokesResidual_tangential
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_tangential {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space} (ht : t < 1)
    (hs : 0 < AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x)
    (hw : inner h (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hf : P.f (inner h (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)) ≠ 0) :
    (angularComponent x (ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual
        (physicalVelocity P h) (physicalPressure P h) t x) +
        thetaAxialViscosity P h (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) =
      -radialDivergence 2 (physicalStressTheta P h) (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)) ∧
    ((ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual (physicalVelocity P h) (physicalPressure P h) t x) 2 +
        axialAxialViscosity P h (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) =
      -radialDivergence 1 (physicalStressAxial P h) (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.partialX_H
statement:
theorem partialX_H {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    partialX P.H w = 2 * P.f w + 2 * w.1 * partialX P.f w

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.partialX_axial
statement:
theorem partialX_axial (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : 0 < w.1) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    partialX (axial P h) w =
      (partialX P.U w + P.axialLag h w / (2 * L h w.2)) / Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) +
      Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * (partialX (partialX P.U) w +
        partialX (P.axialLag h) w / (2 * L h w.2))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.partialX_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem partialX_hasDerivAt {f : Field} {w : Point} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f w) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => f (x, w.2)) (partialX f w) w.1

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.partialX_theta
statement:
theorem partialX_theta (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : w.1 ≠ 0) (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    partialX (theta P h) w =
      (partialX P.f w * w.1 * P.angularLag h w + P.f w * P.angularLag h w +
        P.f w * w.1 * partialX (P.angularLag h) w) / L h w.2 +
        2 * partialX P.f w + 2 * w.1 * partialX (partialX P.f) w

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.partialZ_pressureProfile
statement:
theorem partialZ_pressureProfile {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    SimilarityProfile.partialZ (pressureProfile P h) p =
      pullback h (-A h - 1) (SimilarityProfile.Z h (-2 * A h) P.pressure) p

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.physical_radius
statement:
theorem physical_radius {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1) = SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (2 * (inner h p).1)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.physical_swirl_value
statement:
theorem physical_swirl_value {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1) * swirlProfile P h p = pullback h (-A h) P.E p

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.radialDivergence_eq_deriv
statement:
theorem radialDivergence_eq_deriv (k : ℝ) {S : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalProfile}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hs : 0 ≤ p.2.1) (hS : DifferentiableAt ℝ S p) :
    radialDivergence k S p =
      deriv (fun r => S (p.1, (r ^ 2 / 2, p.2.2))) (Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1)) +
        k * S p / Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.radialDivergence_physicalStressAxial
statement:
theorem radialDivergence_physicalStressAxial {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    radialDivergence 1 (physicalStressAxial P h) p =
      SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (-A h - 1) *
        (sourceAxial P h (inner h p) / L h (inner h p).2 +
          2 * ((inner h p).1 * partialX (partialX P.U) (inner h p) +
            partialX P.U (inner h p)))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.radialDivergence_physicalStressTheta
statement:
theorem radialDivergence_physicalStressTheta {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) (hf : P.f (inner h p) ≠ 0) :
    radialDivergence 2 (physicalStressTheta P h) p =
      SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (-A h - 1) * (Real.sqrt (2 * (inner h p).1) *
        (P.f (inner h p) * sourceTheta P h (inner h p) / L h (inner h p).2 +
          2 * ((inner h p).1 * partialX (partialX P.f) (inner h p) +
            2 * partialX P.f (inner h p))))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.radialDivergence_pullback
statement:
theorem radialDivergence_pullback {h b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (k : ℝ) {S : Field} {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hS : DifferentiableAt ℝ S (inner h p)) :
    radialDivergence k (pullback h b S) p = SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (b - 1 / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt (2 * (inner h p).1) * partialX S (inner h p) +
        k * S (inner h p) / Real.sqrt (2 * (inner h p).1))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.radius_mul_rpow
statement:
theorem radius_mul_rpow {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (b : ℝ) {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1) * SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ b =
      SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (b + 1 / 2) * Real.sqrt (2 * (inner h p).1)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.sqrt_radial_two
statement:
theorem sqrt_radial_two {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (S SX : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * X) * SX + 2 * S / Real.sqrt (2 * X) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (SX + S / X)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.thetaAxialViscosity_eq
statement:
theorem thetaAxialViscosity_eq {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    thetaAxialViscosity P h p = SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (-A h - 1 + 2 * h) *
      (Real.sqrt (2 * (inner h p).1) *
        SlowExpansionResidual.Z2 h (-A h - 1 / 2) P.f (inner h p))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.theta_divergence
statement:
theorem theta_divergence (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : 0 < w.1) (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * (partialX (theta P h) w + theta P h w / w.1) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * (P.f w * sourceTheta P h w / L h w.2 +
        2 * (w.1 * partialX (partialX P.f) w + 2 * partialX P.f w))

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.theta_divergence_coefficient
statement:
theorem theta_divergence_coefficient (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : w.1 ≠ 0) (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    partialX (theta P h) w + theta P h w / w.1 =
      P.f w * sourceTheta P h w / L h w.2 +
        2 * (w.1 * partialX (partialX P.f) w + 2 * partialX P.f w)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.theta_eq_lag_minus_slope
statement:
theorem theta_eq_lag_minus_slope (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) :
    theta P h w = P.f w * (w.1 * P.angularLag h w / L h w.2 - slopeA P w)

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.theta_smoothAt
statement:
theorem theta_smoothAt (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : w.1 ≠ 0) (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (theta P h) w

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.theta_transport_coefficient
statement:
theorem theta_transport_coefficient (h : ℝ) {w : Point} (hw : w ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hX : w.1 ≠ 0) (hf : P.f w ≠ 0) (hL : L h w.2 ≠ 0) :
    SimilarityProfile.T h (-A h - 1 / 2) P.f w +
        SlowDivergence.radialFlux h 0 P.U w * (partialX P.f w + P.f w / w.1) +
        P.U w * SimilarityProfile.Z h (-A h - 1 / 2) P.f w =
      -P.f w * sourceTheta P h w / L h w.2

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.theta_transport_stress
statement:
theorem theta_transport_stress {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hw : inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) (hf : P.f (inner h p) ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * p.2.1) * SlowExpansionResidual.transportResidual 1 2
        (fluxProfile P h) (axialProfile P h) (swirlProfile P h) (fun _ => 0) p +
        thetaAxialViscosity P h p = -radialDivergence 2 (physicalStressTheta P h) p

name: NavierStokes.LeadingStress.transport_pullback_add_axialViscosity
statement:
theorem transport_pullback_add_axialViscosity {h e : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (α m : ℝ) (v u f source : Field) {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint}
    (hp : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (inner h p)) :
    SlowExpansionResidual.transportResidual α m (pullback h 0 v) (pullback h (-A h) u)
        (pullback h e f) (pullback h (e - 1) source) p +
        SimilarityProfile.partialZ (SimilarityProfile.partialZ (pullback h e f)) p =
      SimilarityProfile.q h p ^ (e - 1) *
        (SimilarityProfile.T h e f (inner h p) +
          v (inner h p) * (partialX f (inner h p) + α * f (inner h p) / (inner h p).1) +
          u (inner h p) * SimilarityProfile.Z h e f (inner h p) -
          2 * ((inner h p).1 * partialX (partialX f) (inner h p) + m * partialX f (inner h p)) +
          source (inner h p))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.angular_radial_operator
statement:
theorem angular_radial_operator {F : PhysicalProfile} {t r z : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (radiusPoint t r z)) :
    deriv (deriv (fun u => u * radialSlice F t z u)) r +
        deriv (fun u => u * radialSlice F t z u) r / r -
        r * radialSlice F t z r / r ^ 2 =
      r * (2 * (radiusPoint t r z).2.1 * partialS (partialS F) (radiusPoint t r z) +
        4 * partialS F (radiusPoint t r z))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.backwardStress_divergence
statement:
theorem backwardStress_divergence {R : ℝ → ℝ} {a r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (ha : a < r)
    (hi : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * R u) (Ioi a))
    (hc : ContinuousOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * R u) (Ioi a)) :
    deriv (backwardStress R) r + 2 * backwardStress R r / r = -R r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.backwardStress_formula
statement:
theorem backwardStress_formula {K f T : ℝ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hK : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, DifferentiableAt ℝ K u)
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual K f u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction K f) (Ioi r))
    (ht : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * T u) (Ioi r))
    (hboundary : Tendsto (boundary K f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    backwardStress (fun u => T u + viscousResidual K f u) r =
      K r * deriv f r +
        ((∫ u in Ioi r, u ^ 2 * T u) + ∫ u in Ioi r, correction K f u) / r ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.backwardStress_ge_boundary
statement:
theorem backwardStress_ge_boundary {K f T : ℝ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hK : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, DifferentiableAt ℝ K u)
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual K f u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction K f) (Ioi r))
    (ht : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * T u) (Ioi r))
    (hboundary : Tendsto (boundary K f) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hKpos : ∀ u ∈ Ioi r, 0 ≤ K u) (hKdec : ∀ u ∈ Ioi r, deriv K u ≤ 0)
    (hfinc : ∀ u ∈ Ioi r, 0 ≤ deriv f u) (hTpos : ∀ u ∈ Ioi r, 0 ≤ T u) :
    K r * deriv f r ≤ backwardStress (fun u => T u + viscousResidual K f u) r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.backwardStress_ge_mass
statement:
theorem backwardStress_ge_mass {K f T : ℝ → ℝ} {r c : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hK : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, DifferentiableAt ℝ K u)
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual K f u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction K f) (Ioi r))
    (ht : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * T u) (Ioi r))
    (hboundary : Tendsto (boundary K f) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hfi : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Ioi r)) (hflim : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hKpos : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, 0 ≤ K u) (hKdec : ∀ u ∈ Ioi r, deriv K u ≤ 0)
    (hfinc : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, 0 ≤ deriv f u)
    (hcompare : ∀ u ∈ Ioi r, c * deriv f u ≤ u ^ 2 * T u) :
    (c / r ^ 2) * (1 - f r) ≤
      backwardStress (fun u => T u + viscousResidual K f u) r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.boundary_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem boundary_hasDerivAt {K f : ℝ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.deriv_deriv_mul
statement:
theorem deriv_deriv_mul {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f r) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g r) :
    deriv (deriv (fun u => f u * g u)) r =
      deriv (deriv f) r * g r + 2 * deriv f r * deriv g r + f r * deriv (deriv g) r

theorem heatAmplitude_heat_equation (C : ℝ) {a t r : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a)

    deriv (fun t => heatAmplitude C a t r) t =
      deriv (deriv (heatAmplitude C a t)) r + deriv (heatAmplitude C a t) r / r -

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.heat_times_factor_residual
statement:
theorem heat_times_factor_residual (C : ℝ) {a t r : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a)
    (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) {f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hft : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => f t r) t) (hfr : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f t) r) :
    deriv (fun u => heatAmplitude C a u r * f u r) t -
      (deriv (deriv (fun u => heatAmplitude C a t u * f t u)) r +
        deriv (fun u => heatAmplitude C a t u * f t u) r / r -
        heatAmplitude C a t r * f t r / r ^ 2) =
      heatAmplitude C a t r * deriv (fun u => f u r) t +
        viscousResidual (heatAmplitude C a t) (f t) r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.integral_viscousResidual

theorem integral_viscousResidual {K f : ℝ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hK : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, DifferentiableAt ℝ K u)
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Ici r, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual K f u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction K f) (Ioi r))
    (hboundary : Tendsto (boundary K f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    (∫ u in Ioi r, u ^ 2 * viscousResidual K f u) =
      boundary K f r + ∫ u in Ioi r, correction K f u
