name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.pureSwirl_navierStokesResidual
statement:
theorem pureSwirl_navierStokesResidual {F P : PhysicalProfile} {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)) :
    ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual
      (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (fun _ => 0) F (fun _ => 0)) (AxisymmetricResidual.pressure P) t x =
      AxisymmetricResidual.pack
        (x 0 * (partialS P (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) - F (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) ^ 2) -
          x 1 * residualCoefficient F (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))
        (x 1 * (partialS P (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) - F (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x) ^ 2) +
          x 0 * residualCoefficient F (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))
        (partialZ P (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.regular_leading_residual
statement:
theorem regular_leading_residual {F : PhysicalProfile} {t r z : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (radiusPoint t r z)) :
    r * (partialT F (radiusPoint t r z) -
      2 * (radiusPoint t r z).2.1 * partialS (partialS F) (radiusPoint t r z) -
        4 * partialS F (radiusPoint t r z)) =
      deriv (fun u => r * F (radiusPoint u r z)) t -
        (deriv (deriv (fun u => u * radialSlice F t z u)) r +
          deriv (fun u => u * radialSlice F t z u) r / r - r * radialSlice F t z r / r ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.terminalStress_formula
statement:
theorem terminalStress_formula (C : ℝ) {h t r z : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z)) (Ioi r))
    (hT : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * timeResidual C h f t z u) (Ioi r))
    (hb : Tendsto (boundary (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    terminalStress C h f t z r =
      heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t r * deriv (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) r +
        ((∫ u in Ioi r, u ^ 2 * timeResidual C h f t z u) +
          ∫ u in Ioi r, correction (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
            (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) u) / r ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.terminalStress_ge_boundary
statement:
theorem terminalStress_ge_boundary {C h t r z : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z)) (Ioi r))
    (hT : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * timeResidual C h f t z u) (Ioi r))
    (hb : Tendsto (boundary (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t r * deriv (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) r ≤
      terminalStress C h f t z r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.terminalStress_nonneg
statement:
theorem terminalStress_nonneg {C h t r z : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hv : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) u) (Ioi r))
    (hc : IntegrableOn (correction (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z)) (Ioi r))
    (hT : IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * timeResidual C h f t z u) (Ioi r))
    (hb : Tendsto (boundary (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.terminal_correction_nonneg
statement:
theorem terminal_correction_nonneg {C h t r z : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t r z))))
    (hfpos : 0 ≤ deriv f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t r z)))) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.terminal_navierStokesResidual
statement:
theorem terminal_navierStokesResidual (C : ℝ) {h t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1)
    (hs : 0 < AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f
      (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))))
    {a : ℝ} (ha : a < AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x)
    (hi : IntegrableOn (fun s => swirlCoefficient C h f (t, (s, x 2)) ^ 2) (Ioi a))
    (hc : ContinuousOn (fun s => swirlCoefficient C h f (t, (s, x 2)) ^ 2) (Ioi a))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (canonicalPressure (swirlCoefficient C h f))
      (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)) :
    ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual (terminalVelocity C h f) (terminalPressure C h f) t x =
      AxisymmetricResidual.pack
        (-x 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) *
          (leadingResidual C h f t (Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x)) (x 2) -
            axialViscosity C h f (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)))
        (x 0 / Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) *
          (leadingResidual C h f t (Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x)) (x 2) -
            axialViscosity C h f (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)))
        (partialZ (canonicalPressure (swirlCoefficient C h f)) (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.terminal_radial_residual
statement:
theorem terminal_radial_residual (C : ℝ) {h t r z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t r z)))) :
    deriv (fun u => heatAmplitude C (1 + h) u r * flattening h f (radiusPoint u r z)) t -
      (deriv (deriv (fun u => heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t u * radialSlice (flattening h f) t z u)) r +
        deriv (fun u => heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t u * radialSlice (flattening h f) t z u) r / r -
        heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t r * radialSlice (flattening h f) t z r / r ^ 2) =
      heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t r *
        (deriv f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t r z))) /
          (SimilarityProfile.q h (radiusPoint t r z) *
            CoordinateAlgebra.L h (SimilarityProfile.eta h (radiusPoint t r z)))) +
        viscousResidual (heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t) (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) r

theorem timeDenominator_pos {h t z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.timeResidual_lower_comparison
statement:
theorem timeResidual_lower_comparison {C h t r u R z : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hru : r ≤ u) (huR : u ≤ R) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t u z))))
    (hfpos : 0 ≤ deriv f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t u z)))) :
    (r ^ 3 * heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t R / (2 * timeDenominator h t z)) *
        deriv (radialSlice (flattening h f) t z) u ≤ u ^ 2 * timeResidual C h f t z u

name: NavierStokes.TerminalStress.timeSlice_hasDerivAt
NavierStokes.TerminalStress.weighted_timeResidual
statement:
theorem weighted_timeResidual {C h t r z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (radiusPoint t r z)))) :
    r ^ 2 * timeResidual C h f t z r =

    (hmean : avg s w t = -b / a)
    (hvar : avg s w (fun i => (t i - (-b / a)) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + (-b / a) ^ 2) + ρ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * phaseDensity a v (t i) = 1) ∧
      avg s (fun i => w i * phaseDensity a v (t i)) (fun i => loopA v (t i)) = a ∧
      avg s (fun i => w i * phaseDensity a v (t i)) (fun i => loopC v (t i)) = -b

statement:
theorem cosineTilt_stress_positive (p₁ p₂ m amplitude : ℝ)

    ∀ θ, 2 < p₁ + p₂ * cosineTilt m amplitude θ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.cosineTilt_variance

    angularMean (fun θ => (cosineTilt m amplitude θ - m) ^ 2) = amplitude ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_cosine_moments
statement:
theorem exists_cosine_moments (m V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) :
    ∃ t : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t ∧
      Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi) ∧ angularMean t = m ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = V

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_cosine_moments_with_projection
statement:
theorem exists_cosine_moments_with_projection (p₁ p₂ m V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hmargin : 2 + |p₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * V)| < p₁ + p₂ * m) :
    ∃ t : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t ∧
      Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi) ∧ angularMean t = m ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = V ∧
      ∀ θ, 2 < p₁ + p₂ * t θ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop
statement:
theorem exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop (a b ρ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∃ A C : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧ ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) C ∧
      Function.Periodic A 1 ∧ Function.Periodic C 1 ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, A φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, C φ) = -b ∧
      ∀ φ, 0 < A φ ∧
        A φ * (1 + (C φ / A φ) ^ 2) = a * (1 + (-b / a) ^ 2) + ρ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_rephased_shear_loop
statement:
theorem exists_rephased_shear_loop (t : ℝ → ℝ) (a m ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hv : 0 < v) (ht : ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t)
    (hperiodic : Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi))
    (hmean : angularMean t = m)
    (hvar : angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    ∃ A C : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧ ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) C ∧
      Function.Periodic A 1 ∧ Function.Periodic C 1 ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, A φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, C φ) = a * m ∧
      ∀ φ, 0 < A φ ∧ A φ * (1 + (C φ / A φ) ^ 2) = v

statement:
theorem abs_deriv_normalizedPostPulseEnergy_le (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ)
    (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    |deriv (normalizedPostPulseEnergy d) eta| ≤
      (2 * flattenLength + 4 * tailConstant) * d.core.lam *

      (Real.exp d.core.pulseStart * pulseAmplitude d.core ^ 2 * shape q ^ 2)) eta| ≤

statement:
theorem energyDensity_release_bound (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

    energyDensity d eta y ≤ 4 * energyDensity d eta d.releaseStart *
      (Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (-2 * (y - d.releaseStart)) +
        d.h ^ 8 * Real.exp 8 * Real.exp (-(2 * d.h) * (y - d.releaseStart)))

      Real.exp (2 * releasePrimitive d (y - d.releaseStart)) *
      (tailShape d (y - tailStart d) / (1 - d.rho)) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.SchedulePressure.exists_natural_profiles
statement:
theorem exists_natural_profiles (d : TailData) {j : ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters d.h j) (hP : 2 ≤ d.core.P) :
    ∃ δ σ Λ C : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < σ ∧ 0 < Λ ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∃ f U V Pr : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        NaturalProfile.IsNaturalSolution d.h j Λ (axisPressure d)
          (NaturalAxisCoefficients.realAmplitude d.h j σ Λ C) f U V Pr ∧
        (∀ p ∈ NaturalProfile.domain Λ, 0 ≤ Λ * p.1 → Λ * p.1 ≤ 41 / 10 → 0 < f p) ∧
        (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          |NaturalAxisData.Z d.h j (axisPressure d) η| ≤ δ →
            23 / 10 < -2 * (4 / Λ) * NaturalAxisBridge.partialY f (4 / Λ, η) / f (4 / Λ, η))

statement:

    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters d.h j) (hP : 2 ≤ d.core.P) :
    ∃ δ σ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < σ ∧
      (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        |NaturalAxisData.Z d.h j (axisPressure d) η| ≤ δ →
          99 / 100 < NaturalAxisData.chi d.h j σ η) ∧
      ∃ data : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs d.h j σ (axisPressure d),
        ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ →
          ∀ C : ℝ, data.normalizationThreshold Λ ≤ C →
            Nonempty (NaturalProfile.ProfileFamily data Λ C)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.compact_inverse_quadratic_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_inverse_quadratic_bounds [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (S : Set P) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hB : ContinuousOn B S) (hA : ContinuousOn A S)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ S, (B p).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ β K : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ 0 < K ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(B p).inverse‖ ≤ β ∧ ‖A p‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.compact_uniform_small_correction
statement:
theorem compact_uniform_small_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (S : Set P) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hB : ContinuousOn B S) (hA : ContinuousOn A S)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ S, (B p).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ β ε : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ 0 < ε ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ d : E, ‖d‖ ≤ ε →
      ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖ ∧ B p c + A p c c = d

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_local_analytic_solver
statement:
theorem exists_local_analytic_solver [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ (g : RepairData E → E) (U : Set (RepairData E)),
      IsOpen U ∧ base B A ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ⊤ g U ∧ g (base B A) = 0 ∧
      ∀ z ∈ U, z.1.1 (g z) + z.1.2 (g z) (g z) = z.2

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_local_bounded_analytic_solver
statement:
theorem exists_local_bounded_analytic_solver [CompleteSpace E]
    (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A₀ : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ (g : RepairData E → E) (U : Set (RepairData E)) (C : ℝ),
      IsOpen U ∧ base B₀ A₀ ∈ U ∧ 0 < C ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ⊤ g U ∧
      g (base B₀ A₀) = 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ U,
        z.1.1 (g z) + z.1.2 (g z) (g z) = z.2 ∧ ‖g z‖ ≤ C * ‖z.2‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_smooth_parameter_branch
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_parameter_branch [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    (p₀ : P) (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (d : P → E)
    (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d)
    (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (hB₀ : B p₀ = B₀.toContinuousLinearMap) (hd₀ : d p₀ = 0) :
    ∃ (c : P → E) (U : Set P) (C : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ p₀ ∈ U ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U ∧ c p₀ = 0 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, B p (c p) + A p (c p) (c p) = d p ∧ ‖c p‖ ≤ C * ‖d p‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_unique_quadratic_correction
statement:
theorem exists_unique_quadratic_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (d : E) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hsmall : 4 * ‖B.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖A‖ * r ≤ 1)
    (hd : 2 * ‖B.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖d‖ ≤ r) :
    ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ r ∧ B c + A c c = d

theorem solution_norm_bound (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c d : E) (β δ K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hinv : ∀ x, ‖B₀.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hB : ‖B - B₀.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ δ) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ K)
    (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ r) (hsmall : β * (δ + K * r) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (heq : B c + A c c = d) : ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.angular_change
statement:
theorem angular_change (e0 X0 y0 δ : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y, radiusX X0 y *
      (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y - baseH lam e0 X0 y)) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * δ

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.exact_endpoint_moment
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.exact_endpoint_moment {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 X0 y0 a b Iprior Itarget : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0)
    (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hδ : (Itarget - prefixI lam e0 X0 a b Iprior) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 ∈
      Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    Iprior + (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0
      (B.coefficients ((Itarget - prefixI lam e0 X0 a b Iprior) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0)) y) =
        Itarget

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.exact_target
statement:
theorem exact_target (e0 X0 y0 Iold Itarget : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0)
    (hδ : (Itarget - Iold) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    Iold + (∫ y, radiusX X0 y *
      (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0
        (B.coefficients ((Itarget - Iold) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0)) y -
          baseH lam e0 X0 y)) = Itarget

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.joint_contDiffOn {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 y0 : ℝ) {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    {S : Set P} {δ : P → ℝ} (hδ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ δ S)
    (hsmall : ∀ p ∈ S, δ p ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × ℝ => modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients (δ z.1)) z.2)
      (S ×ˢ univ)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.logSlope_le
statement:
theorem logSlope_le (hlam : 0 < lam) (e0 y0 δ y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0)

statement:

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.pressure_interval_neutral
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.pressure_interval_neutral {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 y0 a b δ : ℝ) (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y) ^ 2) =
      ∫ y in Icc a b, (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.pressure_neutral
statement:
theorem pressure_neutral (e0 y0 δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) = 0

statement:
theorem angularScale_pos (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0) :

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_delta_integrable
statement:

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_integral_formula
statement:
theorem angular_integral_formula (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (hX : 0 ≤ X0) :
    (∫ y, radiusX X0 y * (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y - baseH lam e0 X0 y)) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * ∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_interval_change
statement:
theorem angular_interval_change (lam e0 X0 y0 a b : ℝ) (c : Coeff)
    (hX : 0 ≤ X0) (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y) -
      (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * baseH lam e0 X0 y) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * ∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_weight_formula
statement:
theorem angular_weight_formula (lam e0 X0 y : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X0) :
    radiusX X0 y * baseH lam e0 X0 y =
      X0 * Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * e0 * Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.exists_normalized_branch
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_branch (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (ε K : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < K ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ δ ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
        (∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative (c δ) y) = δ ∧
        (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative (c δ) y) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 ∧
        ‖c δ‖ ≤ K * |δ|

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearMatrix_det
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det (lam : ℝ) :
    (linearMatrix lam).det = 2 * moment (angularSlope lam) * moment (pressureSlope lam) *
      (Real.exp (2 * pressureSlope lam) - Real.exp (2 * angularSlope lam))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearMatrix_det_ne_zero

statement:
theorem modifiedE_hasDerivAt (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c)
      (baseE lam e0 y * (-1 / 2 - lam) * (1 + relative c (y - y0)) +
        baseE lam e0 y * deriv (relative c) (y - y0)) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_logSlope
statement:
theorem modifiedE_logSlope (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) (he0 : e0 ≠ 0)
    (hpos : 1 + relative c (y - y0) ≠ 0) :
    logSlope (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c) y =
      -lam + deriv (relative c) (y - y0) / (1 + relative c (y - y0))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_hasCompactSupport (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_support
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_support (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    support (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c - baseE lam e0) ⊆
      Icc (y0 - 3 / 20) (y0 + 43 / 20)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_tsupport
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_tsupport (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    tsupport (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c - baseE lam e0) ⊆ Ioo (y0 - 1) (y0 + 3)

NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.moment_map_identity
statement:
theorem moment_map_identity (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv lam hlam c + quadraticCLM lam c c =
      ![∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y,
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)]

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.positive_and_slope_of_small
statement:
theorem positive_and_slope_of_small (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ)
    (h0 : |relative c y| ≤ 1 / 2) (h1 : |deriv (relative c) y| ≤ lam / 4) :
    0 < 1 + relative c y ∧ -lam + deriv (relative c) y / (1 + relative c y) ≤ -lam / 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_change_integrable
statement:
theorem pressure_change_integrable (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_change_moment
statement:
theorem pressure_change_moment (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)) =
      2 * (moment (pressureSlope lam) * c 0 +
        Real.exp (2 * pressureSlope lam) * moment (pressureSlope lam) * c 1) +
      quadraticMoment lam 0 * (c 0) ^ 2 + quadraticMoment lam 1 * (c 1) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_delta_integrable

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_integral_formula
statement:
theorem pressure_integral_formula (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ y, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) =
      e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y0) *
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_interval_change
statement:
theorem pressure_interval_change (lam e0 y0 a b : ℝ) (c : Coeff)
    (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2) -
      (∫ y in Icc a b, (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) =
      e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y0) *
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.relative_square

theorem relative_square (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.angular_change
statement:
theorem angular_change (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (3 * y / 2) *
      (correctedAngular d w.coefficients (y, eta) - finalAngular d (y, eta))) =
      (baseWeight d (correctionCenter d) / 2) * normalizedDebt d eta

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.correctedHistory_eq_integral
statement:
theorem correctedHistory_eq_integral (eta : ℝ) :
    correctedHistory d w.coefficients eta =
      ∫ t in Iic d.releaseStart, Real.exp (3 * t / 2) * correctedAngular d w.coefficients (t, eta)

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.exact_endpoint
statement:
theorem exact_endpoint (eta : ℝ) : correctedHistory d w.coefficients eta =

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.logSlope_le
statement:

    logSlope (fun t => correctedAngular d w.coefficients (t, eta)) y ≤ -d.core.lam / 2

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.physical_endpoint
statement:
theorem physical_endpoint (eta : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt 2 * correctedHistory d w.coefficients eta =
      (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
        correctedAngular d w.coefficients (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.physical_integral_endpoint
statement:
theorem physical_integral_endpoint (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Iic d.releaseStart, Real.exp t * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp t) *
      correctedAngular d w.coefficients (t, eta)) =
      (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
        correctedAngular d w.coefficients (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)

statement:
theorem actual_debt_first_jet_bound (d : TailData) (hlam : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 15) (eta : ℝ) :
    |normalizedDebt d eta| ≤ (3 * Real.exp 3) * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ) ∧
    |deriv (normalizedDebt d) eta| ≤ (3 * Real.exp 3) * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ)

      |normalizedDebt d eta| < ε ∧ |deriv (normalizedDebt d) eta| < ε

statement:

    linearCLM lam c + quadraticCLM lam c c =
      ![∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y,
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)]

statement:

statement:
theorem complete_angular_reset :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedAngular d c) ∧
        (∀ p, 0 < correctedAngular d c p) ∧
        (∀ eta y, y ∉ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart →
          correctedAngular d c (y, eta) = finalAngular d (y, eta)) ∧
        (∀ eta, (∫ y, (correctedAngular d c (y, eta)) ^ 2 - (finalAngular d (y, eta)) ^ 2) = 0 ∧
          Real.sqrt 2 * correctedHistory d c eta =
            (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
              correctedAngular d c (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)) ∧
        (∀ eta y, y ∈ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart →
          logSlope (fun t => correctedAngular d c (t, eta)) y ≤ -d.core.lam / 2)

theorem exists_smooth_solver_on_ball [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (β K r : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hinv : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ K)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ g : E → E, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β))) ∧
      (∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)), quadraticMap B A (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖) ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)), ∀ e ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)),
        ‖g d - g e‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d - e‖

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.uniform_reset_branch

      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ δ ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
          (∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative (c δ) y) = δ ∧
          (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative (c δ) y) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 ∧
          ‖c δ‖ ≤ L * |δ| ∧ ‖deriv c δ‖ ≤ L ∧ ∀ y,
            |relative (c δ) y| ≤ L * |δ| ∧ |deriv (relative (c δ)) y| ≤ L * |δ|

        (8 * eta ^ 2 / (1 + eta ^ 2) ^ 2) * futureMass d y 2 eta

        (8 * eta ^ 2 / (1 + eta ^ 2) ^ 2) * futureMass d y 2 eta) eta

name: NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_eq [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (pastIntegral M v f) z -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => χ y.1 • totalIntegral M v f y) z

name: NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_norm_le
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_norm_le [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z‖ ≤
      ‖pastIntegral M v (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) z‖ +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => χ y.1) z‖ *
            ‖totalIntegral M v (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) f) z‖

statement:

    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ)
    (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (hB : ∀ i ≤ n, 0 ≤ B i)
    (hsource : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, ∀ Y : E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (s, Y)‖ ≤ A j)
    (hcutoff : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ z : ℝ × E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => χ y.1) z‖ ≤ B i)
    (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z‖ ≤
      (A n + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * B i * A (n - i)) * (b - a)

statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_futureIntegral [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineCoefficients_decomposition
statement:
theorem affineCoefficients_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineCoefficients_exp_bound
statement:
theorem affineCoefficients_exp_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :
    |affineCoefficients c q A j| ≤
      coefficientBound c.P c.m * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (|q| + |A|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineDebt_normalized_bound
statement:
theorem affineDebt_normalized_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) :
    |normalizedDebt c (affineDebt c q A) i| ≤
      (debtBound c.P c.m i / c.lam) * Real.exp (-(1 / (2 * c.lam))) * (|q| + |A|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_contDiff

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_jet_bound
statement:
theorem affineProfile_jet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y| ≤
      correctionJetBound c.P c.m k * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (|q| + |A|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_jet_decomposition
statement:
theorem affineProfile_jet_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y =
      q * iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c 1 0) y +

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_jet_formula
statement:
theorem affineProfile_jet_formula (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y =
      ∑ j : Fin 2, affineCoefficients c q A j * iteratedDeriv k logTemplate (y - center c j)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_bound
statement:
theorem correctionJet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (y : ℝ) :
    |correctionJet c amp k eta y| ≤
      (2 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_eq
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eq (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (eta y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_eta_bound
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)

    (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |deriv (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y) eta| ≤
      (4 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_eta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eta_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_bound
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y| ≤
      correctionJetBound c.P c.m k * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_eta_bound
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |deriv (fun s => iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp s) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y) eta| ≤
      (2 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_formula
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_formula (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ)
    (eta : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y =
      affineCoefficients c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta) j *
        iteratedDeriv k logTemplate (y - center c j)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :

        (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, eta)) =

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix_derivative_small
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix_derivative_small (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) :
    |deriv (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
        (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t))) eta| ≤
      (4 * prefixBound c.P c.m 0) * c.lam ^ 29

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
      (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t)))
      (prefixCoefficient c 0 * (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2)) eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix_small
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix_small (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.paper_correction_bounds
statement:
theorem paper_correction_bounds (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hsmall : lam ≤ 1 / 120),
      let c := paperParameters P m lam hP hm hlam (by linarith)
      ∀ (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ), |eta| ≤ 1 →
        |correctionJet c amp k eta y| ≤ C * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|) ∧
        ∀ amp' : ℝ, HasDerivAt amp amp' eta →
          |deriv (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y) eta| ≤
            C * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.paper_prefix_bounds
statement:
theorem paper_prefix_bounds (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hsmall : lam ≤ 1 / 120),
      let c := paperParameters P m lam hP hm hlam (by linarith)
      pulseAmplitude c ≤ C * lam ^ 30 ∧
        ∀ (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ), |eta| ≤ 1 →
          |massMoment c amp eta c.pulseStart /
            (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, eta))| ≤ C * lam ^ 29 ∧
          |deriv (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
            (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t))) eta| ≤ C * lam ^ 29

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.prefixJ_bounds
statement:
theorem prefixJ_bounds (c : Parameters) :
    0 ≤ prefixJ c ∧
      prefixJ c ≤ (5 / 2) * Real.sqrt 2 * c.P +
        4 * Real.sqrt 2 * c.P * Real.exp c.m * Real.exp (3 * Real.exp c.m)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.prefixJ_fixed_interval
statement:
theorem prefixJ_fixed_interval (c : Parameters) :
    prefixJ c = (5 / 2) * Real.sqrt 2 * c.P +
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.m,
        Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 * y / 2) *
          radialAmplitude c.P c.dropLength c.lam y * dropCoefficient c.m y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.prefixM_bounds

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.prefixM_fixed_interval
statement:
theorem prefixM_fixed_interval (c : Parameters) :
    prefixM c = 4 + ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.m,

theorem two_row_solution_bound {k lam A0 A1 r0 r1 x0 x1 d0 d1 : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlam' : lam ≤ 1)
    (hA0 : k ≤ A0) (hA1 : k ≤ A1)
    (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hr0' : r0 ≤ Real.exp 1)
    (hgap : lam ≤ r0 - r1)
    (h0 : A0 * (x0 + r0 * x1) = d0) (h1 : A1 * (x0 + r1 * x1) = d1) :
    lam * |x0| ≤ ((1 + Real.exp 1) / k) * (|d0| + |d1|) ∧

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.ideal_lag_ge_one
NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.ideal_source_displayed
statement:
theorem ideal_source_displayed (h η : ℝ) :
    idealSource h η =
      (3 / 5) * (4 * coordinateFactor h η - 1) - h * (1 - 8 * η ^ 2) +
        (axialExponent h + 4 * axialShape η) * η * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.ideal_source_positive_decomposition
statement:
theorem ideal_source_positive_decomposition (h η : ℝ) :
    idealSource h η = 9 / 5 - h + (16 / 5) * h * η ^ 2 +
      2 * (axialExponent h + 4 * axialShape η) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.pulse_amplitude_endpoint_signs
statement:
theorem pulse_amplitude_endpoint_signs {K error₀ error₁ : ℝ}
    (hKlo : 1 / 5 ≤ K) (hKhi : K ≤ 1 / 4)
    (herror₀ : |error₀| ≤ 1 / 100) (herror₁ : |error₁| ≤ 1 / 100) :
    K * (9 / 10 : ℝ) ^ 2 - pulseEnergyDebt + error₀ < 0 ∧
      0 < K * (6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 2 - pulseEnergyDebt + error₁

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.pulse_amplitude_root
statement:
theorem pulse_amplitude_root {K : ℝ} (error : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hKlo : 1 / 5 ≤ K) (hKhi : K ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn error (Set.Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5)))
    (herror : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), |error A| ≤ 1 / 100) :
    ∃ A ∈ Set.Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5),
      K * A ^ 2 - pulseEnergyDebt + error A = 0

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.two_moment_reset
statement:
theorem two_moment_reset {r₁ r₂ : ℝ} (hgap : r₂ ≠ r₁) (debt₁ debt₂ : ℝ) :
    let b := (debt₁ - debt₂) / (r₂ - r₁)
    let a := -debt₁ - r₁ * b
    debt₁ + a + r₁ * b = 0 ∧ debt₂ + a + r₂ * b = 0

statement:
theorem amplitude_spec (d : OutgoingTail.TailData)
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hscale : errorScale d.core ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
        OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = 0 ∧
      |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ 128 * errorScale d.core ∧
      (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d A eta = 0 → A = amplitude d eta)

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_late
NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_prefix
statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_prefix (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ≤ d.core.pulseStart) :
    energyIntegrand d A eta y =
      eta ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * dropCoefficient d.core.m y ^ 2) -
        shape eta ^ 2 * (coreEnergyWeight d.core y / 2)

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_pulse
statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_pulse (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.core.pulseStart ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.endpoint) :
    energyIntegrand d A eta y = normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 *
      (pulseWeight d.core (y - d.core.pulseStart) *
        (pulseRatio d.core (fun _ => A) (y - d.core.pulseStart, eta) ^ 2 - 1 / 2))

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.exists_uniform_amplitude_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_amplitude_threshold (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : OutgoingTail.TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
        9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
        (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
          OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = 0 ∧
        |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / d.core.lam)) ∧
        (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d A eta = 0 → A = amplitude d eta)

      (Ioi d.core.endpoint)) :

      normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 / d.core.lam * scaledPulseEnergy d.core A eta -
        tailEnergy d eta / 2

theorem exists_scheduled_reset_energy_bounds :

      ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 → ∃ w : ResetWitness d K,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (normalizedResetEnergy d w.coefficients) ∧
        ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
          |normalizedResetEnergy d w.coefficients eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam ^ (29 : ℕ) ∧

        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (normalizedResetEnergy d w.coefficients) ∧
        ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →

statement:
theorem amplitude_clamped_equation (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) :
    PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d c eta ^ 2 +
      PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta * amplitude d c eta +
      PulseAmplitude.negativeClamp (constantTerm d c eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_bound (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta e : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e) (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e)
    (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) (hT : |deriv (PulseAmplitude.normalizedTail d) eta| ≤ e)
    (hs : |deriv (energyShift d c) eta| ≤ e) : |deriv (amplitude d c) eta| ≤ 128 * e

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_identity
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_identity (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta : ℝ) (hneg : constantTerm d c eta < -(1 / 5)) :
    (2 * PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d c eta +
        PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta) * deriv (amplitude d c) eta +
      deriv (PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core) eta * amplitude d c eta +
        deriv (constantTerm d c) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_energy_equation
statement:
theorem amplitude_energy_equation (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (hc : constantTerm d c eta ≤ -(1 / 5)) : energyPolynomial d c (amplitude d c eta) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hscale : combinedScale d K ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      9 / 10 < amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧ amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      totalEnergy d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
      |deriv (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta| ≤ 128 * combinedScale d K ∧
      (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d w.coefficients A eta = 0 →
        A = amplitude d w.coefficients eta)

statement:
theorem amplitude_spec_of_bounds (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)

    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    9 / 10 < amplitude d c eta ∧ amplitude d c eta < 6 / 5 ∧ totalEnergy d c (amplitude d c eta) eta = 0

statement:
theorem amplitude_unique (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.coefficient_derivative_bounds
statement:
theorem coefficient_derivative_bounds (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.exists_corrected_amplitude
statement:
theorem exists_corrected_amplitude (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ K C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ → ∃ w : ResetWitness d K,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
          9 / 10 < amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧ amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
          totalEnergy d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
          |deriv (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / d.core.lam)) ∧
          (∀ XR : ℝ, 0 < XR →
            IntegrableOn (radialEnergyIntegrand d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta XR) (Ioi 0) ∧
            (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialEnergyIntegrand d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta XR X) = 0) ∧
          (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d w.coefficients A eta = 0 →
            A = amplitude d w.coefficients eta)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.numerical_coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem numerical_coefficient_bounds (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)
    (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e)
    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    1 / 5 ≤ PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core ∧
      PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core ≤ 13 / 50 ∧
      |PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta| ≤ 1 / 100 ∧
      -(13 / 50) ≤ constantTerm d c eta ∧ constantTerm d c eta ≤ -(23 / 100)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ns_after_endpoint
statement:
theorem Ns_after_endpoint (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) :
    Ns w Amp (y, eta) =
      (4 * d.h * eta * S w Amp (y, eta) - coordinateFactor eta * dEta (S w Amp) (y, eta)) /
        Real.exp y + 4 * velocityExponent d.h * eta * Pi w (y, eta) -
          coordinateFactor eta * dEta (Pi w) (y, eta)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ns_eq_source_integral
NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ns_equation
NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ns_hasDerivAt
NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ns_integrated
statement:
theorem Ns_integrated (w : ResetWitness d K) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (p : Point) :
    Ns w Amp p = -W d Amp p * U d Amp p +
      axialExponent d.h * (M d Amp p - p.2 * dEta (M d Amp) p) / X p +
        (4 * d.h * p.2 * S w Amp p - coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (S w Amp) p) / X p +
          4 * velocityExponent d.h * p.2 * Pi w p - coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (Pi w) p

statement:
theorem Pi_eq_future_integral (w : ResetWitness d K) (y eta : ℝ) :
    Pi w (y, eta) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi y, E w (t, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Pi_eq_past_integral
statement:
theorem Pi_eq_past_integral (w : ResetWitness d K) (y eta : ℝ) :
    Pi w (y, eta) = SchedulePressure.axisPressure d eta +
      ∫ t in Iic y, E w (t, eta) ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Pi_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem Pi_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => Pi w (y, p.2)) (E w p ^ 2 / 2) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Pi_ideal
statement:
theorem Pi_ideal (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    Pi w (y, eta) = SchedulePressure.axisPressure d eta +
      (5 / 2) * d.core.P ^ 2 * shape eta ^ 2 * Real.exp (y / 5)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Pi_smooth
statement: theorem Pi_smooth (w : ResetWitness d K) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Pi w)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Pi_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem Pi_zero (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) :
    Pi w (0, eta) = initialPi d eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_after_endpoint
statement:
theorem Qs_after_endpoint (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) :
    Qs w Amp (y, eta) = -1 +
      ((1 - d.h) * I w (y, eta) - axialExponent d.h * eta * dEta (I w) (y, eta)) /
        (Real.exp (3 * y / 2) * E w (y, eta))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_dilation
statement:
theorem Qs_dilation (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (p : Point) :
    (XR * Real.sqrt (2 * XR) * angularStock w Amp p) /
      (physicalX XR p * physicalH XR w p) = Qs w Amp p

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_eq_source_integral
statement:
theorem Qs_eq_source_integral (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (y eta : ℝ) :
    Qs w Amp (y, eta) =
      (∫ t in Iic y, Real.exp (3 * t / 2) * E w (t, eta) * Sq w Amp (t, eta)) /
        (Real.exp (3 * y / 2) * E w (y, eta))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_equation
statement:
theorem Qs_equation (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    deriv (fun y => Qs w Amp (y, p.2)) p.1 +
      (1 + dY (H w) p / H w p) * Qs w Amp p = Sq w Amp p

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem Qs_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => Qs w Amp (y, p.2))
      (Sq w Amp p - (1 + dY (H w) p / H w p) * Qs w Amp p) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_initial
statement:
theorem Qs_initial (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) :
    Qs w Amp (0, eta) =
      ((3 / 5) * (4 * (1 - 2 * d.h * eta ^ 2) - 1) - d.h * (1 - 8 * eta ^ 2) +
        (axialExponent d.h + 4 * coordinateFactor eta) * eta *
          (2 * eta / (1 + eta ^ 2))) / (8 / 5)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_integrated
statement:
theorem Qs_integrated (w : ResetWitness d K) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (p : Point) :
    Qs w Amp p = -W d Amp p +
      ((1 - d.h) * I w p - axialExponent d.h * p.2 * dEta (I w) p -
        coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (J w Amp) p +
          2 * (d.h - axialExponent d.h) * p.2 * J w Amp p) / (X p * H w p)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Qs_smooth
statement:
theorem Qs_smooth (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Qs w Amp)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.S_eq_integral
statement:
theorem S_eq_integral (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (y eta : ℝ) :
    S w Amp (y, eta) = ∫ t in Iic y, Real.exp t * (U d Amp (t, eta) ^ 2 - E w (t, eta) ^ 2 / 2)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.S_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem S_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => S w Amp (y, p.2)) (X p * energyDensity w Amp p) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.S_smooth
statement:
theorem S_smooth (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (S w Amp)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.S_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem S_zero (w : ResetWitness d K) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    S w Amp (0, eta) = initialS d eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Sn_ideal
statement:
theorem Sn_ideal (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    Sn w Amp (y, eta) = incomingSnConstant d eta + incomingSnGrowing d eta * Real.exp (y / 5)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Sq_formula
statement:
theorem Sq_formula (w : ResetWitness d K) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (p : Point) :
    Sq w Amp p = -W d Amp p * (dY (H w) p / H w p) - d.h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * U d Amp p) -
      (axialExponent d.h * p.2 + coordinateFactor p.2 * U d Amp p) * (dEta (E w) p / E w p)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Sq_ideal
statement:
theorem Sq_ideal (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) : Sq w Amp (y, eta) = incomingSq d eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.U_after_endpoint
statement:
theorem U_after_endpoint (d : TailData) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) : U d Amp (y, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.U_before_pulse
statement:
theorem U_before_pulse (d : TailData) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ d.core.pulseStart) :
    U d Amp (y, eta) = dropCoefficient d.core.m y * eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.U_ideal
statement:
theorem U_ideal (d : TailData) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    U d Amp (y, eta) = 4 * eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.U_smooth
statement:
theorem U_smooth (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (U d Amp)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ubar_parameter
statement:
theorem Ubar_parameter (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    dEta (Ubar d Amp) p = dEta (M d Amp) p / X p

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.Ubar_smooth
statement:
theorem Ubar_smooth (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Ubar d Amp)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.W_after_endpoint
statement:
theorem W_after_endpoint (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) : W d Amp (y, eta) = 1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.W_formula
statement:
theorem W_formula (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    W d Amp p = 1 - 2 * axialExponent d.h * p.2 * Ubar d Amp p -
      coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (Ubar d Amp) p

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.W_ideal
statement:
theorem W_ideal (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) : W d Amp (y, eta) = 1 - 4 * (1 - 2 * d.h * eta ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.W_smooth
statement:
theorem W_smooth (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (W d Amp)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.XW_eq_mul_W
statement:
theorem XW_eq_mul_W (d : TailData) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (p : Point) :
    XW d Amp p = X p * W d Amp p

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.XW_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem XW_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => XW d Amp (y, p.2))
      (X p * (1 - 2 * axialExponent d.h * p.2 * U d Amp p -
        coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (U d Amp) p)) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.XW_smooth
statement:
theorem XW_smooth (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) :

statement:
theorem angularSource_weight (w : ResetWitness d K) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (p : Point) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.angularStock_eq_source_integral
statement:
theorem angularStock_eq_source_integral (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}

statement:
theorem angularStock_eq_source_primitive (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}

    angularStock w Amp (y, eta) = angularStock w Amp (0, eta) +
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..y, X (t, eta) * angularSource w Amp (t, eta)

theorem angularWeight_eq (w : ResetWitness d K) (p : Point) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.angularWeight_ideal
statement:
theorem angularWeight_ideal (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :

statement: theorem angularWeight_smooth (w : ResetWitness d K) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angularWeight w)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.angular_past
statement:
theorem angular_past (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y => angularWeight w (y, eta)) (Iic (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      (∫ y in Iic (0 : ℝ), angularWeight w (y, eta)) = initialI d eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.angular_product_eq
statement:
theorem angular_product_eq (w : ResetWitness d K) (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (y eta : ℝ) :
    E w (y, eta) * U d Amp (y, eta) =
      angular d.core.P d.core.dropLength d.core.lam (y, eta) * U d Amp (y, eta)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.angular_source_continuous
NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.angular_source_past
statement:
theorem angular_source_past (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}

      (∫ y in Iic (0 : ℝ), X (y, eta) * angularSource w Amp (y, eta)) =
        angularStock w Amp (0, eta)

NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.axialStock_eq_source_primitive

theorem axialStock_eq_source_primitive (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}

statement:
theorem dEta_E_ideal (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_H
statement:
theorem dEta_H (w : ResetWitness d K) (p : Point) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_I_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem dEta_I_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => dEta (I w) (y, p.2)) (X p * dEta (H w) p) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_I_zero
statement:
theorem dEta_I_zero (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) :
    dEta (I w) (0, eta) = ((5 / 8) * d.core.P) *
      (shape eta * (-(2 * eta / (1 + eta ^ 2))))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_J_after_endpoint
NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_J_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem dEta_J_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => dEta (J w Amp) (y, p.2))
      (X p * (dEta (U d Amp) p * H w p + U d Amp p * dEta (H w) p)) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_J_zero
statement:
theorem dEta_J_zero (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) :
    dEta (J w Amp) (0, eta) = ((5 / 2) * d.core.P) * shape eta +
      ((5 / 2) * d.core.P * eta) * (shape eta * (-(2 * eta / (1 + eta ^ 2))))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_M_after_endpoint
statement:
theorem dEta_M_after_endpoint (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) : dEta (M d Amp) (y, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_M_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem dEta_M_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => dEta (M d Amp) (y, p.2)) (X p * dEta (U d Amp) p) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_M_ideal
statement:
theorem dEta_M_ideal (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) : dEta (M d Amp) (y, eta) = 4 * Real.exp y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_M_zero
statement:
theorem dEta_M_zero (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) :
    dEta (M d Amp) (0, eta) = 4

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_Pi_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem dEta_Pi_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => dEta (Pi w) (y, p.2)) (E w p * dEta (E w) p) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_Pi_ideal
statement:
theorem dEta_Pi_ideal (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    dEta (Pi w) (y, eta) = deriv (SchedulePressure.axisPressure d) eta -
      5 * d.core.P ^ 2 * shape eta ^ 2 * shapeRate eta * Real.exp (y / 5)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_S_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem dEta_S_hasDerivAt (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => dEta (S w Amp) (y, p.2))
      (X p * (2 * U d Amp p * dEta (U d Amp) p - E w p * dEta (E w) p)) p.1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_S_zero
statement:
theorem dEta_S_zero (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) :
    dEta (S w Amp) (0, eta) = 32 * eta +
      (5 / 6) * d.core.P ^ 2 * shape eta ^ 2 * shapeRate eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_U_ideal
statement:
theorem dEta_U_ideal (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_energyDensity
statement:
theorem dEta_energyDensity (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :
    dEta (energyDensity w Amp) p =

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_energyWeight
statement:
theorem dEta_energyWeight (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}

      (2 * U d Amp p * dEta (U d Amp) p - E w p * dEta (E w) p)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_history_zero
NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_massWeight
statement:
theorem dEta_massWeight (d : TailData) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (p : Point) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_mul
statement:
theorem dEta_mul {f g : Field} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (p : Point) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingHistories.dEta_transportWeight
statement:
theorem dEta_transportWeight (w : ResetWitness d K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.actual_ideal_cone_margins
statement:
theorem actual_ideal_cone_margins {v : TailData} {K : ℝ}
    (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness v K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) (η : ℝ) :
    coneA w (y, η) = 4 / 5 ∧ coneB w Amp (y, η) = 0 ∧
      0 < coneA w (y, η) - coneB w Amp (y, η) * coneRatio w Amp (y, η) ∧
      2 * coneB w Amp (y, η) * coneRatio w Amp (y, η) +
        coneB w Amp (y, η) ^ 2 / coneA w (y, η) +
          (coneA w (y, η) - 2) * coneRatio w Amp (y, η) ^ 2 ≤ 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.actual_preliminary_margins
statement:
theorem actual_preliminary_margins {v : TailData} {K : ℝ}
    (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness v K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hP : Real.exp (v.core.dropLength + 1) ≤ v.core.P ^ 2)
    (hhT : v.h ≤ Real.exp (-(v.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8)
    (he : dropSpeed v.core.m ≤ dropThreshold)
    (hlam : v.core.lam * entranceRatioBound v.core.P v.core.m ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ preliminaryWindow v) :
    (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ coneA w p - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p ∧
      2 * coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p + coneB w Amp p ^ 2 / coneA w p +
        (coneA w p - 2) * coneRatio w Amp p ^ 2 ≤ 5 / 8

theorem axialLag_integrated_history (v : TailData) (y η : ℝ) :

      4 * v.h * η * normalizedEnergyHistory v.core y η -
        d η * deriv (normalizedEnergyHistory v.core y) η +
          4 * A v.h * η * entrancePressure v y η -
            d η * deriv (entrancePressure v y) η

statement:
theorem compact_actual_preliminary_cone {v : TailData} {K : ℝ}
    (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness v K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hP : Real.exp (v.core.dropLength + 1) ≤ v.core.P ^ 2)
    (hhT : v.h ≤ Real.exp (-(v.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8)
    (he : dropSpeed v.core.m ≤ dropThreshold)
    (hlam : v.core.lam * entranceRatioBound v.core.P v.core.m ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4) :
    ∃ gap p₀ : ℝ, 0 < gap ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, p₀ < s →
      ∀ p ∈ preliminaryWindow v,
        2 + gap < s * (1 - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p / coneA w p) ∧
        coneA w p * (1 + (coneB w Amp p / coneA w p) ^ 2) + gap <
          ConeAlgebra.coneBound (s * (1 - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p / coneA w p))
            (s * (coneRatio w Amp p + coneB w Amp p / coneA w p))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.exists_actual_preliminary_cone_scale
statement:
theorem exists_actual_preliminary_cone_scale {v : TailData} {K : ℝ}
    (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness v K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hP : Real.exp (v.core.dropLength + 1) ≤ v.core.P ^ 2)
    (hhT : v.h ≤ Real.exp (-(v.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8)
    (he : dropSpeed v.core.m ≤ dropThreshold)
    (hlam : v.core.lam * entranceRatioBound v.core.P v.core.m ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4) :
    ∃ gap XR₀ : ℝ, 0 < gap ∧ 0 < XR₀ ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, XR₀ < XR →
      ∀ p ∈ preliminaryWindow v,
        2 + gap < OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp p *
          (1 - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p / coneA w p) ∧
        coneA w p * (1 + (coneB w Amp p / coneA w p) ^ 2) + gap <
          ConeAlgebra.coneBound
            (OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp p * (1 - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p / coneA w p))
            (OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp p * (coneRatio w Amp p + coneB w Amp p / coneA w p))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.exists_ordered_actual_preliminary_cone
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_actual_preliminary_cone :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ v : TailData, M ≤ v.core.m →
      amplitudeThreshold v.core.m ≤ v.core.P →
      v.core.lam ≤ lambdaThreshold v.core.P v.core.m →
      v.h ≤ heightThreshold v.core.m v.core.lam →
      ∀ {K : ℝ} (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness v K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ},
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp →
        (∀ y η : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → y ≤ v.core.holdStart → |η| ≤ 1 →
          coneFloor * (η ^ 2 + Real.exp (-y)) ≤ OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, η)) ∧
        ∃ gap XR₀ : ℝ, 0 < gap ∧ 0 < XR₀ ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, XR₀ < XR →
          ∀ p ∈ preliminaryWindow v,
            2 + gap < OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp p *
              (1 - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p / coneA w p) ∧
            coneA w p * (1 + (coneB w Amp p / coneA w p) ^ 2) + gap <
              ConeAlgebra.coneBound
                (OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp p * (1 - coneB w Amp p * coneRatio w Amp p / coneA w p))
                (OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp p * (coneRatio w Amp p + coneB w Amp p / coneA w p))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.exists_ordered_preliminary_bounds

      ∀ y η : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → y ≤ v.core.holdStart → |η| ≤ 1 →

        (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ radialA v.core y - shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η ∧

    (hlam : v.core.lam * entranceRatioBound v.core.P v.core.m ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ radialA v.core y - shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η ∧
      2 * shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η + shear v.core y η ^ 2 / radialA v.core y +
        (radialA v.core y - 2) * directionRatio v y η ^ 2 ≤ 5 / 8

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialLag_bound
statement:
theorem pressureAxialLag_bound (v : TailData) {y η : ℝ} (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ v.core.dropLength + 1) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) :
    |pressureAxialLag v y η| ≤ (3 * (y + 1) + 4 * pressureBound) * |η| *
      angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem pressureAxialLag_hasDerivAt (v : TailData) (y η : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => pressureAxialLag v t η)
      (pressureAxialSource v y η - pressureAxialLag v y η) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialLag_ideal
statement:
theorem pressureAxialLag_ideal (v : TailData) (η : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    pressureAxialLag v y η =
      4 * A v.h * η * SchedulePressure.axisPressure v η -
        d η * deriv (SchedulePressure.axisPressure v) η +
          (5 / 6) * (5 * d η * shapeGradient η + (10 * A v.h + 1) * η) *
            angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialLag_le_envelope
statement:
theorem pressureAxialLag_le_envelope (v : TailData) {y T η : ℝ} (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hyT : y ≤ T) (hyend : y ≤ v.core.endpoint) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) :
    |pressureAxialLag v y η| ≤ (3 + 4 * pressureBound) * |η| * energyEnvelope v.core.P T

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialSource_bound
statement:
theorem pressureAxialSource_bound (v : TailData) {y η : ℝ} (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hyend : y ≤ v.core.endpoint) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) :
    |pressureAxialSource v y η| ≤ pressureSourceBound * |η| *
      angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialSource_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem pressureAxialSource_deriv_bound (v : TailData) {y η : ℝ} (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hyend : y ≤ v.core.endpoint) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) :
    |deriv (pressureAxialSource v y) η| ≤ pressureSourceBound *
      angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureAxialSource_hasDerivAt_eta
statement:
theorem pressureAxialSource_hasDerivAt_eta (v : TailData) (y η : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (pressureAxialSource v y)
      ((2 + 4 * A v.h) * η * pressureGradient v y η -
        d η * deriv (pressureGradient v y) η + 4 * A v.h * entrancePressure v y η +
          (1 - 2 * η * shapeGradient η) * angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2) η

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureBound_pos
statement: theorem pressureBound_pos : 0 < pressureBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureClock_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem pressureClock_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (pressureClock c) ((1 / 2) * clockEnergy c y) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureClock_ideal
statement:
theorem pressureClock_ideal (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    pressureClock c y = (5 / 2) * clockEnergy c y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureGradient_contDiff_eta
statement:
theorem pressureGradient_contDiff_eta (v : TailData) (y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureGradient_eq_future
statement:
theorem pressureGradient_eq_future (v : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureGradient_hasDerivAt_y
statement:
theorem pressureGradient_hasDerivAt_y (v : TailData) (y η : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => pressureGradient v t η)
      (-shapeGradient η * angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressureSourceBound_pos
statement: theorem pressureSourceBound_pos : 0 < pressureSourceBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.pressure_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_coefficient_bound {h η : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hη : |η| ≤ 1) : |2 * h * η + d η * shapeGradient η| ≤ 3 * |η|

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.primitive_continuous_of_continuous
statement:
theorem primitive_continuous_of_continuous {r : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : Continuous r) :
