name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.radialA_bounds
statement: theorem radialA_bounds (c : Parameters) (y : ℝ) : (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ radialA c y ∧ radialA c y ≤ 11 / 5

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.radialA_drop
statement:
theorem radialA_drop (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hy' : y ≤ c.dropLength + 1) : radialA c y = 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.radialA_upper_lam
statement:
theorem radialA_upper_lam (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    radialA c y ≤ 2 + 2 * c.lam

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.second_ramp_cone_margins
statement:
theorem second_ramp_cone_margins (v : TailData) {y η : ℝ} (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hy : v.core.dropLength + 1 ≤ y) (hyT : y ≤ v.core.holdStart) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hhT : v.h ≤ Real.exp (-(v.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8)
    (hlam : v.core.lam * entranceRatioBound v.core.P v.core.m ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (2 : ℝ) ≤ radialA v.core y - shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η ∧
      2 * shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η + shear v.core y η ^ 2 / radialA v.core y +
        (radialA v.core y - 2) * directionRatio v y η ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shapeGradient_contDiff
statement: theorem shapeGradient_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ shapeGradient

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shapeSquare_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem shapeSquare_hasDerivAt (η : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => shape t ^ 2) (-2 * shapeGradient η * shape η ^ 2) η

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shape_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem shape_hasDerivAt (η : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt shape (-shapeGradient η * shape η) η

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shape_interval
statement: theorem shape_interval {η : ℝ} (hη : |η| ≤ 1) : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ shape η ∧ shape η ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_direction_drop_bound
statement:
theorem shear_direction_drop_bound (v : TailData) {y η : ℝ}
    (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ v.core.dropLength + 1)
    (hη : |η| ≤ 1) (hP : Real.exp (v.core.dropLength + 1) ≤ v.core.P ^ 2)
    (hhT : v.h ≤ Real.exp (-(v.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8) :
    |shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η| ≤
      (4 * axialBound / coneFloor) * dropSpeed v.core.m

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_direction_identity
statement:
theorem shear_direction_identity (v : TailData) (y η : ℝ)
    (hQ : 0 < angularLag v.core v.h η y) :
    |shear v.core y η * directionRatio v y η| =
      (2 * |deriv (dropCoefficient v.core.m) y| * |η| * |axialLag v y η|) /
        (angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (y, η) ^ 2 * angularLag v.core v.h η y)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_drop_abs
statement:
theorem shear_drop_abs (c : Parameters) {y η : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hy' : y ≤ c.dropLength + 1) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hP : Real.exp (c.dropLength + 1) ≤ c.P ^ 2) :
    |shear c y η| ≤ 4 * dropSpeed c.m

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_drop_square
statement:
theorem shear_drop_square (c : Parameters) {y η : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hy' : y ≤ c.dropLength + 1) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hP : Real.exp (c.dropLength + 1) ≤ c.P ^ 2) :
    shear c y η ^ 2 ≤ 16 * dropSpeed c.m ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_early
statement: theorem shear_early (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 1) (η : ℝ) : shear c y η = 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_is_actual
statement:
theorem shear_is_actual (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y < c.pulseStart) (η : ℝ) :
    shear c y η = 2 * deriv (fun t => axial c amp (t, η)) y /
      angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.shear_second_ramp
statement:
theorem shear_second_ramp (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ} (hy : c.dropLength + 1 ≤ y) (η : ℝ) :
    shear c y η = 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.slope_integral_upper
statement:
theorem slope_integral_upper (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    OutgoingSchedule.primitive (slope c.dropLength c.lam) y ≤ 3 / 5

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.slope_nonneg_before_dropEnd
statement:
theorem slope_nonneg_before_dropEnd (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ≤ c.dropLength + 1) : 0 ≤ slope c.dropLength c.lam y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.slope_nonpos_after_first_ramp
statement:
theorem slope_nonpos_after_first_ramp (c : Parameters) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) : slope c.dropLength c.lam y ≤ 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.transportW_bounds
statement:
theorem transportW_bounds (c : Parameters) {h y η : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) : -3 ≤ transportW c h y η ∧ transportW c h y η ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.transportW_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem transportW_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) (h y η : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => transportW c h t η)
      (-L h η * (dropCoefficient c.m y - averagedDrop c y)) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.transportW_second_ramp
statement:
theorem transportW_second_ramp (c : Parameters) {h y η : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 100) (hy : c.dropLength + 1 ≤ y) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) :
    1 / 2 ≤ transportW c h y η

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.weightedClockEnergy_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem weightedClockEnergy_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (weightedClockEnergy c)
      (2 * slope c.dropLength c.lam y * weightedClockEnergy c y) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.weightedClockEnergy_monotone
statement:
theorem weightedClockEnergy_monotone (c : Parameters) :
    MonotoneOn (weightedClockEnergy c) (Iic (c.dropLength + 1))

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.affineError_decomposition
statement:
theorem affineError_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A y : ℝ) :
    affineError c q A y = q * affineError c 1 0 y + A * affineError c 0 1 y

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.affineError_eta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem affineError_eta_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ}
    (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => affineError c (parameterPolynomial t) (amp t) y)
      (affineError c (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2) amp' y) eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.affineLag_decomposition
statement:
theorem affineLag_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A y : ℝ) :
    affineLag c q A y = q * affineLag c 1 0 y + A * affineLag c 0 1 y

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.affineLag_error
statement:
theorem affineLag_error (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |affineLag c q A y - (forcing c q A y / decay c -
      deriv (forcing c q A) y / decay c ^ 2 +
        (prefixCoefficient c 0 * q) * Real.exp (-decay c * y))| ≤
      lagBound c.P c.m * (|q| + |A|) * c.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.affineLag_eta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem affineLag_eta_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ}
    (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => affineLag c (parameterPolynomial t) (amp t) y)
      (affineLag c (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2) amp' y) eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.affineProfile_zero_left
statement:
theorem affineProfile_zero_left (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    affineProfile c q A y = 0

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.amplitude_fullError_bounds
statement:
theorem amplitude_fullError_bounds (d : OutgoingTail.TailData)
    (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hscale : PulseAmplitude.errorScale d.core ≤ 1 / 1000)
    {eta y : ℝ} (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |fullError d.core (PulseAmplitude.amplitude d) eta y| ≤
        fullLagBound d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ 2 ∧
      |deriv (fun t => fullError d.core (PulseAmplitude.amplitude d) t y) eta| ≤
        fullLagBound d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.convolution_abs_le
statement:
theorem convolution_abs_le {β M y : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |f t| ≤ M) :
    |convolution β f y| ≤ M / β

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.convolution_eq_weighted
statement:
theorem convolution_eq_weighted (β : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    convolution β f y = Real.exp (-β * y) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..y, Real.exp (β * t) * f t

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.convolution_linear
statement:
theorem convolution_linear (β q A y : ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    convolution β (fun t => q * f t + A * g t) y =
      q * convolution β f y + A * convolution β g y

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.convolution_second_order
statement:
theorem convolution_second_order {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    {f f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f₁ t) t)
    (hf₁ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f₁ (f₂ t) t) (hf₂ : Continuous f₂) (y : ℝ) :
    convolution β f y = f y / β - f₁ y / β ^ 2 -
      Real.exp (-β * y) * (f 0 / β - f₁ 0 / β ^ 2) + convolution β f₂ y / β ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.corrected_amplitude_fullError_bounds
statement:
theorem corrected_amplitude_fullError_bounds
    {d : OutgoingTail.TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness d K)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (hscale : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.combinedScale d K ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ∀ eta y : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ y →
      |fullError d.core (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) eta y| ≤
        fullLagBound d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ 2 ∧
      |deriv (fun t => fullError d.core (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) t y) eta| ≤
        fullLagBound d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.decay_inv_cube_le
statement:
theorem decay_inv_cube_le (c : Parameters) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    M / decay c ^ 3 ≤ 16 * M

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.decay_pos
statement: theorem decay_pos (c : Parameters) : 0 < decay c

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.deriv_zero_of_zero_left
statement: theorem deriv_zero_of_zero_left {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ y ≤ 0, f y = 0) : deriv f 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.exists_corrected_uniform_lag_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_corrected_uniform_lag_threshold (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ K C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : OutgoingTail.TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ → ∃ w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness d K,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧
        ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
          9 / 10 < CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧
          CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
          CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients
            (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
          ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y →
            |fullError d.core (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) eta y| ≤
              C * d.core.lam ^ 2 ∧
            |deriv (fun t => fullError d.core (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) t y) eta| ≤
              C * d.core.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.exists_uniform_lag_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_lag_threshold (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : OutgoingTail.TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ → ∀ eta y : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ y →
        |fullError d.core (PulseAmplitude.amplitude d) eta y| ≤ C * d.core.lam ^ 2 ∧
        |deriv (fun t => fullError d.core (PulseAmplitude.amplitude d) t y) eta| ≤
          C * d.core.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.exponential_correction_quadratic
statement:
theorem exponential_correction_quadratic {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) ≤ 64 * lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcingBound_pos
statement: theorem forcingBound_pos {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (m : ℝ) : 0 < forcingBound P m

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcing_contDiff
statement: theorem forcing_contDiff (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (forcing c q A)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcing_eq_pulseRatio
statement:
theorem forcing_eq_pulseRatio (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :
    forcing c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta) y = pulseRatio c amp (y, eta)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcing_jet_decomposition
statement:
theorem forcing_jet_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (forcing c q A) y =
      q * iteratedDeriv k (forcing c 1 0) y + A * iteratedDeriv k (forcing c 0 1) y

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcing_jet_formula
statement:
theorem forcing_jet_formula (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (forcing c q A) y =
      A * c.lam ^ k * iteratedDeriv k mainPulse (c.lam * y) +
        iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcing_second_bound
statement:
theorem forcing_second_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A y : ℝ) : |iteratedDeriv 2 (forcing c q A) y| ≤
      forcingBound c.P c.m * (|q| + |A|) * c.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.forcing_zero_left
statement:
theorem forcing_zero_left (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    forcing c q A y = 0

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.fullError_bounds_of_amplitude_bounds
statement:
theorem fullError_bounds_of_amplitude_bounds (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta)
    (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (hamp : |amp eta| ≤ 6 / 5) (hamp' : |amp'| ≤ 1)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |fullError c amp eta y| ≤ fullLagBound c.P c.m * c.lam ^ 2 ∧
      |deriv (fun t => fullError c amp t y) eta| ≤ fullLagBound c.P c.m * c.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.fullError_eq
statement:
theorem fullError_eq (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :
    fullError c amp eta y = pulseError c amp eta y +
      (prefixCoefficient c 0 * parameterPolynomial eta) * Real.exp (-decay c * y)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.fullError_eta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem fullError_eta_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ}
    (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => fullError c amp t y)
      (affineError c (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2) amp' y +
        (prefixCoefficient c 0 * (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2)) * Real.exp (-decay c * y)) eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.fullLagBound_pos
statement: theorem fullLagBound_pos {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (m : ℝ) : 0 < fullLagBound P m

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.initial_memory_bound
statement:
theorem initial_memory_bound (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |(prefixCoefficient c 0 * q) * Real.exp (-decay c * y)| ≤
      prefixBound c.P c.m 0 * |q| * c.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.kernel_continuous
statement: theorem kernel_continuous (β y : ℝ) : Continuous (kernel β y)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.kernel_hasDerivAt
statement:

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.lag_second_order_error
statement:
theorem lag_second_order_error {β M y : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    {f f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f₁ t) t)
    (hf₁ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f₁ (f₂ t) t) (hf₂ : Continuous f₂)
    (hzero : f 0 = 0) (hzero₁ : f₁ 0 = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |f₂ t| ≤ M) (m₀ : ℝ) :
    |lag β m₀ f y - (f y / β - f₁ y / β ^ 2 + m₀ * Real.exp (-β * y))| ≤ M / β ^ 3

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.massMoment_pulse
statement:
theorem massMoment_pulse (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    massMoment c amp eta (c.pulseStart + y) = massMoment c amp eta c.pulseStart +
      (momentScale c 0 * shape eta) *
        ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..y, Real.exp (decay c * t) * forcing c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta) t

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.normalizedLag_eq_affineLag
statement:
theorem normalizedLag_eq_affineLag (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.normalizedLag_error
statement:
theorem normalizedLag_error (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |normalizedLag c amp eta y - (pulseRatio c amp (y, eta) / decay c -
      deriv (fun t => pulseRatio c amp (t, eta)) y / decay c ^ 2 +
        (prefixCoefficient c 0 * parameterPolynomial eta) * Real.exp (-decay c * y))| ≤
      lagBound c.P c.m * (2 + |amp eta|) * c.lam ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.normalizedLag_eta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem normalizedLag_eta_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ}
    (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => normalizedLag c amp t y)
      (affineLag c (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2) amp' y) eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.normalizedLag_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem normalizedLag_hasDerivWithinAt (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (normalizedLag c amp eta)
      (pulseRatio c amp (y, eta) - decay c * normalizedLag c amp eta y) (Ici 0) y

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.normalizedLag_ode
statement:
theorem normalizedLag_ode (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :

statement:
theorem pulseError_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.pulseError_scaled
statement:
theorem pulseError_scaled (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :
    pulseError c amp eta y = normalizedLag c amp eta y -
      (pulseRatio c amp (y, eta) / decay c -
        c.lam * deriv (scaledPulse c amp eta) (c.lam * y) / decay c ^ 2 +
        (prefixCoefficient c 0 * parameterPolynomial eta) * Real.exp (-decay c * y))

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.pulse_denominator
statement:
theorem pulse_denominator (c : Parameters) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    Real.exp (c.pulseStart + y) * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart + y, eta) =
      (momentScale c 0 * shape eta) * Real.exp (decay c * y)

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.scaledPulse_deriv
statement:
theorem scaledPulse_deriv (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.PulseLag.smooth_amplitude_fullError_bounds
statement:
theorem smooth_amplitude_fullError_bounds (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp)
    (hamp : ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → |amp eta| ≤ 6 / 5)
    (hamp' : ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → |deriv amp eta| ≤ 1) :
    ∀ eta y : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ y →
      |fullError c amp eta y| ≤ fullLagBound c.P c.m * c.lam ^ 2 ∧

name: NavierStokes.PulseEnergyHistory.S_at_pulseStart
NavierStokes.PulseEnergyHistory.corrected_pulse_history_bounds
statement:
theorem corrected_pulse_history_bounds (w : ResetWitness d K) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (hscale : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.combinedScale d K ≤ 1 / 1000)
    {eta y : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.pulseLength) :
    |S w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta)| /
        (X (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) * E w (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) ^ 2) ≤
      historyConstant d.core.P d.core.m * Real.exp 26 / d.core.lam ∧
    |dEta (S w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients))
        (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta)| /
        (X (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) * E w (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) ^ 2) ≤
      historyConstant d.core.P d.core.m * Real.exp 26 / d.core.lam

name: NavierStokes.PulseEnergyHistory.dEta_S_at_pulseStart
statement:
theorem dEta_S_at_pulseStart (w : ResetWitness d K) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) (eta : ℝ) :
    dEta (S w amp) (d.core.pulseStart, eta) =
      2 * PulseAmplitude.prefixAxialEnergy d.core * eta +
        2 * PulseAmplitude.prefixAngularEnergy d.core * shape eta ^ 2 * shapeRate eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseEnergyHistory.dEta_energyWeight_pulse
statement:
theorem dEta_energyWeight_pulse (w : ResetWitness d K) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.pulseLength) :
    dEta (energyWeight w amp) (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) =
      pulseNormalization d.core eta * PulseAmplitude.pulseWeight d.core y *
        (2 * pulseRatio d.core amp (y, eta) * deriv (fun t => pulseRatio d.core amp (y, t)) eta -
          2 * shapeRate eta * (pulseRatio d.core amp (y, eta) ^ 2 - 1 / 2))

name: NavierStokes.PulseEnergyHistory.energyWeight_pulse
statement:
theorem energyWeight_pulse (w : ResetWitness d K) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.pulseLength) :
    energyWeight w amp (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) =
      pulseNormalization d.core eta * PulseAmplitude.pulseWeight d.core y *
        (pulseRatio d.core amp (y, eta) ^ 2 - 1 / 2)

name: NavierStokes.PulseEnergyHistory.energy_sources_bound
statement:
theorem energy_sources_bound (w : ResetWitness d K) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) {eta y B : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.pulseLength)
    (hR : |pulseRatio d.core amp (y, eta)| ≤ B)
    (hReta : |deriv (fun t => pulseRatio d.core amp (y, t)) eta| ≤ B) :
    |energyWeight w amp (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta)| ≤
        pulseNormalization d.core eta * (6 * B ^ 2 + 2) ∧
      |dEta (energyWeight w amp) (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta)| ≤
        pulseNormalization d.core eta * (6 * B ^ 2 + 2)

    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ 13 / lam)

name: NavierStokes.ShapedWaitBounds.axialLag_hold_bound
statement:
theorem axialLag_hold_bound (v : TailData) {η t : ℝ}
    (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htw : t ≤ v.core.wait) :
    |axialLag v (v.core.holdStart + t) η| ≤ Real.exp (-t) *
      (initialAxialBound v.core.P v.core.m * |η| + t *
        (pressureSourceBound * |η| * angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (v.core.holdStart, η) ^ 2))

    |deriv (fun θ => axialLag v (v.core.holdStart + t) θ) η| ≤ Real.exp (-t) *
      (initialAxialDerivativeBound v.core.P v.core.m + t *

name: NavierStokes.ShapedWaitBounds.axialLag_hold_deriv_ratio_bound
statement:

    |deriv (fun θ => axialLag v (v.core.holdStart + t) θ) η /
      angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (v.core.holdStart + t, η)| ≤
      axialDerivativeWaitConstant v.core.P v.core.m * (1 + t) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 - v.core.lam) * t)

name: NavierStokes.ShapedWaitBounds.axialLag_hold_hasDerivAt_eta
statement:

statement:

      |deriv (fun θ => OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (v.core.pulseStart, θ) /
        OutgoingHistories.E w (v.core.pulseStart, θ)) η| ≤

name: NavierStokes.ShapedWaitBounds.canonical_hold_estimates
statement:
theorem canonical_hold_estimates {v : TailData} {K : ℝ}
    (w : UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness v K) {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    {η t : ℝ} (hh1 : v.h ≤ 1 / 100) (hhlam : v.h ≤ v.core.lam / 4)
    (hhT : v.h ≤ Real.exp (-(v.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8)
    (hη : |η| ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htw : t ≤ v.core.wait) :
    holdFloor v.core.m * (η ^ 2 + v.core.lam + Real.exp (-(1 - v.core.lam) * t)) ≤
        OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (v.core.holdStart + t, η) ∧
      |OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (v.core.holdStart + t, η) - equilibrium v.core v.h η| ≤
        holdConstant v.core.P v.core.m * (1 + t) * Real.exp (-(1 - v.core.lam) * t) ∧
      |deriv (fun θ => OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (v.core.holdStart + t, θ) - equilibrium v.core v.h θ) η| ≤
        holdConstant v.core.P v.core.m * (1 + t) * Real.exp (-(1 - v.core.lam) * t) ∧
      |OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (v.core.holdStart + t, η) / OutgoingHistories.E w (v.core.holdStart + t, η)| ≤
        holdConstant v.core.P v.core.m * |η| * (1 + t) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 - v.core.lam) * t) ∧
      |deriv (fun θ => OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (v.core.holdStart + t, θ) /
        OutgoingHistories.E w (v.core.holdStart + t, θ)) η| ≤
          holdConstant v.core.P v.core.m * (1 + t) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 - v.core.lam) * t)

    |z / angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.holdStart + t, η)| ≤
      (A / initialEnergyLower c.P c.m + pressureSourceBound * initialEnergyUpper c.P c.m) *

statement:
theorem normalizedAxial_hasDerivAt (v : TailData) (η : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun θ => axialLag v (v.core.holdStart + t) θ /
      angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (v.core.holdStart + t, θ))
      (deriv (fun θ => axialLag v (v.core.holdStart + t) θ) η /
        angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (v.core.holdStart + t, η) +
          shapeGradient η * (axialLag v (v.core.holdStart + t) η /
            angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (v.core.holdStart + t, η))) η

    |Real.exp t * pressureAxialSource v (v.core.holdStart + t) η| ≤
      pressureSourceBound * |η| * angular v.core.P v.core.dropLength v.core.lam (v.core.holdStart, η) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.Ns_integrated_Ubar
statement:
theorem Ns_integrated_Ubar (w : ResetWitness d K) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) (p : Point) :
    Ns w amp p = -W d amp p * U d amp p +
      StressAlgebra.axialExponent d.h * (Ubar d amp p - p.2 * dEta (Ubar d amp) p) +
      (4 * d.h * p.2 * S w amp p - StressAlgebra.coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (S w amp) p) / X p +
      4 * StressAlgebra.velocityExponent d.h * p.2 * Pi w p -
        StressAlgebra.coordinateFactor p.2 * dEta (Pi w) p

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.Ns_pulse_expansion
statement:
theorem Ns_pulse_expansion (w : ResetWitness d K) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.pulseLength) :
    Ns w amp (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) / E w (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) =
      angularEquilibrium d eta * mainDirection d amp eta y +
        ((1 / 2 - d.h) + geometricSource d eta) * fullError d.core amp eta y -
        (1 / 2 - d.h) * eta * deriv (fun t => normalizedLag d.core amp t y) eta +
        axialHistoryError w amp eta y

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.Ns_pulse_identity
statement:
theorem Ns_pulse_identity (w : ResetWitness d K) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.pulseLength) :
    Ns w amp (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) / E w (d.core.pulseStart + y, eta) =
      -pulseRatio d.core amp (y, eta) +
        ((1 / 2 - d.h) + (1 / 2 - d.h) * eta * shapeGradient eta) * normalizedLag d.core amp eta y -
        (1 / 2 - d.h) * eta * deriv (fun t => normalizedLag d.core amp t y) eta +
        axialHistoryError w amp eta y

theorem PulseConeAt.true_criterion {w : ResetWitness d K} {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Point}
    (h : PulseConeAt w amp p) :

      2 * shearB w amp p * directionRatio w amp p + shearB w amp p ^ 2 / radialA w p +
        (radialA w p - 2) * directionRatio w amp p ^ 2 < 2 ∧
      2 < radialA w p * (1 + (shearB w amp p / radialA w p) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.perturbed_cone_margins
statement:
theorem perturbed_cone_margins {lam R C Z b v eps F M : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (heps' : eps ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hR' : R ≤ F) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hC' : C ≤ 2001 / 1000)
    (hZ : Z ≤ 6 / 5) (hmain : |2 * R - C * Z| ≤ M)
    (hb : |b + R| ≤ eps) (hv : |v - (2 * R - C * Z)| ≤ eps)
    (hbudget : coneErrorBudget F M eps lam ≤ 1 / 100) :
    b * v ≤ 74 / 100 ∧
      2 * b * v + b ^ 2 / (2 + 2 * lam) + 2 * lam * v ^ 2 ≤ 168 / 100

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.perturbed_true_cone
statement:
theorem perturbed_true_cone {lam R C Z b v eps F M : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (heps' : eps ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hR' : R ≤ F) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hC' : C ≤ 2001 / 1000)
    (hZ : Z ≤ 6 / 5) (hmain : |2 * R - C * Z| ≤ M)
    (hb : |b + R| ≤ eps) (hv : |v - (2 * R - C * Z)| ≤ eps)
    (hbudget : coneErrorBudget F M eps lam ≤ 1 / 100) :
    0 < (2 + 2 * lam) - b * v ∧
      2 * b * v + b ^ 2 / (2 + 2 * lam) + ((2 + 2 * lam) - 2) * v ^ 2 < 2 ∧
      2 < (2 + 2 * lam) * (1 + (b / (2 + 2 * lam)) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.pulseAngularSource_error_bound
statement:
theorem pulseAngularSource_error_bound (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh' : h ≤ 1 / 2)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta)
    (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (hamp : |amp eta| ≤ 6 / 5) (hamp' : |amp'| ≤ 1)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |pulseAngularSource c h amp eta y - (c.lam - h + (1 / 2 - h) * eta * shapeGradient eta)| ≤
      sourceConstant c.P c.m * c.lam ^ 30

name: NavierStokes.PulseCone.pulseAngularSource_error_identity
statement:
theorem pulseAngularSource_error_identity (c : Parameters) (h : ℝ) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :
    pulseAngularSource c h amp eta y - (c.lam - h + (1 / 2 - h) * eta * shapeGradient eta) =
      angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart + y, eta) *
        (-c.lam * ((2 * (1 / 2 - h) * eta - (1 - eta ^ 2) * shapeGradient eta) *
          normalizedLag c amp eta y + (1 - eta ^ 2) * deriv (fun t => normalizedLag c amp t y) eta) +
          (2 * h * eta + (1 - eta ^ 2) * shapeGradient eta) * pulseRatio c amp (y, eta))

    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta)

    (hrel : d.releaseStart ≤ Real.log X) :
    (∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d w.coefficients eta u) =
      ∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d w.coefficients eta' u

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.radial_history_eventual
statement:
theorem radial_history_eventual (eta : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)
    (hfar : tailEnd d ≤ Real.log X) :
    (∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d w.coefficients eta u) = X * radialH d w.coefficients eta X / (1 - d.h)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.radial_history_integrable
statement:
theorem radial_history_integrable (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    IntegrableOn (radialH d w.coefficients eta) (Ioc 0 (Real.exp y))

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_angular_moment
statement:
theorem renormalized_angular_moment (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialH d w.coefficients eta X - radialPowerH d X) = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_log_integrable
statement:
theorem renormalized_log_integrable (eta : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => correctedWeight d w.coefficients eta y - powerWeight d y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_log_integral
statement:
theorem renormalized_log_integral (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, correctedWeight d w.coefficients eta y - powerWeight d y) = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_radial_integrable
statement:
theorem renormalized_radial_integrable (eta : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => radialH d w.coefficients eta X - radialPowerH d X) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.complete_release_moments
statement:
theorem complete_release_moments :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedAngular d c) ∧
        ∀ eta : ℝ,
          IntegrableOn (fun X => radialH d c eta X - radialPowerH d X) (Ioi 0) ∧
          (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialH d c eta X - radialPowerH d X) = 0 ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → tailEnd d ≤ Real.log X →
            (∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d c eta u) = X * radialH d c eta X / (1 - d.h)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_contDiff
statement:
theorem correctedWeight_contDiff (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedWeight d c eta)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_eq_power
statement:
theorem correctedWeight_eq_power (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : tailEnd d ≤ y) : correctedWeight d c eta y = powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_eq_release
statement:
theorem correctedWeight_eq_release (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) : correctedWeight d c eta y = releaseWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_ideal
NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.corrected_eq_release
statement:
theorem corrected_eq_release (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) : correctedAngular d c (y, eta) = finalAngular d (y, 0)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.exponential_radial_weight
statement:
theorem exponential_radial_weight (y : ℝ) :
    Real.exp y * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp y) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 * y / 2)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.image_exp_Iic
statement: theorem image_exp_Iic (y : ℝ) : Real.exp '' Iic y = Ioc 0 (Real.exp y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.momentCandidate_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem momentCandidate_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) (q : ℝ → ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y)
    (hq : HasDerivAt q (-profileSlope d y - d.h - (1 + profileSlope d y) * q y) y) :
    HasDerivAt (momentCandidate d q) (releaseWeight d y) y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.powerWeight_integrable
statement: theorem powerWeight_integrable (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (powerWeight d) (Iic y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.powerWeight_integral
statement:
theorem powerWeight_integral (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Iic y, powerWeight d t) = powerWeight d y / (1 - d.h)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.profileSlope_before_tail
statement:
theorem profileSlope_before_tail (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ tailStart d) :
    profileSlope d y = releaseSlope d (y - d.releaseStart)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.radialH_comp_exp
statement:
theorem radialH_comp_exp (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • radialH d c eta (Real.exp y) = Real.sqrt 2 * correctedWeight d c eta y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.radialPowerH_comp_exp
statement:
theorem radialPowerH_comp_exp (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • radialPowerH d (Real.exp y) = Real.sqrt 2 * powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.radial_difference_comp_exp
statement:
theorem radial_difference_comp_exp (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • (radialH d c eta (Real.exp y) - radialPowerH d (Real.exp y)) =
      Real.sqrt 2 * (correctedWeight d c eta y - powerWeight d y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem releaseLag_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (releaseLag d)
      (-releaseSlope d t - d.h - (1 + releaseSlope d t) * releaseLag d t) t

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_contDiff
statement: theorem releaseWeight_contDiff (d : TailData) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (releaseWeight d)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_eq_power
statement:
theorem releaseWeight_eq_power (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : tailEnd d ≤ y) :
    releaseWeight d y = powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem releaseWeight_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt (releaseWeight d) (releaseWeight d y * (1 + profileSlope d y)) y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_pos
statement: theorem releaseWeight_pos (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) : 0 < releaseWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.shifted_releaseLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem shifted_releaseLag_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ tailStart d) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => releaseLag d (t - d.releaseStart))
      (-profileSlope d y - d.h - (1 + profileSlope d y) * releaseLag d (y - d.releaseStart)) y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailEnd_pos
statement: theorem tailEnd_pos (d : TailData) : 0 < tailEnd d

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailLag_zero_late
statement: theorem tailLag_zero_late (d : TailData) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) : tailLag d t = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailShapeDeriv_zero_early
statement:
theorem tailShapeDeriv_zero_early (d : TailData) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailShapeDeriv_zero_late
statement:
theorem tailShapeDeriv_zero_late (d : TailData) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    tailShapeDeriv d t = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.weighted_power
statement:
theorem weighted_power (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (3 * y / 2) * (powerConstant d * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + d.h) * y)) = powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.abs_increment_le
statement:
theorem abs_increment_le {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b C : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, |f' t| ≤ C) : |f b - f a| ≤ C * (b - a)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualA_finite
NavierStokes.TailCone.actualA_release
statement:
theorem actualA_release {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualBs_zero
statement:
theorem actualBs_zero {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualI_eq_releaseHistory
statement:
theorem actualI_eq_releaseHistory {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    OutgoingHistories.I w (y, eta) = ReleaseMoments.history d w.coefficients eta y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualI_eta_zero
statement:
theorem actualI_eta_zero {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    OutgoingHistories.dEta (OutgoingHistories.I w) (y, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualNs_eq_releaseNumerator
statement:
theorem actualNs_eq_releaseNumerator {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (y, eta) = releaseNumerator d eta y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualNs_finite_bound
statement:
theorem actualNs_finite_bound {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (hsmall : K * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ) ≤ 1) (eta : ℝ) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.releaseStart) :
    |OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (y, eta)| ≤
      finiteNumeratorBudget d * finalAngular d (d.core.endpoint, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualP1_finite_large
statement:
theorem actualP1_finite_large {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) {XR eta y : ℝ} (hXR : finiteRadiusThreshold d < XR) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) (hQ : d.core.lam / 4 ≤ OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta)) :
    16 < OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp (y, eta)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualP2_eq
statement:
theorem actualP2_eq {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (XR eta y : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hQ : 0 < OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta)) :
    OutgoingHistories.p2 XR w Amp (y, eta) = OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w Amp (y, eta) *
      (OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (y, eta) /
        (OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta)))

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualPi_eq_correctedPi
statement:
theorem actualPi_eq_correctedPi {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (y eta : ℝ) :
    OutgoingHistories.Pi w (y, eta) = CorrectedPressureBounds.correctedPi w y eta

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualPi_eta_zero
statement:
theorem actualPi_eta_zero {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    OutgoingHistories.dEta (OutgoingHistories.Pi w) (y, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualPi_uniform
statement:
theorem actualPi_uniform {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    OutgoingHistories.Pi w (y, eta) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * releaseFutureMass d y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualQs_eq_normalizedLag
statement:
theorem actualQs_eq_normalizedLag {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta) = ReleaseMoments.normalizedLag d w.coefficients eta y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualRatio_eq_releaseVelocityRatio
statement:
theorem actualRatio_eq_releaseVelocityRatio {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (y, eta) /
      (OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta)) =
        releaseVelocityRatio d w.coefficients eta y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_after_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem actualS_after_hasDerivAt {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => OutgoingHistories.S w Amp (t, eta))
      (-(Real.exp y * OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) ^ 2) / 2) y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_backward
statement:
theorem actualS_backward {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y)
    (hz : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp eta) eta = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.S w Amp (y, eta) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi y, Real.exp t * correctedAngular d w.coefficients (t, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_endpoint
statement:
theorem actualS_endpoint {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ)
    (hz : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp eta) eta = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.S w Amp (d.core.endpoint, eta) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (postPulseEnergy d eta + ResetEnergyBounds.resetEnergy d w.coefficients eta)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_eta_after_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem actualS_eta_after_hasDerivAt {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => OutgoingHistories.dEta (OutgoingHistories.S w Amp) (t, eta))
      (-(Real.exp y * OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) ^ 2) * correctedEtaSlope w eta y) y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_eta_endpoint
statement:
theorem actualS_eta_endpoint {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.dEta (OutgoingHistories.S w Amp) (d.core.endpoint, eta) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (deriv (postPulseEnergy d) eta +
        deriv (ResetEnergyBounds.resetEnergy d w.coefficients) eta)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_eta_zero
statement:
theorem actualS_eta_zero {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.dEta (OutgoingHistories.S w Amp) (y, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_finite_bounds
statement:
theorem actualS_finite_bounds {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (hsmall : K * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ) ≤ 1) (eta : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.releaseStart) :
    |OutgoingHistories.S w Amp (y, eta)| ≤ finiteEnergyBudget d * energyDensity d eta d.core.endpoint ∧
    |OutgoingHistories.dEta (OutgoingHistories.S w Amp) (y, eta)| ≤
      finiteEnergyBudget d * energyDensity d eta d.core.endpoint

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actualS_uniform
statement:
theorem actualS_uniform {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y)
    (hz : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp eta) eta = 0) :
    OutgoingHistories.S w Amp (y, eta) =
      (Real.exp y / 2) * releaseFutureEnergy d y

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actual_energyWeight_eq
statement:
theorem actual_energyWeight_eq {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (Amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp t * (OutgoingHistories.U d Amp (t, eta) ^ 2 - OutgoingHistories.E w (t, eta) ^ 2 / 2) =
      CorrectedPulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand d w.coefficients (Amp eta) eta t

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actual_finite_ratio_bound
statement:
theorem actual_finite_ratio_bound {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hsmall : K * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ) ≤ 1) (eta : ℝ) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.releaseStart)
    (hQ : d.core.lam / 4 ≤ OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta)) :
    |OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (y, eta) /
      (OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta))| ≤
      finiteConeConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (10 : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.actual_release_cone
statement:
theorem actual_release_cone {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hsmall : releaseConeConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (29 : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp)
    {XR eta y : ℝ} (hXR : releaseRadiusThreshold d < XR) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ tailStart d + 1 / 2)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients (Amp q) q = 0) :
    0 < OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta) ∧
    2 < releaseA d y ∧
    2 < XR * Real.exp y * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta) / CoordinateAlgebra.L d.h eta ∧
    releaseA d y < ConeAlgebra.coneBound
      (XR * Real.exp y * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta) / CoordinateAlgebra.L d.h eta)
      ((XR * Real.exp y * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta) / CoordinateAlgebra.L d.h eta) *
        (OutgoingHistories.Ns w Amp (y, eta) /
          (OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) * OutgoingHistories.Qs w Amp (y, eta))))

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.amplitude_energy_zero_germ
statement:
theorem amplitude_energy_zero_germ {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta : ℝ)
    (hneg : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.constantTerm d w.coefficients eta < -(1 / 5)) :
    ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 eta, CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients
      (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients q) q = 0

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.cone_of_zero_bs
statement:
theorem cone_of_zero_bs {a r p : ℝ} (ha : 2 < a) (ha' : a ≤ 4)
    (hr : |r| ≤ 1 / 2) (hp : 16 < p) :
    2 < p ∧ 2 < a ∧ a < ConeAlgebra.coneBound p (p * r)

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.correctedEtaSlope_abs_le
statement:
theorem correctedEtaSlope_abs_le {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (hsmall : K * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ) ≤ 1) (eta y : ℝ) :
    |correctedEtaSlope w eta y| ≤ 5

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.correctedEta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem correctedEta_hasDerivAt {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (eta y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun q => OutgoingHistories.E w (y, q))
      (OutgoingHistories.E w (y, eta) * correctedEtaSlope w eta y) eta

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.correctedFlatSlope_bounds
statement:
theorem correctedFlatSlope_bounds {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    (eta y : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    -d.core.lam - 1 / 10 - resetSourceError d K ≤ correctedFlatSlope w eta y ∧
      correctedFlatSlope w eta y ≤ -d.core.lam + resetSourceError d K

name: NavierStokes.TailCone.correctedFlat_Sq
statement:
theorem correctedFlat_Sq {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K)
    {Amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Amp) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hscale : CorrectedPulseAmplitude.combinedScale d K ≤ 1 / 1000)
    (hpulse : PulseCone.sourceConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (29 : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 8)
    (hh1 : d.h ≤ 1 / 100) (hhT : d.h ≤ Real.exp (-(d.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8)
    (hreset : resetSourceError d K ≤ d.core.lam / 4)
    (hfinite : finiteConeConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (10 : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hrelease : releaseConeConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (29 : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    {XR eta y : ℝ} (hXR : tailRadiusThreshold d < XR) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (hy : d.core.endpoint ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ tailStart d + 1 / 2) :
    0 < OutgoingHistories.Qs w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) (y, eta) ∧
    actualBs w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) y eta = 0 ∧
    2 < actualA w y eta ∧ actualA w y eta ≤ 4 ∧
    2 < OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) (y, eta) ∧
    actualA w y eta < ConeAlgebra.coneBound
      (OutgoingHistories.p1 XR w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) (y, eta))
      (OutgoingHistories.p2 XR w (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) (y, eta))

      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam0 → ∃ w : ResetWitness d K,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧
        (∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy d w.coefficients
          (CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0) ∧

      PulseCone.sourceConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (29 : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
      d.h ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ d.h ≤ Real.exp (-(d.core.holdStart + 3 / 5)) / 8 ∧
      resetSourceError d K ≤ d.core.lam / 4 ∧
      finiteConeConstant d.core.P d.core.m * d.core.lam ^ (10 : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.axialBackwardStress_bound
statement:
theorem axialBackwardStress_bound {C h t z r R Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1)
    (hR : Y ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t R z))) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s => SimilarityProfile.partialZ (TerminalStress.canonicalPressure
      (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f)) (t, (s, z))) (Ioi (r ^ 2 / 2)) ∧
    |axialBackwardStress C h f t z r| ≤ ((R ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / (2 * r)) *
      |logScaleDerivative h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z)| *
      TerminalStress.heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t r ^ 2 *
      (1 - f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z))))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.axialBackwardStress_divergence
statement:
theorem axialBackwardStress_divergence {C h t z r R Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1)
    (hR : Y ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t R z))) :
    deriv (axialBackwardStress C h f t z) r + axialBackwardStress C h f t z r / r =
      -SimilarityProfile.partialZ (TerminalStress.canonicalPressure
        (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f)) (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.axialPressureIntegral_bound
statement:
theorem axialPressureIntegral_bound (C : ℝ) {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    0 ≤ axialPressureIntegral C h f p ∧ axialPressureIntegral C h f p ≤
      TerminalStress.physicalHeat C (1 + h) p ^ 2 * (1 - f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h p)))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.axialPressureIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem axialPressureIntegral_eq (C : ℝ) {h : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hq : 0 < SimilarityProfile.q h p) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    axialPressureIntegral C h f p = C ^ 2 * p.2.1 ^ (-2 * amplitudeExponent h) *
      taperDerivativeIntegral h f (pressureCoordinates h p)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.canonicalPressure_contDiffAt
statement:
theorem canonicalPressure_contDiffAt (C : ℝ) {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (TerminalStress.canonicalPressure (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f)) p

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.canonicalPressure_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalPressure_eq (C : ℝ) {h : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hq : 0 < SimilarityProfile.q h p) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    TerminalStress.canonicalPressure (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f) p =
      -(C ^ 2 / 2) * p.2.1 ^ (-2 * amplitudeExponent h) *
        taperedPressureFactor h f (pressureCoordinates h p)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.canonicalPressure_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem canonicalPressure_hasDerivAt_z (C : ℝ) {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z => TerminalStress.canonicalPressure
      (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f) (p.1, (p.2.1, z)))
      (logScaleDerivative h p * axialPressureIntegral C h f p) p.2.2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.canonicalPressure_partialZ
statement:
theorem canonicalPressure_partialZ (C : ℝ) {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    SimilarityProfile.partialZ (TerminalStress.canonicalPressure
      (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f)) p =
      logScaleDerivative h p * axialPressureIntegral C h f p

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.canonicalPressure_partialZ_bound
statement:
theorem canonicalPressure_partialZ_bound (C : ℝ) {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2)
    (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    |SimilarityProfile.partialZ (TerminalStress.canonicalPressure
      (TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f)) p| ≤

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.canonicalPressure_partialZ_contDiffAt

theorem canonicalPressure_partialZ_contDiffAt (C : ℝ) {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.outgoingPressure_edge_bound
statement:
theorem outgoingPressure_edge_bound (C : ℝ) (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} {δ : ℝ} (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hδ : Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h p) = y0 + 3 - δ) :
    |SimilarityProfile.partialZ (outgoingPressure C d y0) p| ≤
      (2 / (1 - 2 * d.h)) * SimilarityProfile.q d.h p ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D d.h) *
        TerminalStress.physicalHeat C (1 + d.h) p ^ 2 *
          (d.rho * FlatCutoff.edge 4 δ * TerminalStress.taperFactor δ)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.outgoingPressure_partialZ
statement:
theorem outgoingPressure_partialZ (C : ℝ) (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    SimilarityProfile.partialZ (outgoingPressure C d y0) p =
      logScaleDerivative d.h p * ∫ s in Ioi p.2.1,
        TerminalStress.physicalHeat C (1 + d.h) (p.1, (s, p.2.2)) ^ 2 *
          OutgoingTail.tailShape d (Real.log (s / SimilarityProfile.q d.h p) - y0) *
          OutgoingTail.tailShapeDeriv d (Real.log (s / SimilarityProfile.q d.h p) - y0) / s

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.outgoingPressure_partialZ_bound
statement:
theorem outgoingPressure_partialZ_bound (C : ℝ) (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    |SimilarityProfile.partialZ (outgoingPressure C d y0) p| ≤
      (2 / (1 - 2 * d.h)) * SimilarityProfile.q d.h p ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D d.h) *
        TerminalStress.physicalHeat C (1 + d.h) p ^ 2 *
          (1 - OutgoingTail.tailShape d (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h p) - y0))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.outgoing_navierStokesResidual
statement:
theorem outgoing_navierStokesResidual (C : ℝ) (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {t : ℝ} {x : ProblemStatement.Space} (ht : t < 1)
    (hs : 0 < AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) :
    ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual
      (TerminalStress.terminalVelocity C d.h (outgoingTaper d y0))
      (TerminalStress.terminalPressure C d.h (outgoingTaper d y0)) t x =
      AxisymmetricResidual.pack
        (-x 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) *
          (TerminalStress.leadingResidual C d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t
            (Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x)) (x 2) -
          TerminalStress.axialViscosity C d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)))
        (x 0 / Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x) *
          (TerminalStress.leadingResidual C d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t
            (Real.sqrt (2 * AxisymmetricFields.radialEnergy x)) (x 2) -
          TerminalStress.axialViscosity C d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x)))
        (SimilarityProfile.partialZ (outgoingPressure C d y0) (AxisymmetricFields.profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.parameterPartial_hasDerivAt
NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.physicalEdit_eq_released_carrier
statement:
theorem physicalEdit_eq_released_carrier (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1)
    (hfull : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h p / K) + 1 / 5) :
    SimilarityProfile.q d.h p ^ (-amplitudeExponent d.h) *
      ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit d K (SimilarityProfile.eta d.h p) (SimilarityProfile.X d.h p) =
        TerminalStress.physicalHeat (releasedNormalization d K) (1 + d.h) p *
          outgoingTaper d (Real.log K - 1 / 5) (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h p))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.physicalHeat_pos
NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.physicalHeat_radial_le
statement:
theorem physicalHeat_radial_le {C h t z a s : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h)

statement:
theorem released_heat_bound (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)

    (hX : K ≤ SimilarityProfile.X d.h p) :
    SimilarityProfile.q d.h p ^ (1 - CoordinateAlgebra.D d.h) *
      TerminalStress.physicalHeat (releasedNormalization d K) (1 + d.h) p ≤

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.released_terminal_tilt
statement:
theorem released_terminal_tilt (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) {K y0 t z r R Λ : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hh4 : d.h ≤ 1 / 4) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (hΛ : 1 ≤ Λ) (hRΛ : R ^ 2 ≤ Λ * r ^ 2)
    (hX : K ≤ SimilarityProfile.X d.h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z))
    (hR : y0 + 3 ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t R z)))
    (hinside : Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z)) < y0 + 3) :
    0 < TerminalStress.terminalStress (releasedNormalization d K) d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t z r ∧
    |axialBackwardStress (releasedNormalization d K) d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t z r| /
      TerminalStress.terminalStress (releasedNormalization d K) d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t z r ≤
        16 * Λ * (Λ - 1) * OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (d.releaseStart, 0) * d.h ^ 4

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.released_terminal_tilt_small
statement:
theorem released_terminal_tilt_small (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) {K y0 t z r R Λ ε : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hh4 : d.h ≤ 1 / 4) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (hΛ : 1 ≤ Λ) (hRΛ : R ^ 2 ≤ Λ * r ^ 2)
    (hX : K ≤ SimilarityProfile.X d.h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z))
    (hR : y0 + 3 ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t R z)))
    (hinside : Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X d.h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z)) < y0 + 3)
    (hsmall : d.h ≤ ε / (1 + 16 * Λ * (Λ - 1) * OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (d.releaseStart, 0))) :
    |axialBackwardStress (releasedNormalization d K) d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t z r| /
      TerminalStress.terminalStress (releasedNormalization d K) d.h (outgoingTaper d y0) t z r ≤ ε

statement:
theorem swirlCoefficient_sq (C h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint}
    (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f p ^ 2 =
      (C ^ 2 / 2) * p.2.1 ^ (-2 * amplitudeExponent h - 1) *
        RadialHeatProfile.profile (1 + h) (2 * (1 - p.1) / p.2.1) ^ 2 *
        f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h p)) ^ 2

    (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s => TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f (p.1, (s, p.2.2)) ^ 2)
      (Ioi p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.swirlCoefficient_sq_scaled
statement:
theorem swirlCoefficient_sq_scaled (C : ℝ) {h : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hq : 0 < SimilarityProfile.q h p)
    (hs : 0 < p.2.1) {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) :
    TerminalStress.swirlCoefficient C h f (p.1, (p.2.1 * v, p.2.2)) ^ 2 =
      (C ^ 2 / 2 * p.2.1 ^ (-2 * amplitudeExponent h - 1)) *
        taperedDensity h f (pressureCoordinates h p) v

statement:
theorem taperDerivativeIntegral_bound {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1)
    (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y) (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1)
    (hν : 0 < p.1) :
    0 ≤ taperDerivativeIntegral h f p ∧
      taperDerivativeIntegral h f p ≤
        RadialHeatProfile.profile (1 + h) (2 * p.1) ^ 2 * (1 - f p.2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.taperedPressureFactor_eq
statement:
theorem taperedPressureFactor_eq {h B Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 ≤ p.1) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hy : Y ≤ p.2 + Real.log B) (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    taperedPressureFactor h f p = heatPressureFactor h p.1 - compactDeficit h f B p

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.taperedPressureFactor_hasDerivAt_y
statement:
theorem taperedPressureFactor_hasDerivAt_y {h Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) (hν : 0 < p.1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => taperedPressureFactor h f (p.1, y))
      (2 * taperDerivativeIntegral h f p) p.2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.terminalStress_ge_mass
statement:
theorem terminalStress_ge_mass {C h t z r R Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1)
    (hR : Y ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t R z))) :
    (r * TerminalStress.heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t R / (2 * TerminalStress.timeDenominator h t z)) *
      (1 - f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z)))) ≤
        TerminalStress.terminalStress C h f t z r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.terminal_forcing_integrable
statement:
theorem terminal_forcing_integrable (C : ℝ) {h t z r Y : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * TerminalStress.viscousResidual
      (TerminalStress.heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (TerminalStress.radialSlice (TerminalStress.flattening h f) t z) u) (Ioi r) ∧
    IntegrableOn (TerminalStress.correction (TerminalStress.heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t)
      (TerminalStress.radialSlice (TerminalStress.flattening h f) t z)) (Ioi r) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * TerminalStress.timeResidual C h f t z u) (Ioi r)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalPressure.terminal_tilt_bound
statement:
theorem terminal_tilt_bound {C h t z r R Y Λ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ht : t < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) (hmono : ∀ y, 0 ≤ deriv f y)
    (hplateau : ∀ y, Y ≤ y → f y = 1)
    (hR : Y ≤ Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t R z)))
    (hΛ : 1 ≤ Λ) (hRΛ : R ^ 2 ≤ Λ * r ^ 2)
    (hinside : f (Real.log (SimilarityProfile.X h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z))) < 1) :
    0 < TerminalStress.terminalStress C h f t z r ∧
    |axialBackwardStress C h f t z r| / TerminalStress.terminalStress C h f t z r ≤
      tiltConstant h Λ * SimilarityProfile.q h (TerminalStress.radiusPoint t r z) ^ (1 - CoordinateAlgebra.D h) *
        TerminalStress.heatAmplitude C (1 + h) t r

    {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {f : E × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ p ∈ K, ContinuousAt f (p, 0)) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < f (p, 0)) :

statement:
theorem physicalStress_jets (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) {S : Set EdgeParam}

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (physicalStress C d y0) (p, x)‖ ≤ A * FlatCutoff.edge 4 x / x ^ N

statement:

theorem pressureGradient_at_s (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam)

      (timeOf p, (s, p.2)) =
      FlatCutoff.edge 4 (logCoordinate (outerS d y0 p) s) *

      tailShape d (Real.log (s / chartQ d p) - y0) *
      tailShapeDeriv d (Real.log (s / chartQ d p) - y0) / s =
      scalarFlatDensity 4 3 (fun v => pressureCoefficient C d y0 (p, v)) (outerS d y0 p) s

statement:

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profileStressFactor_zero_ne

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profileStress_contDiff
statement:
theorem profileStress_contDiff (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profileStress_factorization
statement:
theorem profileStress_factorization (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (y : ℝ × ℝ) :
    profileStress C d y0 y =
      (FlatCutoff.edge 4 y.2 / y.2 ^ 3) • profileStressFactor C d y0 y

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profileStress_jets
statement:
theorem profileStress_jets (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ b →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (profileStress C d y0) (η, x)‖ ≤ A * FlatCutoff.edge 4 x / x ^ N

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profileStress_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem profileStress_of_nonpos (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ × ℝ} (hy : y.2 ≤ 0) : profileStress C d y0 y = 0

theorem profileTilt_eq_ratio (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 η : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profile_relative_cone
statement:
theorem profile_relative_cone {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < ε →
      0 < profileAngularStress C d y0 (η, x) ∧ 2 < profileSpeed C d y0 (η, x) ∧
      (profileSpeed C d y0 (η, x) - 2) * profileAxialStress C d y0 (η, x) ^ 2 <
        2 * profileAngularStress C d y0 (η, x) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profile_true_cone
statement:
theorem profile_true_cone {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < ε →
      2 < profileP C d y0 (η, x) ∧ profileSpeed C d y0 (η, x) <
        ConeAlgebra.coneBound (profileP C d y0 (η, x)) (profileJ C d y0 (η, x))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.profile_uniform_cone
statement:
theorem profile_uniform_cone {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε m : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < m ∧ ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| < ε →
      m ≤ profileAngularFactor C d y0 (η, x) ∧
      m ≤ profileSpeed C d y0 (η, x) - 2 ∧ m ≤ profileConeGap C d y0 (η, x)

statement:
theorem radialS_eq (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (y : EdgeParam × ℝ) :

statement:

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radialTaper_contDiffAt
statement:
theorem radialTaper_contDiffAt (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam) {r : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radialTaper_deriv
statement:
theorem radialTaper_deriv (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) :
    deriv (radialTaper d y0 p) r = (2 / r) *
      ((FlatCutoff.edge 4 (edgeCoordinate (outerRadius d y0 p) r) /
        edgeCoordinate (outerRadius d y0 p) r ^ 3) *
        taperSlopeFactor d (edgeCoordinate (outerRadius d y0 p) r))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radialTaper_plateau
statement:
theorem radialTaper_plateau (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radius_contDiff

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radius_edgeCoordinate

theorem radius_edgeCoordinate (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radius_normalizedParam
statement:
theorem radius_normalizedParam (d : TailData) (y0 x : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ^ 2 < 1) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.radius_pos

statement:
theorem radius_square (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (y : EdgeParam × ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.time_weight_eq_density
statement:
theorem time_weight_eq_density (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) :
    r ^ 2 * timeResidual C d.h (logTaper d y0) (timeOf p) p.2 r =
      radialFlatDensity 4 3 (fun v => timeCoefficient C d y0 (p, v)) (outerRadius d y0 p) r

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.time_weight_integrable
NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.time_weight_integral
statement:
theorem time_weight_integral (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (y : EdgeParam × ℝ) :
    (∫ u in Ioi (radius d y0 y),
      u ^ 2 * timeResidual C d.h (logTaper d y0) (timeOf y.1) y.1.2 u) =
        ParametricFlatFactor.primitive 4 3 (timeCoefficient C d y0) y

name: NavierStokes.TerminalEdgeFactor.viscous_weight_integrable
statement:
theorem viscous_weight_integrable (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) (p : EdgeParam)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u => u ^ 2 * viscousResidual
      (heatAmplitude C (1 + d.h) (timeOf p)) (radialTaper d y0 p) u) (Ioi r)

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.EdgeFactor.aligned_collar
statement:
theorem EdgeFactor.aligned_collar {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {c : ℝ}
    {T : E × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} (F : EdgeFactor K c T)
    (hfirst : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < (F.coefficient (p,0)).1)
    {O : Set (E × ℝ)} (hO : IsOpen O) (hK0 : K ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ) ⊆ O)
    {v s : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hv : ContinuousOn v O) (hs : ContinuousOn s O)
    (halign : ∀ p ∈ K, tilt (F.coefficient (p,0)) = s (p,0)) :
    ∃ d ε : ℝ, ∃ W : Set (E × ℝ), 0 < d ∧ d < F.width ∧ 0 < ε ∧ IsOpen W ∧
      K ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) d ⊆ W ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => direction (F.coefficient q)) W ∧
      (∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) d,
        ε ≤ directionProjection (s (p,x)) (tilt (F.coefficient (p,x))) ∧
        ε ≤ directionGap (v (p,x)) (s (p,x)) (tilt (F.coefficient (p,x)))) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
        direction (T (p,x)) = direction (F.coefficient (p,x)) ∧
        ε ≤ directionProjection (s (p,x)) (tilt (T (p,x))) ∧
        ε ≤ directionGap (v (p,x)) (s (p,x)) (tilt (T (p,x))))

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.EdgeFactor.collar
statement:
theorem EdgeFactor.collar {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {c : ℝ} {T : E × ℝ → V}
    (F : EdgeFactor K c T) :
    ∃ d m : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ d < F.width ∧ d ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < m ∧
      K ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) d ⊆ F.domain ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d → m * FlatCutoff.edge c x ≤ ‖T (p,x)‖

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.EdgeFactor.derivative_bound
statement:
theorem EdgeFactor.derivative_bound {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKd : UniqueDiffOn ℝ K) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {T : E × ℝ → V}
    (F : EdgeFactor K c T) (n : ℕ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdw : d < F.width)
    (hdom : K ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) d ⊆ F.domain)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ T (p,x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ K,
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i T (p,x)‖ ≤ C * FlatCutoff.edge c x / x^N

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.EdgeFactor.direction_collar
statement:
theorem EdgeFactor.direction_collar {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {c : ℝ}
    {T : E × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} (F : EdgeFactor K c T)
    (hfirst : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < (F.coefficient (p,0)).1) :
    ∃ d : ℝ, ∃ W : Set (E × ℝ), 0 < d ∧ d < F.width ∧ IsOpen W ∧
      K ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) d ⊆ W ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => direction (F.coefficient q)) W ∧
      (∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d →
        direction (T (p,x)) = direction (F.coefficient (p,x))) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ d → 0 < (T (p,x)).1)

statement:

NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.activationCoefficient_smooth

    {D : ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.actual_edge_join
statement:
theorem actual_edge_join {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    {T κ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ < 1)
    {Ct : ℝ} (hCt : 0 < Ct) (dt : TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {S : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} {O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S O)
    (hSO : Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc a b ⊆ O)
    (hinterior : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Ioo a b, S (η,y) ≠ 0)
    {wL wR : ℝ} (hwL : 0 < wL) (hwR : 0 < wR) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < wL →
      leftChart a S (η,x) = activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (x,η)) →
    (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < wR →
      rightChart b S (η,x) = profileStress Ct dt y0 (η,x)) →
    WeightedBounds (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (T^2) a b S

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.actual_shear_coordinates_smooth
statement:
theorem actual_shear_coordinates_smooth (T κ : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)

    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (actualP1 T κ L) (logDomain J hJ).carrier ∧

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.actual_shear_coordinates_zero
statement:
theorem actual_shear_coordinates_zero {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)

    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.actual_shear_domain
statement:
theorem actual_shear_domain {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)
    {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0) {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hKJ : K ⊆ J)
    {L U : Field} (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => shearSize T κ X0 L U (q.2,q.1)) O ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => shearSlope T κ X0 L U (q.2,q.1)) O

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.aligned_direction_collar
statement:
theorem aligned_direction_collar {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {O : Set (E × ℝ)} (hO : IsOpen O) (hK0 : K ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ) ⊆ O)
    {v s t : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hv : ContinuousOn v O) (hs : ContinuousOn s O)
    (ht : ContinuousOn t O) (halign : ∀ p ∈ K, t (p,0) = s (p,0)) :
    ∃ d ε : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ 0 < ε ∧ K ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) d ⊆ O ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) d,
        ε ≤ directionProjection (s (p,x)) (t (p,x)) ∧
        ε ≤ directionGap (v (p,x)) (s (p,x)) (t (p,x))

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.compact_nonzero_collar
statement:
theorem compact_nonzero_collar {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {B : E × ℝ → V}

    (hK0 : K ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ) ⊆ O) (hne : ∀ p ∈ K, B (p,0) ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.exists_natural_activation_factor
statement:
theorem exists_natural_activation_factor {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    {T κ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ < 1) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    Nonempty (EdgeFactor (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (T^2)
      (fun q => activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (q.2,q.1)))

name: NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.exists_natural_activation_factor_aligned
statement:
theorem exists_natural_activation_factor_aligned {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    {T κ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ < 1) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ∃ G : EdgeFactor (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (T^2)
        (fun q => activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (q.2,q.1)),
      (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 < (G.coefficient (η,0)).1) ∧
      ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, tilt (G.coefficient (η,0)) =
        referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (0,η) / referenceP1 L (0,η)

statement:

    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    {T κ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ < 1) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    let S := fun q : ℝ × ℝ => activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (q.2,q.1)
    ∃ G : EdgeFactor (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (T^2) S,
      HasStrictDirectionCollar (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) S G.coefficient
        (fun q => shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (q.2,q.1))
        (fun q => shearSlope T κ N.endpoint L U (q.2,q.1)) G.width
