name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.compact_amplitude_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_amplitude_bounds {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hSU : S ⊆ U) {a : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U)
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖deriv (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) η‖ ≤ D ∧
      |a η| ≤ D ∧ |deriv a η| ≤ D

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.composed_solver_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem composed_solver_deriv_bound {g : Coeff → Coeff} {ε C : ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 ε))
    (hbound : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε, ‖fderiv ℝ g v‖ ≤ C)
    {d : ℝ → Coeff} {η : ℝ} (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ d η)
    (hmem : d η ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε) :
    ‖deriv (g ∘ d) η‖ ≤ C * ‖deriv d η‖

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correctionCLM_apply
statement:
theorem correctionCLM_apply (P : Patch) (x : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    correctionCLM P x c = correction P c x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_contDiff
statement:
theorem correction_contDiff (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correction P c)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem correction_derivative_bound (P : Patch) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv k (correction P c) x| ≤ C * ‖c‖

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_family_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_first_jet_bound
statement:
theorem correction_first_jet_bound (P : Patch) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ),
      |correction P c x| ≤ D * ‖c‖ ∧ |deriv (correction P c) x| ≤ D * ‖c‖

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem correction_hasCompactSupport (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :
    HasCompactSupport (correction P c)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem correction_iteratedDeriv (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (correction P c) x = ∑ j, c j * iteratedDeriv k (bump P j) x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_moment
statement:
theorem correction_moment (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ x, x ^ s * correction P c x) = ∑ j, c j * bumpMoment P s j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_parameter_deriv
NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_square
statement:
theorem correction_square (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    (correction P c x) ^ 2 = ∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * (bump P j x) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_square_moment
statement:
theorem correction_square_moment (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ x, x ^ s * (correction P c x) ^ 2) = ∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * squareMoment P s j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_support
statement:
theorem correction_support (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :
    support (correction P c) ⊆ Icc P.left P.right

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_tsupport
statement:
theorem correction_tsupport (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :
    tsupport (correction P c) ⊆ Ioo P.left P.right

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.energy_density_rescale
statement:
theorem energy_density_rescale (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    (physicalProfile P lam R a c (R * x)) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a (R * x)) ^ 2 =
      (2 * a ^ 2) * weightedChange P lam c 0 x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_heat_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_heat_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν q : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hq : 0 < q)
    {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        ∀ η ∈ S,
          physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + heatDebt T ν K η = 0 ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
          FirstJetBound P a c η (C / K) ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_normalized_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    ∃ (g : Coeff → Coeff) (ε C : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 ε) ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε,
        momentMap P lam (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ g d‖ ≤ C ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ,
          (|correction P (g d) x| ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
            |deriv (correction P (g d)) x| ≤ C * ‖d‖) ∧
          (0 < x → 0 < baseProfile lam x + correction P (g d) x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_uniform_parameter_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_parameter_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ v : Coeff, ‖v‖ < ε →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        ∀ η ∈ S, momentMap P lam (c η) = amplitudeDebt (a η) v ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ ∧
          FirstJetBound P a c η (C * ‖v‖) ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < a η * (baseProfile lam x + correction P (c η) x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.heatDebt_independent
statement:
theorem heatDebt_independent (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν : ℝ) {K : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (η : ℝ) : heatDebt T ν K η = heatDebt T ν K 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.integral_rescale
statement:
theorem integral_rescale (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (F : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ X, F X) = R * ∫ x, F (R * x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.intervals_separated
statement:
theorem intervals_separated (P : Patch) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i < j) :
    upper P i ≤ lower P j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_apply (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv P lam hlam c = (linearMatrix P lam).mulVec c

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.linearMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det_ne_zero (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    (linearMatrix P lam).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.linearMatrix_entry
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_entry (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    linearMatrix P lam i j = bumpMoment P (powers lam i) j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.lower_gt_left
statement: theorem lower_gt_left (P : Patch) (j : Fin 3) : P.left < lower P j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.lower_lt_upper
statement: theorem lower_lt_upper (P : Patch) (j : Fin 3) : lower P j < upper P j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.mixed_moment_unchanged
statement:
theorem mixed_moment_unchanged (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (U : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ X, X / R ∈ Ioo P.left P.right → U X = 0) :
    (∫ X, U X * physicalProfile P lam R a c X) = ∫ X, U X * cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.momentMap_identity
statement:
theorem momentMap_identity (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv P lam hlam c + quadraticCLM P c c = momentMap P lam c

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.normalizedDebt_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedDebt_eq (R a : ℝ) (d : Coeff) :
    normalizedDebt R a d = amplitudeDebt a (scaledDebt R d)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.patch_heat_disjoint
statement:
theorem patch_heat_disjoint (P : Patch) (lam q K a h ν : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hK : 0 < K) (hpatch : q * P.right ≤ 1)
    (c : Coeff) (E : ℝ → ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    (physicalProfile P lam (q * K) a c X - cleanProfile lam (q * K) a X) *
      HeatTailEdit.change E h ν K X = 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalDifference_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem physicalDifference_hasCompactSupport (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun X => physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_cancel
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_cancel (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (ha : 0 < a)
    (c d : Coeff) (heq : momentMap P lam c = normalizedDebt R a d) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c + d = 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_eq
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_eq (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c =
      ![2 * a ^ 2 * momentMap P lam c 0,
        2 * R * a ^ 2 * momentMap P lam c 1,
        R * Real.sqrt (2 * R) * a * momentMap P lam c 2]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_integrable
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_integrable (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun X => ((physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 -
      (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) / X) ∧
    Integrable (fun X => (physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 -
      (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) ∧
    Integrable (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
      (physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_positive_radius
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_positive_radius (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c =
      ![∫ X in Ioi 0, ((physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) / X,
        ∫ X in Ioi 0, (physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2,
        ∫ X in Ioi 0, Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
          (physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X)]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_eq_clean_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_clean_of_nonpos (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ≤ 0) :
    physicalProfile P lam R a c X = cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_eq_clean_outside
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_clean_outside (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (X : ℝ)
    (hX : X / R ∉ Ioo P.left P.right) :
    physicalProfile P lam R a c X = cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_family_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_family_contDiffOn (P : Patch) (lam R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {U : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => physicalProfile P lam R (a z.1) (c z.1) z.2) (U ×ˢ Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.powers_injective
statement: theorem powers_injective (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) : Injective (powers lam)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.pressure_density_rescale
statement:
theorem pressure_density_rescale (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    ((physicalProfile P lam R a c (R * x)) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a (R * x)) ^ 2) /
        (R * x) = (2 * a ^ 2 / R) * weightedChange P lam c (-1) x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.quadraticCLM_apply
statement:
theorem quadraticCLM_apply (P : Patch) (c d : Coeff) :
    quadraticCLM P c d =
      ![(1 / 2) * ∑ j, squareMoment P (-1) j * c j * d j,
        (1 / 2) * ∑ j, squareMoment P 0 j * c j * d j, 0]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.scaled_heatDebt_bound
statement:
theorem scaled_heatDebt_bound (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν q : ℝ)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K →
      ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (heatDebt T ν K 0)‖ ≤ C / K

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.square_change_add_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem square_change_add_of_disjoint (b p t : ℝ) (hpt : p * t = 0) :
    (b + p + t) ^ 2 - b ^ 2 = ((b + p) ^ 2 - b ^ 2) + ((b + t) ^ 2 - b ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.upper_lt_right
statement: theorem upper_lt_right (P : Patch) (j : Fin 3) : upper P j < P.right

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_identity
statement:
theorem weightedChange_identity (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w x : ℝ) :
    weightedChange P lam c w x =
      x ^ (w + slope lam) * correction P c x + x ^ w * (correction P c x) ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_integrable
statement:
theorem weightedChange_integrable (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w : ℝ) :
    Integrable (weightedChange P lam c w)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_integral
statement:
theorem weightedChange_integral (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, weightedChange P lam c w x) =
      (∑ j, c j * bumpMoment P (w + slope lam) j) +
        (∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * squareMoment P w j) / 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_bump_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_bump_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * bump P j x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_bump_sq_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_bump_sq_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * (bump P j x) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_correction_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_correction_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * correction P c x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_correction_sq_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_correction_sq_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * (correction P c x) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Continuous g) (hs : support g ⊆ Icc P.left P.right) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * g x)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_at_switch
statement:
theorem E_at_switch (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    E F XR (switchRadius F XR, eta) = carrierAmplitude F * (1 - F.data.rho)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_contDiffOn
statement: theorem E_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (E F XR) domain

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_eq_clean_switch_profile
statement:
theorem E_eq_clean_switch_profile (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hX : switchRadius F XR ≤ X) :
    E F XR (X, eta) = HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta X

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_family_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem E_family_contDiffOn (F : Profile) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => E F z.1 z.2) familyDomain

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_on_patch
statement:
theorem E_on_patch (F : Profile) (XR eta x : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc compensationPatch.left compensationPatch.right) :
    E F XR (patchRadius F XR * x, eta) =
      shapedPatchAmplitude F eta * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + F.data.core.lam))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_tail_factorization
statement:
theorem E_tail_factorization (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hX : switchRadius F XR ≤ X) :
    E F XR (X, eta) = HeatTailEdit.powerTail F.data.h (carrierAmplitude F)
      (switchRadius F XR) (HeatTailEdit.outgoingShape F.data) X

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.H_contDiffOn
statement: theorem H_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (H F XR) domain

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.H_family_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem H_family_contDiffOn (F : Profile) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => H F z.1 z.2) familyDomain

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.H_scaling
statement:
theorem H_scaling (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    H F XR p = Real.sqrt XR * F.H (p.1 / XR, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.I_integrable
statement:
theorem I_integrable (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u => H F XR (u, eta)) (Ioc 0 X)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.I_scaling
statement:
theorem I_scaling (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    I F XR eta X = (XR * Real.sqrt XR) * ∫ u in Ioc 0 (X / XR), F.H (u, eta)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.J_scaling
statement:
theorem J_scaling (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    J F XR eta X = (XR * Real.sqrt XR) * F.J eta (X / XR)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.M_scaling
statement:
theorem M_scaling (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    M F XR eta X = XR * F.M eta (X / XR)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.Pi_canonical
statement:
theorem Pi_canonical (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    Pi F XR (X, eta) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ u in Ioi X, E F XR (u, eta) ^ 2 / u

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.Pi_contDiffOn
statement: theorem Pi_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Pi F XR) domain

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.Pi_family_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem Pi_family_contDiffOn (F : Profile) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Pi F z.1 z.2) familyDomain

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.Pi_tendsto_axis
statement:
theorem Pi_tendsto_axis (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    Tendsto (fun X => Pi F XR (X, eta)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (axisDatum F XR eta))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.S_scaling
statement:
theorem S_scaling (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    S F XR eta X = XR * ∫ u in Ioc 0 (X / XR), F.energyDensity eta u

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.U_contDiffOn

statement:
theorem U_family_contDiffOn (F : Profile) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => U F z.1 z.2) familyDomain

NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_bounds
statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_variable_bounds {S : Set ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    {a : ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff} (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S)
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : ∀ η ∈ S, ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η‖ ≤ D)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ S) :
    ‖amplitudeDebt (a η) (v η)‖ ≤ D * ‖v η‖ ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeDebt (a θ) (v θ)) S η‖ ≤
        D * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_derivWithin
statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_variable_derivWithin {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff}
    {η : ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (ha : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η)
    (hv : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ v S η) :
    derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeDebt (a θ) (v θ)) S η =
      -(derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η * v η +
        amplitudeFactors (a η) * derivWithin v S η)

theorem compact_amplitude_within_bounds {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S)

    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η‖ ≤ D ∧
      |a η| ≤ D ∧ |derivWithin a S η| ≤ D

    (hd : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ d S η) (hmem : d η ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε) :
    ‖derivWithin (g ∘ d) S η‖ ≤ C * ‖derivWithin d S η‖

NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_compensation_for_scaled_family
statement:
theorem exists_compensation_for_scaled_family (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η)
    (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + d K η = 0 ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C / K) ∧
        ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_compensation_for_switch_family

theorem exists_compensation_for_switch_family (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η)
    (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt K (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt K (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + d K η = 0 ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C / K) ∧
        ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_physical_heat_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_physical_heat_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + physicalDebt T K η = 0 ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
          FirstJetWithinBound P a c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η (C / K) ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_variable_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_variable_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → Coeff,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S → (∀ η ∈ S, ‖v η‖ < ε) →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        momentMap P lam (c η) = amplitudeDebt (a η) (v η) ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v η‖ ∧
        ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖) ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖)) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < a η * (baseProfile lam x + correction P (c η) x)

    ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ L ∧ FirstJetBound P a c η L

        HeatTailEdit.energyDebt (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile T K η) T.h (1 - η ^ 2) K,
        HeatTailEdit.angularDebt (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile T K η) T.h (1 - η ^ 2) K]

      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (physicalDebt T K θ)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η‖ ≤ B / K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_family_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem scaled_family_ratio_bounds (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    {S : Set ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S) (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt K (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt K (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ Bq : ℝ, 0 < Bq ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)) S ∧
      ∀ η ∈ S, ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)‖ ≤ Bq / K ∧
        ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ Bq / K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_triple_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_triple_derivWithin
statement:
theorem scaled_triple_derivWithin {S : Set ℝ} (K : ℝ) {p e i : ℝ → ℝ} {η : ℝ}
    (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (hp : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ p S η) (he : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ e S η)
    (hi : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ i S η) :
    derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K ![p θ, e θ, i θ]) S η =
      scaledDebt K ![derivWithin p S η, derivWithin e S η, derivWithin i S η]

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_triple_first_jet_bound
statement:
theorem scaled_triple_first_jet_bound {S : Set ℝ} {K B : ℝ} {p e i : ℝ → ℝ} {η : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (hp : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ p S η) (he : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ e S η)
    (hi : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ i S η)
    (hpb : |p η| ≤ B / K ∧ |derivWithin p S η| ≤ B / K)
    (heb : |e η| ≤ B ∧ |derivWithin e S η| ≤ B)
    (hib : |i η| ≤ B * Real.sqrt K ∧ |derivWithin i S η| ≤ B * Real.sqrt K) :
    ‖scaledDebt K ![p η, e η, i η]‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K ![p θ, e θ, i θ]) S η‖ ≤ B / K

theorem heatE_pos (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hX : 0 < X) (heta : eta ∈ parameterDomain) :
    0 < heatE F XR (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_times_U
statement:
theorem heatE_times_U (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    heatE F XR (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta) = OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatRow_integrable
statement:
theorem heatRow_integrable (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (heta : eta ∈ parameterDomain) : IntegrableOn (heatRow F XR eta i) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatRow_integral
statement:
theorem heatRow_integral (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, heatRow F XR eta i X) =
      ParametricTerminalCompensation.physicalDebt F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta i

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatRow_zero_before
statement:
theorem heatRow_zero_before (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) (hXK : X ≤ switchRadius F XR) : heatRow F XR eta i X = 0

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heat_differences
statement:
theorem heat_differences (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    heatE F XR (X, eta) - OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) =
      HeatTailEdit.change (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta)
        F.data.h (ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) (switchRadius F XR) X ∧
    heatE F XR (X, eta) ^ 2 - OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) ^ 2 =
      HeatTailEdit.squareChange (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta)
        F.data.h (ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) (switchRadius F XR) X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.integrable_positive_tail
statement:
theorem integrable_positive_tail (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hz : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ K → f X = 0) (hi : IntegrableOn f (Ioi K)) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.integral_positive_tail
statement:
theorem integral_positive_tail (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hz : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ K → f X = 0) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, f X) = ∫ X in Ioi K, f X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.kernel_decomposition
statement:
theorem kernel_decomposition (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :
    canonicalKernel F XR c eta X = OutgoingDilation.canonicalKernel F XR eta X + changeRow F XR c eta 0 X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameter_sq_le_one
statement: theorem parameter_sq_le_one {eta : ℝ} (heta : eta ∈ parameterDomain) : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchIncrement_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchIncrement_eq_difference
statement:
theorem patchIncrement_eq_difference (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :
    patchIncrement F XR c (X, eta) =
      TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
        (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) (c eta) X -
      TerminalCompensation.cleanProfile F.data.core.lam (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchRow_integrable
statement:
theorem patchRow_integrable (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchRow_integral
statement:
theorem patchRow_integral (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, patchRow F XR c eta i X) =
      TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
        (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) (c eta) i

statement:
theorem patch_square_difference (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    E F XR c (X, eta) ^ 2 - heatE F XR (X, eta) ^ 2 = patchRow F XR c eta 1 X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.positive_tail_indicator

    (Ioi (0 : ℝ)).indicator f = (Ioi K).indicator f

statement:
theorem renormalized_decomposition (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :

      (OutgoingDilation.H F XR (X, eta) - OutgoingDilation.powerH F XR X) + changeRow F XR c eta 2 X

statement:
theorem canonical_margins (F : Profile)

      rightClock F s ≤ F.data.core.pulseStart - 3

statement:

    (hhi : OutgoingDilation.clock XR X ≤ F.data.core.pulseStart) :
    OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) =
      xAmplitude F XR eta * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + F.data.core.lam))

    OutgoingDilation.U F XR (X, eta) = 0 ∧

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.square_half_power
statement:
theorem square_half_power (lam R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (R ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * R ^ (-1 - 2 * lam)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supportLeft_formula
statement:
theorem supportLeft_formula (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) {s : Slot} (hs : s ≠ .heat) :
    supportLeft F XR s = OutgoingDilation.radius XR (leftClock F s + 1)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supportLeft_pos
statement:
theorem supportLeft_pos (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot) :
    0 < supportLeft F XR s

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supportRight_formula
statement:
theorem supportRight_formula (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) {s : Slot} (hs : s ≠ .heat) :
    supportRight F XR s = OutgoingDilation.radius XR (rightClock F s - 1)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.support_margins
statement:
theorem support_margins (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot) :
    left F XR s < supportLeft F XR s ∧
      supportLeft F XR s < supportRight F XR s ∧
      supportRight F XR s < right F XR s

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supported_update_eqOn
statement:
theorem supported_update_eqOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    {s t : Slot} (hst : s ≠ t) {v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hv : Supported F XR s v)
    (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) :
    EqOn (fun p => g p + v p) g (window F XR t ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supported_update_germ
statement:
theorem supported_update_germ (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    {s t : Slot} (hst : s ≠ t) {v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hv : Supported F XR s v)
    (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ∈ window F XR t) :
    (fun q => g q + v q) =ᶠ[𝓝 p] g

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supported_update_jets
statement:
theorem supported_update_jets (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    {s t : Slot} (hst : s ≠ t) {v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hv : Supported F XR s v)
    (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ∈ window F XR t) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => g q + v q) p = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g p

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supported_updates_preserve_fields
statement:
theorem supported_updates_preserve_fields (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (c : ℝ → HeatedOutgoing.Coeff) {s t : Slot} (hst : s ≠ t) (ht : t ≠ .heat)
    {vU vE : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hu : Supported F XR s vU) (he : Supported F XR s vE)
    (eta : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ window F XR t) :
    HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta) + vU (X, eta) = 0 ∧
      HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (X, eta) + vE (X, eta) =
        xAmplitude F XR eta * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + F.data.core.lam))

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.supported_vanishes
statement:
theorem supported_vanishes (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    {s t : Slot} (hst : s ≠ t) {v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hv : Supported F XR s v)
    (eta : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ window F XR t) : v (X, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.terminal_correction_inner_support
statement:
theorem terminal_correction_inner_support (P : TerminalCompensation.Patch)
    (c : TerminalCompensation.Coeff) :
    support (TerminalCompensation.correction P c) ⊆
      Icc (TerminalCompensation.lower P 0) (TerminalCompensation.upper P 2)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.terminal_lower_min
statement:
theorem terminal_lower_min (P : TerminalCompensation.Patch) (j : Fin 3) :
    TerminalCompensation.lower P 0 ≤ TerminalCompensation.lower P j

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.terminal_upper_max
statement:
theorem terminal_upper_max (P : TerminalCompensation.Patch) (j : Fin 3) :
    TerminalCompensation.upper P j ≤ TerminalCompensation.upper P 2

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.window_inside_wait
statement:
theorem window_inside_wait (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (s : Slot) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ window F XR s) :
    F.data.core.holdStart < OutgoingDilation.clock XR X ∧
      OutgoingDilation.clock XR X < F.data.core.pulseStart

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.window_nonempty
statement:
theorem window_nonempty (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot) :
    (window F XR s).Nonempty

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.windows_disjoint
statement:
theorem windows_disjoint (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    {s t : Slot} (hst : s ≠ t) : Disjoint (window F XR s) (window F XR t)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.witness_fields
statement:
theorem witness_fields {F : Profile} {XR C : ℝ}
    (w : HeatedOutgoing.CompensationWitness F XR C) {s : Slot} (hs : s ≠ .heat)
    (eta : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ window F XR s) :
    HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta) = 0 ∧
      HeatedOutgoing.E F XR w.coefficients (X, eta) =
        xAmplitude F XR eta * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + F.data.core.lam))

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.xAmplitude_contDiff

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.xAmplitude_pos

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.xAmplitude_shape
statement:
theorem xAmplitude_shape (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) :
    xAmplitude F XR eta = xAmplitude F XR 0 / (1 + eta ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.actualChartAxial_eq_desired
statement:
theorem actualChartAxial_eq_desired {coord A B lam a b power lo hi M qlo qhi : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hB : B ≠ 0) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (v : PressureStream.Plane) (d : PressureStream.Plane → Debt) {p : ChartPoint}
    (hq : chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (actualChartPotential coord A B lam a b power lo hi M v d) p) :
    actualChartAxial coord A B lam a b power lo hi M v d p = slowChartDesired coord A B lam a b d (p.1, p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.actualChartPotential_eq_chartPotential
statement:
theorem actualChartPotential_eq_chartPotential {coord A B lam a b power lo hi M qlo qhi : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hB : B ≠ 0) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (v : PressureStream.Plane) (d : PressureStream.Plane → Debt) {p : ChartPoint}
    (hq : chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi) :
    actualChartPotential coord A B lam a b power lo hi M v d p =
      chartPotential coord A B lam a b (fun z => d z.2.1) p

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.actual_rank_stream_identities
statement:
theorem actual_rank_stream_identities (s : WeightedClasses.StripData ChartPoint)
    {coord A B lam a b power lo hi qlo qhi α : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < coord) (hc1 : coord < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartInput p ∈ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.positiveTime)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hR : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p.1 ∈ Icc lo hi)
    (hz : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p ∈ supportBand a b qlo qhi → δ ≤ s.zeta p)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane) (w : PressureStream.Plane × PressureStream.Plane)
    {d : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane → Debt}
    (hd : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s α (fun n p => d n p.2.1)) :
    ∀ n p, p ∈ s.domain →
      actualChartAxial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) (d n) p =
        slowChartDesired coord A B lam a b (d n) (p.1, p.2.1) ∧
      PressureStream.graphDivergence (PressureStream.physicalSpeed power (M n)) ((0 : PressureStream.Plane), v n) w
        (actualChartRadial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) w (d n))
        (actualChartAxial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) (d n)) p = 0

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.actual_rank_stream_meanClass
statement:
theorem actual_rank_stream_meanClass (s : WeightedClasses.StripData ChartPoint)
    {coord A B lam a b power lo hi qlo qhi α : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < coord) (hc1 : coord < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartInput p ∈ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.positiveTime)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hR : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p.1 ∈ Icc lo hi)
    (hz : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p ∈ supportBand a b qlo qhi → δ ≤ s.zeta p)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane) (w : PressureStream.Plane × PressureStream.Plane)
    {d : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane → Debt}
    (hd : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s α (fun n p => d n p.2.1)) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => actualChartPotential coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) (d n)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => actualChartRadial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) w (d n))

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.actual_rank_velocity_meanClass
statement:
theorem actual_rank_velocity_meanClass (s : WeightedClasses.StripData ChartPoint)
    {coord A B lam a b power lo hi qlo qhi α : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < coord) (hc1 : coord < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartInput p ∈ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.positiveTime)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hR : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p.1 ∈ Icc lo hi)
    (hz : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p ∈ supportBand a b qlo qhi → δ ≤ s.zeta p)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane) (w : PressureStream.Plane × PressureStream.Plane)
    {d : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane → Debt}
    (hd : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s α (fun n p => d n p.2.1)) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => chartAngular coord A B lam a b (fun p => d n p.2.1)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => actualChartAxial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) (d n)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => actualChartRadial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) w (d n))

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.angularIncrement_eq_sum
statement:
theorem angularIncrement_eq_sum (lam C a b ell U : ℝ) (d : Debt) (r : ℝ) :

      ∑ i : Fin 3, d i * angularIncrement lam C a b ell U (Pi.single i 1) r

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.angularIncrement_q_over_Q
statement:
theorem angularIncrement_q_over_Q {q Q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (A lam C a b : ℝ) (d : Debt) (R : ℝ) :
    angularIncrement lam C a b (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A))
      (scaleDebt (Real.sqrt Q) (Q ^ (-A)) d) (Real.sqrt Q * R) / Q ^ (-A) =
      angularIncrement lam C a b (Real.sqrt (q / Q)) ((q / Q) ^ (-A)) d R

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.angularIncrement_rescale

    angularIncrement lam C a b ell U (scaleDebt L W d) (L * r) / W =
      angularIncrement lam C a b (ell / L) (U / W) d r

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.background_eq_shaped_profile
statement:
theorem background_eq_shaped_profile {q r : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (lam U B η : ℝ) :
    background lam (shapedAmplitude B η * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + lam)) (Real.sqrt q) U r =
      U * shapedAmplitude B η * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.chartAngular_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chartAngular_eq_sum (coord A B lam a b : ℝ) (d : ChartPoint → Debt) (p : ChartPoint) :

theorem rank_kernels_meanClass (s : WeightedClasses.StripData ChartPoint)
    {coord A B lam a b qlo qhi rlo rhi : ℝ} (hc : 0 < coord) (hc1 : coord < 1)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hB : B ≠ 0) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartInput p ∈ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.positiveTime)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hR : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p.1 ∈ Icc rlo rhi)
    (hz : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p ∈ supportBand a b qlo qhi → δ ≤ s.zeta p)
    (d : Debt) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass s 0 (fun _ => chartKernel coord (angularModel coord A B lam a b d)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass s 0 (fun _ => chartKernel coord (axialModel coord A B lam a b d))

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.rank_stream_meanClass
statement:
theorem rank_stream_meanClass (s : WeightedClasses.StripData ChartPoint)
    {coord A B lam a b qlo qhi rlo rhi α : ℝ} (hc : 0 < coord) (hc1 : coord < 1)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hB : B ≠ 0) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartInput p ∈ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.positiveTime)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hR : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p.1 ∈ Icc rlo rhi)
    (hz : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p ∈ supportBand a b qlo qhi → δ ≤ s.zeta p)
    (w : PressureStream.Plane × PressureStream.Plane)
    {d : ℕ → ChartPoint → Debt} (hd : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s α d) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => chartPotential coord A B lam a b (d n)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass s α (fun n => chartStreamRadial coord A B lam a b w (d n))

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.reserved_five_rows
statement:
theorem reserved_five_rows (F : OutgoingProfile.Profile) {XR q : ℝ}
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hq : 0 < q) (c : ℝ → HeatedOutgoing.Coeff) (A η : ℝ) (d : Debt) :
    FiveRowRank.FiveRows (reservedAngularBase F XR c q (q ^ (-A)) η)
      (reservedAxialBase F XR q (q ^ (-A)) η) d
      (angularIncrement F.data.core.lam (shapedAmplitude (ReservedPatches.radialAmplitude F XR 0) η)
        (ReservedPatches.radialSupportLeft F XR .mean) (ReservedPatches.radialSupportRight F XR .mean)
        (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A)) d)
      (desiredAxialIncrement F.data.core.lam (shapedAmplitude (ReservedPatches.radialAmplitude F XR 0) η)
        (ReservedPatches.radialSupportLeft F XR .mean) (ReservedPatches.radialSupportRight F XR .mean)
        (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A)) d)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaledPrimitive_eq_integral
statement:
theorem scaledPrimitive_eq_integral (f : ℝ → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaledPrimitive_sum
statement:

    scaledPrimitive (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, d i * f i x) r =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, d i * scaledPrimitive (f i) r

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaledPrimitive_zero_below
statement:
theorem scaledPrimitive_zero_below {l r : ℝ} (hl : 0 ≤ l) {f : ℝ → ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaledPrimitive_zero_of_support
statement:
theorem scaledPrimitive_zero_of_support {l u r : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (_ : l < u)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : tsupport f ⊆ Ioo l u) (hm : (∫ s, s * f s) = 0)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_angular_mass
statement:
theorem scaled_angular_mass {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, r ^ (2 : ℕ) * scaleField ell U f r) =
      ell ^ 3 * U * ∫ x, x ^ (2 : ℕ) * f x

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_angular_row
statement:
theorem scaled_angular_row {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (V G f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, r ^ (2 : ℕ) *
      (scaleField ell U G r * scaleField ell U f r + scaleField ell U V r * scaleField ell U g r)) =
        ell ^ 3 * U ^ 2 * ∫ x, x ^ (2 : ℕ) * (G x * f x + V x * g x)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_axial_mass
statement:
theorem scaled_axial_mass {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, r * scaleField ell U f r) = ell ^ 2 * U * ∫ x, x * f x

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_axial_row
statement:
theorem scaled_axial_row {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (V G f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, 2 * r * scaleField ell U G r * scaleField ell U g r -
      r * scaleField ell U V r * scaleField ell U f r) =
        ell ^ 2 * U ^ 2 * ∫ x, 2 * x * G x * g x - x * V x * f x

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_pressure_row
statement:
theorem scaled_pressure_row {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (V f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, (2 * scaleField ell U V r / r) * scaleField ell U f r) =
      U ^ 2 * ∫ x, (2 * V x / x) * f x

statement:
theorem slow_physicalAlias_zero {a b d M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_physicalTotal
statement:
theorem slow_physicalTotal {a b d M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : PressureStream.Plane) {f : ℝ × E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (p : PressureStream.Lift E) (hp : a ≤ p.1) :
    PressureStream.physicalTotal d a M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) p =
      ∫ r, f (r, p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamBeta_eq_slow_direction
statement:
theorem slow_streamBeta_eq_slow_direction (lo hi power M : ℝ) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (w : E) (wfast : PressureStream.Plane) (p : PressureStream.Lift E)
    (hΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)) p) :
    PressureStream.streamBeta (w, wfast)
      (PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)) p =
      PressureStream.streamBeta (w, 0)
        (PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)) p

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamGamma_eq_desired
statement:
theorem slow_streamGamma_eq_desired {a b d M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : PressureStream.Plane) {f : ℝ × E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (hm : ∀ s, (∫ r, r * f (r, s)) = 0)
    (p : PressureStream.Lift E) :
    PressureStream.streamGamma (PressureStream.physicalSpeed d M) ((0 : E), v)
      (PressureStream.streamPotential d a b M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)) p = slowLift f p

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamGamma_eq_desired_slice
statement:
theorem slow_streamGamma_eq_desired_slice {lo hi power M : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hp : 0 < power) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (p : PressureStream.Lift E)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun r => f (r, p.2.1)))
    (hs : support (fun r => f (r, p.2.1)) ⊆ Icc lo hi)
    (hm : (∫ r, r * f (r, p.2.1)) = 0)
    (hΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)) p) :
    PressureStream.streamGamma (PressureStream.physicalSpeed power M) ((0 : E), v)
      (PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)) p = f (p.1, p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamPotential_congr_slice
statement:
theorem slow_streamPotential_congr_slice (lo hi power M : ℝ) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    {f g : ℝ × E → ℝ} (p : PressureStream.Lift E) (he : ∀ r, f (r, p.2.1) = g (r, p.2.1)) :
    PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) p =
      PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift g) p

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamPotential_eq_primitive
statement:
theorem slow_streamPotential_eq_primitive {lo hi power M : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hp : 0 < power) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    {f : ℝ × E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported lo hi f)
    (hm : ∀ s, (∫ r, r * f (r, s)) = 0) (p : PressureStream.Lift E) (hr : lo ≤ p.1) :
    PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) p =
      (∫ r in lo..p.1, r * f (r, p.2.1)) / p.1

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamPotential_eq_scaledPrimitive
statement:
theorem slow_streamPotential_eq_scaledPrimitive {lo hi power M : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hp : 0 < power) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    {f : ℝ × E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported lo hi f)
    (hm : ∀ s, (∫ r, r * f (r, s)) = 0) (p : PressureStream.Lift E) :
    PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) p =
      scaledPrimitive (fun r => f (r, p.2.1)) p.1

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamPotential_eq_scaledPrimitive_slice
statement:
theorem slow_streamPotential_eq_scaledPrimitive_slice {lo hi power M : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hp : 0 < power) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (p : PressureStream.Lift E)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun r => f (r, p.2.1)))

    (hm : (∫ r, r * f (r, p.2.1)) = 0) :
    PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) p =
      scaledPrimitive (fun r => f (r, p.2.1)) p.1

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_streamPotential_phase_independent
statement:
theorem slow_streamPotential_phase_independent (lo hi power M : ℝ) (v : PressureStream.Plane)
    (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (s : E) (Y Y' : PressureStream.Plane) :
    PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) (r, s, Y) =
      PressureStream.streamPotential power lo hi M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f) (r, s, Y')

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.slow_stream_divergence_zero
statement:
theorem slow_stream_divergence_zero {a b d M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : PressureStream.Plane) (w : E × PressureStream.Plane) {f : ℝ × E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (p : PressureStream.Lift E) :
    PressureStream.graphDivergence (PressureStream.physicalSpeed d M) ((0 : E), v) w
      (PressureStream.streamBeta w
        (PressureStream.streamPotential d a b M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)))
      (PressureStream.streamGamma (PressureStream.physicalSpeed d M) ((0 : E), v)
        (PressureStream.streamPotential d a b M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f))) p = 0

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.applyMultiplier_finiteJets
statement:
theorem applyMultiplier_finiteJets (n l : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (m : Frequency → ℂ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ k, ‖m k‖ ≤ B * weight k ^ l) →
      ∀ (f : Source P) (S : Set P) (C : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → Periodic f → 0 ≤ C →
        JetBound f S (n + l + 4) C → JetBound (applyMultiplier m f) S n (K * B * C)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.coefficient_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem coefficient_fderiv_apply {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (k : Frequency) (p v : P) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => coefficient f q k) p v =
      coefficient (parameterPartial v f) p k

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.coefficient_moment_bound
statement:
theorem coefficient_moment_bound {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f)
    {S : Set P} (l : ℕ) {C : ℝ} (h : JetBound f S (l + 4) C)
    (p : P) (hps : p ∈ S) :
    coeffSeminorm l (coefficient f p) ≤
      (3 ^ (l + 4) * C) * ∑' k : Frequency, (weight k ^ 4)⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.exists_uniform_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_coefficient_bound {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hp : Periodic f) (n : ℕ) {K : Set P} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ k,
      weight k ^ n * ‖coefficient f p k‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.fderiv_applyMultiplier
statement:
theorem fderiv_applyMultiplier {m : Frequency → ℂ} (hm : PolynomialGrowth m)
    {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (z : Point P) :
    fderiv ℝ (applyMultiplier m f) z =
      (∑ i : BasisIndex P, parameterLift i
        (applyMultiplier m (parameterPartial (parameterBasis i) f) z)) +
      torusLiftX (applyMultiplier (multiplierX m) f z) +
      torusLiftY (applyMultiplier (multiplierY m) f z)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.mixedJet_inverse_bound
statement:
theorem mixedJet_inverse_bound (d : Direction) {f : Source P}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (q : ℕ) (w : List Bool)
    (S : Set P) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hzero : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖parameterJet q f (p, (x, y))‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖tensorTorusWord (List.replicate (w.length + 5) false)
        (fun Y => parameterJet q f (p, Y)) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖tensorTorusWord (List.replicate (w.length + 5) false)
        (fun Y => parameterJet q f (p, (Y.2, Y.1))) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (p : P) (hps : p ∈ S) (Y : Plane) :
    ‖mixedJet q w (inverse d f) (p, Y)‖ ≤
      ParametricTorusInverse.mixedLossConstant w.length * C

    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (w : List Bool) (p : P) (Y : Plane) {C : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.norm_jet_applyMultiplier_le

    {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f)
    {S : Set P} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h : JetBound f S (n + l + 4) C)
    (p : P) (hps : p ∈ S) (Y : Plane) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (applyMultiplier m f) (p, Y)‖ ≤
      multiplierJetConstant (P := P) n l * B * C

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.norm_multiplierTermDerivative_le

theorem norm_multiplierTermDerivative_le (m : Frequency → ℂ) (f : Source P)
    (k : Frequency) (z : Point P) :

      (∑ i : BasisIndex P, ‖parameterLift i‖ *
        ‖m k * coefficient (parameterPartial (parameterBasis i) f) z.1 k‖) +
      ‖torusLiftX (P := P)‖ * ‖multiplierX m k * coefficient f z.1 k‖ +
      ‖torusLiftY (P := P)‖ * ‖multiplierY m k * coefficient f z.1 k‖

    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (f : ℝ × (S × Plane) → ℂ), Admissible a b f →
      ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → FiniteJetBound (m + 6 * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ M : ℝ, M ≠ 0 → ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × (S × Plane),

    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ a, χ u = 0) (hright : ∀ u, b ≤ u → χ u = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F)
      (f : ℝ × E → F) (p : ℕ) (C : ℝ), M ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ C →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f →
      (∀ n < p, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n))) →
      (∀ n < p, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n))) →
      (∀ n < p, RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)) =
        RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n) →
      FiniteJetBound m (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f p) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (exactAlias χ M v f) z‖ ≤ K * C * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p

name: NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias_supported
NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias_uniform_of_inverse
statement:
theorem exactAlias_uniform_of_inverse {a b : ℝ} {v : E} {χ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (G : (ℝ × E → F) → Prop) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F) (loss : ℕ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ a, χ u = 0) (hright : ∀ u, b ≤ u → χ u = 1)
    (hregular : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (hsmooth : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J f))
    (hsupport : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J f))
    (hsolve : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J f) = f)
    (hclosed : ∀ f, G f → G (RadialAlias.slowDeriv (J f)))
    (htame : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + loss) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
        FiniteJetBound m (J f) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) (K * C)) (m p : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + (loss + 1) * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →

    (hm : ∀ n s, (∫ U in a..b, sourceMean (f n) (U, s)) = 0)
    (hs : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (f n))
    {M : ℕ → ℝ} {κ A growth : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, M n ≠ 0)
    (hfrequency : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |M n|⁻¹ ≤
      A * ChartScales.epsilon h n ^ κ * ChartScales.S n ^ growth) (m N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × (S × Plane),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (exactAlias χ (M n) ((0 : S), vector d) (f n)) z‖ ≤
        C * ChartScales.epsilon h n ^ N

      ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → FiniteJetBound (m + 6 * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ M : ℝ, M ≠ 0 → ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × (S × Plane),

name: NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.totalIntegral_sourceJet_bound
statement:
theorem totalIntegral_sourceJet_bound {a b M C : ℝ} {v : E}
    (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F) (f : ℝ × E → F) (p m : ℕ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hsf : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (hJ : ∀ n < p, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)))
    (hsJ : ∀ n < p, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)))
    (hr : ∀ n < p, RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)) =
      RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)
    (hbound : FiniteJetBound m (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f p) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ m) (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (TransportPrimitive.totalIntegral M v f) z‖ ≤
      (C * (b - a)) * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p

name: NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.totalIntegral_uniform_of_inverse
statement:
theorem totalIntegral_uniform_of_inverse {a b : ℝ} {v : E}
    (G : (ℝ × E → F) → Prop) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F) (loss : ℕ)
    (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hregular : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (hsmooth : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J f))
    (hsupport : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J f))
    (hsolve : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J f) = f)
    (hclosed : ∀ f, G f → G (RadialAlias.slowDeriv (J f)))
    (htame : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + loss) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
        FiniteJetBound m (J f) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) (K * C)) (m p : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + (loss + 1) * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ M : ℝ, M ≠ 0 → ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (TransportPrimitive.totalIntegral M v f) z‖ ≤
          K * C * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p

theorem dividedAlias_eq_pullback {d a b M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : E) (g : ℝ × E → ℝ) :
    PressureStream.divideRadius (RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b M v g) =
      fun z => aliasFactor d a z.1 * UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias
        (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d)) M v (RadialPullback.normalizeSource d a g)
          (RadialPullback.liftChart (RadialPullback.powerChart d a) z)

statement:

    (m : ℕ) : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (g : ℝ × E → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b g →
      ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias
        (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d)) M v
          (RadialPullback.normalizeSource d a g)) z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (PressureStream.divideRadius (RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b M v g)) z‖ ≤
          K * C

    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ n, M n ≠ 0) {g : ℕ → PressureStream.Lift S → ℝ}
    (hg : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε R hε hεone hR) α g)
    (hgc : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g n)) (hgp : ∀ n, PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift (g n))
    (hgm : ∀ n p, PressureStream.torusAverage (g n) p = 0)
    (hgs : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (g n)) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ p : ℕ, ∀ n j, j ≤ m → ∀ z : PressureStream.Lift S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (PressureStream.divideRadius
        (RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b (M n) ((0 : S), vector .radial) (g n))) z‖ ≤

name: NavierStokes.TemporalMeanUpdate.temporal_mean_update
statement:
theorem temporal_mean_update {d a b M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : Plane) (w : S × Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {fθ fz : PressureStream.Lift S → ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fθ) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fz)
    (hpθ : PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift fθ) (hpz : PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift fz)
    (hsz : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b fz) (z : PressureStream.Lift S) :
    fastDerivative h n (desiredIncrement h n fθ) z + centered fθ z = 0 ∧
    fastDerivative h n (axialUpdate d a b M v h n fz) z + centered fz z =
      -fastDerivative h n (axialAlias d a b M v h n fz) z ∧
    PressureStream.graphDivergence (PressureStream.physicalSpeed d M) (0, v) w
      (radialUpdate d a b M v w h n fz) (axialUpdate d a b M v h n fz) z = 0 ∧
    PressureStream.torusAverage (desiredIncrement h n fθ) (z.1, z.2.1) = 0 ∧
    PressureStream.torusAverage (axialUpdate d a b M v h n fz) (z.1, z.2.1) = 0

statement:
theorem rank_axial_eq_desired (p : ReconstructionData) (r : RankData S)
    (axial : S × PressureStream.Plane) (c : Context (Lift S)) (u : State (Lift S))
    (ha : 0 < p.inner) (hd : 0 < p.exponent) (n : ℕ)
    (hlam : 0 < r.lambda) (hC : ∀ x, r.coefficient n x ≠ 0)
    (hra : 0 < r.inner) (hrab : r.inner < r.outer)
    (hell : ∀ x, 0 < r.length n x) (hU : ∀ x, r.velocity n x ≠ 0)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rankDesiredAxial r c u n))
    (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported p.inner p.outer (rankDesiredAxial r c u n))

statement:
theorem rank_divergence_zero (p : ReconstructionData) (r : RankData S)

    (ha : 0 < p.inner) (hd : 0 < p.exponent) (n : ℕ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rankDesiredAxial r c u n))
    (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported p.inner p.outer (rankDesiredAxial r c u n))
    (x : Lift S) :
    PressureStream.graphDivergence (PressureStream.physicalSpeed p.exponent (p.frequency n))
      ((0 : S), p.radialDirection) (c.operators.epsilon n • axial)
      ((rankIncrement p r axial c u).radial n) ((rankIncrement p r axial c u).axial n) x = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.rank_model_rows
statement:
theorem rank_model_rows (r : RankData S) (c : Context (Lift S)) (u : State (Lift S))
    (n : ℕ) (x : S) (hlam : 0 < r.lambda) (hC : r.coefficient n x ≠ 0)
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hab : r.inner < r.outer) (hell : 0 < r.length n x)
    (hU : r.velocity n x ≠ 0) :
    FiveRowRank.FiveRows
      (MeanRankUpdate.background r.lambda (r.coefficient n x) (r.length n x) (r.velocity n x))
      (fun _ => 0) (debt c u n x)
      (fun R => rankAngular r c u n (R, x))
      (fun R => rankDesiredAxial r c u n (R, x))

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.rank_rows_on_patch
statement:
theorem rank_rows_on_patch (r : RankData S) (c : Context (Lift S)) (u : State (Lift S))
    (n : ℕ) (x : S) (Y : PressureStream.Plane)
    (hlam : 0 < r.lambda) (hC : r.coefficient n x ≠ 0)
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hab : r.inner < r.outer) (hell : 0 < r.length n x)
    (hU : r.velocity n x ≠ 0)
    (hV : ∀ R ∈ Ioo (r.length n x * r.inner) (r.length n x * r.outer),
      c.base.angular n (R, (x, Y)) =
        MeanRankUpdate.background r.lambda (r.coefficient n x) (r.length n x) (r.velocity n x) R)
    (hG : ∀ R ∈ Ioo (r.length n x * r.inner) (r.length n x * r.outer),
      c.base.axial n (R, (x, Y)) = 0) :
    FiveRowRank.FiveRows (fun R => c.base.angular n (R, (x, Y)))
      (fun R => c.base.axial n (R, (x, Y))) (debt c u n x)
      (fun R => rankAngular r c u n (R, x))
      (fun R => rankDesiredAxial r c u n (R, x))

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.reconstructed_radial_residual
statement:
theorem reconstructed_radial_residual (r : ReconstructionData)
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hd : 0 < r.exponent) (c : Context (Lift S))
    (u : State (Lift S))
    (hoperator : ∀ f : ScalarField (Lift S), ∀ n x, c.operators.dr f n x =
      PressureStream.graphDr (PressureStream.physicalSpeed r.exponent (r.frequency n))
        (0, r.radialDirection) (f n) x)
    (hsmooth : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u.gr c n))
    (hsupport : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported r.inner r.outer (u.gr c n))
    (n : ℕ) (x : Lift S) :
    (reconstructPressure r c u).radialResidual c n x =
      -PressureStream.rho r.inner r.outer r.inner_lt_outer x.1 * pressureDefect c u n x.2.1 +
        pressureAlias r c u n (x, 0) 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.temporal_fast_cancellation
statement:
theorem temporal_fast_cancellation (r : ReconstructionData) (h : ℝ)
    (axial : S × PressureStream.Plane) (c : Context (Lift S)) (u : State (Lift S))
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hd : 0 < r.exponent)
    (hθ : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u.thetaResidual c n))
    (hz : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u.axialResidual c n))
    (hpθ : ∀ n, PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift (u.thetaResidual c n))
    (hpz : ∀ n, PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift (u.axialResidual c n))
    (hsz : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported r.inner r.outer (u.axialResidual c n))
    (n : ℕ) (x : Lift S) :
    TemporalMeanUpdate.fastDerivative h n ((temporalIncrement r h axial c u).angular n) x +
        TemporalMeanUpdate.centered (u.thetaResidual c n) x = 0 ∧
    TemporalMeanUpdate.fastDerivative h n ((temporalIncrement r h axial c u).axial n) x +
        TemporalMeanUpdate.centered (u.axialResidual c n) x = temporalAlias r h c u n (x, 0) 2

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.angularGenerator_add

theorem angularGenerator_add (a b : ComplexVector) :

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.cylindricalLaplacian_add
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    {f g : D → ℂ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (f + g) x =
      cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz f x + cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz g x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.cylindricalVectorLaplacian_add
statement:
theorem cylindricalVectorLaplacian_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    {a b : D → ComplexVector}
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y i) U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (a + b) x =
      cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a x +
        cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz b x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.gradient_add
statement:
theorem gradient_add (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    {p q : D → ℂ} {x : D} (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x)
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x) :
      LinearWaveResidual.gradient R Vr Vθ Vz (p + q) x = LinearWaveResidual.gradient R Vr Vθ Vz p x + LinearWaveResidual.gradient R Vr Vθ Vz q x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.linearResidual_add
statement:
theorem linearResidual_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B a b : D → ComplexVector) (p q : D → ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y i) U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (a + b) (p + q) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B a p x + LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B b q x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.linearResidual_base_add
statement:
theorem linearResidual_base_add (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz Vt : D → D)
    (B M a : D → ComplexVector) (p : D → ℂ) {x : D}
    (hB : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => B y i) x)
    (hM : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => M y i) x) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt (B + M) a p x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B a p x +
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz M a x +
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a M x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.linearResidual_sum
statement:
theorem linearResidual_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B : D → ComplexVector) (u : ι → D → ComplexVector) (p : ι → D → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u l y i) U)
    (hp : ∀ l ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p l) U) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (∑ l ∈ s, u l) (∑ l ∈ s, p l) x =
      ∑ l ∈ s, LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (u l) (p l) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.nonlinearResidual_add_sub
statement:
theorem nonlinearResidual_add_sub {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B a b : D → ComplexVector) (p q : D → ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y i) U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (a + b) (p + q) x -
        nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B a p x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B b q x + LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a b x +
        LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz b a x + LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz b b x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.nonlinearResidual_mean_add
statement:
theorem nonlinearResidual_mean_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B M a : D → ComplexVector) (p q : D → ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => B y i) U)
    (hM : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => M y i) U)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (M + a) (p + q) x =
      nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B M p x +
      nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt (B + M) a q x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.nonlinearResidual_sum
statement:
theorem nonlinearResidual_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B : D → ComplexVector) (u : ι → D → ComplexVector) (p : ι → D → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u l y i) U)
    (hp : ∀ l ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p l) U)
    (hdisj : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, l ≠ j → Disjoint (tsupport (u l)) (tsupport (u j)))
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (∑ l ∈ s, u l) (∑ l ∈ s, p l) x =
      ∑ l ∈ s, nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (u l) (p l) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.transport_add_left
statement:
theorem transport_add_left (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    (a b v : D → ComplexVector) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz (a + b) v x =
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a v x + LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz b v x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.transport_add_right
statement:
theorem transport_add_right (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    (u a b : D → ComplexVector) {x : D}
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (hb : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => b y i) x) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz u (a + b) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz u a x + LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz u b x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.transport_sum_left
statement:
theorem transport_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    (u : ι → D → ComplexVector) (v : D → ComplexVector) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz (∑ l ∈ s, u l) v x =
      ∑ l ∈ s, LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz (u l) v x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.transport_sum_right
statement:
theorem transport_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.LabelData.residualCoefficients_field
statement:
theorem LabelData.residualCoefficients_field {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (g : Frame D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.radial U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.axial U)
    (B M : D → ComplexVector) (hB : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => B y i) U)
    (hM : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => M y i) U)
    (d : LabelData D) (hd : d.Regular U) {x : D × ℝ} (hx : x ∈ liftDomain U) (i : Fin 3) :
    (field (d.residualCoefficients g B M i) d.frequency d.phase d.angularFrequency x).re =
      (Actual.nonlinearResidual g.viscosity (fun y => g.radius y.1)
        (liftDirection g.radial) angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial) (liftDirection g.time)
        ((fun y => B y.1) + (fun y => M y.1)) d.wave d.pressureField x i).re -
          (d.gaussianField x i).re - (d.aliasField x i).re

statement:
theorem field_linearResidual {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (g : Frame D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.radial U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.axial U)
    {B a : VectorCoefficients D} (hB : ∀ i, SmoothCoefficients U (B i))
    (ha : ∀ i, SmoothCoefficients U (a i)) {c : Coefficients D} (hc : SmoothCoefficients U c)
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ)
    {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    vectorField (linearResidual g k Φ kp B a c) k Φ kp p =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual g.viscosity (fun q => g.radius q.1)
        (liftDirection g.radial) angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial)
        (liftDirection g.time) (vectorField B k Φ kp) (vectorField a k Φ kp)
        (field c k Φ kp) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem field_neg (c : Coefficients D) (k : ℝ) (Φ : D → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (p : D × ℝ) :
    field (-c) k Φ kp p = -field c k Φ kp p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_nonconstant
statement:
theorem field_nonconstant (c : Coefficients D) (k : ℝ) (Φ : D → ℝ)
    (kp : ℤ) (p : D × ℝ) :
    field (nonconstant c) k Φ kp p = field c k Φ kp p - c 0 p.1

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_nonlinearResidual
statement:
theorem field_nonlinearResidual {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (g : Frame D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.radial U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.axial U)
    {B a : VectorCoefficients D} (hB : ∀ i, SmoothCoefficients U (B i))
    (ha : ∀ i, SmoothCoefficients U (a i)) {c : Coefficients D} (hc : SmoothCoefficients U c)
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ)
    {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    vectorField (nonlinearResidual g k Φ kp B a c) k Φ kp p =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual g.viscosity (fun q => g.radius q.1)
        (liftDirection g.radial) angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial)
        (liftDirection g.time) (vectorField B k Φ kp) (vectorField a k Φ kp)
        (field c k Φ kp) p +
      LinearWaveResidual.transport (fun q => g.radius q.1) (liftDirection g.radial)
        angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial) (vectorField a k Φ kp) (vectorField a k Φ kp) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_realCoefficients
statement:
theorem field_realCoefficients (c : Coefficients D) (k : ℝ) (Φ : D → ℝ)
    (kp : ℤ) (p : D × ℝ) :
    field (realCoefficients c) k Φ kp p = ((field c k Φ kp p).re : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_scalarLaplacian
statement:
theorem field_scalarLaplacian {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (g : Frame D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.radial U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.axial U)
    {c : Coefficients D} (hc : SmoothCoefficients U c)
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ)
    {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    field (scalarLaplacian g k Φ kp c) k Φ kp p =
      cylindricalLaplacian (fun q => g.radius q.1) (liftDirection g.radial)
        angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial) (field c k Φ kp) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_secondAngular
statement:
theorem field_secondAngular {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) {c : Coefficients D}
    (hc : SmoothCoefficients U c) {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U)
    (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ) {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    field (angularDifferentiate kp (angularDifferentiate kp c)) k Φ kp p =
      along angularDirection (along angularDirection (field c k Φ kp)) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_secondDerivative
statement:
theorem field_secondDerivative {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) {c : Coefficients D}
    (hc : SmoothCoefficients U c) {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U)
    {V : D → D} (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ)
    {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    field (differentiate V k Φ (differentiate V k Φ c)) k Φ kp p =
      along (liftDirection V) (along (liftDirection V) (field c k Φ kp)) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_smoothOn
statement:
theorem field_smoothOn {U : Set D} {c : Coefficients D} (hc : SmoothCoefficients U c)
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (field c k Φ kp) (liftDomain U)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem field_sub (c d : Coefficients D) (k : ℝ) (Φ : D → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (p : D × ℝ) :
    field (c - d) k Φ kp p = field c k Φ kp p - field d k Φ kp p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_transport
statement:
theorem field_transport {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (g : Frame D)
    (a : VectorCoefficients D) {b : VectorCoefficients D}
    (hb : ∀ i, SmoothCoefficients U (b i))
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ)
    {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    vectorField (transport g k Φ kp a b) k Φ kp p =
      LinearWaveResidual.transport (fun q => g.radius q.1) (liftDirection g.radial)
        angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial) (vectorField a k Φ kp)
          (vectorField b k Φ kp) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_vectorLaplacian
statement:
theorem field_vectorLaplacian {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (g : Frame D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.radial U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g.axial U)
    {a : VectorCoefficients D} (ha : ∀ i, SmoothCoefficients U (a i))
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (k : ℝ) (kp : ℤ)
    {p : D × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ liftDomain U) :
    vectorField (vectorLaplacian g k Φ kp a) k Φ kp p =
      cylindricalVectorLaplacian (fun q => g.radius q.1) (liftDirection g.radial)
        angularDirection (liftDirection g.axial) (vectorField a k Φ kp) p

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.field_zero
statement:
