    {x : SpaceTime} (hr : 0 < x.2 0)
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ ((commonGraph Q h k).map x)) (a : Cylinder → ComplexVector) :
    CurlClassBounds.vectorPotential K LinearWaveResidual.coordinateRadius
      (LinearWaveResidual.spaceDirection 0) (LinearWaveResidual.spaceDirection 1)
      (LinearWaveResidual.spaceDirection 2)
      (fun y => (L / K) * Φ ((commonGraph Q h k).map y))
      (fun y => Q ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h) • a ((commonGraph Q h k).map y)) x =
      Q ^ (-h) • CurlClassBounds.vectorPotential L PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
        (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
        (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ a ((commonGraph Q h k).map x)

    (s : WeightedClasses.StripData E) (d : LinearWaveBounds.GraphDirections E)
    (ψ : ℕ → E → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (G : CurlClassBounds.CylindricalGeometry s.domain (a.radius n) (d.radialField n)
      (fun _ => d.angular) (d.axialField s n))
    (hK : a.frequency n ≠ 0) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a.phase n) s.domain)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a.amplitude n) s.domain)
    (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ n) s.domain)
    (hn : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, a.normal s d n x ≠ 0)
    (ht : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, normalDot (a.normal s d n x) (a.amplitude n x) = 0)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s.domain) :
    CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl (a.radius n) (d.radialField n) (fun _ => d.angular)
      (d.axialField s n) ((a.withCutoff ψ).curlPotential s d n) x =
      vectorMode (a.frequency n) (a.phase n) ((a.corrected s d ψ).amplitude n) x

theorem cylindricalCurl_congr {R : E → ℝ} {Vr Vθ Vz : E → E}
    {A B : E → ComplexVector} {x : E} (hAB : A =ᶠ[𝓝 x] B) :
    CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz A x =
      CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz B x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCurlCovariance.cylindricalCurl_cutoff
statement:
theorem cylindricalCurl_cutoff (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    {χ : E → ℝ} {B : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hχ : DifferentiableAt ℝ χ x) (hB : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => B y i) x) :
    CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz (fun y => χ y • B y) x =
      χ x • CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz B x +
        CurlClassBounds.normalCross (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz χ x) (B x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCurlCovariance.cylindricalCurl_pull
statement:
theorem cylindricalCurl_pull {Γ : E → F} {R : F → ℝ} {r : E → ℝ}
    {Vr Vθ Vz : F → F} {Sr Sθ Sz : E → E} {x : E} {l : ℝ}
    (hl : l ≠ 0) (hr : r x ≠ 0) (hΓ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Γ x)
    (hDr : fderiv ℝ Γ x (Sr x) = l • Vr (Γ x))
    (hDθ : fderiv ℝ Γ x (Sθ x) = Vθ (Γ x))
    (hDz : fderiv ℝ Γ x (Sz x) = l • Vz (Γ x)) (hR : R (Γ x) = l * r x)
    {a : F → ComplexVector} (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) (Γ x))
    (c : ℂ) :
    CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl r Sr Sθ Sz (fun y => c • a (Γ y)) x =
      (c * (l : ℂ)) • CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz a (Γ x)

statement:

    CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl (fun y => R (e y)) (reindexVector e Vr)
      (reindexVector e Vθ) (reindexVector e Vz) (fun y => B (e y)) x =
      CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz B (e x)

    (Ψ : SpaceTime → ℝ) (v : SpaceTime → ComplexVector)
    (hphase : ∀ z ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U,
      K * Ψ z = L * Φ ((commonGraph Q h k).map z))
    (hamplitude : ∀ z ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U,
      v z = Q ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h) • a ((commonGraph Q h k).map z)) :
    EqOn (referencePotential K Ψ v)
      (fun z => Q ^ (-h) • CurlClassBounds.vectorPotential L PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
        (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
        (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ a ((commonGraph Q h k).map z))
      ((commonGraph Q h k).source U)

    {Φ : Cylinder → ℝ} {a : Cylinder → ComplexVector}
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U)
    (hn : ∀ x ∈ U, phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ x ≠ 0)
    (ht : ∀ x ∈ U, normalDot (phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ x) (a x) = 0)
    (Ψ : SpaceTime → ℝ) (v : SpaceTime → ComplexVector)
    (hphase : ∀ z ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U,
      K * Ψ z = L * Φ ((commonGraph Q h k).map z))
    (hamplitude : ∀ z ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U,
      v z = Q ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h) • a ((commonGraph Q h k).map z))
    {t : ℝ} {q : Space} (hz : (t, q) ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U)
    {A : VelocityField} (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A (t, CylindricalResidual.chart q))
    (hAvalue : (fun z : SpaceTime => A (z.1, CylindricalResidual.chart z.2)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (t, q)]
      (fun z => CylindricalResidual.frame (z.2 1) (realVector (referencePotential K Ψ v z))))
    (i : Fin 3) :
    (vectorMode L Φ (CurlClassBounds.realizedCoefficient L PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ a) ((commonGraph Q h k).map (t, q)) i).re =

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCurlCovariance.reference_correctedWave_constructed
statement:
theorem reference_correctedWave_constructed {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (h : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    {U : Set Cylinder} (hU : IsOpen U) (hR : ∀ x ∈ U, x.1.1 ≠ 0)
    {K L : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0)
    {Φ : Cylinder → ℝ} {a : Cylinder → ComplexVector}
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U)
    (hn : ∀ x ∈ U, phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ x ≠ 0)
    (ht : ∀ x ∈ U, normalDot (phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ x) (a x) = 0)
    (Ψ : SpaceTime → ℝ) (v : SpaceTime → ComplexVector)
    (hphase : ∀ z ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U,
      K * Ψ z = L * Φ ((commonGraph Q h k).map z))
    (hamplitude : ∀ z ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U,
      v z = Q ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h) • a ((commonGraph Q h k).map z))
    (hper : ∀ t r z : ℝ, Periodic
      (fun θ => referencePotential K Ψ v (t, AxisymmetricResidual.pack r θ z)) (2 * Real.pi))
    {t : ℝ} {q : Space} (hz : (t, q) ∈ (commonGraph Q h k).source U)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (j : PolarCharts.Index) (hchart : (t, q) ∈ validCylindrical δ j)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    (vectorMode L Φ (CurlClassBounds.realizedCoefficient L PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (commonGraph Q h k).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (commonGraph Q h k).axial Φ a) ((commonGraph Q h k).map (t, q)) i).re =
      Q ^ CoordinateAlgebra.A h * CylindricalResidual.frame (-(q 1))
        (SpatialCurl.spatialCurl (globalCartesianPotential δ (referencePotential K Ψ v))

    {θ : D} {R : D → ℝ} {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D}
    {Φ : D → ℝ} {a : D → ComplexVector} {slope K : ℝ} (m : ℤ)
    (hR : CopyAngularInvariance.Invariant θ R)
    (hr : CopyAngularInvariance.Invariant θ Vr)
    (hθ : CopyAngularInvariance.Invariant θ Vθ)
    (hz : CopyAngularInvariance.Invariant θ Vz)
    (hΦ : CopyAngularInvariance.AffinePhase θ slope Φ)
    (ha : CopyAngularInvariance.Invariant θ a) (hfreq : K * slope = (m : ℝ)) (x : D) :

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCurlCovariance.vectorPotential_pull
statement:
theorem vectorPotential_pull {Γ : E → F} {R : F → ℝ} {r : E → ℝ}
    {Vr Vθ Vz : F → F} {Sr Sθ Sz : E → E} {x : E} {l b K L : ℝ}
    (hl : l ≠ 0) (hr : r x ≠ 0) (hK : K ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hKL : K * b = L)
    (hΓ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Γ x)
    (hDr : fderiv ℝ Γ x (Sr x) = l • Vr (Γ x))
    (hDθ : fderiv ℝ Γ x (Sθ x) = Vθ (Γ x))
    (hDz : fderiv ℝ Γ x (Sz x) = l • Vz (Γ x)) (hR : R (Γ x) = l * r x)
    {Φ : F → ℝ} (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (Γ x)) (a : F → ComplexVector) (c : ℝ) :
    CurlClassBounds.vectorPotential K r Sr Sθ Sz (fun y => b * Φ (Γ y))
      (fun y => c • a (Γ y)) x =
      (c / l) • CurlClassBounds.vectorPotential L R Vr Vθ Vz Φ a (Γ x)

      (reindexVector e Vθ) (reindexVector e Vz) (fun y => Φ (e y)) (fun y => a (e y)) x =
      CurlClassBounds.vectorPotential K R Vr Vθ Vz Φ a (e x)

statement:
theorem context_fullResidual_physicalTZ {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (h : ℝ) (k n : ℕ)
    (c : CorrectionState.Context Lift) (s : CorrectionState.State Lift)
    (H : MatchesAtTZ c.operators (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k) n)
    {U : Set Cylinder} (hU : IsOpen U) (hR : ∀ x ∈ U, x.1.1 ≠ 0)
    {p₀ : Cylinder → ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => PhysicalResidualBridge.baseComponents c n x i) U)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => PhysicalResidualBridge.incrementComponents s n x i) U)
    (hp₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p₀ U) (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (s.totalPressureIncrement n) U)
    {t : ℝ} {q : ProblemStatement.Space}
    (hz : (t, q) ∈ graphSourceTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k) U)
    (hbase : ∀ i, PhysicalResidualBridge.graphResidual (Q ^ h)
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (graphRadialTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k)) graphAngularTZ
      (graphAxialTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k))
      (graphTemporalTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k))
      (PhysicalResidualBridge.baseComponents c n) p₀
      (graphMapTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k) (t, q)) i =
        LiftedMeanResidual.virtualDivergence c n
          (graphMapTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k) (t, q)) i +
        s.errors.base n (graphMapTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k) (t, q)) i)
    {u : ProblemStatement.VelocityField} {P : ProblemStatement.PressureField}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u (t, CylindricalResidual.chart q))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (t, CylindricalResidual.chart q))
    (hrep : (fun z : ProblemStatement.SpaceTime => u (z.1, CylindricalResidual.chart z.2)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (t, q)]
      (fun z => CylindricalResidual.frame (z.2 1)
        (velocityTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k)
          (fun y j => PhysicalResidualBridge.baseComponents c n y j +
            PhysicalResidualBridge.incrementComponents s n y j) z)))
    (hpRep : CylindricalResidual.pressurePullback P =ᶠ[𝓝 (t, q)]
      pressureTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k)
        (fun y => p₀ y + s.totalPressureIncrement n y)) (i : Fin 3) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.fullResidual c s n
      (graphMapTZ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h k) (t, q)) i =
      Q ^ (2 * CoordinateAlgebra.A h + 1 / 2) *
        CylindricalResidual.frame (-(q 1))
          (ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual u P t (CylindricalResidual.chart q)) i

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.radialDirection_swap
statement:
theorem radialDirection_swap (c : CorrectionState.Context Lift) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.radialDirection (swapContext c) n =
      reindexVector swapCylinder.toContinuousLinearEquiv
        (LiftedMeanResidual.radialDirection c n)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.radialDiv_swap
statement:
theorem radialDiv_swap (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators Lift)
    (k : ℝ) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field Lift) :
    (swapOperators o).radialDiv k (swapField f) = swapField (o.radialDiv k f)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.realFrameLaplacian_reindex
statement:
theorem realFrameLaplacian_reindex (e : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E) (a : E → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realFrameLaplacian (fun y => R (e y)) (reindexVector e Vr)
      (reindexVector e Vθ) (reindexVector e Vz) (fun y => a (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.realFrameLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a (e x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.realTransport_reindex
statement:
theorem realTransport_reindex (e : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E) (u v : E → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realTransport (fun y => R (e y)) (reindexVector e Vr)
      (reindexVector e Vθ) (reindexVector e Vz)
      (fun y => u (e y)) (fun y => v (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.realTransport R Vr Vθ Vz u v (e x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapCylinder_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapCylinder_apply (x : Cylinder) :
    swapCylinder x = (swapSlow x.1, x.2)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapCylinder_swapCylinder
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapCylinder_swapCylinder (x : Cylinder) :
    swapCylinder (swapCylinder x) = x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapCylinder_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapCylinder_symm_apply (x : Cylinder) :
    swapCylinder.symm x = swapCylinder x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapSlow_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapSlow_apply (x : Lift) :
    swapSlow x = (x.1, ((x.2.1.2, x.2.1.1), x.2.2))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapSlow_swapSlow
statement: @[simp] theorem swapSlow_swapSlow (x : Lift) : swapSlow (swapSlow x) = x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapSlow_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem swapSlow_symm_apply (x : Lift) : swapSlow.symm x = swapSlow x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.swapSlow_toContinuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem swapSlow_toContinuousLinearMap :
    swapSlow.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm ℝ ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap.prodMap
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Plane))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.timeDirection_swap
statement:
theorem timeDirection_swap (c : CorrectionState.Context Lift) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.timeDirection (swapContext c) n =
      reindexVector swapCylinder.toContinuousLinearEquiv
        (LiftedMeanResidual.timeDirection c n)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.time_swap
statement:
theorem time_swap (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators Lift) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field Lift) :
    (swapOperators o).time (swapField f) = swapField (o.time f)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.transport_reindex
statement:
theorem transport_reindex (e : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E) (u v : E → ComplexVector) (x : E) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport (fun y => R (e y)) (reindexVector e Vr)
      (reindexVector e Vθ) (reindexVector e Vz)
      (fun y => u (e y)) (fun y => v (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz u v (e x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalResidualTZ.virtualDivergence_swap
statement:
theorem virtualDivergence_swap (c : CorrectionState.Context Lift) (n : ℕ) (x : Cylinder) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.virtualDivergence (swapContext c) n x =
      LiftedMeanResidual.virtualDivergence c n (swapCylinder x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.along_pull
statement:
theorem along_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (V : E → E) (f : E → F) :
    along (vector e V) (fun x => f (e x)) = fun x => along V f (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.along_pull_component
statement:
theorem along_pull_component {ι : Type*} (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (V : E → E)
    (f : E → ι → F) (i : ι) :
    along (vector e V) (fun x => f (e x) i) =
      fun x => along V (fun y => f y i) (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.angularAverage_pull
statement:
theorem angularAverage_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : CorrectionState.OscillatoryScalar E) :
    CorrectionState.angularAverage (fun n x => f n (cylinder e x)) =
      field e (CorrectionState.angularAverage f)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.angularDifferentiate_pull
statement:
theorem angularDifferentiate_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (kp : ℤ)
    (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicFields.angularDifferentiate kp (coefficients e a) =
      coefficients e (HarmonicFields.angularDifferentiate kp a)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.angularDirection_pull
statement:
theorem angularDirection_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) :
    vector (cylinder e) (LiftedMeanResidual.angularDirection (D := E)) =
      LiftedMeanResidual.angularDirection

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.axialDirection_pull
statement:
theorem axialDirection_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.axialDirection (context e c) n =
      vector (cylinder e) (LiftedMeanResidual.axialDirection c n)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.axialResidual_pull
statement:
theorem axialResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) :
    (state e u).axialResidual (context e c) = field e (u.axialResidual c)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.bandLimited_pull
statement:
theorem bandLimited_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) {a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E} {N : ℕ}
    (ha : HarmonicFields.BandLimited a N) : HarmonicFields.BandLimited (coefficients e a) N

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.block_bandLimited
statement:
theorem block_bandLimited (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) {b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock E} {N : ℕ}
    (hb : b.BandLimited N) : (block e b).BandLimited N

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.block_oscillation
statement:
theorem block_oscillation (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock E) :
    (block e b).oscillation = oscillation e b.oscillation

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.block_pressure
statement:
theorem block_pressure (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock E) :
    (block e b).oscillatoryPressure = fun n x => b.oscillatoryPressure n (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.block_pressureBounds
NavierStokes.StateReindex.block_roundtrip
statement:
theorem block_roundtrip (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock D) :
    block e (block e.symm b) = b

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.block_waveBounds
NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficientMass_pull
statement:
theorem coefficientMass_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) (x : D) :
    HarmonicFields.coefficientMass (coefficients e a) x = HarmonicFields.coefficientMass a (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_add
statement:
theorem coefficients_add (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a b : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    coefficients e (a + b) = coefficients e a + coefficients e b

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficients_apply (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E)
    (j : ℤ) (x : D) : coefficients e a j x = a j (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_constant
statement:
theorem coefficients_constant (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : E → ℂ) :
    coefficients e (HarmonicFields.constantCoefficient a) =
      HarmonicFields.constantCoefficient (fun x => a (e x))

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_fun
statement:
theorem coefficients_fun (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) (j : ℤ) :
    coefficients e a j = fun x => a j (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_mul
statement:
theorem coefficients_mul (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a b : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    coefficients e (a * b) = coefficients e a * coefficients e b

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_neg
statement:
theorem coefficients_neg (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    coefficients e (-a) = -coefficients e a

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_roundtrip
statement:
theorem coefficients_roundtrip (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients D) :
    coefficients e (coefficients e.symm a) = a

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_sub
statement:
theorem coefficients_sub (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a b : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    coefficients e (a - b) = coefficients e a - coefficients e b

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_support
statement:
theorem coefficients_support (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    (coefficients e a).support = a.support

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.coefficients_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coefficients_zero (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) : coefficients e 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.complexBase_pull
statement:
theorem complexBase_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.complexBase (context e c) n =
      fun x => LiftedMeanResidual.complexBase c n (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.complexPerturbation_pull
statement:
theorem complexPerturbation_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.complexPerturbation (state e u) n =
      fun x => LiftedMeanResidual.complexPerturbation u n (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.complexPressure_pull
statement:
theorem complexPressure_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.complexPressure (state e u) n =
      fun x => LiftedMeanResidual.complexPressure u n (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.constantVector_pull
statement:
theorem constantVector_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (B : E → ComplexVector) :
    HarmonicResidual.constantVector (fun x => B (e x)) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.constantVector B i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.contextBase_pull
statement:
theorem contextBase_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (n : ℕ) :
    HarmonicResidual.contextBase (context e c) n = fun x => HarmonicResidual.contextBase c n (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.contextFrame_pull
statement:
theorem contextFrame_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (n : ℕ) :
    HarmonicResidual.contextFrame (context e c) n = frame e (HarmonicResidual.contextFrame c n)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.context_roundtrip
statement:
theorem context_roundtrip (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context D) :
    context e (context e.symm c) = c

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.covarianceMass_liftAssoc
statement:
theorem covarianceMass_liftAssoc (k : ℕ) (u : CorrectionState.State (Associated S))
    (i j : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    CorrectionState.radialMoment k ((state (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S) u).covariance i j) n s =
      associatedMass (fun x => x.1.1 ^ k * u.covariance i j n x) s

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.covariance_pull
statement:
theorem covariance_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (u : CorrectionState.State E) (i j : Fin 3) :
    (state e u).covariance i j = field e (u.covariance i j)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.cylinder_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cylinder_apply (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : D × ℝ) :
    cylinder e x = (e x.1, x.2)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.cylinder_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cylinder_symm_apply (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : E × ℝ) :
    (cylinder e).symm x = (e.symm x.1, x.2)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.differentiate_pull
statement:
theorem differentiate_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (V : E → E) (k : ℝ)
    (Phi : E → ℝ) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicFields.differentiate (vector e V) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) (coefficients e a) =
      coefficients e (HarmonicFields.differentiate V k Phi a)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.dr_pull
statement:
theorem dr_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators E)
    (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field E) : (operators e o).dr (field e f) = field e (o.dr f)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.dz_pull
statement:
theorem dz_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators E)
    (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field E) : (operators e o).dz (field e f) = field e (o.dz f)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.evaluate_pull
statement:
theorem evaluate_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E)
    (x : D) (theta : ℝ) :
    HarmonicFields.evaluate (coefficients e a) x theta = HarmonicFields.evaluate a (e x) theta

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.fderiv_field
statement:
theorem fderiv_field (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field E)
    (n : ℕ) (x : D) (v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (field e f n) x (e.symm v) = fderiv ℝ (f n) (e x) v

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.fderiv_pull
statement:
theorem fderiv_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : E → F) (x v : D) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (e y)) x v = fderiv ℝ f (e x) (e v)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.field_roundtrip
statement:
theorem field_roundtrip (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field D) :
    field e (field e.symm f) = f

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.fullGoodResidual_pull
statement:
theorem fullGoodResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) (x : D × ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.fullGoodResidual (context e c) (state e u) n x i =
      LiftedMeanResidual.fullGoodResidual c u n (cylinder e x) i

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.fullResidual_liftAssoc_return
statement:
theorem fullResidual_liftAssoc_return
    (c : CorrectionState.Context (PressureStream.Lift S))
    (u : CorrectionState.State (PressureStream.Lift S)) (n : ℕ)
    (x : PressureStream.Lift S × ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.fullResidual
      (context (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm c)
      (state (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm u) n
      (cylinder (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S) x) i =
      LiftedMeanResidual.fullResidual c u n x i

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.fullResidual_pull
statement:
theorem fullResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) (x : D × ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.fullResidual (context e c) (state e u) n x i =
      LiftedMeanResidual.fullResidual c u n (cylinder e x) i

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.gr_pull
statement:
theorem gr_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) :
    (state e u).gr (context e c) = field e (u.gr c)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.gradientCoefficients_pull
statement:
theorem gradientCoefficients_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.gradient (frame e g) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) kp (coefficients e a) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.gradient g k Phi kp a i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.harmonicField_pull
statement:
theorem harmonicField_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (x : D × ℝ) :
    HarmonicFields.field (coefficients e a) k (fun y => Phi (e y)) kp x =
      HarmonicFields.field a k Phi kp (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.iteratedFDeriv_pull
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : E → F) (m : ℕ) (x : D) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => f (e y)) x =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (e x)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => e.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.labelResidual_pull
statement:
theorem labelResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (d : HarmonicResidual.LabelData E)
    (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E) (B M : E → ComplexVector) :
    (label e d).residualCoefficients (frame e g) (fun x => B (e x)) (fun x => M (e x)) =
      fun i => coefficients e (d.residualCoefficients g B M i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.labelWaveResidual_pull
statement:
theorem labelWaveResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (d : HarmonicResidual.LabelData E)
    (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E) (B M : E → ComplexVector) :
    (label e d).waveResidualCoefficients (frame e g) (fun x => B (e x)) (fun x => M (e x)) =
      fun i => coefficients e (d.waveResidualCoefficients g B M i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.linearCoefficients_pull
statement:
theorem linearCoefficients_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (B a : HarmonicResidual.VectorCoefficients E)
    (p : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.linearResidual (frame e g) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) kp
      (fun i => coefficients e (B i)) (fun i => coefficients e (a i)) (coefficients e p) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.linearResidual g k Phi kp B a p i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.linearResidual_field_pull
statement:
theorem linearResidual_field_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (epsilon : ℝ) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz Vtime : E → E) (B a : E → ComplexVector) (p : E → ℂ) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual epsilon (fun y => R (e y))
      (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz) (vector e Vtime)
      (fun y => B (e y)) (fun y => a (e y)) (fun y => p (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual epsilon R Vr Vt Vz Vtime B a p (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.meanGoodResidual_pull
statement:
theorem meanGoodResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) (x : D) (i : Fin 3) :
    (state e u).meanGoodResidual (context e c) n x i = u.meanGoodResidual c n (e x) i

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.meanResidual_pull
statement:
theorem meanResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) (x : D) (i : Fin 3) :
    (state e u).meanResidual (context e c) n x i = u.meanResidual c n (e x) i

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.memClass_pull
NavierStokes.StateReindex.nonconstant_pull
statement:
theorem nonconstant_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.nonconstant (coefficients e a) =
      coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.nonconstant a)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.nonlinearCoefficients_pull
statement:
theorem nonlinearCoefficients_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (B a : HarmonicResidual.VectorCoefficients E)
    (p : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.nonlinearResidual (frame e g) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) kp
      (fun i => coefficients e (B i)) (fun i => coefficients e (a i)) (coefficients e p) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.nonlinearResidual g k Phi kp B a p i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.norm_iteratedFDeriv_pull
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : E → F) (m : ℕ) (x : D) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => f (e y)) x‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (e x)‖

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.ofBlock_pull
statement:
theorem ofBlock_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock E)
    (G A : HarmonicResidual.BlockCoefficients E) (n : ℕ) :
    HarmonicResidual.ofBlock (block e b) (blockCoefficients e G) (blockCoefficients e A) n =
      label e (HarmonicResidual.ofBlock b G A n)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.oscillation_roundtrip
statement:
theorem oscillation_roundtrip (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : CorrectionState.Oscillation D) :
    oscillation e (oscillation e.symm f) = f

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.pressureMass_liftAssoc
statement:
theorem pressureMass_liftAssoc (f : Associated S → ℝ) (s : S) :
    PressureStream.pressureMass (fun x => f (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S x)) s =
      associatedMass f s

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.radialDirection_pull
statement:
theorem radialDirection_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.radialDirection (context e c) n =
      vector (cylinder e) (LiftedMeanResidual.radialDirection c n)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.radialDiv_pull
statement:
theorem radialDiv_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators E)
    (k : ℝ) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field E) :
    (operators e o).radialDiv k (field e f) = field e (o.radialDiv k f)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.radialMoment_liftAssoc
statement:
theorem radialMoment_liftAssoc (k : ℕ) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field (Associated S))
    (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    CorrectionState.radialMoment k (field (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S) f) n s =
      associatedMass (fun x => x.1.1 ^ k * f n x) s

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.radialResidual_pull
statement:
theorem radialResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) :
    (state e u).radialResidual (context e c) = field e (u.radialResidual c)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.realCoefficients_pull
statement:
theorem realCoefficients_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.realCoefficients (coefficients e a) =
      coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.realCoefficients a)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.realComponentLinearResidual_pull
statement:
theorem realComponentLinearResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (epsilon : ℝ) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz Vtime : E → E) (B a : E → Fin 3 → ℝ) (p : E → ℝ) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realComponentLinearResidual epsilon (fun y => R (e y))
      (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz) (vector e Vtime)
      (fun y => B (e y)) (fun y => a (e y)) (fun y => p (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.realComponentLinearResidual epsilon R Vr Vt Vz Vtime B a p (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.realFrameLaplacian_pull
statement:
theorem realFrameLaplacian_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz : E → E) (a : E → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realFrameLaplacian (fun y => R (e y))
      (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz) (fun y => a (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.realFrameLaplacian R Vr Vt Vz a (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.realTransport_pull
statement:
theorem realTransport_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz : E → E) (u v : E → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realTransport (fun y => R (e y)) (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz)
      (fun y => u (e y)) (fun y => v (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.realTransport R Vr Vt Vz u v (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.reducedMeanResidual_pull
statement:
theorem reducedMeanResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) (x : D) :
    (state e u).reducedMeanResidual (context e c) n x = u.reducedMeanResidual c n (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.residualBlock_liftAssoc_return
statement:
theorem residualBlock_liftAssoc_return
    (c : CorrectionState.Context (PressureStream.Lift S))
    (u : CorrectionState.State (PressureStream.Lift S))
    (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock (PressureStream.Lift S))
    (G A : HarmonicResidual.BlockCoefficients (PressureStream.Lift S)) :
    block (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S)
      (HarmonicResidual.residualBlock
        (context (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm c)
        (state (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm u)
        (block (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm b)
        (blockCoefficients (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm G)
        (blockCoefficients (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S).symm A)) =
      HarmonicResidual.residualBlock c u b G A

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.residualBlock_pull
statement:
theorem residualBlock_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (u : CorrectionState.State E)
    (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock E) (G A : HarmonicResidual.BlockCoefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.residualBlock (context e c) (state e u) (block e b)
      (blockCoefficients e G) (blockCoefficients e A) =
      block e (HarmonicResidual.residualBlock c u b G A)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.rotate_pull
statement:
theorem rotate_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : HarmonicResidual.VectorCoefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.rotate (fun i => coefficients e (a i)) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.rotate a i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.scalarLaplacian_component_pull
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_component_pull {ι : Type*} (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz : E → E) (f : E → ι → F) (i : ι) (x : D) :
    HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian (fun y => R (e y))
      (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz) (fun y => f (e y) i) x =
      HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vt Vz (fun y => f y i) (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.scalarLaplacian_field_pull
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_field_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz : E → E) (f : E → F) (x : D) :
    HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian (fun y => R (e y))
      (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz) (fun y => f (e y)) x =
      HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vt Vz f (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.scalarLaplacian_pull
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (a : HarmonicFields.Coefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.scalarLaplacian (frame e g) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) kp (coefficients e a) =
      coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.scalarLaplacian g k Phi kp a)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.stateMean_pull
statement:
theorem stateMean_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (u : CorrectionState.State E) (n : ℕ) :
    HarmonicResidual.stateMean (state e u) n = fun x => HarmonicResidual.stateMean u n (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.state_roundtrip
statement:
theorem state_roundtrip (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (u : CorrectionState.State D) :
    state e (state e.symm u) = u

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.thetaResidual_pull
statement:
theorem thetaResidual_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (u : CorrectionState.State E) :
    (state e u).thetaResidual (context e c) = field e (u.thetaResidual c)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.timeDirection_pull
statement:
theorem timeDirection_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (n : ℕ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.timeDirection (context e c) n =
      vector (cylinder e) (LiftedMeanResidual.timeDirection c n)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.time_pull
statement:
theorem time_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators E)
    (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field E) : (operators e o).time (field e f) = field e (o.time f)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.torusAverage_liftAssoc
statement:
theorem torusAverage_liftAssoc (f : Associated S → ℝ) (p : ℝ × S) :
    PressureStream.torusAverage (fun x => f (ParticularWaveBounds.liftAssoc S x)) p =
      associatedTorusAverage f p

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.totalErrors_pull
statement:
theorem totalErrors_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a : CorrectionState.ExcludedErrors E) :
    (errors e a).total = oscillation e a.total

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.totalPressure_pull
statement:
theorem totalPressure_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (u : CorrectionState.State E) :
    (state e u).totalPressureIncrement =
      fun n x => u.totalPressureIncrement n (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.totalVelocity_pull
statement:
theorem totalVelocity_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (c : CorrectionState.Context E) (u : CorrectionState.State E) :
    (state e u).totalVelocity (context e c) = oscillation e (u.totalVelocity c)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.transportCoefficients_pull
statement:
theorem transportCoefficients_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (a b : HarmonicResidual.VectorCoefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.transport (frame e g) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) kp
      (fun i => coefficients e (a i)) (fun i => coefficients e (b i)) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.transport g k Phi kp a b i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.transport_field_pull
statement:
theorem transport_field_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz : E → E) (u v : E → ComplexVector) (x : D) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport (fun y => R (e y)) (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz)
      (fun y => u (e y)) (fun y => v (e y)) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vt Vz u v (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.vectorLaplacian_field_pull
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_field_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vt Vz : E → E) (a : E → ComplexVector) (x : D) :
    HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalVectorLaplacian (fun y => R (e y))
      (vector e Vr) (vector e Vt) (vector e Vz) (fun y => a (e y)) x =
      HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vt Vz a (e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.vectorLaplacian_pull
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : HarmonicResidual.Frame E)
    (k : ℝ) (Phi : E → ℝ) (kp : ℤ) (a : HarmonicResidual.VectorCoefficients E) :
    HarmonicResidual.vectorLaplacian (frame e g) k (fun x => Phi (e x)) kp
      (fun i => coefficients e (a i)) =
      fun i => coefficients e (HarmonicResidual.vectorLaplacian g k Phi kp a i)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.virtualDivergence_pull
statement:
theorem virtualDivergence_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (c : CorrectionState.Context E)
    (n : ℕ) (x : D × ℝ) :
    LiftedMeanResidual.virtualDivergence (context e c) n x =
      LiftedMeanResidual.virtualDivergence c n (cylinder e x)

name: NavierStokes.StateReindex.viscosity_pull
statement:
theorem viscosity_pull (e : D ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (o : MeanIncrementBounds.Operators E)
    (k : ℝ) (f : MeanIncrementBounds.Field E) :
    (operators e o).viscosity k (field e f) = field e (o.viscosity k f)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.angle_translate_pack
statement:
theorem angle_translate_pack (t r theta z s : ℝ) :
    (t, AxisymmetricResidual.pack r theta z) + s • ((0 : ℝ), coordinateVector 1) =
      (t, AxisymmetricResidual.pack r (theta + s) z)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandAmplitude_eq_reference
statement:
theorem bandAmplitude_eq_reference (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h : ℝ) {Q Qr : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (gap : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (j : ℤ)
    (hKr : referenceFrequency D j ≠ 0) {U : Set Parameter} (R : ReferenceODE D j U)
    (p : Parameter) (hp : parameterChange h Q Qr p ∈ U) (Y : Plane) :
    bandAmplitude D h hQ hQr gap K j (p, Y) =
      velocityWeight h Q Qr • referenceVelocity D.reference D.context D.state D.carrierBlock
        D.gaussianInput D.aliasInput j (parameterChange h Q Qr p, coverPower gap Y)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandDomain_open
statement:
theorem bandDomain_open (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h Q Qr : ℝ) (gap : ℕ)
    {U : Set Parameter} (hU : IsOpen U) : IsOpen (bandDomain D h Q Qr gap U)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandNormal_ne
statement:
theorem bandNormal_ne {x : Cylinder} (hx : x ∈ bandDomain D h Q Qr gap U) :
    phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).radial
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).axial
      (bandPhase D h Q Qr gap K j) x ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandPhase_eq_actualCarrier
statement:
theorem bandPhase_eq_actualCarrier (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h Q Qr : ℝ)
    (gap n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) (hfrequency : ∀ m, D.carrierBlock.frequency m ≠ 0)
    (hphase : ∀ p Y, D.carrierBlock.frequency n * D.carrierBlock.phase n (p, Y) =
      D.carrierBlock.frequency D.reference.band * D.carrierBlock.phase D.reference.band
        (parameterChange h Q Qr p, coverPower gap Y))
    (hangular : D.carrierBlock.angularFrequency n = D.carrierBlock.angularFrequency D.reference.band) :
    bandPhase D h Q Qr gap ((j : ℝ) * D.carrierBlock.frequency n) j =
      fun x => (actualCarrier D.background D.carrierBlock j).phase n (waveEquiv x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandPhase_smooth
statement: theorem bandPhase_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (bandPhase D h Q Qr gap K j) (bandDomain D h Q Qr gap U)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandPressureMode_eq_physical
statement:
theorem bandPressureMode_eq_physical (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h : ℝ) {Q Qr : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (i gap : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (j : ℤ)
    (hKr : referenceFrequency D j ≠ 0) {U : Set Parameter} (R : ReferenceODE D j U)
    {z : SpaceTime} (hz : 0 < z.2 0)
    (hp : parameterChange h Q Qr (nativeMap h Q i z).1.1 ∈ U) :
    bandPressureMode D h hQ hQr gap K j ((PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).map z) =
      (Q ^ (2 * CoordinateAlgebra.A h) : ℝ) • complexPhysicalPressure D h Qr (i + gap) j z

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandPressure_eq_reference
statement:
theorem bandPressure_eq_reference (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h : ℝ) {Q Qr : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (gap : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (j : ℤ)
    (hKr : referenceFrequency D j ≠ 0) {U : Set Parameter} (R : ReferenceODE D j U)
    (p : Parameter) (hp : parameterChange h Q Qr p ∈ U) (Y : Plane) :
    bandPressure D h hQ hQr gap K j (p, Y) =
      pressureWeight h Q Qr • ParticularWaveAssembly.referencePressure D.reference D.context D.state D.carrierBlock
        D.gaussianInput D.aliasInput j (parameterChange h Q Qr p, coverPower gap Y)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandRawPressure_eq_lift
statement:
theorem bandRawPressure_eq_lift (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h : ℝ) {Q Qr : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (gap : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (j : ℤ)
    (hKr : referenceFrequency D j ≠ 0) {U : Set Parameter} (R : ReferenceODE D j U)
    (x : Cylinder) (hx : parameterChange h Q Qr (waveEquiv x).1.1 ∈ U) :
    bandRawPressure D h hQ hQr gap K j x =
      pressureWeight h Q Qr • referenceRawPressure D j (waveEquiv (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandRaw_eq_lift
statement:
theorem bandRaw_eq_lift (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h : ℝ) {Q Qr : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (gap : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (j : ℤ)
    (hKr : referenceFrequency D j ≠ 0) {U : Set Parameter} (R : ReferenceODE D j U)
    (x : Cylinder) (hx : parameterChange h Q Qr (waveEquiv x).1.1 ∈ U) :
    bandRaw D h hQ hQr gap K j x =
      velocityWeight h Q Qr • liftRaw D j (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandRaw_smooth
statement: theorem bandRaw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (bandRaw D h hQ hQr gap K j) (bandDomain D h Q Qr gap U)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.bandRaw_tangent
statement:
theorem bandRaw_tangent {x : Cylinder} (hx : x ∈ bandDomain D h Q Qr gap U) :
    normalDot (phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius
      (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).radial PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular
      (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).axial (bandPhase D h Q Qr gap K j) x)
      (bandRaw D h hQ hQr gap K j x) = 0

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.band_physical_pressure
statement:
theorem band_physical_pressure (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h : ℝ) {Q Qr : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (i gap : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (j : ℤ)
    (hKr : referenceFrequency D j ≠ 0) {U : Set Parameter} (R : ReferenceODE D j U)
    {z : SpaceTime} (hz : 0 < z.2 0)
    (hp : parameterChange h Q Qr (nativeMap h Q i z).1.1 ∈ U)
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) (chart : PolarCharts.Index)
    (hchart : z ∈ PhysicalCurlCovariance.validCylindrical delta chart) :
    (bandPressureMode D h hQ hQr gap K j ((PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).map z)).re =
      Q ^ (2 * CoordinateAlgebra.A h) *
        physicalPressure D h Qr (i + gap) delta j (z.1, CylindricalResidual.chart z.2)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.band_physical_velocity
statement:
theorem band_physical_velocity {z : SpaceTime}
    (hz : z ∈ (PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).source (bandDomain D h Q Qr gap U))
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) (chart : PolarCharts.Index)
    (hchart : z ∈ PhysicalCurlCovariance.validCylindrical delta chart) (component : Fin 3) :
    (bandVelocity D h hQ hQr i gap K j ((PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i).map z) component).re =
      Q ^ CoordinateAlgebra.A h * CylindricalResidual.frame (-(z.2 1))
        (physicalVelocity D h Qr (i + gap) delta j (z.1, CylindricalResidual.chart z.2)) component

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.chartChange_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartChange_apply (h Q Qr : ℝ) (gap : ℕ) (x : Lift) :
    chartChange h Q Qr gap x =
      (ratioPower Q Qr (1 / 2) * x.1,
        ((ratioPower Q Qr (CoordinateAlgebra.D h) * x.2.1.1,
          ratioPower Q Qr 1 * x.2.1.2), coverPower gap x.2.2))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.clock_mul_velocity
statement:
theorem clock_mul_velocity {Q Qr : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr) (h : ℝ) :
    clockWeight h Q Qr * velocityWeight h Q Qr = sourceWeight h Q Qr

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonPotential_curl
statement:
theorem commonPotential_curl (n : ℕ) {x : (P × ℝ) × Plane} (hx : x ∈ D.strip.domain) :
    CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl (D.background.radius n) (D.directions.radialField n)
      (fun _ => D.directions.angular) (D.directions.axialField D.strip n)
      (commonPotential D j n) x =
    vectorMode ((D.wave j).frequency n) ((D.wave j).phase n) ((D.wave j).amplitude n) x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonPotential_fullTurn
statement:
theorem commonPotential_fullTurn (n : ℕ) (x : (P × ℝ) × Plane) :
    commonPotential D j n (x + (2 * Real.pi) • D.directions.angular) =
      commonPotential D j n x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonPotential_smooth
statement:
theorem commonPotential_smooth (n : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (commonPotential D j n) D.strip.domain

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonPressure_fullTurn
statement:
theorem commonPressure_fullTurn (n : ℕ) (x : (P × ℝ) × Plane) :
    commonPressure D j n (x + (2 * Real.pi) • D.directions.angular) =
      commonPressure D j n x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonRaw_germ
statement:
theorem commonRaw_germ (n : ℕ) {x : (P × ℝ) × Plane} (hx : x ∈ D.strip.domain) :
    (rawCommon D j).amplitude n =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => C.slot.cutoff n y •
        (actualCopyCoefficients D.reference D.charts D.context D.state D.carrierBlock
          D.gaussianInput D.aliasInput j D.background D.copy).amplitude n y)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonRaw_smooth
statement:
theorem commonRaw_smooth (n : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((rawCommon D j).amplitude n) D.strip.domain

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.commonRaw_tangent
statement:
theorem commonRaw_tangent (n : ℕ) {x : (P × ℝ) × Plane} (hx : x ∈ D.strip.domain) :
    normalDot ((rawCommon D j).normal D.strip D.directions n x)
      ((rawCommon D j).amplitude n x) = 0

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.complexPhysicalPressure_periodic
statement:
theorem complexPhysicalPressure_periodic (D : AssemblyData Parameter) (h Qr : ℝ)
    (I : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (hk : D.carrierBlock.frequency D.reference.band ≠ 0) (t r z : ℝ) :
    Periodic (fun theta => complexPhysicalPressure D h Qr I j
      (t, AxisymmetricResidual.pack r theta z)) (2 * Real.pi)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.complexPhysicalPressure_smoothAt
statement: theorem complexPhysicalPressure_smoothAt : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (complexPhysicalPressure D h Qr I j) z

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.cylinderChange_angular
statement:
theorem cylinderChange_angular (h Q Qr : ℝ) (gap : ℕ) (x : Cylinder) :
    cylinderChange h Q Qr gap (PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular x) =
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.cylinderChange_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cylinderChange_apply (h Q Qr : ℝ) (gap : ℕ) (x : Cylinder) :
    cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x = (chartChange h Q Qr gap x.1, x.2)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalParticularWave.cylinderChange_axial
statement:
theorem cylinderChange_axial {Q Qr : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr)
    (h : ℝ) (i gap : ℕ) (x : Cylinder) :
    let G := PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i
    let H := PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Qr h (i + gap)
    cylinderChange h Q Qr gap (G.axial x) =

theorem linear_change_direction {X E F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (C : E →L[ℝ] F) {f : X → E} {g : X → F} {x v : X} {a b : ℝ}
    {u : E} {w : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (he : (fun y => C (f y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g)
    (hdf : fderiv ℝ f x v = a • u) (hdg : fderiv ℝ g x v = b • w) :
    C u = (b / a) • w

    (hphi : AffinePhase theta slope phi) (ha : Invariant theta a)

    mode K phi a (x + (2 * Real.pi) • theta) = mode K phi a x

statement:
theorem phaseNormal_chartChange {Q Qr : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQr : 0 < Qr)
    (h : ℝ) (i gap : ℕ) (K Kr : ℝ) {x : Cylinder} (hx : 0 < x.1.1)
    {Φ : Cylinder → ℝ} (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x)) :
    let G := PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i
    let H := PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Qr h (i + gap)
    phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius G.radial
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular G.axial
      (fun y => (Kr / K) * Φ (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap y)) x =
    normalWeight Q Qr K Kr • phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius H.radial
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular H.axial Φ (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x)

    (hK : K ≠ 0) (h : ℝ) (i gap : ℕ) {x : Cylinder} (hx : 0 < x.1.1)
    {Φ Ψ : Cylinder → ℝ} (hΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x))
    (hphase : (fun y => K * Φ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => Kr * Ψ (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap y)) :
    let G := PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Q h i
    let H := PhysicalResidualBridge.commonGraph Qr h (i + gap)
    phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius G.radial
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular G.axial Φ x =
    normalWeight Q Qr K Kr • phaseNormal PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.radius H.radial
      PhysicalResidualBridge.ScaledGraph.angular H.axial Ψ (cylinderChange h Q Qr gap x)

    (A B : Parameter → ℝ) (hQ : 0 < Q D.reference.band)
    (hgap : gap D.reference.band = 0) (hK : ∀ n, D.carrierBlock.frequency n ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) :

    (h : ℝ) (Q : ℕ → ℝ) (gap : ℕ → ℕ) (reference : ℕ) (angular : ℤ)
    (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow) (A B : Parameter → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hQn : 0 < Q n) (hQr : 0 < Q reference) :
    (physicalBlock b h Q gap reference angular g w A B).phase n =
      phase (CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g (gap n) 0
        (PhysicalParticularWave.clockWeight h (Q n) (Q reference))
        (PhysicalParticularWave.ratioPower_pos hQn hQr _).ne')
        (w.cutoff ∘ CopySolveCompatibility.nativeTimeMap 0
          (PhysicalParticularWave.clockWeight h (Q n) (Q reference)))
        (fun p => (b.frequency reference / b.frequency n) *
          A (PhysicalParticularWave.parameterChange h (Q n) (Q reference) p))
        (fun p => (b.frequency reference / b.frequency n) *
          PhysicalParticularWave.clockWeight h (Q n) (Q reference) *
          B (PhysicalParticularWave.parameterChange h (Q n) (Q reference) p))

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.physicalBlock_native_germ
statement:
theorem physicalBlock_native_germ (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock (Parameter × Plane))
    (h : ℝ) (Q : ℕ → ℝ) (gap : ℕ → ℕ) (reference : ℕ) (angular : ℤ)
    (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow) (A B : Parameter → ℝ)
    (hinj : InjOn quotientPoint ((fun z => g.center + g.basis z) '' w.outer))
    (n : ℕ) (shift rate : ℝ) (hrate : rate ≠ 0) (copy : Frequency) {z : Parameter × Plane}
    (hz : CopySolveCompatibility.nativeTimeMap shift rate
      ((CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g (gap n) shift rate hrate).coordinates copy z.2) ∈ w.core) :
    (physicalBlock b h Q gap reference angular g w A B).phase n =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      nativePhase (CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g (gap n) shift rate hrate)
        (fun p => (b.frequency reference / b.frequency n) *
          (A (PhysicalParticularWave.parameterChange h (Q n) (Q reference) p) -
            shift * B (PhysicalParticularWave.parameterChange h (Q n) (Q reference) p)))
        (fun p => (b.frequency reference / b.frequency n) * rate *
          B (PhysicalParticularWave.parameterChange h (Q n) (Q reference) p)) copy

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.physicalBlock_weighted
statement:
theorem physicalBlock_weighted (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock (Parameter × Plane))
    (h : ℝ) (Q : ℕ → ℝ) (gap : ℕ → ℕ) (reference : ℕ) (angular : ℤ)
    (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow) (A B : Parameter → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.profilePhase_eq_literal
statement:
theorem profilePhase_eq_literal (g : Geometry) (χ : Plane → ℝ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Parameter → ℝ) (x : (Parameter × ℝ) × Plane) :
    angularLift (profilePhase g χ ε p pz x0 F G) p x =
      PhaseCalculus.phase ε p pz x0 (fun s => F (s.1, (s.2.2, s.2.1)))
        (fun s => G (s.1, (s.2.2, s.2.1)))
        (slowSwap x.1.1, (x.1.2, periodicClock g χ x.2))

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.profilePhase_germ
statement:
theorem profilePhase_germ (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow)
    (hinj : InjOn quotientPoint ((fun z => g.center + g.basis z) '' w.outer))
    (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Parameter → ℝ) (k : Frequency)
    {x : (Parameter × ℝ) × Plane} (hx : g.coordinates k x.2 ∈ w.core) :
    angularLift (profilePhase g w.cutoff ε p pz x0 F G) p =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => PhaseCalculus.phase ε p pz x0 (fun s => F (s.1, (s.2.2, s.2.1)))
        (fun s => G (s.1, (s.2.2, s.2.1)))
        (slowSwap y.1.1, (y.1.2, (g.coordinates k y.2).2)))

statement:

    (hinj : InjOn quotientPoint ((fun z => g.center + g.basis z) '' w.outer))
    (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Parameter → ℝ) (k : Frequency)
    {x : (Parameter × ℝ) × Plane} (hx : g.coordinates k x.2 ∈ w.core) (m : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (angularLift (profilePhase g w.cutoff ε p pz x0 F G) p) x =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => PhaseCalculus.phase ε p pz x0
        (fun s => F (s.1, (s.2.2, s.2.1))) (fun s => G (s.1, (s.2.2, s.2.1)))
        (slowSwap y.1.1, (y.1.2, (g.coordinates k y.2).2))) x

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_angular_weighted
statement:
theorem transportPhase_angular_weighted (Φ : P × Plane → ℝ) (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ)
    {K Kr : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (hKr : Kr ≠ 0) (m : ℤ) (x : (Q × ℝ) × Plane) :
    K * angularLift (transportPhase Φ φ gap K Kr) ((m : ℝ) / K) x =
      Kr * angularLift Φ ((m : ℝ) / Kr) ((φ x.1.1, x.1.2), coverPower gap x.2)

NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem transportPhase_contDiffOn {Φ : P × Plane → ℝ} {φ : Q → P} {U : Set P} {V : Set Q}

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_eq_refined
statement:
theorem transportPhase_eq_refined (g : Geometry) (χ : Plane → ℝ) (A B : P → ℝ)
    (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ) (K Kr : ℝ) :
    transportPhase (phase g χ A B) φ gap K Kr =
      phase (CopySolveCompatibility.refineGeometry g gap) χ
        (fun p => (Kr / K) * A (φ p)) (fun p => (Kr / K) * B (φ p))

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_eq_scaled_clock
statement:
theorem transportPhase_eq_scaled_clock (g : Geometry) (χ : Plane → ℝ) (A B : P → ℝ)
    (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ) (K Kr rate : ℝ) (hrate : rate ≠ 0) :
    transportPhase (phase g χ A B) φ gap K Kr =
      phase (CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap 0 rate hrate)
        (χ ∘ CopySolveCompatibility.nativeTimeMap 0 rate)
        (fun p => (Kr / K) * A (φ p)) (fun p => (Kr / K) * rate * B (φ p))

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_native_germ
statement:
theorem transportPhase_native_germ (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow)
    (hinj : InjOn quotientPoint ((fun z => g.center + g.basis z) '' w.outer))
    (A B : P → ℝ) (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ) (K Kr shift rate : ℝ) (hrate : rate ≠ 0)
    (copy : Frequency) {z : Q × Plane} (hφ : ContinuousAt φ z.1)
    (hz : CopySolveCompatibility.nativeTimeMap shift rate
      ((CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap shift rate hrate).coordinates copy z.2) ∈ w.core) :
    transportPhase (phase g w.cutoff A B) φ gap K Kr =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      nativePhase (CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap shift rate hrate)
        (fun p => (Kr / K) * (A (φ p) - shift * B (φ p)))
        (fun p => (Kr / K) * rate * B (φ p)) copy

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_native_jets
statement:
theorem transportPhase_native_jets (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow)
    (hinj : InjOn quotientPoint ((fun z => g.center + g.basis z) '' w.outer))
    (A B : P → ℝ) (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ) (K Kr shift rate : ℝ) (hrate : rate ≠ 0)
    (copy : Frequency) {z : Q × Plane} (hφ : ContinuousAt φ z.1)
    (hz : CopySolveCompatibility.nativeTimeMap shift rate
      ((CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap shift rate hrate).coordinates copy z.2) ∈ w.core)
    (m : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (transportPhase (phase g w.cutoff A B) φ gap K Kr) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (nativePhase (CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap shift rate hrate)
          (fun p => (Kr / K) * (A (φ p) - shift * B (φ p)))
          (fun p => (Kr / K) * rate * B (φ p)) copy) z

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_path
statement:
theorem transportPhase_path (g : Geometry) (w : ClockWindow)
    (hinj : InjOn quotientPoint ((fun z => g.center + g.basis z) '' w.outer))
    (A B : P → ℝ) (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ) (K Kr shift rate : ℝ) (hrate : rate ≠ 0)
    (copy : Frequency) (p : Q) (hφ : ContinuousAt φ p) (Y : Plane) (t : ℝ)
    (htransverse :
      ((CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap shift rate hrate).coordinates copy Y).1 ∈
        Icc w.lower.1 w.upper.1)
    (ht : shift + rate * t ∈ Icc w.lower.2 w.upper.2) :
    transportPhase (phase g w.cutoff A B) φ gap K Kr
        (p, (CopySolveCompatibility.transportGeometry g gap shift rate hrate).path copy Y t) =
      (Kr / K) * (A (φ p) - (shift + rate * t) * B (φ p))

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_periodic
statement:
theorem transportPhase_periodic {Φ : P × Plane → ℝ}
    (hΦ : ∀ p Y k, Φ (p, Y + latticePoint k) = Φ (p, Y))
    (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ) (K Kr : ℝ) (p : Q) (Y : Plane) (k : Frequency) :
    transportPhase Φ φ gap K Kr (p, Y + latticePoint k) =
      transportPhase Φ φ gap K Kr (p, Y)

name: NavierStokes.PeriodicPhaseAssembly.transportPhase_weighted
statement:
theorem transportPhase_weighted (Φ : P × Plane → ℝ) (φ : Q → P) (gap : ℕ)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (Kr : ℝ) (z : Q × Plane) :
    K * transportPhase Φ φ gap K Kr z = Kr * Φ (φ z.1, coverPower gap z.2)

statement:
theorem supported_nonlinearResidual_sum (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hs : SupportedOscillations sys label χ Y U u) (labels : Finset ι) (n : ℕ)
    (hlevel : ∀ l ∈ labels, 1 ≤ (label n l).1)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (label n) (↑labels : Set ι))
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D × ℝ → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D × ℝ → D × ℝ}
    (Vt : D × ℝ → D × ℝ)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr (liftDomain U))
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ (liftDomain U))
    (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz (liftDomain U))
    (B : D × ℝ → ComplexVector) (p : ι → D × ℝ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u l n y i) (liftDomain U))
    (hp : ∀ l ∈ labels, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p l) (liftDomain U))
    {x : D × ℝ} (hx : x.1 ∈ U) :
    Actual.nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B
      (∑ l ∈ labels, LinearWaveResidual.realLift (u l n)) (∑ l ∈ labels, p l) x =
        ∑ l ∈ labels, Actual.nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B
          (LinearWaveResidual.realLift (u l n)) (p l) x

statement:
theorem zero_wave_unlocalized_error
    (c : CorrectionState.Context D) (u : CorrectionState.State D)
    (b : CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock D) (n : ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ i, b.velocity n i = 0) (hp : b.pressure n = 0) (x : D) :
    ParticularWaveAssembly.residualSource c u b

theorem SourcePair.actualVelocity_outer_scale {Q : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Q]

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.actual_phase_identification
statement:
theorem actual_phase_identification (k ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : PhaseCalculus.Slow → ℝ) (s : PhaseCalculus.Slow)
    (v : Plane → ℝ) (m : ℤ) (hm : k * p = (m : ℝ)) (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) :
    k * PhaseCalculus.phase ε p pz x0 F G (s, θ, v Y) =
      (m : ℝ) * θ + k * ((pz / ε) * s.2.1 + x0 * s.1 -
        v Y * (p * F s + pz * G s))

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.angular_principal_finite
statement:
theorem angular_principal_finite {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (i : Fin 2) :
    ∃ F : Finset SignedIndex, ∀ Y,
      SmoothLoop.angularMean (fun θ => principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ 0 *
        principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ i.succ) =
      ∑ a ∈ F, diagonalCovariance P hdet outer ε T q x a i Y

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.angular_principal_regular
statement:
theorem angular_principal_regular {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (i : Fin 2) :
    let f := fun Y => SmoothLoop.angularMean (fun θ =>
      principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ 0 * principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ i.succ)
    Continuous f ∧ ∀ Y k, f (Y + TorusAverages.latticePoint k) = f Y

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.averaged_covariance_expansion
statement:
theorem averaged_covariance_expansion (V R : Plane → ℝ → Vector)
    (hV : Continuous V.uncurry) (hR : Continuous R.uncurry) (i : Fin 2) :
    doubleAverage (fun Y θ => (V Y θ + R Y θ) 0 * (V Y θ + R Y θ) i.succ) =
      doubleAverage (fun Y θ => V Y θ 0 * V Y θ i.succ) +
        doubleAverage (covarianceError V R i)

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.correctedVelocity_split
statement:
theorem correctedVelocity_split (a : WaveCoefficients X) (s : StripData X)
    (d : GraphDirections X) (ψ : ℕ → X → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    correctedVelocity a s d ψ n x = cutoffVelocity a ψ n x + curlVelocity a s d ψ n x

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.covariance_expansion
statement:
theorem covariance_expansion (V R : Plane → ℝ → Vector) (i : Fin 2) (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) :
    (V Y θ + R Y θ) 0 * (V Y θ + R Y θ) i.succ =
      V Y θ 0 * V Y θ i.succ + covarianceError V R i Y θ

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.coveredVector_succ

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.cutoffModeField_eq_source
statement:
theorem cutoffModeField_eq_source {N : ℕ}
    (A : (U : UnsignedLabel) → SourcePair Q sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) (q : ℝ) (x : SlotColoring.Position)
    (a : SignedIndex → WaveCoefficients X) (ψ : SignedIndex → ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (band : SignedIndex → ℕ) (point : SignedIndex → Plane → ℝ → X)
    (hcoeff : ∀ b Y θ, ((a b).withCutoff (ψ b)).amplitude (band b) (point b Y θ) =
      (A b.1).actualAmplitude hdet (outer b.1) (ε b.1) (T b.1) q x b.2 Y)
    (hphase : ∀ b Y θ, (a b).frequency (band b) * (a b).phase (band b) (point b Y θ) =
      slotPhase (A b.1).pairData b.2 (Y, θ)) (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) :
    cutoffModeField a ψ band point Y θ = sourceField A hdet outer ε T q x Y θ

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.cutoffModeField_physical_covariance
statement:
theorem cutoffModeField_physical_covariance (sys : SlotSystem D h vr vt)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (A : (U : UnsignedLabel) → SourcePair Q sys (tailLabel N U))
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqN : q ≤ ChartScales.Q N) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (T0 : Vec2)
    (hcone : ∀ U, mask D (tailLabel N U) q x ≠ 0 →
      SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (A U).sourceMatrix (chartTarget h q N T0 U))
    (a : SignedIndex → WaveCoefficients X) (ψ : SignedIndex → ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (band : SignedIndex → ℕ) (point : SignedIndex → Plane → ℝ → X)
    (hcoeff : ∀ b Y θ, ((a b).withCutoff (ψ b)).amplitude (band b) (point b Y θ) =
      (A b.1).actualAmplitude hdet (physicalOuter h N b.1) (physicalViscosity h N b.1)
        (chartTarget h q N T0 b.1) q x b.2 Y)
    (hphase : ∀ b Y θ, (a b).frequency (band b) * (a b).phase (band b) (point b Y θ) =
      slotPhase (A b.1).pairData b.2 (Y, θ)) (i : Fin 2) :
    doubleAverage (fun Y θ => cutoffModeField a ψ band point Y θ 0 *
      cutoffModeField a ψ band point Y θ i.succ) =
      q ^ (-velocityExponent h - 1 / 2) * T0 i

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.cutoffVelocity_identification
statement:
theorem cutoffVelocity_identification (a : WaveCoefficients X) (ψ : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (z : X) {U : UnsignedLabel} (P : PairData sys U)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : ℝ) (T : Vec2)
    (q : ℝ) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (j : Fin 2) (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ)
    (ha : (a.withCutoff ψ).amplitude n z = slotAmplitude P hdet outer ε T q x j Y)
    (hphase : a.frequency n * a.phase n z = slotPhase P j (Y, θ)) :
    cutoffVelocity a ψ n z = slotVelocity P hdet outer ε T q x j Y θ

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.cutoff_periodized_coefficient
statement:
theorem cutoff_periodized_coefficient {U : UnsignedLabel} (P : PairData sys U)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (j : Fin 2)
    (ψ : Plane → ℝ) (a : Plane → Vector)
    (hψ : support ψ ⊆ slotSet h sys.radius vr vt (signedLabel U j))
    (ha : support a ⊆ slotSet h sys.radius vr vt (signedLabel U j))
    (hlocal : ∀ z, ψ z • a z = nativeVector P hdet j z)
    (outer ε : ℝ) (T : Vec2) (q : ℝ) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (Y : Plane) :
    TorusAverages.periodize ψ ((SlotGeometry.cover ^ SlotColoring.nativeIndex h U.1) Y) •
      (fun i => ((outer * amplitude ε (mask D U q x) P.matrix T j *
        TorusAverages.periodize a
          ((SlotGeometry.cover ^ SlotColoring.nativeIndex h U.1) Y) i : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      slotAmplitude P hdet outer ε T q x j Y

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.finite_corrected_field_split
statement:
theorem finite_corrected_field_split {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι)
    (a : ι → WaveCoefficients X) (s : ι → WeightedClasses.StripData X)
    (d : ι → GraphDirections X) (ψ : ι → ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (band : ι → ℕ) (point : ι → X) :
    (∑ b ∈ F, correctedVelocity (a b) (s b) (d b) (ψ b) (band b) (point b)) =
      (∑ b ∈ F, cutoffVelocity (a b) (ψ b) (band b) (point b)) +
        ∑ b ∈ F, curlVelocity (a b) (s b) (d b) (ψ b) (band b) (point b)

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.finite_scaled_corrected_field_split
statement:
theorem finite_scaled_corrected_field_split {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (outer : ι → ℝ)
    (a : ι → WaveCoefficients X) (s : ι → WeightedClasses.StripData X)
    (d : ι → GraphDirections X) (ψ : ι → ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (band : ι → ℕ) (point : ι → X) :
    (∑ b ∈ F, outer b • correctedVelocity (a b) (s b) (d b) (ψ b) (band b) (point b)) =
      (∑ b ∈ F, outer b • cutoffVelocity (a b) (ψ b) (band b) (point b)) +
        ∑ b ∈ F, outer b • curlVelocity (a b) (s b) (d b) (ψ b) (band b) (point b)

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.mode_identification
statement:
theorem mode_identification {X : Type*} (κ : ℝ) (Φ : X → ℝ)
    (a : X → ComplexVector) (z : X) {U : UnsignedLabel} (P : PairData sys U)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : ℝ) (T : Vec2)
    (q : ℝ) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (j : Fin 2) (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ)
    (ha : a z = slotAmplitude P hdet outer ε T q x j Y)
    (hphase : κ * Φ z = slotPhase P j (Y, θ)) :
    (fun i => (vectorMode κ Φ a z i).re) =
      slotVelocity P hdet outer ε T q x j Y θ

NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.physical_principal_covariance
statement:
theorem physical_principal_covariance (sys : SlotSystem D h vr vt)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqN : q ≤ ChartScales.Q N) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (T0 : Vec2)
    (hcone : ∀ U, mask D (tailLabel N U) q x ≠ 0 →
      SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (P U).matrix (chartTarget h q N T0 U)) (i : Fin 2) :
    doubleAverage (fun Y θ =>
      principalField P hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N)
        (chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ 0 *
      principalField P hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N)
        (chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ i.succ) =
      q ^ (-velocityExponent h - 1 / 2) * T0 i

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.physical_source_covariance
statement:
theorem physical_source_covariance (sys : SlotSystem D h vr vt)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (A : (U : UnsignedLabel) → SourcePair Q sys (tailLabel N U))
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqN : q ≤ ChartScales.Q N) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (T0 : Vec2)
    (hcone : ∀ U, mask D (tailLabel N U) q x ≠ 0 →
      SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (A U).sourceMatrix (chartTarget h q N T0 U)) (i : Fin 2) :
    doubleAverage (fun Y θ =>
      sourceField A hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N)
        (chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ 0 *
      sourceField A hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N)
        (chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ i.succ) =
      q ^ (-velocityExponent h - 1 / 2) * T0 i

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.physical_source_plus_remainder
statement:
theorem physical_source_plus_remainder {Q : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Q]
    (sys : SlotSystem D h vr vt) (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (A : (U : UnsignedLabel) → SourcePair Q sys (tailLabel N U))
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqN : q ≤ ChartScales.Q N) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (T0 : Vec2)
    (hcone : ∀ U, mask D (tailLabel N U) q x ≠ 0 →
      SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (A U).sourceMatrix (chartTarget h q N T0 U))
    (hphase : ∀ U j, Continuous ((A U).phase j))
    (R : Plane → ℝ → Vector) (hR : Continuous R.uncurry) (i : Fin 2) :
    let V := sourceField A hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N) (chartTarget h q N T0) q x
    doubleAverage (fun Y θ => (V Y θ + R Y θ) 0 * (V Y θ + R Y θ) i.succ) =
      q ^ (-velocityExponent h - 1 / 2) * T0 i + doubleAverage (covarianceError V R i)

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.physical_source_torus_covariance
statement:
theorem physical_source_torus_covariance {Q : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Q]
    (sys : SlotSystem D h vr vt) (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (A : (U : UnsignedLabel) → SourcePair Q sys (tailLabel N U))
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqN : q ≤ ChartScales.Q N) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (T0 : Vec2)
    (hcone : ∀ U, mask D (tailLabel N U) q x ≠ 0 →
      SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (A U).sourceMatrix (chartTarget h q N T0 U)) (i : Fin 2) :
    ∃ g : C(TorusInverse.Torus, ℂ),
      (∀ Y, g (TorusAverages.quotientPoint Y) =
        ((SmoothLoop.angularMean (fun θ =>
          sourceField A hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N)
            (chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ 0 *
          sourceField A hdet (physicalOuter h N) (physicalViscosity h N)
            (chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ i.succ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∫ z, g z ∂TorusInverse.torusMeasure) =
        ((q ^ (-velocityExponent h - 1 / 2) * T0 i : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principalField_angular_periodic
statement:
theorem principalField_angular_periodic {N : ℕ}
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) (q : ℝ) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) :
    principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y (θ + 2 * Real.pi) =

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principalField_apply
statement:
theorem principalField_apply {N : ℕ}
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position)
    (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ i =
      ∑ᶠ a : SignedIndex,
        slotVelocity (P a.1) hdet (outer a.1) (ε a.1) (T a.1) q x a.2 Y θ i

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principalField_auxiliary_periodic
statement:
theorem principalField_auxiliary_periodic {N : ℕ}
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) (q : ℝ) (x : SlotColoring.Position)
    (hphase : ∀ U j Y k, (P U).phases j (Y + TorusAverages.latticePoint k) = (P U).phases j Y)
    (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) (k : TorusInverse.Frequency) :
    principalField P hdet outer ε T q x (Y + TorusAverages.latticePoint k) θ =
      principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principalField_components
statement:
theorem principalField_components {N : ℕ}
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position)
    (Y : Plane) (θ : ℝ) :
    principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ 0 =
      assembledRadial P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ ∧

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principalField_continuous
statement:
theorem principalField_continuous {N : ℕ}
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position)

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principalField_finite
statement:
theorem principalField_finite {N : ℕ}
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)

    ∃ F : Finset SignedIndex, ∀ Y θ,
      principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ =
        ∑ a ∈ F, slotVelocity (P a.1) hdet (outer a.1) (ε a.1) (T a.1) q x a.2 Y θ

name: NavierStokes.PrimaryFieldAssembly.principal_torus_average
statement:
theorem principal_torus_average {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (P : (U : UnsignedLabel) → PairData sys (tailLabel N U))
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (outer ε : UnsignedLabel → ℝ)
    (T : UnsignedLabel → Vec2) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (i : Fin 2) :
    ∃ g : C(TorusInverse.Torus, ℂ),
      (∀ Y, g (TorusAverages.quotientPoint Y) =
        ((SmoothLoop.angularMean (fun θ => principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ 0 *
          principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ i.succ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∫ z, g z ∂TorusInverse.torusMeasure) =
        ((doubleAverage (fun Y θ => principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ 0 *
          principalField P hdet outer ε T q x Y θ i.succ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
